items.english_text: A true proverb it is, most illustrious and gracious Lord, our Father and Pastor, that beneficence is a golden chain and fetter whereby the human soul is secretly bound and drawn: this we ourselves have manifestly experienced. For it is evident unto the whole world what generous and illustrious benefits our Lviv Brotherhood Church hath received from Their Mercies, the illustrious rulers of Moldo-Wallachia, the renowned Mohylas, ancestors of Your Mercy—in particular, of pious memory, His Mercy Symeon, your father, and His Mercy Jeremiah, uncle of Your Illustriousness. For by their renowned and lavish expenditure our church was exalted on high, remaining unto their eternal glory.

items.english_text: Likewise thee also, O renowned Mohyla, our Father and Pastor, by thine outstanding noble virtues, our Brotherhood hath ever possessed as a particular benefactor, experiencing special proofs of confirmed benevolence: which have so bound, strengthened, and drawn us unto thee, that in renewing the memory of those of holy remembrance, we strive that we, well-wishers in God, might in some small part repay Their Mercies, the ancestors of Your Grace, and you their renowned descendants. Especially since virtue itself and gratitude, ready to spring forth from our hearts into open sight, demand this of us. With the memory therefore of light and grateful confession of the ancestors of Your Illustriousness, while offering yearly prayer for their souls and for the long-lasting life and health of Your Grace in this world, with fitting declarations:

items.english_text: our desire is ardently to honor and exalt the renowned family of Your Illustriousness with immortal renown. Striving therefore with all our strength, behold, following the renewal of our Brotherhood Printing-House, we issue under the illustrious name of Your Grace this very first book, filled with God-inspired consolations, and offer it unto thee, as a pious man unto a pious patron. For who is such a witness thereof, as that thou, being born of a most renowned family, having deservedly gained the royal favor of the Crown of Poland and the goodwill of His Royal Majesty our gracious King, and of the whole Commonwealth, and having formed bonds of friendship with the noble assembly of Senators of the Crown of Poland, didst renounce all these things out of piety, making an offering unto God the Creator, voluntarily embracing poverty and virginal chastity, lovingly receiving the angelic monastic habit? And immediately, by the providence of God and the favor of His Royal Majesty, by the common consent of both spiritual and lay fathers, thou wast crowned with high ecclesiastical dignity. [^14]

items.english_text: Witness thereto is thy fervent prayer unto God the Creator, unto His most pure and most blessed Mother, and unto the beloved Eastern Church. Witness also is thy zealous and pious care for the multiplication of the praise of God, for the elevation of schools, for good order in the Monastery, and for the internal and external adornment of churches. By the rule of thy piety, not only Kyiv, but the whole Rus’ land rejoices and gives thanks unto God, that unto that holy place, for the profit and consolation of all Christendom, after holy and pious men, He hath granted so holy, pious, and watchful a Pastor.

items.english_text: Unto thee therefore, a pious father, we offer, present, and dedicate this pious Book, and place it beneath the broad wings of our Father and Pastor. Let it fly forth under thy patronage; let it pay thee this tribute; under thy name let it go forth securely into the world. Receive therefore, most illustrious, most venerable, and gracious Father and our Pastor, this work kindly, graciously, and favorably; and deign ever to keep us, thy servants and perpetual petitioners, grateful well-wishers of Your Illustriousness, in thy gracious, fatherly love and holy prayers.

items.english_text: Let us sing of Mary the Virgin, the glory of the whole world, who blossomed forth from mankind and gave birth unto the Master, the heavenly gate, the hymn of the bodiless hosts and the adornment of the faithful. For she was revealed as heaven and the temple of the Godhead. She, having broken down the middle wall of enmity, brought in peace and opened the kingdom. Having her, therefore, as the anchor of faith, we have as our Defender the Lord Who was born of her. Be of good courage therefore, be of good courage, O people of God; for He shall conquer the enemies, for He is almighty.

items.slavonic_text: Страданіа похвалою, и вѣнцевъ почтеніи, славніи страстотерпци ѡдѣяшася тобою Гди, терпѣніемъ бо ранъ, беззаконныхъ побѣдиша: и силою Божественною, съ нб̃съ побѣду прїяша, тѣхъ молебми, и насъ свободи ѿ невидимаго врага Сп̃се, и спаси насъ.
items.english_text: With the praise of suffering and the honor of crowns were the glorious passion-bearers clothed by Thee, O Lord; for by the endurance of wounds they conquered the lawless, and by divine power they received victory from heaven. By their supplications, deliver us also from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save us!

items.slavonic_text: Защитнаа предстателнице, и помощнице всѣмъ: оупованіе непоколебимое, и заступнице миру: помяни на якѡ бл̃гаа, и даруй согрѣшеніем ѡпущеніе, и дшам спасеніе, и на покааніа стези настави: к тебе бо прибѣгаемъ вѣрою, и тебе молимъ теплѣ, и просим любезно: не ѡстави ѡ насъ милости твоея.
items.english_text: Protecting advocate and helper of all, unshakable hope and mediatress for the world: remember us, as thou art good, and grant remission of transgressions and salvation unto our souls, and guide us onto the paths of repentance. For unto thee do we flee in faith, and thee do we fervently entreat and lovingly implore: withhold not thy mercy from us![^24]

items.slavonic_text: Ины Сѣдална, егда стихословитсѧ Г. Ка: Гласъ, а̃.

items.slavonic_text: Судище твое страшное, и судъ праведе: дѣлаже моя лютая: но ты самъ милостиве, предвари мя Спаси, и муки свободи, избави Вл̃ко шнухъ части, и сподоби ѡдесную тебе стати ми, Судіе праведный.
items.english_text: Thy judgment-seat is dreadful, and Thy judgment is righteous, but my deeds are vile; yet do Thou Thyself anticipate me, O merciful Savior, and deliver me from torment; rescue me, O Master, from the lot of the goats, and vouchsafe that I may stand at Thy right hand, O righteous Judge!

items.slavonic_text: Безневѣстная ч̃тая Бце Дво, едина вѣрным предстателнице и покрове: ѿ бѣдъ и скорбей, и лютыхъ обстояніи всѣхъ избави: иже на тя надежду Отроковице имѣщих, и дша наша спаси, Бж҃ственными молитвами своими.
items.english_text: Unwedded and pure Virgin Mother of God, sole protectress and shelter of the faithful: deliver from perils and tribulations and all grievous distresses those who place their hope in thee, O Maiden, and save our souls by thy divine prayers!

items.slavonic_text: В Понелокъ Канонъ Покаяненъ. Емуже Краегранесіе сицево: Согрѣшеніи мои скверну ѡмыи Слове. Твореніе Іѡсифово.
items.english_text: *Thy victorious right hand hath been glorified in strength in a manner befitting God; for, O Immortal One, as almighty it shattered the adversaries, forging a new path for Israel through the deep.*

items.slavonic_text: Твоя побѣдителнаа десница, бголепно въ крѣпости прославися, тако Безсмертне, якѡ всемогущаа, противныя сотре, Іизраилѧ, путь въ глубинѣ новогодѣлавшая.
items.english_text: Blot out the multitude of my sins according to the multitude of Thy mercies, I beseech Thee, O Christ, and grant me thoughts of repentance, that I may glorify the Mother of God, full of divine grace, who is beyond understanding.

items.slavonic_text: Грѣховъ моихъ оумноженіе потрѣби, помножеству Хе милостіи твоихъ молютися, и мысль обращенїа ми даруй: да прославляю иже паче оума Богоблагодатную.
items.english_text: Because of the tender mercy of Thy compassions, Thou didst appear on earth incarnate as man; therefore, O Word of God, receive me now who have sinned more than any man, as in repentance I fall down before Thy compassions.

items.slavonic_text: Явился еси, за милосердїе щедротъ, на земли воплощаемь чл̃къ: тѣмже паче чл̃ка слове Бжїй, согрѣшивша прїими мя ннѣ, покаяніе щедротами твои припадающаго.
items.english_text: Imitating the death of Christ Who suffered willingly, O all-lauded and ever-memorable martyrs, ye endured manifold sufferings and death.

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Мертвости подобящеся, Ха волею пострадавшаго, всехвальніи страсти претерпѣсте многовидныа и смерть, присноглавучните мунцн.
items.english_text: Bearing within you the fire of divine love, O sufferers, ye quenched it not; but ye burned up the fire of the flame of deception and extinguished all the fire of Gehenna.

items.slavonic_text: Огнь любве Бж̃твеніи внутрь носяще страдалцы, не оугосисте: но огнь прелести пламени попалисте, и геенны всяку поплалите.
items.english_text: The ranks of the Bodiless Powers sing praise unto thee with us, O all-immaculate Virgin; for in awe thou didst give birth unto Him Who was truly incarnate without fiction, remaining a Virgin even as before childbirth, O Bride of God!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канонъ Безплотнымъ. Твореніе Ѳеофаново.
items.english_text: Standing brightly before the throne of the Master, O all-pure Angels: pray ye unto the Word Who is co-unoriginate with the Father, the Angel of Great Counsel, that He may breathe into me a word of assistance.

items.slavonic_text: Пр̃толꙋ престояще свѣтло Владычнемꙋ, пр̃чтіи Аггли: Ѡц҃у собезначална, и того великаго совѣта Аггла, слово мнѣ вдохнꙋти въ помощь молитеся.
items.english_text: Ye mirrors of the God-originating light and radiance of the thrice-radiant dawn, singing in all-bright glory: pray ye for aid unto Him Who first conceived the angelic ranks and established the divine intelligible world.

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Зерцала свѣта Бг҃оначалнаго, и трисолнечныа заря сїаніе, всесвѣтне поюще, поспѣшествовати молитеся: Аггльскїи чины первѣе оумысливъ, оума Бж҃ственный составивъ.
items.english_text: Having adorned the orders of the supreme Powers as God, He Who is higher than the Cherubim dwelt in thy virginal womb, O Mother of God, and unchangeably became flesh.

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Украсивъ яко Бгъ чиноначалїа, вышнимъ Силамъ: въ чрево твое Бц̃е неискусобрачное вселися, Херувімъ вышше: и плоть непремѣнна бысть.
items.english_text: *Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human nature, and didst compassionately take form therein: gird me with power from on high, that I may cry unto Thee: Holy is the living temple of Thine ineffable glory, O Lover of mankind!*

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Единъ свѣдыи чл҃ческаго существа неможеніе, и милостивнѣ въне ѡбразився: препояши мя свыше силою, еже вопити тебѣ: Ст̃ый, хра[мъ] ѡдушевленны, неизреченныа ти славы, чл̃колюбче.
items.english_text: Bow down, lament, O my soul, and cry aloud: I have sinned against the only One Who knows thy hidden secrets! And bring forth fruits of repentance, that the compassionate Lord may cleanse thee, His servant, and deliver thee from eternal [torment].

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Поникни, гради, ѡ дше, и возопій: согрѣшихъ единому свѣдущему тайнаа твоя: и покажи плоды покажн: яко очиститъ тя щедрыи Гдь, вѣчнаго избавитъ.
items.english_text: O good and compassionate Lord, save me: like the Publican I cry unto Thee with fear, dragged down deep by a multitude of sins, burdened with the weight of transgressions, and filled with boundless shame.

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Днне бл̃аже, оучести паси мя: якѡ мытарѧ съ страхомъ зопію ти, множество грѣховъ влеки глубоко, и преславлен есмъ тяготою прегрѣшеніи, и студа безмѣрнаго исполняемъ.
items.english_text: Enlightened with the wisdom and understanding of the truth, the martyrs turned Hellenic wisdom into foolishness, manfully destroyed wickedness, and having suffered valiantly, worthily received the crowns of victory, rejoicing.

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋдростію и разꙋмо истинны, Мꙋнцы просвѣщаеми: Еллинскую мудрость ѡбуиша, му[жески]
items.english_text: Confessing the Trinity as a Monad in essence and three in Persons, O sufferers, ye destroyed the delusion of polytheism through divine faith; and ye were revealed as beacons, illuminating the hearts of all with the rays of grace.

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. items.slavonic_text: же злобу разрушиша: и крѣпко пострадавше, достойне воспріяша побѣды вѣнца, радующеся.
items.english_text: O pure Bride of God: thou didst give birth unto the Savior Who rests among the saints, the Son and Word co-unoriginate with the Father, Who through the Holy Spirit cleanses those who piously honor Him.

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Единицу естествомъ Трцу же лицы, страдлци исповѣдающе, прелести многобожїа, Бж̃твеною вѣрою потре́бисте: и свѣтилници явишася, всѣхъ ѡзаряюще срца, зарями благодатными.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers]. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: Спала Бгоневѣсто ч̃таа: сг̃го породила еси, въ ст̃ыхъ почивающаго, Сн̃а и слова Ѡц҃у собезначалнаго: ѡчищающаго стымъ Дх҃омъ, иже того бл̃гочестно ѡчищающихъ.
items.english_text: The Seraphim, drawing closely nigh unto the divine and deifying Light and abundantly filled with His primary outpourings, are illuminated in a primal manner; and they become secondary lights, being deified by grace.

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣту Бг҃одѣтелному, Серафіми искрено приближающеся, и множицею того насыщаеми перводатными сїяньми, перводѣтелнѣ свѣтятся: и якѡ свѣти вторіи бываютъ, положеніемъ ѡбожаеми.
items.english_text: Zealously desiring to praise the brightness of the Angels, let us fittingly entreat with purity of mind and pure lips the aid granted by God through them, that we may be renewed by their radiance.

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Аггльскꙋю свѣтлость, пѣти оусердно желающе: иже тѣхъ ради ѿ Бг҃а помощь подаемꙋю, бг̃олепнѣ просимъ, оума чистотою, и пр̃чтыми оусты: и ѡбновимся сихъ сїяніем.
items.english_text: Vouchsafed to behold the supersubstantial light as far as is possible, Gabriel brought the joyous greeting unto thee, O all-praised Maiden, proclaiming thereby the conception of the Word and foretelling His ineffable birth.

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Тьма пресущественнаго, видѣти сподобляемъ, якоже мо́щно Гавріилъ, радованенъ гласъ принесе тебѣ, Дв̃нце всепѣтая: Слова зачатїе имъ возвѣщающъ, и неизреченное ржтвѡ проповѣдающъ.
items.english_text: *Habakkuk, having perceived with prophetic eyes thee as the mountain overshadowed by divine grace, foreproclaimed that the Holy One of Israel would come forth from thee...*

items.slavonic_text: Гору тя благодатію Бж̃твенною присѣнную, прозорливыма Аввакумъ оусмотривъ ѡчима: ис тебе изыити
items.english_text: Unto whom shall I liken thee, O my wretched soul, that committest evil and fearest not the Good One? Turn back, cry aloud unto Him Who willingly became poor for thy sake: O Knower of hearts, have compassion and save me!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: изыити Інлева, провозглашаше Ст̃агѡ: на спасеніе наше, и ѡбновленіе.
items.english_text: Thou didst ordain repentance, O Christ, for those who turn unto Thee; grant it unto me, O Jesus, before the end of my life, giving me compunction and sighing, that like the harlot of old I may kiss Thy feet, O Master!

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Кому тя дше моѧ ѡкааннаа оуподоблю, дѣлающи лютаа, и не боязливыи бл̃гнꙋ, обратися, возопій, къ иже тебе ради ѡбнищавшему волею: срце вѣдче, оущедривъ спаси мя.
items.english_text: Filled with spiritual waters, O martyrs, by divine nod ye were revealed as rivers of living water; and ye dried up the turbid streams of delusion, O glorious ones, and watered the hearts of the faithful.

items.slavonic_text: Нарече покаяніе Хе̃ ѡбращающїимся: еже ми подажъ Ісе, прежде житія конца: дая ми оумиленіе и воздыханіе, якѡ блудници первѣе, лобызающе нозѣ твои Вл̃ко.
items.english_text: Having valiantly contended, O divine martyrs, ye endured fire and sword and great and grievous torment; by their supplications, O Word of God, deliver from great torments those who praise them with all their soul.

items.english_text: The Son Who was begotten of the Father before time, accepted birth in time, becoming incarnate of thee, O incorrupt Virgin; for the compassionate One, Who is above all days and years, desired to take away the ancient warfare of earthly men.

items.slavonic_text: Вельми подвигшеся Бж̃твенніи Мунци, огня и меча, и лютое велко претерпѣсте томленіе, тѣхъ моленіем Слове Бж҃ій, великихъ избави мукъ, иже вседушно тѣхъ блажащи.

items.slavonic_text: Иже древле из Ѡц҃а нерожденна, Сн̃ъ рожденся, ржтво прїят лѣтное, нетлѣе Дв̃о воплощаемя: многолѣтнюю брань земныхъ ѡити хотя бл̃гоутробныи, иже дней и лѣтъ превыше сыи.
items.english_text: The Angels, Cherubim, and Seraphim, filled with primary beauty, shine brightly with divine rays, receiving the deifying hierarchy, and they sing: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Анголи первѣю исполняюще красотꙋ, и Херувіми, и Серафіми: Бж҃твенными зарями искрно свѣтятса, Бг҃одѣлнаго священноначаліа приемлюще: иже пою, слава силѣ твоей Гди.
items.english_text: With ceaseless voices the sacred Seraphim sing of the thrice-radiant Unity of the Godhead, revealing the mystery of theology before the throne and teaching the Orthodox faith.

items.english_text: Receiving unerringly the outpouring of wisdom and multitude of knowledge from the single and simple Supreme Wisdom, the Cherubim impart it godlike unto the other ranks, sending down enlightenment unto them.

items.slavonic_text: юще Серафіми, пр̃стол Бгословіа таинство, и православнѣи вѣрѣ научающе.
items.english_text: He Who is understood to be above every nature, beyond comprehension in His divine creative power, accomplished a mystery on earth: illuminated with virginal splendors, He dwelt in thy womb, O all-pure one!

items.slavonic_text: Премудрости изліяніе, и множество разума, Единственныа и простыя самопремудрости, непрелестнѣ Херувіми приемлюще: прочимъ Бгоподражателнѣ подаютъ, ниспосылающе ѡнѣмъ просвѣщеніе.
items.english_text: *O Thou Who didst enlighten the ends of the world with the radiance of Thy coming, O Christ, and didst make them bright by Thy Cross: enlighten with the light of Thy divine knowledge the hearts of those who praise Thee in Orthodox faith.*

items.slavonic_text: Иже всякаго ест̃тва превышше разумѣваемъ, паче оума Бг҃оначалны зданїемъ: на земли совершила таинство, Дѣтвенными ѡзаренно свѣтлостми, въ твое чрево вселся Пр̃чтая.
items.english_text: I have fallen into corrupt passions, and I fear the end of Thy righteous judgment-seat, O righteous Lord; therefore I pray Thee: have compassion on me, that I may perform good works that justify me.

items.slavonic_text: Просвѣтивый сїяніемъ пришествїа твоего Хе, и ѡуяснивыи Кр̃томъ си, міру конца: срца просвѣти, свѣтомъ твоего Бгоразумїа, православно поющи тя.
items.english_text: The hidden and secret things of my heart Thou knowest, O my God, Creator, and Lord; condemn me not on that Day of Judgment when Thou shalt judge all things.

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Впадохъ въ страсти тлѣніа, и конца твоего праведнаго судища, праведный Гди, тѣмже молютися, оущедри мя творити дѣаніа бл̃гаа, ѡправдающаа мя.
items.english_text: Partaking of burning, the holy ones were refreshed by their divine love, being God-bearers; strengthened amid torments, the martyrs quenched the fire of temptation by endurance and withered the crafty enemy by their sufferings.

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃отѣтвꙋющаа оуста́, нико́лимогꙋтъ ржтвꙋ твоего ѿроковице, неизреченное повѣдати таинство: неискусомѣннаго бо раждаеши, й на рꙋкꙋ своею носиши, иже рꙋкою содержащаго всяческая.
items.english_text: God-inspired mouths can never declare the ineffable mystery of thy childbearing, O Maiden; for thou didst give birth unto Him Who is without change, and on thine arms dost bear Him Who holds all things in His hand.

items.slavonic_text: Любве Бж҃твенныя ѡгнем распалаема, Гд̃ьствїа, й Власти, и Силы, Чинове вторіи: немолчными оусты Бг҃оначално пѣснословя, едино сущеско и сила.

items.slavonic_text: Разумнаа со Архагглстии чины дх҃ом: й Аггльми, и Началы, собезначалными воиньствы, едино триипоста́вное просвѣтителное существо почита́ти.
items.english_text: Kindled with the fire of divine love, the Dominions, Authorities, and Powers, the secondary orders, sing praise with ceaseless mouths unto the God-originating one essence and power.

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Оукрасися паче всякаго Аггльскаго бл̃голѣпїа, Агглѡ творца заченши и Гд̃а, Керувіми пр̃чтая: плоти прїятїе ѡдушевленнаа воплощеннаго, всенепорочная.
items.english_text: The spiritual ranks together with the Archangels, Angels, and Principalities in the spirit, as co-unoriginate hosts, honor the one thrice-hypostatic, illuminating Essence.

items.slavonic_text: Ѡбыиде насъ послѣднаа бездна, нѣсть избавляющаго: взмѣнихомся якѡ ѡвца на заколеніе, люди твоя, Хе наш...
items.english_text: Adorned beyond all angelic beauty, having conceived the Creator of Angels and Lord, O all-pure one higher than the Cherubim: thou becamest the animate receptacle of the incarnate God, O all-immaculate one.

items.slavonic_text: Исцѣли страсти дш̃а моея, Слове Бж҃ій, ѡмыи мя ѿ всѣхъ сквернъ, да пою тя бл̃гоутробне.
items.english_text: *The lowest abyss hath compassed us about, and there is none to deliver; we were accounted as sheep for the slaughter: save Thy people, O our Christ!*

items.slavonic_text: На путехъ погибелныхъ грѣховными сластми заблудихъ, Хе: но ѡбративъ мя, настави на путь спасенїа.
items.english_text: Heal the passions of my soul, O Word of God; wash me from all defilements, that I may sing praise unto Thee, O compassionate One.

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Каменіе воистинну многоцѣнное, каменіемъ посыпаеми: не ѡвергошася камени живаго, инже неѡтѣканому каменію пожроша, славніи вѣнчающемися Гдни мꙋченицы. Мчнко:
items.english_text: Upon paths of ruin have I strayed through sinful pleasures, O Christ; but turn me back and guide me onto the path of salvation.

[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Ожививше дш̃ѣ раломъ вѣры, и классъ мꙋнцы страданіа, Дх҃ом Бж҃твеннымъ, сторичный возростиша: и пищи Бж̃твеннѣй сподобишася. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Truly precious stones, pelted with stones, ye did not deny the living Stone, nor did ye sacrifice unto stones cut by hands, O glorious martyrs of the Lord who are crowned!

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Огненныхъ слугъ огнь родивши, явилася еси всенепорочная, и твари всякои поистиннѣ, пречистая дво преимущи, вже на бл̃гословеннаа Бгорадованаа.
items.english_text: Having quickened your souls with the plow of faith, O martyrs, by the divine Spirit ye brought forth a hundredfold ear of corn through suffering, and were vouchsafed divine delight.

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Чины Безплотных Гди, престолу пристояще славы твоя чл̃колюбче, гласы непрестанными тя почитаютъ: ты бо крѣпость крѣпостѣх еси ле и пѣніе.
items.english_text: Having given birth unto the Fire that created the fiery servants, thou wast revealed, O all-immaculate one, truly surpassing all creation, O all-pure Virgin, blessed and full of divine joy!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: Лица Бжіа зряще Аггли доброты недомыслимыа, прѣж̃твенаго бг҃олепїя, твоими Бж҃твенными зарями просвѣщаютса: ты бо тѣхъ й свѣтъ еси й радованіе. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers]. Heirmos: The same.*

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Воплотися иже прежде сыи, безплѡтное слово йстебѣ преч̃таа, иже везжелная колею творяй: иже безплотныхъ вѡинства приведеи ѡнебытїа, яко всесиле.
items.english_text: The ranks of the Bodiless Powers, O Lord, standing before the throne of Thy glory, O Lover of mankind, honor Thee with unceasing voices; for Thou art their strength and song.

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Тебе мысленную Бце пещь, разумѣемъ вѣрнїи, якоже бо ѡтроки Сп̃се спас три, превозносимый: всего мя чл̃ка, въ чревѣ ти ѡбнови Бг̃ъ: хвалимый Ѡц҃евъ Бгъ, и препрославлен.
items.english_text: Beholding the unfathomable beauty of the divine countenance and supersubstantial divine splendor, the Angels are illuminated by Thy divine rays; for Thou art their light and joy.

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Яко древле Данїила оукроти, преполевая добродѣтелно, томъ поревнуй ѡ дш҃и, и рыкающаго
items.english_text: He Who existed before, the Bodiless Word, became incarnate of thee, O all-pure one, Who by His will creates all things, and Who brought the bodiless hosts out of non-existence, as almighty.

[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

items.slavonic_text: всегда якѡ левъ, и поясти тя хотяща, къ Бг҃у взиранїемъ прино, бездѣлна сотвори.
items.english_text: *Thee, O Mother of God, we faithful perceive as the spiritual furnace: for as the highly exalted One saved the three children, so hath God wholly renewed me, man, in thy womb: the praised and all-glorious God of our fathers.*

items.slavonic_text: Премножествомъ блуда, Гди, дш҃у ѡскверни лютѣ, премногую же Хе имѣи бл̃гостыню, прїими яко блуднаго, й поюща мя оущедри: хвалимый Ѡц҃ем Кг̃ъ и препрославленъ. Мч:
items.english_text: As of old Daniel tamed the lions by excelling in virtue, emulate him, O my soul, and by ever gazing unto God render powerless the one who ever roars like a lion, seeking to devour thee.

items.slavonic_text: Законом Хв̃ымъ крѣпко оукрѣпляеми, беззаконныхъ лукаваа козни низложиша, непобѣднїи мунцы: законно же скончавшеся воспѣваху: хвалимый Ѡц҃е Бгъ, и препрославлен. М.
items.english_text: Through an excess of prodigality, O Lord, I have grievously defiled my soul; but possessing exceeding goodness, O Christ, receive me as the prodigal and have compassion on me as I sing: Blessed and all-glorious is the God of our fathers!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Воззарнїи Гдни мꙋнцы, распаляеми свѣтомъ Троичнымъ явѣ, мученїа тму, и прелести мглу разрѣшиша, поюще: хвалимый Ѡц҃е Бг҃ъ и препро: Бо:
items.english_text: Firmly strengthened by the law of Christ, the invincible martyrs cast down the wily snares of the lawless; and having finished their course lawfully, they sang: Blessed and all-glorious is the God of our fathers!

[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Законы естества ѡтебѣ обновляются: яко законода́вца Хр̃та, кромѣ законъ плотскихъ, родила еси всенепорочнаа, всѣм избавле́ніе законополагающа, поющимъ: хвалимый Ѡц҃емъ Бг҃ъ и препрославленъ.
items.english_text: Radiant martyrs of the Lord, manifestly kindled by the light of the Trinity, ye dispelled the darkness of torture and the gloom of delusion, singing: Blessed and all-glorious is the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: Безначаленъ свѣтъ сыи Вл̃ко, ѡ свѣта восияя Ѡц҃а: Аггльскаа воинства свѣты оустрои еси, зерцала прїемлюща блистаніа незаходимаго: хвалимый Ѡц҃емъ Бже бл̃гословенъ еси.
items.english_text: The laws of nature are renewed in thee: for beyond the laws of the flesh thou didst give birth unto Christ the Lawgiver, O all-immaculate one, Who ordains deliverance for all that sing: Blessed and all-glorious is the God of our fathers![^27]

items.slavonic_text: Родъ чл̃веческъ, яко всѣхъ Гдь, приставленіемъ Аггльски явѣ сп̃саеши, ихъ бо приставникъ еси всѣмъ вѣрующим, и православно поющим тя: хвалимаго Ѡц҃емъ Бга, й препрославлена.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers]. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: Языкъ и оумъ, неможет Вл̃ко твоихъ чудесъ изрещи, й дѣлъ бл̃голѣпїе, ты бо просвѣти́лъ
items.english_text: Being unoriginate Light, O Master, shining forth from the Father Who is Light: Thou didst establish the angelic hosts as lights, mirrors receiving the flash of the unsetting brightness: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: тилъ еси всяко оутва́рь нб̃ныхъ силъ: воспѣтый Ѡц҃емъ Бже бл̃гословенъ еси. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: As Lord of all, Thou manifestly savest the human race through the guardianship of the Angels; for Thou didst appoint them over all who believe and sing praise unto Thee in Orthodox faith: the praised and all-glorious God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: Нетлѣннаа Сн̃а воплотила, иже прежде безлѣтне из Ѡц҃а, и Бг̃а суща понеже насъ ради бывъ, емуже ннѣ служатъ безплотныхъ чинове, якѡ хвалимому Ѡц҃емъ Бг̃у, и препрославленому.
items.english_text: Tongue and mind cannot declare Thy wonders, O Master, and the beauty of Thy works; for Thou didst illuminate every order of the heavenly Powers: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: В пещи дѣти Іилвы, якоже въ горнилѣ, добротою бл̃гочестїа чистѣйше злата блещащеся, глюще: бл̃гвите вся дѣла Гдна Гда, пойте, и превозносите его во вѣки.
items.english_text: O incorrupt one, thou didst incarnate the Son Who was timelessly begotten of the Father and is God, having become man for our sake, Whom the ranks of the Bodiless Powers now serve as the praised and all-glorious God of our fathers.

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Избавителю мои бл̃гоутробне Хе, ннѣ ѡдержаща мя мглы грѣховныа, й всѣхъ страстіи избави, вопіюща: бл̃гвите вся дѣла Гдна Гда пойте и превозносите его вовѣки.
items.english_text: *In the furnace the children of Israel, as in a crucible, shining with the beauty of piety purer than gold, said: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!*

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: Егда хощеши прїити Хе воглавѣ судити міру: стоящих ѡзераныхъ ти имене схранити, вопіюща, й глюща: бл̃гвите вся дѣла Гдна, Гда пойте, и превозносите его вовѣки. М.
items.english_text: My compassionate Redeemer, O Christ: deliver me now from the sinful gloom that holds me and from all passions, as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Къ земнымъ Хв̃и ст̃ии мꙋченицы преидосте, на земли бо велми подвигшися, некую жизнь воспріясте, поюще: бл̃гвите вся дѣла Гдна, Гда пойте, и превозносите его вовѣки. М.
items.english_text: When Thou shalt come, O Christ, in glory to judge the world: preserve those who stand marked with Thy name, crying aloud and saying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Уязвившеся тѣла мертвенаго, въ сосѣдство вдавше славше мчк, якѡ побѣдоносцы срѣлкостеся: Хви возмалюще мунцы, бл̃гвите вся дѣла Гдна, Гда пойте й превозносите его вовѣки. Бг̃.
items.english_text: Leaving earthly things, O holy martyrs of Christ, having contended valiantly on earth, ye received heavenly life, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Сщенныхъ оуст̃а гласы, издалеча провозвѣстиша преч̃таа: быти чт̃ѣ мтри вся соборшем Хгу, емуже
items.english_text: Wounded in mortal bodies and giving yourselves over to suffering, O glorious martyrs, ye met Christ as victors, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

items.slavonic_text: емуже поемъ пр̃чтая: бл̃гвите вся дѣла Гдна, Гда пойте и превозносите его вовѣки.
items.english_text: The voices of holy mouths foreproclaimed from afar that thou, O all-pure one, wouldst become the honorable Mother of Christ Who created all things, unto Whom we sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣщїемай и ваи свѣтлостий Аггльскихъ воинствъ, зарями трисолнечныа красоты, вѣрніи подражающе, поемъ: вся дѣла Гдна, Гда пойте, и превозносите его вовѣки.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers]. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: Яко источника всякаго добра Бг̃оначалныи: приводи Бж҃твеного свѣта свѣты вторіи, свѣт первы прїемлющаа, и вопіюща: вся дѣла Гдна, Гда пойте, и превозносите его вовѣки.
items.english_text: Illuminated by the splendors of the angelic hosts and the rays of thrice-radiant beauty, let us faithful emulate them, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Оумъ первый содѣтеленъ, премирныа оумы Аггльскїя превѣщно составивъ: томꙋ якѡ приближающася, и вопіющаа: вся дѣла Гдна, Гда пойте и превозносите его вовѣки. Бг҃.
items.english_text: As the divine Source of every good, He brought forth secondary lights of divine light, who receive the primal light and cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Паче слова иже из Ѡц҃а роженна пр̃де вѣкъ: неизреченно воплощена родила еси намъ, Дво всенепорочнаа, емуже вопіемъ: вся дѣла Гдна, Гда пойте, и превозносите его вовѣки.
items.english_text: The primal creative Mind, having established the transcendent angelic minds before all ages, draws them nigh unto Himself as they cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: О́бразъ ч̃таго рожтва твоего, распалаемꙋ кꙋпину, яви неопалиму, и ннѣ нана напастей сверѣпѣющую оугасити молимся пещь: да тя Бц̃у непрестанно величаем.
items.english_text: Him Who was begotten of the Father before the ages beyond all word, thou didst ineffably bear for us incarnate, O all-immaculate Virgin, unto Whom we cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Якоже Хананеа вопію ти: помилуй мя Слове, дш҃а бо има бѣснующися ми наведесми врѣдѣющих, и безумно неподобнаа дѣющꙋ, и нечувствующꙋ Бж҃твенаго ти страха долготерпѣливе.
items.english_text: *The burning bush showed forth an unburnt image of thy pure childbearing; and now we pray thee to quench the furnace of temptations that rages against us, that we may unceasingly magnify thee, O Mother of God.*

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Постави Ги накамени повеленіи твоихъ, душа моея плесне, и
items.english_text: Like the Canaanite woman I cry unto Thee: Have mercy on me, O Word! For my soul is sorely vexed by harmful assaults, foolishly committing unseemly deeds and feeling no divine fear of Thee, O longsuffering Lord!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: выгодно запати мя хотящаго, запни змія, й избави мя его злодѣйствїа: якѡ бл̃гъ й многомилостивъ. М.
items.english_text: Establish the steps of my soul upon the rock of Thy commandments, O Lord, and trip up the serpent who craftily seeks to overthrow me; and deliver me from his malice, as Thou art good and abundant in mercy.

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Преидоше прочее мунцы напастей воду непостоянную, и ранъ лютых волненіа: къ пристанищу тѣхъ радосте, вышняго цр̃твїа: Бж̃твенным тишины наслаждающеся. Мчнко.
items.english_text: The martyrs passed through the unstable water of temptations and the surging waves of grievous wounds unto the joyful haven of the Kingdom on high, enjoying divine tranquility.

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣта невечернаго, Мунцы свѣтовидни бывше, сподобистеся: и вцрски первородныхъ водворяетеся: и со Аггльскими лики радуетеся: снимиже жизнодавца Сн̃а съ молите. Бг҃:
items.english_text: Having become luminous, O martyrs, ye were counted worthy of the unwaning Light; and ye dwell in the Kingdom of the firstborn, rejoicing with the choirs of Angels, with whom implore ye the Life-giving Son!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Носящи иже вся носящаго, и доиши всѣмъ пищу дающаго, веліе непрестанно еже паче оума твое таинство, ковчеже чт̃наго сїяніа Дво Бце, тѣмже тя вѣрою оублажаемъ.
items.english_text: Bearing Him Who upholds all things, and nursing Him Who gives food unto all: great and beyond understanding is thy mystery, O ark of honorable radiance, Virgin Mother of God; therefore in faith we bless thee!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Причалники нѣки неизреченны славѣ, безплотныа оумы Сп̃се составилъ еси, й ннѣ тѣхъ ради люди своя сохрани, иже тебе вѣрою и любовію прибѣгающихъ: да тя Вл̃ку непрестанно величаем.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers]. Heirmos: The same.*

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Посылаеши всего смиреніа Аггла, соблюдающа вседержителю ст̃аго твое: смиреніа бо и любве ты вина еси: и бгомудренію вѣрꙋ сохраняюща, й вся врен твоею силою разорѧюща.
items.english_text: Thou didst establish the bodiless minds as partakers of Thine ineffable glory, O Savior; and now for their sake preserve Thy people who flee unto Thee in faith and love, that we may unceasingly magnify Thee, the Master!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Есть сладость въспѣваемый, небесныи сладостнію свѣтлость, наслѣди вц̃рскꙋхъ твоихъ Вл̃ко: й бл̃гочинное оустроеніе подажъ: да тя Сп̃сителя непрестанно величаемъ. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Thou sendest an Angel of all humility, O Almighty One, guarding Thy holy flock; for Thou art the cause of humility and love, preserving faith in divine wisdom and destroying every harmful thing by Thy power.

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. items.slavonic_text: немолчно твое рожество славя: кунно бо стоятъ взиряюще, веселїа его насыщающеся, и тя Бце непрестанно величающе.
items.english_text: Praising Thy celestial delight and sweet radiance, O Master: make us inheritors of Thy Kingdom, and grant well-ordered stability, that we may unceasingly magnify Thee, the Savior!

items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]
[Blind-tooled brown calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards with concentric decorative rolls and geometric strapwork. In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: На стіхо́внѣ стіхиры Покаянны, Гласъ, а̃.
items.english_text: The intelligible angelic thrones unceasingly glorify thy childbearing; for together they stand gazing, filled with His joy, and unceasingly magnifying thee, O Mother of God!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: Не ѡсуди мене Сп̃се мои, лѣностію грѣховною ѡдержима: но воздвигни ми помышленіе к покаянію, и твоего винограда дѣлателя искрена яви мя, даруй ми единагонадесяте часа мздꙋ, й велію мл̃ть. М.
items.english_text: Eternity awaits thee, O my soul, and the Judge is about to expose thy hidden and vile deeds; neglect not therefore to sigh, but anticipate Him, crying alone: O God, cleanse me and save me!

items.slavonic_text: Страстотерпцы Хви, прїидѣте людіе вси почтемъ, пѣньми й пѣснми дховными, просвѣщники міру, и проповѣданники вѣры, источницы принотекꙋщыа, й зинꙋяже источяютъ вѣрнымъ исцѣленїа: тѣхъ мл̃твами Хе Бже нашъ, миръ даруй мірꙋ своему, и дшамъ нашымъ велію милость.
items.english_text: Condemn me not, O my Savior, who am held fast by sinful slothfulness; but awaken in me thoughts of repentance, and show me to be an earnest laborer in Thy vineyard, granting me the reward of the eleventh hour and great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Грѣшныхъ мл̃твы прїемлющи, и скорбящихъ воздыханіа непрезирающи: моли иже ѡчистою боку твоею, Спастися намъ прест̃аа Дво.
items.english_text: Come, all ye people, let us honor the passion-bearers of Christ with spiritual hymns and songs, as the enlighteners of the world and preachers of the faith, ever-flowing fountains that pour forth healings unto the faithful. By their prayers, O Christ our God, grant peace unto Thy world, and unto our souls great mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Ст̃иры покланны, гласъ, а̃. По: Прехвальніи мч̃нци:
items.english_text: Receiving the prayers of sinners and despising not the sighs of the afflicted: implore Him Who was born of thy pure side, that we may be saved, O all-holy Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: В се житіе мое срамно иждихъ Гди, съ блудницами ѡкаянный, якоже блудный оумнаніемъ зову: О̃че нб̃ный, согрѣши
items.english_text: I have squandered all my life shamefully with harlots, O Lord; wretched that I am, like the prodigal I cry in repentance: Heavenly Father, I have sinned...

items.slavonic_text: Снѣди ради, изведе из рая врагъ Адама: Кр̃том же, Разбойника введе Хс̃ вонь: Помяни мя, вопїюща, егда прїидеши въ Царствіи си.
items.english_text: Because of food the enemy led Adam out of Paradise; but through the Cross Christ led the thief into it, crying: Remember me when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: Оумиленїа источни ми даруй, мл̃рдіемъ коимъ Хе Бже: вся ѡчести ми скверны, золъ безмѣрный оучищяюмъ: й цр̃твїа твоего бл̃годетелю причастника мя сотвори.
items.english_text: Grant me fountains of compunction by Thy mercy, O Christ God; cleanse all the defilements of my boundless evils, and make me a partaker of Thy Kingdom, O Benefactor!

items.slavonic_text: Агглъ твоих чины вмоленіе ти приводим Хе, спси й оущедри насъ тѣхъ ради, яко преблга: вся презирая наша, яже вовѣденїи и невѣденіи согрѣшенїа.
items.english_text: We bring the ranks of Thine Angels unto Thee in supplication, O Christ; save us and have compassion on us for their sake, as Thou art all-good, overlooking all our transgressions committed knowingly and in ignorance.

items.slavonic_text: Крокій вашихъ ст̃іи теченіем, мыслного Фараѡна потописте язѣ: ннѣже нестауете чюдное стр̃ва, пꙋчино йзбушающе болѣзни: тѣмже бл̃жимъ есте.
items.english_text: By the stream of your blood, O holy ones, ye drowned the spiritual Pharaoh; and now ye cease not to pour forth marvelous streams, driving away the abyss of diseases: therefore we call you blessed!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣнь трист҃ую вѣрніи гласомъ со Агглы возопіемъ, Ст̃ъ еси Ѡче со Сном же и Дх҃ом, спси насъ вопіющихъ ти, единосущнаа Тр̃це единице Бже. Сла: И ннѣ: Бг҃:
items.english_text: With the Angels let us faithful cry aloud with one voice the thrice-holy song: Holy art Thou, O Father, with the Son and the Spirit! Save us who cry unto Thee, O consubstantial Trinity, Monad God!

items.slavonic_text: грѣшихъ, ѡчѣсти й спаси мя, й не ѡрини мене, самаго себе ѡ тебе ѡудалившагося, й безплодными дѣлы нынѣ ѡбнищавша.
items.english_text: Having given birth unto the unsetting Light, enlighten my darkened soul that is assailed by demonic suggestions; and deliver me from the fire to come by thy divine prayers, O all-immaculate one![^28] cleanse me and save me, and cast me not away who have distanced myself from Thee and am now impoverished through barren deeds!

items.slavonic_text: Обнищавъ богат сый Хе, чл̃ки ѡбогатилъ еси, безсмертіем и свѣтлостію: тѣмже ѡбнищавша мя сл̃стным житіем, доброди́телми ѡбогати: й съ нищымъ Лазаремъ оучини, богатаго мя мꙋчени изымая, й геенны прележащїа ми.
items.english_text: Though rich, Thou didst become poor, O Christ, and didst enrich men with immortality and brightness; therefore enrich me with virtues who am impoverished through a life of pleasures, and number me with poor Lazarus, delivering me from the torment of the rich man and the Gehenna that awaits me.

items.slavonic_text: Злобою ѡбогатихъся лютѣ, й пищу возлюбихъ, й въ житіи воспїяхъ бл̃гаа Гди, и въ геенну ѡсужденъ быхъ: гладꙋющаго оума моего, яко Лазара презрѣв: пре враты Бж҃твенных дѣланіи поверженна, оущедри мя Гди.
items.english_text: Grievously have I grown rich in wickedness, loving pleasure; in this life I received good things, O Lord, and was condemned unto Gehenna; having neglected my starving mind like Lazarus, cast down before the gates of divine deeds: have compassion on me, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Ины ст̃иры Пр̃течи. Подо́бенъ тоиже.
items.english_text: Marvelous Prophet, Baptist of Christ and Forerunner: my heart is dried up by wickedness; cause it to pour forth ever-flowing rivers of tears through thy prayers, I beseech thee, that being saved through thee in my many afflictions, I may magnify Him Who hath magnified thee!

items.slavonic_text: Пр̃рче чꙋдный, Хв̃ъ кр̃тителю й Пр̃тче: изсушше срце мое безмѣстїемъ, рѣки слезъ приснотекꙋщы сотвори пролити, мл̃твами твоими, молю тя: якѡ да спасе тобою многоболѣзненный, величаю иже тебе возвеличившаго.
items.english_text: Blessed Prophet, in thee do I place all my hope and the life of my human soul, who didst baptize Jesus Christ, the Abyss Who bears away the sins of the world; implore Him, O merciful John, to cleanse my heart and save me!

items.office: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"

items.slavonic_text: Пр̃рче блаженне, ктебѣ надеждꙋ мою всю, й животъ возлагаю чл̃чїа моего: иже Ха крести Іса бездну вземлющаго міру прегрѣшенїа: того мл̃и Іѡане мл̃стиве, срце мое ѡчистити й спасти мя.
items.english_text: Wise preacher of grace, who didst foreannounce repentance unto all nations: grant that my all-wretched and desolate soul may ever bring forth fruits of repentance, O divine Forerunner, unto the salvation of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: Проповѣдниче мудре бл̃годати, иже всѣмъ языком покааніе превозвѣстивыи: всеѡкаяннѣи моей й запустѣвшой дш̃и, Бж҃твенный Пр̃тче, плоды покаяніа бл̃говоли приносити всегда, Сп̃съ душамъ нашымъ.
items.english_text: With the great Forerunner who preached unto all the Lamb Who bears away the sins of the whole world, pray thou, O Virgin, that I, a prodigal, may escape the portion of the goats, and that He may number me, unworthy though I am, among the sheep at His right hand.

items.slavonic_text: Агньца, міру всему вземлющаго грѣхи, егоже превеликїи пр̃тча всѣмъ проповѣда: с нимъ Дво моли, козанчую части ієжити мя чꙋжда вча бл̃дныи, и ѡвца деснымъ его, сочтати мене не достойнаго.
items.english_text: *The Lord will hear me when I cry unto Him [Psalm 4:4 LXX].*

items.slavonic_text: Яко пучина веліа согрѣшеніи моихъ Сп̃се, и лютѣ погружаюся беззаконіи моими: дажь ми руку й спаси мя, якѡ Петрови КЕ, й помилуй мя.
items.english_text: As a great abyss are my transgressions, O Savior, and grievously am I sunken in mine iniquities; stretch forth Thy hand unto me, as unto Peter, O Lord, and save me, and have mercy on me!

items.office: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section:
[Front Cover — Leather Binding]

In the central oval mandorla medallion is embossed the Crucifixion of our Lord Jesus Christ, with the Most Holy Mother of God and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian standing at the foot of the Cross. Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Яко помышленіи злыми й дѣлы ѡбнищихъ Сп̃се, мысль мнѣ подаждь ѡбращеніа Кже: да зову ти, Спаси мя бл̃готелю бл̃гіи, й помилуй мя.
items.english_text: Because I am impoverished through evil thoughts and deeds, O Savior, grant me thoughts of repentance, O God, that I may cry unto Thee: Save me, O good Benefactor, and have mercy on me!

items.office: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section:

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Иже на судищи ваше исповѣданіе ст̃іи, мꙋчительско оустраши силу, й ѡлести чл̃ки свободи, тѣмже й главами оусѣкаеми вопіясте: да будетъ Гди жертва дш̃ъ нашихъ бл̃гопрїятна прѣтобою: яко тебе возлюбивше, нерадихомъ ѡ временнѣй жизни чл̃колюбче.
items.english_text: Your confession at the tribunal, O holy ones, struck fear into the tyrant’s power and set men free from delusion; therefore even when beheaded ye cried: Let the sacrifice of our souls be acceptable before Thee, O Lord; for having loved Thee, we took no heed of temporal life, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Дво всепѣтаа, юже втебѣ таинꙋ, Моѵсей пророческима видѣ ѡчима, кꙋпину горящу й неѡпаляему, Кж̃тво бо огнь, оутрѡбꙋ твоя ч̃стаа неопали, тѣмже молимъ тя, яко матерь Бга нашего, миръ испросити мірови, и велію мл̃ть.
items.english_text: O all-praised Virgin, with prophetic eyes Moses beheld the mystery that was in thee, the bush burning yet unconsumed; for the fire of the Godhead did not burn thy pure womb: therefore we pray thee, as the Mother of our God, to entreat peace for the world and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: По а̃, стихологіи, Сѣдална Покаянны, Гласъ, а̃.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.slavonic_text: Въ беззаконіи зачатъ есмь азъ блудный, несмею воззрѣти на высоту нб̃ную: но надѣяся на чл̃колюбїе твое вопїю, Бже ѡчѣсти мя, й спаси мя.
items.english_text: In iniquities was I conceived, prodigal that I am; I dare not look up unto the height of heaven, but trusting in Thy love for mankind, I cry: O God, cleanse me and save me!

items.slavonic_text: Аще праведникъ едва спасется: азаже грѣшный гдѣ явлюся, иже тяготу й вара дневнаго непонесъ: но съ наемники единагонадесяте часа, причтимя Бже, й спаси мя.
items.english_text: If the righteous man scarcely be saved, where shall I, a sinner, appear, who have not borne the burden and heat of the day? But with the laborers of the eleventh hour, number me, O God, and save me!

items.english_text: Beyond understanding and hearing, thou didst give birth on earth without a father unto Him Who is without a mother in heaven: implore Him, O Mother of God, that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_text: Объятїа Ѡч̃а ѡверстими потщися, блудно бо мое иждих житіе, но на богатко не иждивающее взирая щедрот твоихъ Сп̃се: ннѣ ѡбнищавшее ми срце не презри: тебѣ бо Гди, оумленіемъ зову, согрѣшихъ Ѡч̃е на нбо и претобою.

items.slavonic_text: Богатство Іаково зря добродѣтелей, оукрѣпи кознетворяше, иже праведныхъ врагъ: й разорн столпъ телесныи, сокровища же не окраде духованаго: ѡбрѣте бо сокруженну непорочнаго дш̃у, менеже ѡбнаживъ, плѣни, предвари оубо прежде конца, й избави мя тле тѣхнаго, Сп̃се, й спаси мя. М.
items.english_text: Haste Thou to open Thy Fatherly embrace unto me: prodigally have I squandered my life, looking upon the inexhaustible wealth of Thy bounties, O Savior; despise not now my impoverished heart. For unto Thee, O Lord, in compunction do I cry: Father, I have sinned against heaven and before Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Яко добріи воини единомыдрено вѣровавше, прещеніа мучительска неубоястеся ст̃іи: прїидосте оусердно къ Хꙋ, вземше чт̃ный Кр̃тъ: й скончавше те-
items.english_text: Beholding the wealth of Job's virtues, the enemy of the righteous plotted against him and shattered the bodily pillar; yet he stole not the spiritual treasure, for he found the blameless soul to be contrite. But having stripped me bare, he hath taken me captive: anticipate him therefore before the end, and deliver me from his corruption, O Savior, and save me!

items.english_text: As good soldiers believing with one mind, ye feared not the threats of the tyrants, O holy ones; ye came eagerly unto Christ, taking up the precious Cross; and having finished your course ye received victory from heaven: glory to Him Who strengthened you, glory to Him Who crowned you, glory to Him Who through you works healings for all!

items.slavonic_text: Оучааніе Ниневїтское предвари еси, возвѣщенно запрѣщеніе мимо водѧ, й гнѣвъ побѣди мл̃ть твоя Гди, оумилосердися ннѣ на люди и ст̃аго твое, дланію державною враги наша низложи: мл̃твами Бц̃а, даруй намъ милость твоя.
items.english_text: Thou didst anticipate the despair of the Ninevites, averting the proclaimed destruction, and Thy mercy overcame Thy wrath, O Lord; have compassion now upon Thy people and Thy holy inheritance, and with Thy mighty hand cast down our enemies: through the prayers of the Mother of God, grant us Thy mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Въ разбойники впадохъ помышленьми, й ѡкрадохся оумо; оуязвиша ми дш̃у грѣхми, й лежу неисцѣленъ, Ісе многомилостиве: но возлѣи, Пр̃чтыа мл̃твами, твоя мл̃ть, й лютыа душа моея язвы исцѣли.

items.slavonic_text: Безневѣстная чистая Бце Дво, едина вѣрны предстателнице й покрове: бѣдъ й скорбей, й лютыхъ обстояніи всѣхъ избави, иже на тя оупованіе ѡтроковице имѣщихъ: й дша наша спаси, Бж҃твенными мл̃твами си.
items.english_text: I have fallen among thieves through thoughts, and have been despoiled in mind; my soul hath been wounded by sins, and I lie unhealed, O most merciful Jesus; but pour forth Thy mercy through the prayers of the All-Pure One, and heal the grievous wounds of my soul!

items.slavonic_text: Въвторокъ, Канонъ покаяненъ. Твореніе Іѡсифово.
items.english_text: Unwedded and pure Virgin Mother of God, sole protectress and shelter of the faithful: deliver from perils and tribulations and all grievous distresses those who place their hope in thee, O Maiden, and save our souls by thy divine prayers!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь побѣднꙋю воспоем вси, Бг̃у сотворшему дивнаа чꙋдеса, мышцею высокою: й спасшему Іила, якѡ прославися.
items.english_text: *Let us all sing a song of victory unto God Who wrought marvelous wonders with a lofty arm, and saved Israel; for He is glorified!*

items.slavonic_text: Языкомъ ѡкаанны, грѣховны вопіемъ, й оумрох: й зрямя лежаща врага веселитися. Иже воскрешаяй мертвыя, оживи, спаси мя. Мчнк.
items.english_text: Enslaved by the passions of sin, I fall down before Thee, O Lord, that Thou mayest show me free from them, as I earnestly praise Thy goodness.

items.slavonic_text: Лицы прославишася страдалчестіи, честными оуды своими Ха прославивше: плоть понозивша, и страстію тлѣніе потребиша. Мчнк.
items.english_text: With a wretched tongue I cry out in sin, and am dead; and the enemy rejoices seeing me lying low: O Thou Who raisest the dead, quicken and save me!

items.slavonic_text: Столпы и забрала бл̃гочестїа славніи Мчнци, прилогми вражіими непреклонни пребыша. Тѣхъ молитвами, Бже, оущедри всѣхъ насъ. Бг҃:
items.english_text: The ranks of the sufferers were glorified, having glorified Christ in their honorable members; they subjected the flesh, and by their suffering destroyed corruption.

items.slavonic_text: Яко пр̃толъ огнезрачный Дво носящи зиждителя: яко ѡдушевленъ чертогъ и краснаа палата Цра вамѣстила еси: ѡшла, еже есмы, кромѣ измѣненїа, и смѣшеніа.
items.english_text: As pillars and ramparts of piety, the glorious martyrs remained unshaken by the assaults of the enemy: by their prayers, O God, have compassion on us all!

items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канонъ, Ст̃ому великому Пр̃року Іѡанну Пртчи.
items.english_text: Bearing the Creator as a fiery throne, O Virgin, as a living bridal chamber and beautiful palace thou didst contain the King, Who became what we are without change or confusion.

items.slavonic_text: Гласъ былъ еси Словꙋ великый: тѣмже гласы наш яже ктебѣ творимъ, прїими Пртче: свобождая насъ ѿ злыхъ, ходотаиствомъ си.
items.english_text: Thou wast the great voice of the Word; receive therefore our voices which we lift up unto thee, O Forerunner, delivering us from evils through thine intercession.

items.slavonic_text: Яко оутри, яко слнце восіяв, просвѣщаеши конца, и помрачаеши духи лукавыа: тѣмже мракъ дш̃ъ нашыхъ ѡжени.
items.english_text: Shining forth like the dawn, like the sun, thou dost enlighten the ends of the earth and dispel the evil spirits; therefore drive away the gloom of our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Ертвымъ животъ нашъ приходящъ, проповѣдалъ еси Пртче, тѣмже оумерщвланша мя страсти оумертви: и покажи блажене, Бж҃твенныя свѣтлости причастника. Бг҃:
items.english_text: Thou didst proclaim our Life coming unto mortals, O Forerunner; therefore put to death the passions that mortify me, and show me, O blessed one, to be a partaker of divine radiance.

items.english_text: Having given birth in time unto the timeless Son incarnate, O all-pure Lady: heal the ancient, wretched passions of my soul!

items.slavonic_text: Вл̃чце: вселетнымъ преѡкалянным ми дш̃а страсти исцѣли.
items.english_text: *The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner; this is the rock whereupon Christ hath established His Church, which He redeemed from among the nations.*

items.slavonic_text: Камень егоже небрегоша зиждущей, сеи быстъ въ главꙋ оуглу: сеи есть камень, нанемже оутверди Цр̃ковь свою ХС̃, юже ѿ языкъ искупи.
items.english_text: Behold the weakness wherewith I am clothed, behold the grievous disfigurement of my soul, and give ear unto my voice, O Christ, abundant in mercy; and transform its unseemliness into fair beauty, O Savior!

items.slavonic_text: Виждь мою немощ ѡболченія вню, виждь дша моея лютое безѡбразіе: й вонми гласу моему Хе̃, многомилостиве: и претвори сея нелѣпоту въ бл̃гоѡбразіе Сп̃се.
items.english_text: Save me, the prodigal, O Jesus, who have transgressed Thy saving laws, committing all iniquity foolishly and seduced by thoughts that alienate me from Thee, O Good One!

items.slavonic_text: Спаси Ісе блуднаго, спсима единаго твоя спасенныа престꙋпльша законы: и всяко беззаконіе несмыслено скончавша, й шведенна помышленми, ѡ тебе Блаже чꙋжда мя творящими. Мчнк.
items.english_text: The ranks of the Bodiless Powers truly marveled at your courage, O holy ones; for suffering gloriously upon the tribunal and falling in body, ye cast down all bodiless enemies by divine power.

items.slavonic_text: Чины Безплотныхъ, ст̃ин, вашемъ мужеству констиннѣ оудивишася: якѡ на есьдищи страдающе преславно, й падающе тѣлом, безплотныа вся враги Бж҃твенною силою низвергосте. Мчнк.
items.english_text: Still crimsoned with wounds, still bedewed with drops of blood, O passion-bearers, ye stand rejoicing before the Lord, the immortal King, crowned as victors!

items.slavonic_text: Еще ранъ кромѣ ѡчервлени, еще кровей каплами страстоносци ѡблїва́еми: Гд̃еви предстаете радующеся, бесмертному Цр̃у: яко побѣдоносци вѣнчаваеми.
items.english_text: Thou didst give birth unto Him Whom the Father begat before all ages, thou didst nurse the Nourisher, knowing not man: O most glorious wonder, O new mystery, full of divine joy; therefore the great soul of the faithful doth glorify thee!

items.slavonic_text: Раждаеши, егоже Ѡц҃ъ роди прежде всѣхъ вѣкъ, питаеши питателя, не свѣя мужеска невѣдꙋщи, преславно чꙋдо: новое таинство, Бгорадованнаа, тѣмже веліка дша вѣрныхъ славитъ тя.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Forerunner]. Heirmos: The same.*

items.slavonic_text: сщенно прозябе: й явися плодовиенъ дѣяніи Бж҃твенныхъ. Тѣмже ср̃це мое везжечки неплотствꙋющее, бл̃гоплодно сотвори добры: яко да вѣрно прославляю тя.
items.english_text: From a barren womb that bore not, O Forerunner, thou didst sacredly spring forth and wast revealed fruitful in divine deeds; therefore make my heart, wholly barren of good, fruitful in virtues, that in faith I may glorify thee!

items.slavonic_text: Хлѣбомъ нб̃нымъ оутверди мое ср̃це блаженне, разслабленное лукавыми мысльми: й дажъ ми оусердно творити хотѣнїа всещедраго Бг̃а: якѡ да вѣрно прино славлю тя.
items.english_text: With the heavenly Bread strengthen my heart, O blessed one, weakened as it is by evil thoughts, and grant me zealously to do the will of the all-bountiful God, that in faith I, a sinner, may ever glorify thee, O Prophet.

items.english_text: Thou didst proclaim the Lamb Who bears away the sin of the world, O blessed Prophet; lighten, I pray thee, the heavy burden of my sins, granting me compunction that cleanses the defilements of the passions.

items.english_text: The Word Who came forth taking flesh entirely, clothed Himself with the image of Adam, O incorrupt Mother of God; implore Him therefore to deliver us from passions, and from all tribulations, and from eternal fire.

items.english_text: *Foreseeing in spirit the incarnation of the Word, the Prophet Habakkuk proclaimed, crying: When the years draw nigh, Thou shalt be known; when the time is come, Thou shalt be shown forth. Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*

items.slavonic_text: Еже ми даде Хе̃ богатство, расточихъ злѣ, скончеваа безмѣстнаа: й быхъ нагъ, ѡболче в дѣла безчестїа, тѣмже вопїю ти, іюдеже мя оущедри первою, Бж҃твенною мл̃ оуменила бл̃годатію.
items.english_text: The wealth which Thou gavest me, O Christ, I wickedly squandered, committing unseemly deeds; and I am become naked, clothed in deeds of dishonor; therefore I cry unto Thee: Have compassion on me, and clothe me with Thy first divine grace!

items.slavonic_text: Низведохся безуміемъ, й падохся лютѣ, й на земли лежу неисцѣлно воля: воздвигнима падшымъ востаніе, й на ка-
items.english_text: I was brought down by folly and fell grievously, and I lie upon the earth unhealed; raise me up, O Resurrection of the fallen, and establish my heart, O Christ, upon the rock of saving repentance!

items.english_text: Imitating Christ lifted up upon the Cross, the all-glorious passion-bearers received wounds; and with streams of blood they extinguished the delusion of polytheism, pouring forth streams of healings.

items.slavonic_text: На Кр̃тъ вознесенному Хꙋ подобящеся, прїемлюще раны, всеславніи скорѣ страстотерпцы: й кровными тꙋчами многобожїа оугасивша туча, стрꙋя исцѣленіе источающе. М.
items.english_text: Having traversed the surge and bitter tossing of torments dryshod, O divine sufferers, steered by saving hope, ye hastened unto the haven on high, filled with all joy.

items.slavonic_text: Препадше немо́кренно мукамъ бѣльство, й горкое волненіе, Бж҃твенніи страдалцы, ѡкормленіем спасенныа надежа, къ вышнемꙋ оустремишася пристанищу, всякагѡ веселїа исполняеми. Бг҃:
items.english_text: The angelic hosts marveled, beholding how He Who is invisible in appearance was seen for our sake through thee, O Virgin Mother of God; implore Him to grant salvation unto all who glorify thee in faith.

items.slavonic_text: Дивишася зряще Аггльскаа воинства, какѡ невидимый зракомъ, иже понасъ истебе видимъ бысть, Дво Бгороднице: егоже моли спасенію сподобити, всѣх иже вѣрою тя славящихъ.

items.slavonic_text: Испросивъ спасенїа ризꙋ себѣ, во ѡбнаженіи телесне Гнь Кр̃стителю: ѡбнаженнаго ѡ великаго бл̃гобореніа, ѡблецымя молюся, правды й веселїа ѡдежею.
items.english_text: Having obtained the robe of salvation for thyself in bodily nakedness, O Baptist of the Lord: clothe me, I pray thee, who am stripped bare of noble struggle, with the garment of righteousness and gladness.

Three brass clasp fittings on leather straps are preserved along the fore-edge.][^1]
items.slavonic_text: Каплю спасенїа, ѡдожди мнѣ Пртче, истлаваемъ ражданїемъ похотей, погруженый въ струяхъ Іорданскихъ пищи потока, Іса жизнодавца: яко да подобꙋ тя славлю.
items.english_text: Rain down upon me a drop of salvation, O Forerunner, who am wasting away through the offspring of lusts, who didst immerse in the streams of the Jordan the Torrent of delight, Jesus the Giver of life, that worthily I may glorify thee.

items.slavonic_text: Ни Агглъ, ни ходотаи спасе на, но самъ Гдь пришедый наземлю: емуже правыя пути оуготовалъ еси блаженне, егоже моли оугладити ми стезю, к спасенію наставляющꙋ. Бг҃.
items.english_text: Neither an angel nor an intercessor saved us, but the Lord Himself Who came upon earth, for Whom thou didst make straight the paths, O blessed one; implore Him to smooth my path that leads unto salvation.[^31]

items.slavonic_text: оума, того моли грѣховны скверны насъ ѡчѣстити: яко да храмъ явимся, и вселеніе Бж҃твеннаго Дха.
items.english_text: A sacred temple of God wast thou revealed, having contained God beyond understanding, O Virgin implore Him to cleanse us from the defilements of sin, that we may be shown forth as temples and the dwelling of the divine Spirit.

items.slavonic_text: Твой миръ даждь намъ Сн̃е Бжїй: иного бо развѣ тебе Бг̃а не знаемъ: има твое именуем, якѡ Бгъ живымъ и мертвым ты еси.
items.english_text: *Grant us Thy peace, O Son of God; for other than Thee we know no God: we call upon Thy name, for Thou art the God of the living and of the dead.*

items.slavonic_text: Исполнися грѣхопаденіи многихъ и лютых: влию щедрый й долготерпѣливый, оущедри мя ѡсужденнаго, й не ѡтверзи мене ѡ лица твоего.
items.english_text: I am filled with many and grievous falls into sin; O greatly compassionate and longsuffering Lord, have mercy on me who am condemned, and cast me not away from Thy presence!

items.slavonic_text: Мытаря ѡправдалъ еси Хе̃ воздыхавша: тому оубѡ й азъ подобася бію въ перси, й зову ти: ѡчѣсти мя едине милосерде й щедре. Мчнк.
items.english_text: Thou didst justify the Publican when he sighed, O Christ; imitating him, I also beat my breast and cry unto Thee: Cleanse me, O only compassionate and merciful One!

items.english_text: Thy holy ones, O Lord, were revealed as unerring beacons, driving away the deep night of delusion and enlightening the whole universe with marvelous splendors.

items.english_text: As precious stones having loved Thee, the living Stone, O Master: the martyrs, rolled about by torments, cast down the great edifice of delusion.

items.slavonic_text: Въ двѣ воли единаго ѡ чт̃ныа Тр̃ца, породила еси всенепорочнаа, носящаго единъ состав: егоже прилежно моли, всѣм спастися намъ.
items.english_text: In two wills thou didst give birth unto the One of the honorable Trinity, O all-immaculate one, Who hath a single hypostasis: diligently implore Him that we all may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: Въ пустыню вселися Пртче Хв̃ъ, якоже древле Илїа: тѣмже ср̃це мое ѡпустѣвшее прегрѣшеньми, прилежаніемъ кжитвіе чимъ снабли всеблаженне.

items.english_text: Thou didst dwell in the wilderness, O Forerunner of Christ, even as Elijah of old; therefore through diligence restore my heart that is made desolate by transgressions, O all-blessed one!

items.slavonic_text: Мертвымъ бл̃говѣстися, свѣтъ иже ѡ свѣта быва́выи на земли: гласом твоймъ блаженне, й иже во тмѣ просвѣтихомся лютѣ ѡмраченнаго. Бг҃:
items.english_text: Having become an unshakable pillar and bulwark for the faithful, O great Forerunner of Christ: make steadfast my mind that is shaken by the deceits of the wily one.

items.slavonic_text: Рунцѣ Дв̃у тя проповѣдаетъ Дв̃дъ, пр̃чтая чистоту, тѣмже молютися: ненаго мя цр̃твіа сотвори наслѣдника: да оублажаю тя.
items.english_text: The Light from Light appearing upon earth was proclaimed unto the dead by thy voice, O blessed one; and we who were grievously darkened in gloom were enlightened.

items.slavonic_text: Пр̃ркъ Іѡнѣ подобяся, вопію: животъ мои Бже свободи ѡ нетлѣніа, й спси мя Сп̃се міра, зовуща: Слава тебѣ.
items.english_text: David proclaims thee as the Fleece, O Virgin, in all-pure purity; therefore I pray thee: make me an inheritor of the heavenly Kingdom, that I may call thee blessed!

items.slavonic_text: Скорбишася кости ѡкаянныа ми дша, й тяготою сладостіи многихъ сластіи: но помози ми Хе̃, едине всѣ помаганїе.
items.english_text: *Imitating the Prophet Jonah, I cry: Deliver my life from corruption, O God, and save me, O Savior of the world, who cry: Glory to Thee!*

items.slavonic_text: Въ пучину лютых, й въ збрострастеи впадающїим, вопію ти всесильне Хе: возведимя крѣпкою си рукою, й спаси мя. М.
items.english_text: The bones of my wretched soul are afflicted and weighed down by the burden of many pleasures; but help me, O Christ, the only help of all!

items.slavonic_text: Тмами избра́нныхъ полкъ, ст̃ыхъ страстотерпец, тмы мысленныхъ попраша врагъ, й совокупишася тмамъ нб̃ныхъ оумовъ. Мчнк.
items.english_text: Falling into the abyss of evils and tempest of passions, I cry unto Thee, O almighty Christ: raise me up by Thy strong hand and save me!

items.slavonic_text: Изсушивше глꙋбину безбожїа страдалцы, потока пищиаго наслѣдовасте: тѣмже изсушите разліяніа грѣха моего. Бг҃:
items.english_text: The chosen regiment of myriads of holy passion-bearers trampled upon the myriads of spiritual enemies, and was joined unto the myriads of heavenly minds.

items.slavonic_text: Сщенїа стѣнь явленна Марїе: ѡскверненную сластьми ѡкаянную ми дш̃у ѡчсти, й божественнѣй славѣ причастника мя сотвори.
items.english_text: Having dried up the deep of godlessness, O sufferers, ye inherited the torrent of delight; therefore dry up the overflow of my sin!

items.english_text: Revealed as the tabernacle of sanctification, O Mary: cleanse my wretched soul defiled with pleasures, and make me a partaker of divine glory!

items.english_text: Having immersed the Abyss in the river streams: dry up the abyss of my passions, granting me a fountain of tears, O Forerunner, preacher of Christ!

items.slavonic_text: Иже въ пещи ѡтроком твоим Сп̃се, неприкоснуся ни отꙋжи имъ огнь, тогда три тріе яко единѣми оусты пояху, й бл̃гяху глюще: бл̃гословенъ Бг̃ъ Ѡц҃ъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: From diseases of soul and passions of flesh, from temptations of life and great trials and afflictions, save me, O Forerunner of the Lord!

items.english_text: Mother of God and fair among women, I diligently pray thee: despise me not, O pure one, but have compassion and preserve me unharmed from great hurt!

items.english_text: *The fire touched not nor troubled Thy children in the furnace, O Savior; then the three as with one mouth sang and blessed, saying: Blessed is the God of our fathers!*

items.english_text: Joseph learned endurance, and remained unmoved by all the wiles of the evil one, like a strong pillar: emulate him ever, O my soul, and despond not in evil circumstances!

items.slavonic_text: Зданіемъ страданіи сщенных, палата явистеся честніи пресвѣтлаа: вънеиже Хс̃ почиваетъ, единъ цр̃ь й Гд̃ь: иже къ ѡбителемъ нб̃нымъ преведыи васъ. Бг҃.
items.english_text: Vanquished by bodily pleasures, I am become irrational though endowed with reason, O Word of God, Who by Thy word savest the well-pleasing: save me, a wretch, that blessing I may praise Thy goodness!

items.slavonic_text: Ородовъ тя всѣхъ всепѣтаа, едино избра волю себѣ, Хс̃, яко ч̃рную й чистою въ жилище: й истебе яко слнце восіявъ, землю всю просвѣти.
items.english_text: Redeemed by the blood of Christ Who suffered in the flesh for our sake, O martyrs, for Whose sake ye chose eagerly to pour out your blood: by the building of your sacred sufferings ye were revealed as an all-bright palace, wherein rests Christ, the only King and Lord, Who translated you unto the heavenly mansions!

items.slavonic_text: Яко ветхому й новому бывъ, преизященъ ходотай славне кр̃телю: ходотайствои, ѡбетшавшаго грѣхы, бл̃го ѡбновити мя, ѡбновителя всѣческыхъ моли Іса.
items.english_text: Out of all generations, O all-praised Virgin, Christ chose thee alone as His dwelling, as fair and pure; and shining forth from thee like the sun, He enlightened all the earth.

items.slavonic_text: Яко полагаа покаяніа на земли, явился еси Пртче Хв̃ъ й кр̃телю: егоже оусинити всѣх оукрѣпи мл̃твами си, яко да избавимся ѡ безмѣрныхъ золъ, яже согрѣшаемъ присно.

items.slavonic_text: Ты пꙋстыни пройде путь, воздержаніе всяко прохож мудре: й широтою бговидѣніи свѣтлы весь ѡзарился еси, ихже насладитися й на даруй, Ха моля.
items.english_text: Having become an excellent mediator between the Old and the New, O glorious Baptist: through thine intercession implore Jesus, the Renewer of all, graciously to renew me who am grown old in sins!
