items.english_text: Glorious Apostles, closest friends of Christ: leaving me who show mercy to the friend of the enemy through wicked deeds and am estranged from love, bring me near unto Him Whom I have embittered, through good works, showing kindness through loving-kindness!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ап̃ли славніи, Хв̃ы друзи приснѣйшіи: вражіа дрꙋга мл҃свꙋя люкавыми дѣлесы: любве стр(а)нныа ѡ҆ставляюще мя, възлюби́въ томꙋ присноите, и҆́же тогошемъ изрядныхъ ради дѣлъ, ѡ҆горчи́вшаго, лю́бо бл҃гоꙋтро́біемъ добра показáвша.
items.english_text: All-wise Apostles, divinely-called disciples of Christ, teachers of the universe: by your prayers strengthen me to accept the divine teachings, and help me ever to walk the narrow path, that I may attain unto the most spacious dwelling of Paradise!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ап̃ли всемꙋдріи, Хв̃ы оу҆чнцы бгозванніи, вселеннеи оу҆чителие: ва́шними мл҃твами, бж҃твенными оу҆ченіемъ взаимлати оу҆крѣпи́те мя, и҆ стезю тесную помага́ите ходи́ти ми всегда: ꙗкѡ да доспѣю въ пребываніе раиское пространнѣйшее.
items.english_text: I hymn Peter the foremost, Paul, James, Andrew, and Philip, Simon, Bartholomew, and Thomas, Matthew and John, Mark and Luke, who wrote the Gospel: the divinely-chosen choir with the other Seventy, as eyewitnesses and preachers of the Word!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Петра первопресто́лнаго воспѣва́ю, Па́вла, Іа́кѡва, Андре́а, и҆ Філи́ппа, Сѵ́мона, Вардоломе́а же и҆ Ѳеѡмꙋ: Матѳе́а же и҆ Іѡа́нна, Ма́рка же и҆ Лꙋкꙋ, и҆́же бл҃говѣстіе е҆пписáвшихъ: ликъ Бг҃оизбранный, со инѣми Семдесятми, ꙗкѡ Сло́ву самовидци и҆ проповѣ́дники.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 1.*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ины стихиры ст҃лю Николаю. Гла, а҃. По, Нб҃ным чином.
items.english_text: Flying across the flowers of the Church, like a fledgling of the high angelic nest, O most blessed Nicholas: thou ever criest unto God for us all who are in urgent tribulations and perils, and deliverest us by thy prayers!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Цѣкѡвныѧ цвѣ́ты прелета́я, ꙗкѡже птенецъ вы́шняго гнѣзда Агглскаго, Никола́е пребл̃женне: зове́ши при́но къ Бг҃ꙋ ѡ҆ всѣхъ насъ, и҆́же внꙋжныхъ бѣда́хъ и҆ нападе́ніихъ, и҆ и҆збавляеши, мл҃твами си.
items.english_text: Passing through the beauties of heaven, strangely thou didst understand that glory, O holy of holies; therefore also in heavenly words thou ever utterest the call of those living things, O most sacred father!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: ...ѡ҆нꙋ разꙋмѣ́лъ еси сла́вꙋ, ст҃е ст҃ыхъ, тѣмже и҆ на нб҃саа словеса, при́но живо́ныхъ шнѣх зовеніи являеши, сщ҃еннѣишіи ѡ́че.
items.english_text: Thou didst make the adornment of the sacred vestment a beacon through active virtues, O God-bearing father; therefore also in the sacred ministry thou performest marvelous things of glorious visions, praising Him Who is fierce against us!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Сщенныѧ ѡ҆дежда оу҆краше́ніе, дѣла́телными содѣялъ еси добродѣтелми свѣтилникъ, ѻ́тче бгоно́се, тѣмже и҆ на сщ҃еннодѣйствꙋеши дивная, славных видѣніи: лю́ты на насъ хваля.
items.english_text: Tossed by the abyss of transgressions, having fled unto the calm harbor of thine all-pure prayer, O Mother of God, I cry unto thee: Save me, stretching forth thy strong right hand unto thy servant, O all-immaculate one!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Прегрѣше́ніи пꙋчиною ѡ҆бзрева́ем тихо́мꙋ пристаннищꙋ прибѣг, пречистѣи мл҃твѣ твоеи, бгородительнице, взыва́ю ти: Спаси мя, крѣпкою своею десни́цꙋ просте́рши рабꙋ своему, всенепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: The all-powerful discipleship of the Apostles, moved by the Holy Spirit, abolished the abominable sacrifices to demons; and having preached the one Lord, delivered the nations from idol delusion and taught them to worship the consubstantial Trinity!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: НА СТIХО́ВНѢ, СТIХИ́РЫ Ап̃льскіа, Гласъ, а҃.
items.english_text: Let us with one voice praise Peter and Paul, Luke, Matthew, Mark, John, Andrew, Thomas, Bartholomew, Simon the Canaanite, James, and Philip; and let all the apostolic company be worthily praised!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: ...пріѧтъ вы, и҆ ѿверзо́шася ва́м Ра́йскіа две́ри: и҆ вну́трь бывше дре́ва живо́тнаго наслажда́етеся, Хв̃ꙋ моли́теся, дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ, ми́ръ и҆ ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_text: O all-lauded martyrs, the earth hath received you, and the gates of Paradise have been opened unto you; and being within, ye enjoy the Tree of life: pray Christ to grant peace and great mercy unto our souls!

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйся ра́дости пред̾вѣ́днице: Ап̃лѡмъ и҆ Мꙋ́никомъ весе́ліе: и҆ покро́въ намъ Дв҃о, твои́мъ рабѡмъ.
items.english_text: Rejoice, harbinger of joy, delight of the Apostles and martyrs, and protection unto us, thy servants, O Virgin!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: По а҃, стіхо(логіи), Сѣ: Ап̃льскіа, Гласъ, а҃.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Apostles, Tone 1:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Премꙋ́дріи вселеннѣи ловцы́, ѿ Бг҃а пріемше мл҃твенное, ма́те нн҃ѣ ѡ҆ насъ възпі́ющихъ: Гд̃и сп҃си Цр҃ѧ и҆ гра́дъ свои, и҆ ѿ ѡ҆держа́щихъ зо́лъ свободи, Ап̃лъ ра́ди дꙋша на́ша.
items.english_text: All-wise fishers of the universe, having received from God the power of prayer, intercede now for us who cry aloud: O Lord, save Thy Emperor and Thy city, and deliver our souls from surrounding evils, for the sake of the Apostles!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Трꙋбы Хв҃ы бг҃огласныѧ, въпѣсне да почтꙋ вѣ́рніи, премꙋдріи Ап̃ли, коня, възму́тившыхъ е҆ги́птско мо́ре, и҆ привлекшихъ а҆́ки нѣглавнны чл҃ки, къ бж҃твенномꙋ сп҃сеніа пристаннищꙋ, бл҃годатію Дх҃а.
items.english_text: Let the faithful honor in hymns the divinely-sounding trumpets of Christ, the all-wise Apostles, who stirred up the Egyptian sea like horses, and drew men who were without head unto the divine harbor of salvation by the grace of the Spirit!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Неѡбори́мꙋю стѣнꙋ стяжа́вше вѣрніи, Бц̃ꙋ Ма́рію, пріидѣ́те покло́нимся, и҆ припаде́м кънеи: дерзнове́ніе бо и҆́мат, къ рожшемꙋся и҆знеѧ, моли́тися и҆ спасаетъ ѿ гнѣ́ва и҆ сме́рти, дꙋша на́ша.
items.english_text: Having acquired an insurmountable wall, the Theotokos Mary, come, let us the faithful bow down and fall before her: for she hath boldness to pray unto Him Who was born of her, and she saves our souls from wrath and death!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Мре́жею слове́сною, плетеніѧ ри́торскаа, ры́баріе, прості́и Кр(ес)тного ра́звергъше: просвѣти́ша ꙗ҆зы́ки бл҃гоче́стно сла́вити тя Бг҃а и҆́стиннаго. тѣ́мже ти пѣ́снь оу҆оу҆крѣпльшемꙋ и҆́хъ, вопіемъ: Сла́ва Ѻ҆ц̃ꙋ, и҆ Сн҃ꙋ,...
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: ...сла́ва є҆диносꙋщномꙋ Дх҃ꙋ: сла́ва, и҆́же и҆́хъ ради, просвѣти́вшемꙋ ми́ръ.
items.english_text: With the spiritual net of rhetorical windings, the simple fishermen having cast the net of the Cross: enlightened the nations piously to glorify Thee, the true God; therefore we cry unto Thee Who didst strengthen them: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, glory to the consubstantial Spirit; glory to Him Who through them enlightened the world!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋники Хв̃ы молимъ вси, пришедше кънимъ с̾вѣ́рою: сіи бо ѡ҆ на́ше сп҃се́ніе просятъ: сіи и҆стача́ютъ и҆сцѣленіем бл҃гть: сіи по́ки ѡ҆гоня́ютъ бѣсо́вскіа, ꙗ҆́кѡ сохро́нницы вѣ́рѣ.
items.english_text: We all pray the martyrs of Christ, coming unto them with faith: for they ask for our salvation, they pour forth the grace of healing, they drive away demonic regiments, as guardians of the faith!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆пова́ніе хрстіаномъ преч(ис)тая Дв҃о: е́го́же родила еси Бг҃а, па́че оу҆ма́ и҆ слов, непреста́нно мли ѡ҆воспѣва́ющихъ тѧ, пода́ти ѡ҆ставле́ніе грѣхѡ́мъ на́шымъ всѣмъ, и҆ исправле́ніе житію: да вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вію при́сно тя сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: O hope of Christians, all-pure Virgin: Whom thou didst bear as God beyond mind and word, unceasingly pray for those who hymn thee, to grant remission of all our sins and correction of life, that in faith and love we may ever glorify thee!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ла мы́сленныи Оу҆чнци Сп҃совы: ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣти́ла ѻ҆гне́нныи, ѡ҆заристе всеѧ земля и҆сполне́ніе, бж҃твенными оу҆ченіи. тѣмже молюся, и҆́же въ тмѣ дш҃ꙋ мою просвѣтити свѣтоно́сными лꙋча́ми ва́шими, всеблаже́нніи.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 1:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Преци тя ꙗ҆́сно провозвѣсти́ша Ѻ҆трокови́це, ма́теръ Бж҃ію: и҆ Ап̃ли бж҃твенніи въ ми́рѣ проповѣда́ша: и҆ мы кр(ес)то́влꙋом. тѣмъже вси бл҃гоче́стно мудреннѣ почита́юще воспѣва́е тѧ, и҆ Бц̃ꙋ воистинну при́снѡ и҆менꙋемъ.
items.english_text: Mental luminaries, disciples of the Savior: as fiery luminaries ye illuminated the fullness of all the earth with divine teachings. Therefore I pray: enlighten my soul which is in darkness with your light-bearing rays, O all-blessed ones!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ ЧЕТВЕРТОКЪ, Каноны ст҃ымъ Ап̃лѡмъ.
items.english_text: The Forefathers clearly proclaimed thee beforehand as the Maiden, Mother of God; and the divine Apostles preached thee in the world; and we the cruciform flock, piously and wisely honoring thee, hymn thee and truly call thee the Mother of God!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: ...-рями трисо́лнечнаго сїа́ніа славніи, положе́ніемъ нарекостеся воистиннꙋ бози, свѣтовидніи Ап̃ли. тѣ́мъже по долгꙋ ва́съ вѣ́рно почита́е.
items.english_text: Illuminated with the divine rays of the Thrice-radiant brightness, O glorious ones, ye were truly called gods by adoption, O light-formed Apostles; therefore as is due we faithfully honor you!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Сло́ва оу҆слышавша на земли, замилосе́рдіе ѡ҆блекшаго плотію, и҆зрядныи слꙋжи́теліе, и҆ того всѣхъ и҆сполнителіе повеле́ній вѣрою бывше, при́но почита́ем есте Ап̃ли.
items.english_text: Having heard the Word on earth, Who out of loving-kindness clothed Himself in flesh, O chosen servants, and having become fulfillers of all His commandments in faith, ye are ever honored, O Apostles!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́телными лꙋча́ми прест҃а́гѡ Дх҃а, приѡблаже́нніи всѣго мя просвѣти́те, грѣхѡ́ тмою покрыва́емаго: и҆ копокая́ніа пꙋти, мя наста́вите.
items.english_text: With the illuminating rays of the All-Holy Spirit, O most blessed ones, enlighten me entirely, who am covered with the darkness of sins, and guide me unto the paths of repentance!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Иже ап̃лѡмъ радость, Бгородительнице всенепоро́чная Влч̃це: ꙗкѡ ма́ти бывши, и҆́же ѿтѣх бго́лѣпно сла́вшемꙋ: сни́миже молися, ѻ҆гня́ ге́еньскагѡ изба́вити мя.
items.english_text: Joy of the Apostles, all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, Mother of God: as thou wast the Mother of Him Who was divinely glorified by them, with them pray that I may be delivered from the fire of Gehenna!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Кано ст҃омꙋ Никола́ю. Твореніе Іѡси́фово.
items.english_text: Adorned with righteous crowns and standing before the throne of grace, O Nicholas: ever save by thy prayers those who now crown thee with hymns!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Вѣ́ньци оу҆краша́ем пра́ведными, и҆ пр(ес)толꙋ блг҃ти престоя Никола́е: и҆́же пѣ́сньми тя нн҃ѣ вѣнчꙋвающихъ, при́снѡ спаса́и моли́твами си.
items.english_text: Having received the grace of healings, O all-blessed Nicholas: heal the sores of my soul by thy prayers, and deliver me, I pray, from the assaults that come upon me!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Иже блг҃ть пріемъ исцѣле́ніем, всеблаженне Никола́е: дша моеѧ ꙗ҆́звы, моли́твами си исцѣли, и҆ находящихъ нахоже́ніи и҆збави мя, молюся.
items.english_text: By the strength of the prayer of God, O Nicholas, heal my soul utterly paralyzed by transgressions, and deliver me, I pray, from the wicked evils of life!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Крѣпо́стію Никола́е Бж҃іа мл҃твы, всеразсла́бленную дꙋ́шꙋ мою прегрѣшеньми исцѣли, и҆ житіа злолю́ты избави мя, молюся.
items.english_text: Drive away the darkening of my mind with thy light, O all-immaculate one, and deliver me from eternal darkness, that I may ever sing magnifying thee!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡма́ моего ѡ҆мраче́ніе, всенепоро́чнаѧ, свѣ́томъ си ѡ҆жени,...
items.english_text: The only invisible God became visible by being incarnate, and chose you as His disciples in all the world, proclaiming His name and transcendent glory, O most glorious divine Apostles!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ...и҆ тмы вѣчнꙋющіа избави мя: ꙗ҆́кѡ да пою всегда велича́я тя.
items.english_text: Unto Thee alone have I sinned, O Christ, unto Thee alone have I done iniquity, and defiled my soul; in Thy mercy pity and save me, having Thine all-wise Apostles praying for me, O only Benefactor Jesus!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Иже еди́нъ невидимый Бг҃ъ, види́мъ бысть воплощаем: и҆ оу҆чнки ва из̾бра́, въвсе́м мірѣ, того и҆́мя, и҆ превосходящꙋю сла́вꙋ возвѣщающи: преславе́нніи бж҃твенніи Ап̃ли.
items.english_text: From the bitterness of passions and thoughts, and from every sin, as merciful Apostles deliver me, sweetening my mind through repentance, as with divine delight in heart, O all-lauded ones!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ еди́номꙋ согрѣшихъ Хе, тебѣ еди́номꙋ беззаконо́вах, и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ за́мни ѡ҆сквернихъ. То́ею милостію оу҆щети и҆ спаси мя: и҆мѣя молящла тя еди́не бл҃годѣ́телю Іс҃е, премꙋ́дріѧ Ап̃лы твоя.
items.english_text: With the bodiless ministers, O unwedded Virgin, with all the higher Powers, with the martyrs and Apostles: implore Christ, Whom thou didst incarnate of thy pure blood, that Thy servants may be saved!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Го́рести страсте́и и҆ помы́слѡвъ, и҆ всякаго грѣха́, ꙗ҆кѡ милостивіи Ап̃ли изба́вите мя: покая́ніемъ оу҆слажда́юще моего мысль, ꙗ҆кѡ бж҃твенною наслаще сла́до в срци всехвалніи.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to Saint Nicholas]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Съ невеще́ственными слꙋжи́тели, Дв҃о неискусобра́чнаѧ, съвсѣми вы́шними Си́лами, со Мꙋнки и҆ Ап̃лы, ХА, є҆го́же воплотила еси ѿ чистыхъ крове́й твоихъ: оу҆моли спа́стися рабо́ твои.
items.english_text: Adornment of high priests, breathing of the divine Spirit: by thy myrrh-scented prayers drive away the foul-smelling passions of my heart, O wise Nicholas, I pray!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Первощенникомъ оу҆добре́ніе, бл҃годꙋха́ніе бж҃твеннагѡ Дх҃а, мѵродꙋхнове́нными твоими мл҃твами, злосмра́дныя стра́сти ѡ҆жени срца моего, Никола́е мꙋ́дре, молюся.
items.english_text: In slothfulness do I spend my life, a wretch, and I fear the dread tribunal of Christ; whereat put me not to shame, being entreated by the sacred intercessions of Nicholas!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Дв҃о Бц̃е, нескве́рнаѧ сѣ́ни: ѡ҆скверне́на мя прегрѣше́ньми, ѡ҆чи́сти щедро́тами си, ч(ес)тнѣ́йшимъ кропле́ніи, да́дъ ми рꙋ́кꙋ по́мощи, да зовꙋ: сла́ва тебѣ́ ч(ис)таѧ Бг҃оневѣ́сто.
items.english_text: Filled with divine grace, O hierarch, father Nicholas: save from diverse temptations and troubles those who ever flee beneath thy protection, O all-blessed one!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ ѡ҆сщ҃енъ ꙗ҆ви́ся Бг҃ꙋ, и҆же въ тя все́льшемся па́че оу҆ма́, того́ мл҃и, грѣхо́вныхъ скве́рнъ мя ѡ҆чи́стити: ꙗ҆́кѡ да хра́мъ по зна́ся, и҆ ѡ҆би́телище дх҃о́вное.
items.english_text: Deliver me from great affliction and from many serpentine temptations, O all-immaculate one, who didst bear for us the unwaning Light!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй мя Бц̃е, ꙗ҆́же еди́на ми́лостемъ исто́чникъ ро́ждьша: и҆ раздраше́ни дши мое́й лю́тꙋю болѣ́знь, и҆ недоꙋмѣ́ніе ср́чное, слеза́мъ стрꙋ́ю, и҆ оу҆миле́ніе прежде конца́ пода́ждь, и҆ лю́тыхъ и҆збавле́ніе.
items.english_text: *The Mountain shadowed by the grace of God...*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃аѧ Бц̃е, ѡ҆чи́сти на́съ, я́же прест҃а́го поро́жши пло́тію, оу҆подоби́тися хотя́щаго чл҃ком: и҆ нб҃номꙋ цр҃твію всѣ́хъ пока́зати причле́тники, твои́ми преч(ис)таа мл҃твами.
items.english_text: Having stirred up the godless and tempestuous sea by your coming, O divinely-chosen horses, Apostles of Christ: ye drowned the noetic enemy and drew men who were drowned unto salvation!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тлый на́мъ возсїѧй свѣ́тъ присносꙋ́щный, оу҆́тренюющимъ ѡ҆ сꙋдбахъ за́повѣдей твои́хъ: я́кѡ чл҃колю́бче Хе Бж҃е на́шъ.
items.english_text: Receptacles of the divine radiance of the Spirit: enlighten with the light of repentance my soul darkened and receptive of great passions, O divinely-blessed Apostles!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: На Кр(ес)тѣ пло́тію въздвиза́емъ: я҆зы́ки призвалъ еси́ невѣ́дꙋщыа тебе́, къ твое́мꙋ позна́нію: еди́нъ всѣ́хъ, еди́не многоми́лостиве Хе Бж҃е на́шъ.
items.english_text: Clouds that rained down the water of life: water divinely my soul dried up by the heat of passions, and cause it to bring forth an ear of the virtues of salvation, O all-lauded Apostles!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ́ наꙗдꙋщи стра́сть непра́веднымъ, пра́ведне Гн̃, ѡ҆правда́ся и҆́же пре́жде ѡ҆сꙋжде́нный Ада́мъ, и҆ зове́тъ: сла́ва распя́тію твое́мꙋ долготерпѣли́ве Гд̃и.
items.english_text: Prophets, Apostles, all-lauded martyrs, with the Mother of the Redeemer: pray earnestly that we may be delivered from sins, and eternal torment, and temptations, and troubles, and afflictions!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже ра́и Бг҃онасажде́нный, ꙗви́стися Мꙋ́нницы: стра́сти...
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to Saint Nicholas]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ...че́стныхъ, я́кѡ цвѣ́ты бл҃гоꙋха́нныа притяжа́вше: и҆́миже бл҃гоꙋха́ется вѣ́рныхъ дꙋша всяка.
items.english_text: As the fulfiller of all the commandments of God: help us who are upon earth to keep the ordinances that lead unto salvation, and deliver us from all approaching misfortunes, O father, hierarch Nicholas!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гоцвѣ́тнаѧ и҆ бл҃гоплодо́витаѧ древеса́: и҆́же вѣ́ры бессме́ртїа пло́дъ процвѣто́ша, и҆ злое коре́ніа и҆сто́ргоша: воспое́мъ Мꙋ́ники Гд̃ня.
items.english_text: Having finished thy course ever with Christ: direct our paths toward Him, so that fleeing from lawless wandering, we may attain unto salvific perfection, O God-bearing father Nicholas!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Жезлъ ч(ес)тный, и҆́же прозя́бшій цвѣ́тъ не оу҆вяда́ющій: я́кѡ оу҆зрѣ надре́во възно́сима того́, взпія́ше: вы́кѡ небезча́днꙋ мя яви.
items.english_text: Lulling all the wiles of the enemy to sleep by divine vigilance, O all-wise Nicholas: graciously shed grace upon all who keep vigil and hymn God and put thee forward as intercessor unto Him!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ме́ртва мя содѣ́ла и҆ногда́ во Еде́мѣ, вкꙋше́ніе я́въское: но я́же жи́знь ро́жшіа прч(ис)таѧ, и҆́же дре́вле дре́во оу҆ме́ршаго ѡ҆живи ма́тѣ, и҆ пода́ждь смире́ніе.
items.english_text: The Prophet, understanding by the Spirit of God, praised thee beforehand, O pure one, as the overshadowing mountain: cool me who am melted by the heat of many transgressions by thine intercession, O Virgin, sole correction of men!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Сѣ́ни ма преч(ис)таа ѡ҆б̾держа́ лю́тыа, и҆ воздвигни́ мя ѡ҆гнѧ страсте́й: и҆ и҆зба́ви мя плѣне́ніа, и҆ ѡ҆ѕлобле́ніа лꙋка́выхъ бѣ́совъ, бл҃го непотре́бнаго раба́.
items.english_text: *Thou Who didst enlighten with the radiance of Thy coming...*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Зѣ́ницы дши мое́и ѡ҆зари ч(ис)таѧ, зрѣ́ти ми пр(и)снѡ Бж҃тве́нную свѣ́тлость, и҆ тво́ю сла́вꙋ всенепоро́чнаѧ: я́кѡ да получꙋ ма́ть, и҆ вѣ́чнꙋю сла́вꙋ.
items.english_text: Dropping sweetness and fair joy, ye appeared as mountains, O all-blessed Apostles: crushing all the enemy's grief and delighting the faithful!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ́блакъ и҆ Ра́и, и҆ Две́рь свѣ́та: трапе́зꙋ и҆ рꙋ́но свѣ́тло: рꙋ́кꙋ внꙋтрь ма́нꙋ нося́щꙋ, гла́голю ми́ръ, ч(ис)таѧ Дв̃о Мт҃и.
items.english_text: Coming strangely unto Thine own, O Christ, they recognized Thee and cleaved sincerely unto Thee: therefore deliver me from that strange appearance, O divine Apostles of the Word!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆́браза спа́слъ еси́ ѡ҆ ки́та чл҃колю́бче, и҆ мене́ и҆з̾ глубинны прегрѣше́ніи възведи́ молю́ся.
items.english_text: Heal the hidden wounds of my soul by the prayers of those who clearly preached in the world Thy divine coming and passions, O Compassionate One, and Thy resurrection from the tomb!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же че́сти вся́коѧ превы́шшій, безче́стіе претерпѣ́лъ еси Хе, на Кр(ес)тѣ възне́сся: чл҃ки почести́ хотя́.
items.english_text: With all the Bodiless Ones, implore God the Word, Whom thou didst incarnate beyond word, O Virgin: that Thy servants may be freed from irrational deeds and fleshly passions!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Попне́въши мнѣ́ ѡ҆ставле́ніе тво́е ст҃іи всѣ́мъ: поравоще́нномꙋ лю́тымъ, Хе преблагіи.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to Saint Nicholas]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Болѣ́зными страда́ній, къниболѣ́зненнѣй преидо́сте ст҃іи ко́нчицѣ, неизрече́нней ра́дости сподо́бляеми.
items.english_text: Planted in the courts of the Lord, O father Nicholas, like a fruitful olive tree through grace: thou dost now anoint the faces of all with the oil of thy labors!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Разже́гшеся оу҆́гльми Хв̃ы любве́ премꙋ́дріи: тѣ́мъже въ ѻ҆́гнь вміта́еми, не ѡ҆паля́еми преспѣ́сте.
items.english_text: Make supplication now, O father, for thy servants: that we may receive remission of transgressions, and be delivered from surrounding afflictions and from every distress!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: По рожествѣ всенепоро́чнаѧ, я́коже и҆ пре́жде рождества́ пребы́стъ: Бг҃а бо родила́ еси, дре́вомъ чл҃ка спа́сшаго.
items.english_text: We pray thee, our fervent intercessor before God: leave us not, O holy one, without protection, but save us by thine accustomed prayer!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверне́на ма мнѡ́гими грѣхми, молю́ тя тебѣ́ еди́ной бл҃гой и҆ нескве́рнѣй сѣ́ни, ѡ҆мыи ѡ҆ всѣ́коѧ скве́рны хода́тайством си.
items.english_text: Light-formed temple of Christ, O Maiden: by thy prayers, O Virgin Mother, make us also temples unto the Father, and the Son, and the Spirit, performing things well-pleasing!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: О҆корми́телница ми бꙋди ч(ис)таѧ, вла́емомꙋ въ пꙋчи́нѣ лю́тыхъ жите́йскими нꙋждами: и҆ напра́ви къпри́сному приста́нищꙋ, и҆ спаси́ мя.
items.english_text: *The deepest abyss hath surrounded us...*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Треволне́ніа помышле́ній, и҆ стра́стемъ нахожде́ніа, и҆ глубинны грѣхо́вныѧ, ѡ҆каля́нꙋю ми дꙋ́шꙋ ѡ҆бурева́ютъ: помози́ ми ст҃аѧ Влч̃це.
items.english_text: With verbal nets ye caught the nations unto the knowledge of the creation revealed unto men, O divinely-blessed Apostles: whom pray ye earnestly for peace!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆сщ҃еннаѧ сѣ́ни показа́емаѧ Мрїе: ѡ҆скверне́нꙋю сластьми ѡ҆кая́нꙋю ми дꙋ́шꙋ ѡ҆чи́сти.
items.english_text: My humble soul, my wretched soul, my unrepentant soul: repent and cry out unto Christ: "I have sinned; pity me, O Master, by the prayers of Thine Apostles, for Thou art exceeding good!"

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Пе́щъ Сп҃се ѡ҆роша́шеся, ѻ҆́троци же ликовꙋ́юще поя́хꙋ: бл҃гослове́нъ еси́, Бг҃ъ ѡ҆ц҃ъ наши́хъ.
items.english_text: Thou Who of old didst bring forth for Israel the fountain of waters from the rock of joy, O Christ: tear asunder my darkness and grant me to bring streams of tears, that I may hymn and magnify Thy tender mercy!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Распина́емъ, тва́рь поколѣба́лъ еси, оу҆мерщвля́емъ, ѕміа оу҆мертви́лъ еси, бл҃гослове́нъ еси́ Хе, Бж҃е ѡ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: O Virgin, who didst bring forth the wellspring through the good pleasure of the Father: pray Him as Creator and God to save from temptations and tribulations those who have placed their hope in thee!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Напа́яется же́лчію долготерпѣ́ливый...
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to Saint Nicholas]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ...и҆стача́я ми сла́дость спасе́нную, сла́стною снѣ́дію лише́номꙋ ра́йскіа пи́ща.
items.english_text: Having a multitude of tender mercies, O Christ: drive away the multitude of my evils by the prayers of Nicholas, steering my life which is ever tempest-tossed by the waves of sin![^38]

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́нцы нагото́ми стрꙋ́жемни, ме́ртвости дѣ́телство ѡ҆ложи́ша, красотꙋже бж҃твеннꙋю ѡ҆ Бг҃а прія́ша.
items.english_text: Mightily didst thou trample the enemy, O wise one: strengthen us also to crush him by thy prayers, O Nicholas, who have been enriched with thee as a divine intercessor!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Стр(а)стьми, стра́сти Хв̃ы пр(и)итѣ́ подо́бящеся, добропобѣ́дніи Мꙋ́нци: ра́ны вра́жіа оу҆до́бъ претерпѣ́ша.
items.english_text: Having been the true chief hierarch of Myra: breathe fragrance into our spiritual senses and ever drive away harmful, foul-smelling passions, O father Nicholas!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Распина́ема зря́щи Гд̃а, непоро́чнаѧ Кꙋ́ще гла́ше: оу҆вы́ мнѣ Сн҃е мо́и: ка́ко оу҆мира́еши, живо́те и҆ наде́жда вѣ́рнымъ;
items.english_text: Great things hath Christ done unto thee, O pure Virgin: implore Him ever to magnify His rich mercies upon us, O woman full of the grace of God!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверне́нышася страстьми́ дꙋшꙋ мою, ѡ҆чи́сти Пр(е)ч(ис)таа Бг҃оневѣ́сто: и҆ оу҆ма́ моего лю́тое плѣне́ніе, и҆ ср́ца недоꙋмѣ́ніе, и҆ бѣсо́вскаѧ оу҆стремле́ніа, воско́рѣ потреби́ ч(ис)таѧ.
items.english_text: Christ the Lord, being the Wellspring of life, sent you forth, O disciples, like rivers watering with the knowledge of God all the universe, who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers, and exceeding praised!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ннаго страстьми пло́тскими, всенепоро́чнаѧ, ѡ҆живи оу҆ма́ моего, и҆ Бг҃ови оу҆го́днаа соверша́ти оу҆крѣпи́мя: да велича́ю тя, и҆ сла́влю присно бл҃гоꙋтро́біе твоє́.
items.english_text: Bearing mental fire in your hearts, the divine grace of Christ: ye burnt up the substance of godlessness, O disciples; therefore burn up my material passions, who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers, and exceeding praised!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ома́ти, я́же еди́на Бг҃а ро́жшіа, оу҆мертви́ плотскіа ми сла́сти: и҆ душевнꙋю ми скве́рнꙋ ѡ҆мы́и воско́рѣ: и҆ и҆стяза́ніа бѣсо́вскихъ лꙋка́выхъ и҆зба́ви, и҆ спаси́ мя.
items.english_text: Deliver me from fiery torment, O Christ, by the prayers of Thy glorious disciples, and cast me not away from Thy presence, O Lord, who cry out in repentance: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers, and exceeding praised!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ...[сп҃сшаго] дѣ́ти: и҆ громопла́меннꙋю пе́щь прело́жшаго нахла́[дъ]: ХА Бг҃а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те е҆гѡ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Deliver me, O Lord, from corrupting sins and passions, Who wast incorruptibly born of the Virgin, His Mother: granting incorruption unto those who sing Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers, and exceeding praised!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Е҆гда́ на Кр(ес)тѣ Сп҃се пригвозди́ся, колеба́шеся тва́рь: сл҃нце оу҆гаси́ лꙋча́: и҆ ка́меніе распада́шеся: и҆ а҆́дъ ско́рѡ ѡ҆бнажа́шеся, нетерпя́ держа́вы твоя́.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to Saint Nicholas]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: За ѡ҆сꙋжде́ніе принове́ннаго, ѡ҆сꙋжде́ніе пострада́, за пріе́мшаго наго́тꙋ, на́гъ на дре́вѣ ви́сяше ще́дре, веліѧ ти де́рзъжила, и҆ долготерпѣ́ніе.
items.english_text: By thy strong prayer, O wise one, firmly establish the steps of my heart upon the rock of the most bright commandments of God, saving me without fail from the malicious wiles of the evil enemy!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же безпло́тнымъ сожи́теліе, Хв̃и во́инни: Кр(ес)то́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆рꙋ́жіемъ ѡ҆болче́ни, къ сопротиво́борцꙋ ѡ҆полчи́шася: и҆ того́ кра́сными нога́ми попра́ша.
items.english_text: Ask for us remission of our many transgressions, deliver us from all the wicked things of life and from great temptations that come upon us, O sacred Nicholas, protector of all the faithful and firm foundation!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Стоя́хꙋ посре́дѣ сꙋди́ща, заколе́пни до́бліи, на оу҆ды раздро́бляеми, и҆ зда́ніе разоря́юще пре́лести, и҆ бѣсо́вскаа три́євища низлага́юще.
items.english_text: I am the wretched servant who hid the talent which I received to work good; and I fear the judgment there, wherein, O Judge of all, put me not to shame!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же нб҃съ превы́шшіа: воздвиже́на на дре́вѣ, и҆ низлага́юща воздвиже́ніа вра́жіа, зря́щи еди́наго вы́шняго: вопѣва́ше того́ велегла́сно.
items.english_text: Thee, the all-holy and all-immaculate shelter, we thy servants ever pray day and night with contrite thought, asking: grant deliverance from our sins, attending unto our prayers, O good one!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Воплоща́ется безпло́тныи и҆з тебе́ бг҃олѣ́пно, его́же моли при́чтаа, стра́сти моя́ плотскіа оу҆мертви́ти: и҆ ѡ҆живи́ти дꙋ́шꙋ мою́, оу҆мерщвле́ннꙋю грѣхми.
items.english_text: *In the furnace, the children of Israel...*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Неоу҆клѣка́ющаго сокруше́ніе Ада́ма пе́рвотнаго, Сп҃са, родила́ еси Пр(е)ч(ис)таа, и҆ Бг҃а, того́ оу҆моли, я́звы дꙋша мое́ѧ и҆зцѣли́ти, ня́же неисцѣ́лно влача́ща.
items.english_text: As a ray of the great Sun, He stretched you forth into all the universe, illuminating those who cry with faith, O Apostles: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Воздвигни́ сляца́юща мя къ глиби́нѣ злы́хъ, и҆ и҆́же мнѣ́ борющаго мя, побѣди́ ч(ис)таа, и҆...
items.english_text: As verbal shepherds, as lambs of the Shepherd, as sheep of the Lamb and our Savior Christ, O God-seeing Apostles: pray unceasingly to deliver me from the mental wolf and to make me partaker of the lot of the saved!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ...оу҆язвле́нную безамѣ́стными сластьми дꙋ́шꙋ мою́, преч(ис)таа непре́зри: но оу҆ще́дри, и҆ спаси́ мя.
items.english_text: O most wretched soul, sigh and cry unto the Lord: "I have sinned more than all, and done iniquity grievously; pity and save me, as the Good One of old, like the Publican, like the Thief, O Compassionate One, by the acceptable prayers of the Apostles!"

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И҆збавля́емся вся́ческихъ и҆скꙋше́ній, прч(ис)таа твои́ми къ Бг҃у бо́дреными мл҃твами, и҆́же тебе́ Бц̃у сꙋ́дꙋщии бл҃же́нную и҆ ѡ҆брадо́ванную.
items.english_text: With the Angels, O Mother of God, with the Apostles and martyrs and with the Prophets, implore Christ to save those who cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing praise and exalt Him supremely unto all ages!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ́ я́же видѣ́ Мѡѵсе́й, не ѡ҆пали́мую кꙋпи́нꙋ: и҆ лѣ́ствицꙋ ѡ҆дꙋшевле́ннꙋ, ю́же Іа́кѡвъ видѣ́: и҆ две́рь нб҃нꙋю, є́юже про́йде Хс̃ Бг҃ъ на́шъ: пѣ́сньми, Мт҃и ч(ис)таа велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to Saint Nicholas]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ка́кѡ лю́діе непокори́віи, предади́тъ Кр(ес)тꙋ, еди́наго долготерпѣли́ваго, во́лею ѡ҆бнища́вшаго, и҆ стра́сти пріе́мшаго: и҆ безстра́стію хода́таіа бы́вша, всѣ́мъ и҆́же ѡ҆ Ада́ма попо́лзшымся;
items.english_text: *Him of Whom the Angels stand in awe...*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Распя́тіе безче́стное прія́тъ Хс̃ пло́тію, почи́ти хотя́ ѡ҆безчество́ваннаго вра́гомъ безслове́сными чл҃вка, и҆ дре́внюю добро́тꙋ погуби́вша, сла́ва и҆́же па́че оу҆ма́ мардіи твоемꙋ.
items.english_text: Standing upon the mountain of divine virtues, known unto the ends of the earth by high miracles, O Nicholas, revealed by signs: therefore every nation honors thee unto all ages!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Сл҃нце незаходи́мое Хе: оу҆́тренева́вшихъ ктебѣ́, и҆ тмꙋ стра́даній прете́кшихъ ма́ніемъ тв̃оим, къ свѣ́тꙋ напра́влена еси́ во́я неизрече́нныя сла́вы и҆ свѣ́тлости, просвѣти́ оу҆́бо на́съ тѣ́хъ моли́твами.
items.english_text: In the visions of divine sweetness, O venerable one, thou didst hate the bitterness of passions and pleasures; deliver me from them, I pray Christ, to quell afflictions!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: По́лкъ Мꙋ́нкъ сщ҃енныхъ, тма́и мы́сленныхъ враго́въ побѣди́, и҆ тма́мъ примѣни́ся ст҃ыхъ си́лъ, и҆ тмы ѡ҆страсти́ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ, манове́ніемъ бж҃твенныѧ благода́ти при́нѡ.
items.english_text: As an unshakable pillar and confirmation of the faithful: ever strengthen me who am shaken by worldly evils and demonic blastings, O all-blessed Nicholas, by thy prayers!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́томъ Дв̃о, и҆́же и҆стебе́ воз[сія́вшаго]...
items.english_text: Heal the passions of my heart, O all-pure one, who didst bear the Physician of all; and show me to be a partaker of the righteous lot, O Virgin, having implored Christ!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ...[возсія́вшаго] свѣ́та, оу҆́мъ мо́й ѡ҆зари́, и҆ ср́це просвѣти́: тмꙋ ѿгонѧ́щи грѣхо́внꙋю: и҆ лѣ́ности моеѧ вся́кꙋ мглꙋ прогонѧ́щи.
items.english_text: Ye were shown forth as divine luminaries of the Holy Spirit and light-radiant beacons; and with the light-beholding vision of your honorable and all-wise preaching, O blessed ones, ye enlightened all the universe, having driven away the darkness of idolatry!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Грѣхолюби́въ сы́й, въ лѣ́ности пребыва́ю, и҆ сꙋди́ща чи́стая не оу҆мытнаго трепещꙋ́, вне́мже мя соблюди́ твои́ми ст҃ы́ми мл҃твами, его́неже исто́, не ѡ҆сꙋжде́нна: да я́ко предста́телницꙋ мою́, оу҆блажа́ю тя Прч(ис)таа.
items.english_text: Having become vines of the divine spiritual vineyard, ye brought forth the divine cluster, gushing forth the wine of salvation, O glorious Apostles; therefore deliver me from the drunkenness of pleasures!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Жа́ляшеся еди́нꙋю Дв̃о, и҆ незаиме́ннаго ѡ҆́ка твое́го Сн҃а, содѣ́лавъ мно́гіа грѣхи́ на земли́, и҆ сего́ ра́ди тебѣ́ вопію́: всемилосе́рдая Влч̃це, помози́ ми, и҆ тогда́шнаѧ бѣ́ды и҆зба́ви ма, и҆ спаси́ чи́стая.
items.english_text: I tremble, a wretch, as I contemplate that dread judgment of Thine, O my Christ; with foul deeds am I now surrounded, and condemned before judgment; therefore pity me by the prayers of Thine Apostles!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ко́ль стра́шенъ дн̃ь испыта́ніа Ѻ҆трокови́це: ко́ль оу҆жа́сенъ ѡ҆вѣ́тъ: ко́ль го́рка бѣ́да: кто́ постои́тъ про́чее, пр(е)ч(ис)таа Влч̃це; поми́лꙋй стра́стнꙋю ми дꙋ́шꙋ, и҆ пре́жде конца́ да́ждь ми ѡ҆ставле́ніе Прч(ис)таа.
items.english_text: Thou alone didst deify human nature, having given birth to the incarnate Word; Whom implore with the Apostles and martyrs, O pure and all-immaculate Virgin, for us who in faith bless and honor thee!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же свѣ́тъ поро́жшіа бж҃твенный, и҆́же и҆з Ѻц҃а возсїя́вшаго: ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю ми дꙋ́шꙋ ле́стьми жите́йскими, и҆ бы́вшꙋ врагѡ́мъ поруга́ніе, всенепоро́чнаа оу҆щедри́, и҆ свѣ́тꙋ покая́ніа спа́снаго подо́би чи́стая.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to Saint Nicholas]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Тебе́ и҆́же на дре́вѣ пригво́жшагося пло́тію, и҆ живо́тъ на́мъ пода́вшаго: я́кѡ Сп҃са и҆ Влч̃кꙋ поемъ непреста́нно.
items.english_text: As a light of Christ, as a light-radiant star, as a worker of miracles, as a wellspring of healings, as a speedy helper in sacred trials, as a most fervent deliverer unto those who call upon thee in afflictions, O father: we praise thee with sacred hymns!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Твои́мъ Кр(ес)то́мъ Хе, еди́но ста́до бы́сть Агглѡмъ и҆ чл҃кѡм: и҆...
items.english_text: Thee, the great shepherd and imitator of the Chief Shepherd Christ, we earnestly pray: protect thy servants from sacred misfortunes, O Nicholas, ever delivering them from all worldly assaults!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ...въ еди́но собо́рѣ Нб҃о и҆ земля́ веселя́ся, Гд̃и сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: Already the end draws near; why art thou slothful, O my soul? Why art thou not zealous to live in a manner pleasing unto God? Strive, arise at last, and cry: "O Lover of mankind, have compassion on me by the prayers of Nicholas, steering my life, for Thou art good!"

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section:
Another Canon to Saint Nicholas
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Страстоте́рпца Хв̃ы, прїи́дѣте лю́діе вси почте́мъ, пѣ́сньми и҆ пѣ́сньми дꙋхо́вными: просвѣти́лники ми́рꙋ, и҆ проповѣ́дники вѣ́рѣ: исто́чники приснотекꙋщїа, и҆́зныхже и҆сточа́ютъ вѣ́рнымъ и҆сцѣле́ніа. тѣ́хъ мл҃твами Хе Бж҃е на́шъ, смире́ніе да́рꙋй мі́рꙋ свое́мꙋ, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ве́лію мл҃ть.
items.english_text: Thou who didst bear the divine Light, enlighten me who am darkened by all the assaults of the evil one and living in despondency and having angered God, O all-immaculate one; and guide me unto good works, as thou art the cause of all good things!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Слава: И нн҃ѣ: Кр(ес)тобо: По: Прехвальніи мꙋнцы:
items.english_text: Glorious Apostles, who enlightened the universe: unceasingly pray that our souls may be saved!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: А҆́гньца А҆́гница, и҆ всенепоро́чнаа Влч̃ца, на Кр(ес)тѣ́ я́кѡ оу҆зрѣ́, видѣ́ніа не и҆мѣ́юща ни доброты́, оу҆вы́ мнѣ, пла́чꙋщи гла́ше: гдѣ́ доброта́ твоя́ за́иде сладча́йшій; гдѣ́ бл҃голѣ́піе; гдѣ бл҃года́ть ѡ҆бли́ціѧ зра́ка твое́го, Сн҃ꙋ мо́й вселюбе́зный;
items.english_text: Let us with one voice praise Peter and Paul, Luke, Matthew, Mark, John, Andrew, Thomas, Bartholomew, Simon the Canaanite, James, and Philip; and let all the apostolic company be worthily praised!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Снѣ́ди ра́ди, и҆зведе́ и҆з̾ ра́ѧ вра́гъ Ада́ма: Кр(ес)то́мъ же, Разбо́йника въведе́ Хс̃ во́нь: Помяни́ ма Гн̃, вопію́ща, въ цр(т)віи си.
items.english_text: Rejoice in the Lord, O martyrs: for ye contested with a good contest, ye resisted emperors and conquered the tyrant; ye feared not fire nor sword, nor wild beasts eating your bodies; sending up hymnody unto Christ with the Angels, ye received crowns from heaven. Ask that peace and humility and great mercy be granted unto our souls!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Распе́нся безгрѣ́шне, грѣхꙋ во́вѣкъ взя́лъ еси Хе, и҆ прободе́нъ въ ре́бра, спасе́ніа пото́ки и҆сточи́лъ еси, водꙋ́ же и҆ кро́вь: назида́ѧ сокруше́нныа, чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Virgin Mother of God! Rejoice, praise of all the universe! Rejoice, all-pure Mother of God, blessed one!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: На дре́вѣ пригвожда́емъ во́лею Іс҃е Бж҃е, все ѡ҆́лна́лъ еси ще́дре Ада́мово стра́стное размѣне́ніе, я́звами же ч(ес)тны́ми, бѣсо́вское мно́жество оу҆язвилъ еси.
items.english_text: Because of food the enemy led Adam out of Paradise; but through the Cross Christ led the Thief into it, crying: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: ...дꙋ́ги же ѿго́ните ѿ чл҃вѣкъ си́лою дх҃о́вною.
items.english_text: Having enlightened the ends of the earth with the divine rays of your teachings, ye dispelled the darkness of fierce godlessness; and having passed unto the unwaning Light, ye are faithfully blessed!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Е҆диноси́лнꙋю, единоче́стнꙋю, Тр(ои)цꙋ сла́ви тя, Ѻ҆ц҃а безнача́льнаго Бг҃а, и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ Дх҃а ст҃а́го: еди́но трисоста́вное Бг҃онача́ліе, вѣ́рою велича́емъ.
items.english_text: Possessing essential and hypostatic wisdom, O disciples of Christ, making all things wise: by your divine preaching ye made the world wise, and brought it unto divine understanding!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: На Кр(ес)тѣ тя пригвожда́ема, я́кѡ оу҆зрѣ Хе Бж҃е, я́же тебе́ ро́жшіа пло́тію, пла́чꙋщи вѣща́ше: что́ ти воздае́тъ Евре́йскій собо́ръ законопрестꙋ́пный;
items.english_text: Having endured tortures like the bodiless ones, O sufferers of Christ, ye mightily conquered all the bodiless enemies; therefore ye are worthily blessed unto the ages, O all-lauded ones!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: В ПЯТОКЪ, ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ: НА ГД̃И КО ЗВАХЪ:
items.english_text: Let us worship the Trinity, with the Father, the Son and the right Spirit: in an undivided, inseparable, and co-enthroned unity, O faithful, crying: Holy art Thou, O Thrice-Holy God!

items.office:
ON THURSDAY: CANONS TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Composition of Saint Theophanes.*[^37]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хиры сты́мъ Мꙋ́никѡмъ, Ст҃лемъ, и҆ Прпдбнымъ, гласъ, а҃. по: Прехвальніи мꙋнци:
items.english_text: We bless thee, O all-pure one, as thou didst prophesy; for thou didst bear God in the flesh, Whom the apostolic choir proclaimed: through whom ask for us remission of transgressions, O all-hymned one!

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́никовъ едине́нъное торжество́, стрꙋя́ми свои́хъ крове́й, множе́ство бѣсо́вское оу҆дави́ша, и҆ вся́каго ѡ҆стꙋпи́шася сꙋ́етныа же́ртвы, и҆ Ідо́лскꙋю разрꙋши́ша пре́лесть, терпѣли́вно пострада́вше: и҆ нн҃ѣ мо́лятся, дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ, ми́ръ и҆ ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_text: Thou didst stretch forth Thine all-pure hands on the Cross, O Christ, calling those who were far off from Thee and bringing them near unto Thee. Therefore I pray Thee: gather me who am captive unto passions, and grant me repentance that cleanses every defilement of passion!

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Пасты́ріе всесщ҃енніи: мꙋ́дрыми словесы́ и҆ оу҆че́ніи, всѣ́хъ наоу҆чи́ша, въ еди́нъствѣ Бж҃тво Тр(ои)ческое сла́вити: лицъ слія́ніа и҆ раздѣле́ніа, бж҃твеннѣ оу҆бѣга́юще, и҆ нн҃ѣ мо́лятся, дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ, ми́ръ и҆ ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_text: Thou didst lift up Thine all-pure palms upon the Tree, O Christ, and didst stain Thy fingers with blood, wishing to deliver the work of Thy divine hands, O Lover of mankind, Adam who was held by transgression in the kingdom of death; whom Thou didst raise up by Thine all-powerful authority!

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Преподо́бныхъ Сосло́віе, пло́тскаа хотѣ́ніа оу҆сыпи́ша: и҆ оу҆стремле́ніа ѡ҆бꙋзда́ша, житіе́ равноа́ггльное показа́вше, тѣ́мже я́къ жили́щехъ нб҃ныхъ нн҃ѣ ликоствꙋютъ, Хв̃и моля́щеся: дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́ши, ми́ръ и҆ ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_text: Thou didst deign to suffer for our sake, O Savior, Who art unchangeable in nature and impassible in Godhead; being crucified without beginning with evildoers, Thou Who art sinless; and the sun, unable to endure the audacity, was darkened, and all the earth was shaken, knowing Thee as its Creator!

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Ины стїхи́ры Мꙋ́ченникомъ. Гласъ то́иже.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Stavrotheotokia, Tone 1.*

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Мл҃твами Гд̃и всѣ́хъ Ст҃ы́хъ и҆ Бц̃а, тво́й ми́ръ да́ждь на́мъ, и҆ поми́лꙋй на́съ: я́кѡ еди́нъ ще́дръ.
items.english_text: The undefiled Virgin, seeing on the Tree of old Him Whom she bore of her seedless womb, unable to endure the piercing of her bowels, tearing her hair, cried: "O Thou Who upholdest creation by Thy nod, how art Thou raised upon the Cross as one condemned, wishing in every way to save mankind?"

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же наслѣ́дящи ва́ше и҆сповѣ́даніе ст҃іи, вѣко́вную оу҆оу҆страши́ си́лꙋ, и҆ ѡ҆ пре́лести чл҃вки свободи́, тѣ́мже и҆ гла́вами оу҆сѣка́еми, вопія́сте: да бꙋ́де Гн̃ же́ртва дꙋ́шъ на́шыхъ, бл҃гопрія́тна претобо́ю: я́кѡ тебе́ возлю́биша, нерадя́хꙋ ѡ҆вре́меннѣй жи́зни чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: "Offspring ineffable of the Father pre-eternal," cried the all-pure one, looking upon my Birthgiving on the Cross: "How do I not understand for what things the ungrateful people have rewarded Thee with these? But in that Thou art come to save Thy creation, Thou endurest all things, O long-suffering and compassionate One!"[^39]

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ добрѣ́й кꙋпли ва́шей ст҃іи: я́кѡ кро́ви да́сте, и҆ нб҃са наслѣ́довасте, и҆ вре́менно и҆скꙋси́вшеся, вѣ́чно ра́дꙋетеся. воисти́ннꙋ добра́ ваша кꙋ́пля: тлѣ́ннаа бо ѡ҆ста́вльше, нетлѣ́ннаа воспріѧ́сте: и҆ со А́гглы ликовствꙋ́юще, по́ете непреста́нно, Тр(ои)цꙋ єдиносꙋщнꙋю.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE APOSTLES
items.slavonic_text: Прехвальніи Мꙋ́нци, ва́съ ни земля́ потаи́ла е́стъ, но Нб҃о прія́тъ вы. ѡ҆ве́рзошася ва́мъ ра́йскія две́ри, и҆ вну́трь бы́вше, дре́ва живо́тнаго наслажда́етеся: Хв̃и моли́теся, дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ, ми́ръ и҆ ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_text: Heal my soul grievously ailing with wicked passions, O all-hymned one, who didst bear Christ, the Physician and Savior of all, Who heals every infirmity, and delivers from the malice of the devil and from death him who is wounded!

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃: Блажени я́же избра́лъ и҆ прія́лъ еси Гд̃ь. Покои́.
items.english_text: The Cross was planted upon Golgotha, and immortality blossomed forth for us from the ever-flowing fountain of the Savior's side!

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ка́я жите́йскаа пи́ща, пребыва́етъ печа́ли неприча́стна; ка́я ли сла́ва стои́тъ на земли́ непрело́жна; вся́ сѣ́ни немощнѣ́йша, и҆ вся сна́ преле́стнѣйша: въ еди́нъ ча́съ вся́ сіа́ сме́ртъ пріемле́тъ. но въ свѣ́тѣ Хе лица́ твое́го, и҆ въ наслажде́ніи твоя́ красоты́, и҆́хже избра́ поко́й, я́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: An indestructible wall is the precious Cross of the Savior unto us: for hoping in it, we all are saved!

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃: Дꙋша́ и҆́хъ во бл҃ги́хъ водворя́тся.
items.english_text: By the prayers, O Lord, of all the holy ones and of the Theotokos, grant us Thy peace, and have mercy on us, for Thou alone art compassionate!

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Никто́же безгрѣ́шенъ, никто́же ѡ҆ чл҃къ бы́стъ, то́кмо ты́ еди́не безсме́ртне. тѣ́мже рабы́ своя́ я́кѡ Бг҃ъ ще́дрыи, во свѣ́тѣ сподо́би, ликостоя́ніи А́гглъ твои́хъ, милосе́рдіемъ си презрѣ́ла согрѣше́ніа и҆́хъ, и҆ пода́я тѣ́м ѡ҆ставле́ніе.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Вои́стиннꙋ па́че оу҆ма́ Твоя́ чꙋдеса́ вся́каа, рожества́ твое́го Бг҃оневѣ́сто: я́же проповѣ́даша Про́рци вси: вся́ пресла́внаа, зача́тіе и҆ рж(ес)тво всепѣ́таѧ, недомы́сленно и҆ несказа́но, и҆́мже ми́ръ спа́слъ е́стъ, я́кѡ милосе́рдъ.
items.english_text: Beholding Thy unjust slaying, O Christ, the Virgin cried weeping unto Thee: "Sweet child, how dost Thou die unjustly? And how dost Thou hang upon the Tree, Who didst suspend all the earth upon the waters? Leave me not alone, O Benefactor rich in mercy, Thy Mother and servant, I pray!"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Страда́ніа похва́лою, и҆ вѣ́чнѣною по́честію, славніи страстоте́рпцы, оу҆вяза́вшеся тобо́ю Гн̃: терпѣ́ніемъ бо ра́нъ, беззако́нныхъ побѣди́ша, и҆ си́лою боже́ственною ѡ҆ нб҃съ побѣ́дꙋ прія́ша. тѣ́хъ моли́твами и҆ на́съ свободи́ ѡ҆ невиди́маго вра́га, Сп҃се, и҆ спаси́ на́съ.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 1:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́ко до́бріи конни, единомы́сленнѣ въкрови́вше, преще́ніа мꙋчи́телей не оу҆боя́стеся ст҃іи: прїидо́сте оу҆се́рдно къ Хв̃у, возе́мше ч(ес)тныи Кр(ес)тъ, и҆ ско́нчавше тече́ніе, съ нб҃се побѣ́дꙋ прія́сте. сла́ва оу҆крѣ́пльшемꙋ вы́ Хв̃у, сла́ва вѣнча́вшемꙋ вы́: сла́ва дѣ́йствꙋющемꙋ ва́ми всѣ́мъ и҆сцѣле́ніа.
items.english_text: When Thou wast crucified, O Christ, tyranny perished, and the power of the enemy was trampled down; for neither an Angel nor a man, but Thou Thyself, O Lord, hast saved us: glory to Thee!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Гавріи́лъ провѣща́вшꙋ ти́ Дв̃о, е́же: Ра́дꙋйся, со гла́сомъ воплоща́шеся всѣ́хъ Влч̃ка, въ тебѣ́ ст҃ѣ́м Киво́тѣ, я́коже рече́ пра́ведный Дв҃дъ: я́вися простра́ннѣйши нб҃съ, поноси́вши Зижди́теля своего́. Сла́ва все́льшемся въ тя. Сла́ва проше́дшемꙋ и҆з̾тебе́. Сла́ва свободи́вшемъ на́съ рж(ес)тко́м твои́мъ.
items.english_text: We venerate the Wood of Thy Cross, O Lover of mankind, for upon it Thou wast nailed, O Life of all; and Thou didst open Paradise, O Savior, unto the Thief who came to Thee in faith, and didst account him worthy of delight who confessed Thee: "Remember me, O Lord!" Accept also us who cry as that thief did: "We all have sinned; despise us not in Thy tender mercy!"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ра́нами Ст҃ы́хъ, я́же потебѣ́ пострада́ша, оу҆моле́нъ бꙋ́ди Гд̃и, и҆ вся́ на́ша болѣ́зни, и҆ стра́сти и҆сцѣли́: чл҃колю́бче мо́лимъся.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: The undefiled Ewe-lamb, beholding the Lamb and Shepherd hung dead upon the Wood, cried weeping, exclaiming with a mother's voice: "How shall I endure Thy condescension beyond word, O my Son, and Thy voluntary passions, O God most good?"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 1:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: The weapon of the Cross was revealed in battles of old unto the pious Emperor Constantine, an invincible victory over enemies for the sake of faith: the contrary powers tremble before it; this was salvation unto the faithful and the boast of Paul!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: Thou Who of old didst fashion Adam out of dust, wast struck on the cheek by a clay hand, O Compassionate One, and didst endure crucifixion, mockery, and wounds: O the wonder! O Thy great long-suffering! Glory to Thy life-giving passions, O Lord, whereby Thou hast saved us!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: ...и҆стача́ютъ и҆сцѣле́ніем блг҃ть. во́ини по́лци бж҃твенніи, я́ко сохр́анницы вѣ́ры.
items.english_text: With the praise of suffering and eternal honor, O glorious passion-bearers, having bound yourselves unto the Lord, O holy ones; for by endurance of wounds ye conquered the lawless, and by divine power received victory from heaven. By their prayers deliver us also from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save us!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Сме́ртную держа́вꙋ Хе оу҆праздни́лъ еси́, и҆ и҆́же въ тли́ бѣ́дꙋщіи не оу҆мира́[ют]: но живꙋ́тъ ѡ҆ тебѣ́. поко́и оу҆́бо Гд̃и дꙋша ра́бъ свои́, и҆ оу҆чини́ и҆́хъ въ ст҃ы́ми твои́ми, мл҃твами Бц̃а, да́рꙋя тѣ́мъ ми́лости твоя́.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́на крѣ́пкаѧ и҆ те́плаа предста́телнице, ро́дꙋ чл҃ческому Бц̃е Дв̃о: непреста́нно мл҃и со Пр(о)рки и҆ Мꙋ́нки, съ Ст҃лями и҆ По́стники и҆ Прпдбными: его́же роди́ла еси па́че естества́ Бг҃а сло́ва, спасти́ вся́ческая.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee dead, stretched out upon the Cross, O Christ, Thine all-immaculate Mother cried aloud: "O my Son, co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, what is this ineffable dispensation of Thine, whereby Thou hast saved with Thine all-pure hand the creation of Thy compassion?"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Въ сꙊбботꙋ, Кано́нъ ст҃ымъ Мꙋ́нкѡмъ, и҆ Ст҃лемъ, и҆ Прпдбнымъ, и҆ Оу҆со́пшымъ.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 1:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Столпо́мъ ѻ҆́гненымъ и҆ ѡ҆́блако, Іи҃ля наста́влялъ еси я́кѡ Бг҃ъ: мо́ре разве́ргъ, съ ѡ҆рꙋ́жіемъ Фараѡ́на глꙋби́ною покры́въ: воспое́мъ пѣ́снь побѣ́днꙋю: я́кѡ просла́вися.
items.english_text: When the Sun saw Thee, O Word, hung upon the Wood of the Cross, out of tender mercy, of Thine own will in the flesh: unable to bear the audacity, it was darkened, O Christ, Sun of glory! Therefore enlighten my darkened soul with Thine unapproachable light, and save me, I pray!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Щи́томъ бл҃гоче́стіа ѡ҆гра́ждьшеся бж҃твенніи Страда́лцы, оу҆стреми́шася къскоре́нію, погуби́шаже всю́ си́лꙋ вра́жію: пою́ще пѣ́снь побѣ́днꙋю, Хв̃у оу҆крѣ́пльшемꙋ и҆́хъ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆пасо́сте бж҃твенніи па́стыріе ста́до Бж҃іе, напая́ючи гл҃ньми, волны ѡ҆гоня́юще всеслове́съ сщ҃енныа, и҆ вселя́етеся ра́дꙋющеся въ ѡ҆гра́дѣ нб҃нію: и҆́деже е́стъ вели́кій па́стырь.
items.english_text: Having acquired thee as our protection, O all-pure one, by thy prayers we are delivered from misfortunes; for being ever preserved by the Cross of thy Son, as is due, we all piously magnify thee!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́сти, поще́ніемъ, и҆ болѣ́зньми оу҆мертви́вше пло́ти, бж҃твеннымъ манове́ніем: я́же ты́ посме́рти попе́ніи, и҆́же на́съ ра́ди мі́рка бы́вшаго ХА, всегда́ мл҃ите оу҆щедри́ти на́[съ].
items.english_text: *Let us sing a song of victory unto God Who helped Moses in Egypt and thereby drowned Pharaoh with all his army, for He is glorified!*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ме́ртвъ бы́въ, и҆ ме́ртвымъ дарова́лъ еси бж҃твеннаго твое́го живота́, и҆ бессме́ртнꙋю жи́знь, и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшая ѡ҆ житіа́ тлѣ́ннаго, цр҃твіа твое́го сотвори́ прича́стники, я́ко бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ, и҆ еди́нъ мно́гоми́лостивъ.
items.english_text: Having endured passions for our sake, Who art impassible by nature, and being crucified with evildoers, Thou didst put to death the serpent, the beginner of malice, O Word; and Thou hast saved those who worship Thee!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же любо́вію Хв̃ою оу҆вя́злаемыа Мꙋ́ннца, и҆ вѣнча́вшіася ѡ҆ Бг҃а же́ны: тебе́ всенепоро́чнаа и҆ добра́я въжена́хъ, вси Прпдбныа почита́ютъ, ра́дꙋющеся вѣ́рно, я́кѡ Чр҃цꙋ ст҃ꙋю.
items.english_text: Being the Dayspring of daysprings, O Jesus, Thou didst come unto our nature that was bound toward the setting of life; and the sun, seeing Thee crucified, hid its light!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ его́ на ря́дꙋ, и҆ и҆́деже нѣ́стъ Минѣ́а. Гла, а҃.
items.english_text: Having exchanged temporary death for eternal life, O noble, glorious sufferers, ye were accounted worthy of the heavenly Kingdom: therefore ye are blessed!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Вра́та сме́рти и҆ ве́ріа, свое́ю сме́ртію сокрꙋши́лъ еси бессме́ртне, вра́та ѡ҆ве́рзи я́же па́че оу҆ма́ бессме́ртія, Влч̃ко оу҆со́пшымъ, моли́твами Страстоте́рпецъ твои́хъ.
items.english_text: Bravely assimilating yourselves unto the passions of Christ, ye shrink not from earthly passions, O work of corruption; and by the Word ye drive away spirits, O holy martyrs!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Да бж҃твеннаго живота́ сподо́бися, соше́лъ еси късме́рти: тогда́же и҆спрове́ргъ сокро́вища, на́съ ѿтꙋ́дꙋ и҆зба́вилъ еси, ны́нѣже живода́вче преста́вленнымъ поко́й.
items.english_text: As an Ewe-lamb beholding the Lamb raised upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb exclaimed and cried: "Whither hath Thy beauty set, O Long-suffering One, O Son co-unoriginate?"

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Тьмꙋ мое́ тлѣ́нноєже, и҆ ме́ртвное възпріе́мъ, вънетлѣ́ніе ѡ҆блече́, и҆ къбесконе́чномꙋ житію́ и҆ блаже́номꙋ вознесе́, и҆́дѣже я́кѡ ще́дръ, и҆́хже прія́ поко́й.
items.english_text: Thou who alone didst give birth in time to the timeless God incarnate, O all-holy, all-pure one: heal the perennial passions of my most wretched soul!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ро́ждьши е́же ѡ҆ Бг҃а Бж҃іе сло́во вѣ́рніи...
items.english_text: The wounds of my soul, the perplexity of my heart, the darkening of thoughts, and the corruption of mind, do thou abolish, O all-pure one, as thou art merciful, by thy prayers!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: ...вѣ́рніи воспое́мъ: та́ко бо чи́стая, пꙋ́ть жи́зни оу҆ме́ршым бы́сть: я́же я́кѡ бг҃опріе́мницꙋ и҆ Бц̃у, просла́вимъ.
items.english_text: Thou who didst bear the Light, the Redeemer of my darkness and eternal torments: deliver me, O all-pure one, that being saved, I may hymn thy loving-kindness!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Да оу҆тверди́тся ср́це мое́ въ во́ли твое́и Хе Бж҃е: и҆́же на вода́хъ Нб҃о оу҆твержеи вто́рое, и҆ ѡ҆снова́выи на вода́ земли́ всемогіи.
items.english_text: In the deep of evils and the tempest of passions am I drowned; I call upon thy calm harbor, O all-pure one: save me, for thou art a harbor unto the faithful!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Мно́гіа мꙋ́ки претерпѣ́сте, и҆ благи́хъ мно́гихъ сподо́бистеся, мно́жество Мꙋ́нкъ сщ҃енное: тѣ́мже мл҃твами ва́шими, зомо́нꙋхъ безмѣ́рное мно́жество оу҆ничто́жте.
items.english_text: *Let my heart be established in Thy will, O Christ God: Who didst establish the second heaven upon the waters, and didst found the earth upon the waters, O All-powerful One!*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃енніи, ѡ҆дѣ́явшеся пра́ведно блг҃тію, и҆ весе́ліе кра́сное: Преподо́бныхъ собо́ръ, стяжа́вше: невеще́ственнымъ слꙋжи́телемъ оу҆подо́бишася.
items.english_text: Thou didst stretch forth Thy palms upon the Cross, and didst stain Thy divine fingers with blood: delivering the work of Thy hands, wounded Adam, by Thy good hand, O only Good and Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Хв̃ы Пр(о)рцы, бж҃твенныи Мꙋ́нци, Сщ҃нныхъ же́нъ сосло́віе: и҆́же пострада́вше мꙋ́жески, и҆ спо́стнѣ просла́вльшися, и҆́хже моли́твами ми́лости твоя́ Сп҃се всѣ́мъ да́рꙋй.
items.english_text: Thy side was pierced with a spear, correcting the slipping of the rib; He was raised upon the Wood Who received the fruit of the tree of old, and opened Paradise unto the prudent Thief!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ѡ҆ земля́ Хе чл҃ка, рꙋко́ю твое́ю созда́въ во́лею, я́кѡ ѡ҆ на́съ всѣ вѣ́рою преста́вльшыяся рабы́ твоя́, нб҃ныи бл҃гъ сподо́би.
items.english_text: Confirmations of the Church, foremost pillars of piety, destroyers of the enemy, martyrs of the Lord: with pure thought let us bless you in hymnody!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ороди́телнице неискособра́чнаа, проше́ніа всѣ́хъ принеси́, года́телю на́шемꙋ Кг҃ови, ро́жшемꙋ тя ѡ҆ оу҆тро́бы твое́ѧ: я́кѡ да ѡ҆брѧ́щемъ соверше́нное лю́ты и҆збавле́ніе.
items.english_text: As divine branches of the spiritual vineyard, O martyrs: the clusters brought forth by your endurance pour out wine that cheers the hearts of the faithful!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ еди́нъ сы́й бл҃гъ, я́кѡ еди́нъ многоми́лостивъ, и҆́же бл҃гоче́стно къ тебѣ́ ѿше́дшыхъ, къ не́ныхъ селе́ніи оу҆поко́и: и҆́деже неизрече́ннаа ра́дость и҆ наслажде́ніе:
items.english_text: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O all-hymned Virgin: Who by the Wood of His Cross made those who were corrupted through the fruit to become partakers of incorruption through divine grace!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: ...и҆́деже собо́ръ Мꙋ́ник всеве́села.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Theotokos]. Heirmos: The same.*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ еди́нъ яви́лся на земли́, Сп҃се мо́й безгрѣ́шенъ: и҆́же грѣхи́ мі́рꙋ взе́мляй, я́кѡ млрдъ: ѡ҆ сего́ преста́вльшихся вѣ́рою, дꙋ́ша поко́й, въ дво́рѣхъ ст҃ы́хъ ти́, въпи́щи ра́нѣтчи, чловеколю́бче.
items.english_text: Abolish all the fruitlessness of my barren mind, and show my soul to be fruitful in virtues, O most holy Mother of God, helper of the faithful!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Сме́рти держа́вꙋ разѡрѣ́: живо́тъ неразори́мый, всѣ́мъ вѣ́рнымъ и҆сточи́лъ еси́ Гд̃и: въ то́м оу҆́бо оу҆чини́, бл҃гоче́стно ѿше́дшаа, презира́ѧ прегрѣше́ніа, и҆ проща́ѧ грѣхи́ и҆ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Deliver me, O all-immaculate one, from every assault of many serpentine temptations, and from eternal fire and darkness, who didst bear the pre-eternal Light!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Безсѣ́мене зача́тъ ч(ис)таа, сло́во присносꙋ́щное, пло́тски къ на́мъ прише́дшее, и҆ сме́рти крѣ́пость разоршаго, и҆ ме́ртвымъ поко́й и҆ жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю, свои́мъ милосе́рдіемъ да́рꙋющее.
items.english_text: By the dread tribunal, O pure one, and by that unquenchable fire, and by the fierce account, I am wholly condemned: hasten to save me, O all-pure Sovereign Lady, thy servant!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
