items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ Гн̃ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ оу҆боя́хся: разꙋмѣ́хъ дѣла́ твоя́, Пр(о)ркъ гла́ше: и҆ просла́вих тя чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: That God might deify human nature, He became man; incorruptibly, O pure Virgin, thou didst contain Him beyond word: therefore with one voice we all the faithful bless thee!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Претерпѣ́ваше Мꙋ́нци вся́кіа ра́ны, нра́вомъ добле́ственныи, я́коже ѡ҆вча́та непоро́чнаа Хв̃и приведо́стеся: и҆́же за всѣ́ закала́емъся живо́тꙋ.
items.english_text: *I heard, O Lord, Thy report, and was afraid; I understood Thy works, cried the Prophet, and glorified Thy power, O Lover of mankind!*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃іа сло́ва науча́еми: дꙋша́ нб҃[есъ и҆з]ба́виша ѡ҆ оу҆зе́тъ лю́тнаго, и҆́хже бл҃гоче́стномꙋдреныхъ почита́емъ.
items.english_text: Being the righteous Lawgiver, Thou wast numbered with the lawless; Thou wast raised upon the Wood, O Benefactor Lord, wishing to justify all!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пцы Бж҃твеннымъ Дх҃омъ бы́вше, то́щи бж҃твеніи, крѣ́пко побѣди́сте дꙋ́ховъ лꙋка́вствіа, прпбныи блг҃тію.
items.english_text: All the angelic hosts were astonished, seeing Thee on the Cross with soldiers, O Sun, conquering the prince of darkness!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Having drawn grace through healings, the martyrs, receiving spiritual gifts, wash away from all soul-corrupting passions by the grace of God!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Having received the slumber of negligence, O passion-bearers, by the vigilance of divine faith ye lulled its assaults to sleep in a corner, and rejoicing ye suffered!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: "Woe is me, Child! How do I see Thee raised upon the Wood and put to death unjustly, Who grantest life?" cried the Virgin weeping!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Theotokos]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Преиспещре́на бж҃твенными добро́дѣтелми: родила́ еси Сло́во собезнача́льно Ѻц҃ꙋ, чи́стая Дв҃о, и҆же доброде́телми Нб҃са вои́стиннꙋ покры́вшаго, его́же моли при́снѡ, оу҆щедри́ти на́[съ].
items.english_text: O Virgin Theotokos, undefiled tabernacle: cleanse me who am defiled by transgressions with thy compassions, by the most honorable sprinkling, and give me a helping hand, that I may cry: Glory to thee, O pure Bride of God!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: O Virgin, thou wast revealed as a sanctified temple unto God, Who dwelt within thee beyond understanding; pray Him to cleanse me from the defilements of sins, that I may be known as a temple and a spiritual dwelling-place!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Have mercy on me, O Theotokos, who alone didst give birth unto the Wellspring of mercies; and heal the fierce sickness and heartache of my soul, grant me a stream of tears and compunction before the end, and deliverance from evils!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: O holy Theotokos, who didst bear in the flesh the All-Holy One Who willed to become like unto men: cleanse us, and by thy most pure prayers show all to be partakers of the heavenly Kingdom!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: *Make the bright and ever-existing Light to shine forth upon us who rise early at dawn unto the judgments of Thy commandments: for Thou art the Lover of mankind, O Christ our God!*[^41]

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Being lifted up in the flesh upon the Cross, Thou didst call the nations that knew Thee not unto the knowledge of Thyself: the only One of all, O only greatly merciful Christ our God!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: When the passion came upon Thee unjustly, O righteous Lord, Adam who was formerly condemned was justified, and cries aloud: "Glory to Thy crucifixion, O long-suffering Lord!"

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Like a paradise planted by God were ye revealed, O martyrs; the passions of the honorable ones, having acquired them as sweet-smelling flowers, whereby every soul of the faithful is filled with fragrance!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: As fair-flowering and fruitful trees that blossomed forth the fruit of the immortality of faith and uprooted the evil roots: let us hymn the martyrs of the Lord!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: The honorable rod who sprouted forth the unfading Flower, when she beheld Him lifted up upon the Tree, cried aloud: "Leave me not childless!"

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Theotokos]. Heirmos: Grant me Thy [peace]...*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: The tasting of the tree of old in Eden made me dead; but thou who didst bear the Life, O pure Mother, make me alive who was dead of old through the tree, and grant me humility!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Fierce gloom hath encompassed me, O most pure one; raise me up from the fire of passions, and deliver me from captivity and from the malice of evil demons, as I am an unprofitable servant!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Enlighten the pupils of my soul, O pure one, that I may ever behold the divine brightness and thy glory, O all-immaculate one, that I may obtain mercy and eternal glory!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Cloud, and Paradise, and Door of light, Table and radiant Fleece, Urn carrying within the Manna: I proclaim peace unto thee, O pure Virgin Mother!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: *As Thou didst save the type from the whale, O Lover of mankind: lead me up also from the deep of transgressions, I pray!*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Thou Who art higher than every honor didst endure dishonor, O Christ, being lifted up upon the Cross, wishing to honor mankind!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Grant Thy forgiveness unto me, as unto all the holy ones, who am enslaved unto evil things, O most good Christ!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: By the pains of sufferings ye passed over unto a painless end, O holy ones, being accounted worthy of ineffable joy!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Being kindled with the coals of the love of Christ, O all-wise ones: therefore cast into the fire, ye were not consumed, but prospered!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: After giving birth, O all-immaculate one, thou didst remain even as thou wast before birthgiving: for thou didst bear God, Who saved man by the Tree!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Theotokos]. Heirmos: As the Prophet Jonah...*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Defiled by many sins, I pray thee who alone art the good and undefiled tabernacle: wash me clean from every defilement by thy mediation!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Be thou a pilot unto me, O pure one, tossed about in the abyss of evils by worldly distresses; and direct me unto the eternal haven, and save me!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: The billows of thoughts, and assaults of passions, and depths of sin tempest-toss my wretched soul: help me, O holy Sovereign Lady!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: O Mary, who wast revealed as a sanctified tabernacle: cleanse my wretched soul that is defiled by pleasures!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: *The furnace was bedewed, O Savior, and the children, dancing in chorus, sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: When crucified, Thou didst shake creation; when slain, Thou didst put the serpent to death: blessed art Thou, O Christ, God of our fathers!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: The Long-suffering One was given gall to drink pouring forth saving sweetness for me, who was deprived of the food of Paradise through pleasurable eating!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: The martyrs, scraped while naked, put off the operation of mortality, and received divine beauty from God!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: In their sufferings assimilating themselves unto the passions of Christ, the gloriously victorious martyrs readily endured the wounds inflicted by the enemy!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Beholding the Lord crucified, the undefiled Ewe-lamb cried: "Woe is me, O my Son! How dost Thou die, O Life and Hope of the faithful?"

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Theotokos]. Heirmos: He Who in the furnace...*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Cleanse my soul that is defiled with passions, O most pure Bride of God; and swiftly destroy the cruel captivity of my mind, the perplexity of my heart, and the demonic assaults, O pure one!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: As I am slain by fleshly passions, O all-immaculate one, make my mind alive and strengthen me to accomplish things pleasing unto God, that I may magnify thee, O Virgin, and ever glorify thy loving-kindness!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: O Mother of God, who alone didst bear God: put to death my fleshly pleasures, swiftly wash away the defilement of my soul, deliver me from the torment of evil demons, and save me!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: Adorned with divine virtues, thou didst bear the Word co-unoriginate with the Father, O pure Virgin, Who truly covered the heavens with virtues; pray Him unceasingly to have compassion on us!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́днаго бл҃женны впещи́, сп҃с[шаго дѣ́ти...]
items.english_text: *Him Who wondrously saved the blessed children in the furnace...*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: *...and turned the roaring, flaming furnace into dew: hymn Christ God, and highly exalt Him unto all ages!*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: When Thou wast nailed to the Cross, O Savior, creation quaked; the sun quenched its rays, and the rocks were split, and Hades was swiftly despoiled, unable to endure Thy dominion!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: For the condemnation of the guilty one Thou didst suffer condemnation; for him who took on nakedness, Thou didst hang naked upon the Tree, O Compassionate One: great is Thy forbearance and long-suffering!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Companions of the bodiless hosts, soldiers of Christ: clad with the Cross as with an armor, ye drew up in battle array against the adversary, and trampled him under your fair feet!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: The noble victims stood in the midst of the tribunal, torn limb from limb, tearing down the edifice of deceit, and casting down the demonic altars!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Beholding the only Most High, Who is higher than the heavens, lifted up upon the Tree and casting down the arrogance of the enemy, she sang unto Him with a loud voice!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Theotokos]. Heirmos: Him before Whom tremble...*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: The Bodiless One is incarnate of thee in a manner fitting God; pray Him, O pure one, to put to death my fleshly passions and to make alive my soul that is deadened by sins!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Thou didst bear the Savior and God, Who healed the crushing of the first-fashioned Adam, O most pure one; pray Him to heal the wounds of my soul, which drag me down incurably!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Raise me up who am bowed down unto the depth of evil things, and conquer him who wars against me, O pure one, and despise not my soul that is wounded by shameful pleasures, O most pure one, but have compassion and save me!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: We are delivered from all manner of temptations, O most pure one, by thy vigilant prayers unto God, who judge thee to be the blessed and full-of-grace Theotokos!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: *Thee, whom Moses beheld as the unburnt bush, and the animate ladder which Jacob saw, and the heavenly gate through which Christ our God passed: in hymns, O pure Mother, do we magnify!*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: How did the disobedient people surrender unto the Cross the only Long-suffering One, Who voluntarily became poor and accepted passions, and became the Mediator of dispassion unto all who fell through Adam?

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Christ accepted dishonorable crucifixion in the flesh, wishing to rest man who was dishonored by the enemy through brute beasts and who lost his ancient beauty: glory to Thy compassion that is beyond understanding!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: O Christ, unwaning Sun: by Thy nodding Thou didst guide unto the light of ineffable glory and brightness the soldiers who rose early unto Thee and passed through the darkness of sufferings; therefore enlighten us by their prayers!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: The company of sacred martyrs conquered myriads of spiritual enemies, and was joined unto myriads of holy powers, ever dispelling the dark passions of our souls by the sign of divine grace!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Illuminate my mind and enlighten my heart with the Light that shone forth from thee, driving away the darkness of sin and banishing all the gloom of my slothfulness!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Theotokos]. Heirmos: Radiant cloud...*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Being a lover of sin, I abide in slothfulness, and I tremble before the inexorable tribunal, O pure one; preserve me uncondemned therein by thy holy prayers, that as my protectress I may call thee blessed, O most pure one!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Lamenting, O only Virgin, before the unslumbering eye of thy Son, having committed many sins upon earth, therefore I cry unto thee: All-merciful Sovereign Lady, help me, deliver me from the misfortunes of that time, and save me, O pure one!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: How fearful is the day of examination, O Maiden! How terrible is the account! How bitter is the misfortune! Who shall endure it, O most pure Sovereign Lady? Have mercy on my passion-plagued soul, and grant me forgiveness before the end, O most pure one!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear the divine Light Who shone forth from the Father: have compassion, O all-immaculate one, upon my soul that is darkened by worldly deceits and become a mockery unto enemies, and account it worthy of the light of saving repentance, O pure one!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Thee Who wast nailed in the flesh upon the Tree and didst grant life unto us, as Savior and Master we unceasingly hymn!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ, one flock was made of Angels and men; and in one assembly heaven and earth rejoice: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Passion-bearers of Christ, come, all ye people, let us honor them with spiritual songs and hymns: the luminaries of the world and preachers of the faith, the ever-flowing fountains from which healings pour forth unto the faithful! By their prayers, O Christ our God, grant peace unto Thy world, and great mercy unto our souls!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion.*

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: When the Ewe-lamb and all-immaculate Sovereign Lady beheld the Lamb upon the Cross having neither form nor beauty, she wept and cried: "Woe is me! Whither hath Thy beauty set, O sweetest One? Where is Thy majesty? Where is the grace of the countenance of Thine appearance, O my dearly-beloved Son?"

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: For the sake of food the enemy led Adam out of Paradise; but through the Cross, Christ led the Thief into it, who cried: "Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!"

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Being crucified, O Sinless One, Thou didst take away the sin of the world, O Christ; and pierced in the ribs, Thou didst pour forth streams of salvation, both water and blood, restoring the crushed, O Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же стра́стемъ оу҆подо́блшеся, во́лею пострада́вшему пло́тію, Мꙋ́нци славніи: при́нѡ стра́сти оу҆сыпля́ете неисцѣ́льныа, неве́ч[ерн...]
items.english_text: Being voluntarily nailed upon the Tree, O Jesus God, Thou didst completely undo, O Compassionate One, the passionate exchange of Adam; and by Thy precious wounds Thou didst wound the multitude of demons!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: Having assimilated yourselves unto the passions of Him Who voluntarily suffered in the flesh, O glorious martyrs: ye ever lull to sleep incurable passions and drive away illnesses from men by spiritual power!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: We glorify Thee, the Trinity of equal power and equal honor: God the unoriginate Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit; the one Godhead in three Persons do we magnify in faith!

items.office:
ON FRIDAY: CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^40]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: When she who bore Thee in the flesh beheld Thee nailed to the Cross, O Christ God, she wept and said: "What is this that the lawless assembly of the Hebrews returns unto Thee?"

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: *Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable Fathers, Tone 1.*

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: The united feast of the martyrs drowned the demonic multitude in the streams of their blood; they renounced every vain sacrifice and destroyed the idolatrous delusion, having suffered with endurance; and now they pray that there may be granted unto our souls peace and great mercy!

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: All-venerable pastors: by wise words and teachings ye taught all to glorify the Trinity in the unity of the Godhead, divinely avoiding both the confusion and division of Persons; and now ye pray that there may be granted unto our souls peace and great mercy!

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: The choir of venerable fathers lulled to sleep the fleshly desires and bridled their impulses, showing forth an angelic life; therefore they now dance in chorus in the heavenly mansions, praying unto Christ to grant unto our souls peace and great mercy!

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Martyrs, Tone 1:*

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: By the prayers, O Lord, of all the saints and of the Theotokos, grant us Thy peace, and have mercy on us, for Thou alone art compassionate!

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: They who inherited your confession, O holy ones, terrified the power of the ages and set men free from deceit; therefore, even when beheaded, ye cried: "Let the sacrifice of our souls, O Lord, be acceptable before Thee, for they loved Thee and disregarded temporal life, O Lover of mankind!"

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: O the good merchandise of yours, O holy ones! For ye gave your blood, and inherited the heavens; and having been tried for a time, ye rejoice eternally! Truly good was your merchandise: for leaving behind corruptible things, ye received incorruptible things; and rejoicing in chorus with the Angels, ye unceasingly sing unto the consubstantial Trinity!

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion: "The glory of the world..."*

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: O all-lauded martyrs, the earth hath not concealed you, but heaven hath received you! The gates of Paradise opened unto you, and being within, ye delight in the Tree of Life; pray Christ to grant unto our souls peace and great mercy!

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: What worldly pleasure abides unpartaking of sorrow? What glory stands upon earth unchanging? All things are frailer than a shadow, all things are more deceitful than dreams: in one hour death takes all these away! But in the light of Thy countenance, O Christ, and in the delight of Thy beauty, give rest unto those whom Thou hast chosen, for Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: No one is sinless, none among men hath lived without sin, save Thou alone, O Immortal One! Therefore, as the compassionate God, account Thy servants worthy of the light, in the choirs of Thine Angels, overlooking their transgressions in Thy loving-kindness, and granting them forgiveness!

items.office: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: Truly beyond understanding are all thy wonders, and the manner of thy birthgiving, O Bride of God, which all the prophets foretold: all-glorious was thy conception and birthgiving, O all-hymned one, incomprehensible and ineffable, whereby the world was saved, for He is merciful!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs, Tone 1:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: With the praise of suffering and eternal honor, O glorious passion-bearers, having bound yourselves unto the Lord; for by endurance of wounds ye conquered the lawless, and by divine power received victory from heaven. By their prayers deliver us also from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save us!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: Like good warriors, covered in blood with one mind, ye feared not the threats of the torturers, O holy ones: ye came zealously unto Christ, taking up the precious Cross; and having finished your course, ye received victory from heaven! Glory to Christ Who strengthened you! Glory to Him Who crowned you! Glory to Him Who works healings for all through you!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: When Gabriel proclaimed unto thee: "Rejoice!" O Virgin, with his voice the Master of all became incarnate within thee, the holy Ark, as righteous David said; thou wast revealed more spacious than the heavens, having borne thy Creator! Glory to Him Who dwelt within thee! Glory to Him Who came forth from thee! Glory to Him Who delivered us through thy birthgiving![^42]

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs, Tone 1:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ники Хв̃ы мл҃нма вси, прише́дше къни́мъ вѣ́рою: сі́и бо ѡ҆ на́ше спасе́ніе прося́тъ, сі́и...
items.english_text: By the wounds of the holy ones which they suffered for Thy sake, be Thou entreated, O Lord, and heal all our sicknesses and passions, O Lover of mankind, we pray!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Martyrs of Christ, entreat God for us, we all pray, coming unto you in faith: for they pray for our salvation, they pour forth the grace of healings, as divine regiments of soldiers, guardians of the faith!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Thou didst abolish the power of death, O Christ, and those who were in corruption die no more, but live in Thee; therefore, O Lord, give rest unto the souls of Thy servants, and rank them with Thy saints, by the prayers of the Theotokos, granting them Thy mercies!

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: O only strong and fervent protectress of the human race, Virgin Theotokos: unceasingly pray with the Prophets and Martyrs, with the Hierarchs, Ascetics, and Venerable ones, unto God the Word Whom thou, O Virgin, didst bear beyond nature, to save all!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: *With a pillar of fire and a cloud Thou didst guide Israel as God, parting the sea and covering Pharaoh with his arms in the deep: let us sing a song of victory, for He is glorified!*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Being shielded with the buckler of piety, the divine passion-bearers hastened unto the combat and destroyed all the power of the enemy, singing a song of victory unto Christ Who strengthened them!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Ye shepherded the flock of God, O divine pastors, watering it with sacred words, driving away the savage wolves, and rejoicing ye dwell in the heavenly sheepfold, where the Chief Shepherd is!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Having deadened the passions of the flesh by fasting and sufferings, through divine nodding: pray Christ Who became poor for our sake ever to have compassion on us!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Having become dead, Thou didst grant of Thy divine life and immortal life unto the dead; make those who have departed from corruptible life in faith partakers of Thy Kingdom, as Thou art compassionate and the only greatly merciful One!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: The women martyrs bound by the love of Christ and crowned by God, and all the venerable women, faithfully honor thee, O all-immaculate one and fair among women, rejoicing as unto the holy Queen!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Thou didst smash the gates of death and its bars by Thy death, O Immortal One; open the gates of immortality that are beyond understanding unto the departed, O Master, by the prayers of Thy passion-bearers!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: That we might be accounted worthy of divine life, Thou didst descend unto death; and overthrowing its treasuries, Thou didst deliver us from thence: now grant rest unto the departed, O Giver of life!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Taking upon Thyself my corruptible and dead darkness, Thou didst clothe it with incorruption, and didst raise it unto endless and blessed life, where do Thou give rest, as Thou art compassionate, unto those whom Thou hast received!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Having given birth unto God the Word of God, let us, the faithful, hymn her for thus the pure one became the way of life unto the dead: let us glorify her as the God-receiver and Theotokos!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: *Let my heart be established in Thy will, O Christ God: Who didst establish the second heaven upon the waters, and didst found the earth upon the waters, O All-powerful One!*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Ye endured many torments and were accounted worthy of many blessings, O sacred multitude of martyrs; therefore by your prayers destroy the immense multitude of evils!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: The hierarchs, being righteously clothed with grace and fair gladness, and the assembly of venerable fathers, became like unto the bodiless ministers!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Prophets of Christ, divine martyrs, choir of sacred women who suffered manfully and were glorified in fasting: by their prayers grant Thy mercies unto all, O Savior!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: O Christ, Who by Thy hand didst voluntarily fashion man from the dust of the earth: account Thy servants who have departed unto Thee in faith worthy of heavenly blessings!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: O unwedded Mother of God, offer the petitions of all unto God our Benefactor, Who was born from thy womb, that we may find perfect deliverance from evils!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [for the Departed]. Heirmos: Thou Who alone knowest the weakness of human...*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: As Thou alone art good, as Thou alone art greatly merciful: give rest in the heavenly mansions unto those who have piously departed unto Thee where the all-joyful assembly of the martyrs is!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Thou alone wast revealed upon earth as sinless, O my Savior, Who takest away the sins of the world as Thou art merciful; therefore give rest unto the souls of those who have departed in faith, in the courts of Thy saints, O Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Having destroyed the power of death, Thou didst pour forth indestructible life unto all the faithful, O Lord; place therein those who have piously departed, overlooking their transgressions and forgiving their sins, O Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Without seed thou didst conceive, O pure one, the ever-existing Word Who came unto us in the flesh and destroyed the might of death, granting rest and eternal life unto the dead through His tender mercy!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: *I heard, O Lord, Thy report, and was afraid; I understood Thy works, cried the Prophet, and glorified Thy power, O Lover of mankind!*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: The martyrs endured all manner of wounds, being noble in disposition, and like spotless lambs were brought unto Christ, Who was slain as the Life of all!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Being taught by the words of God, they delivered their souls from the bonds of the fierce one; therefore we honor these piously-minded ones!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Made strong by the divine Spirit, O divine fast-bearers, ye powerfully conquered the spirits of malice by grace, O venerable ones!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́выися живо́те на́шъ, во́лею на дре́вѣ: и҆́же вѣ́рою преше́дшаа, живо́тъ сподо́би вѣ́чномꙋ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Thou Who didst voluntarily die upon the Tree, O our Life: account those who have departed in faith worthy of eternal life, O Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...и҆ ѡ҆верзо́шася Гд̃а женскій ли́къ, страда́юще мꙋ́женски, ни побѣди́шася теле́сными сластьми ст҃ы́а, поспѣ́шницꙋ тя́ и҆мꙋща Преч(ис)таа.
items.english_text: They were opened and the choir of women opened unto the Lord, suffering manfully; nor were the holy women overcome by bodily pleasures, having thee as their helper, O most pure one!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́въ А҆́да, непобѣди́мою си́лою, въмѣне́нъ бы́стъ въ ме́ртвыхъ: еди́нъ сы́й свобо́дь Хе, дꙋ́ша свободи́ бл҃гочести́вѣ, я́же къ не́мъ ѡ҆сꙋжде́ніа, ст҃ы́хъ Мꙋ́никъ мольба́ми.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [for the Departed]. Heirmos: The mountain of grace...*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же всѣ́хъ сы́й я́кѡ Влч̃ка, прови́дѣцъ тонію, и҆́же ѡ҆ Ада́ма твое́го заколе́ніа и҆схо́дъ даде́й и҆ цѣнꙋ́, тѣ́мже мо́лимся твои́ми щедро́тами: преста́вльшыася поко́и, согрѣше́ніемъ подаѧ́ ѡ҆ставле́ніе.
items.english_text: Having put Hades to death by Thine unconquerable power, Thou wast numbered among the dead, Who alone art free, O Christ: by the entreaties of the holy martyrs, set free the souls of those who piously departed unto Thee from condemnation!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Прія́тъ Сп҃се мо́и, е́же въ гро́бѣ положе́ніе: и҆ и҆́же въ гро́бѣхъ жи́ти ѡ҆сꙋжде́нныя ме́ртвеца, я́кѡ Бг҃ъ воскреси́лъ еси́. нн҃ѣже жи́зни присносꙋ́щней сподо́би преста́вленныя: я́кѡ еди́нъ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: Being the Master and Foreseer of all, Who didst give Thyself as the price and ransom of the slaughter of Adam: therefore we pray Thee by Thy compassions, give rest unto the departed, granting remission of their sins!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́ся ро́дъ чл҃чіи рж(ес)тво́мъ ти́, та́ бо родила́ еси на́мъ воста́вныи живо́тъ, сме́рти потреби́теліе, и҆ къ жи́зни содѣва́ющіи въсхо́дъ: Бгороди́телнице, всенепоро́чнаа Влч̃це.
items.english_text: Thou didst accept burial in the tomb, O my Savior, and as God Thou didst raise the dead who were condemned to dwell in tombs; now account the departed worthy of eternal life, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тлый на́мъ возсїя́й свѣ́тъ присносꙋ́щный, оу҆́тренюющимъ ѡ҆ сꙋдба́хъ за́повѣдеи твои́хъ: я́кѡ чл҃колю́бче Хе Бж҃е на́шъ.
items.english_text: The human race was saved through thy birthgiving, for thou didst bear for us the resurrected Life, the Destroyer of death, Who made an ascent unto life, O Theotokos, all-immaculate Sovereign Lady!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Взꙋ́жшися бл҃гоче́стіемъ, не оу҆язвлени яви́стеся Мꙋ́нци, борца́ стрѣла́ми: и҆ побѣдоно́сци блг҃тію бы́вше, вѣ́ньца полꙋчи́сте.
items.english_text: *Make the bright and ever-existing Light to shine forth upon us who rise early at dawn unto the judgments of Thy commandments: for Thou art the Lover of mankind, O Christ our God!*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Помаза́ ма́стію бж҃твенною Гн̃, Сщ҃енники своя́, оу҆пасо́ша въ преподо́біи вѣ́рныхъ мно́жества, и҆ наста́вльшаа къ ѡ҆гра́дѣ нб҃сней.
items.english_text: Being girded with piety, the martyrs were revealed unwounded by the arrows of the adversary; and becoming victorious by grace, ye received crowns!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃еннотꙋ́нци сщ҃еннѣйшіи, преподо́бніи вси: я́же Дх҃а оу҆стра́ховляюще, и҆ цр҃твію прича́стници бы́вше, бж҃твенно прославля́етеся.
items.english_text: Anointing His priests with divine ointment, O Lord, they shepherded the multitude of the faithful in holiness and guided them unto the heavenly sheepfold!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же нн҃ѣ преста́вль, повеле́ніемъ си Влч̃ко Гд̃и, сподо́би цр҃твію твое́мꙋ, съ ст҃ы́ми: вся́ презира́ѧ и҆́м древная согрѣше́ніа.
items.english_text: Most sacred hieromartyrs and all venerable ones: living in the fear of the Spirit and becoming partakers of the Kingdom, ye are divinely glorified!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Е҆́же по́стомъ и҆ страда́ніемъ съсла́вꙋ ѡ҆брѣ́тше не́кую жены́, Пр(е)ч(ис)таа, тебе́ предста́телницꙋ и҆мꙋ́ще: смѣ́лꙋ дерзжа́вꙋ раздрꙋши́ша.
items.english_text: Account those who have now departed by Thy command, O Master Lord, worthy of Thy Kingdom with the saints, overlooking all their former transgressions!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆сѣ́кла ѿи́де сме́ртнаго, сме́ртъ прія́тъ, и҆ сме́рти жа́ло притꙋпи́лъ еси́: но са́мъ поко́и нꙋ́же прія́тъ живода́вче, Мꙋ́ченич(ескими) мольба́ми.
items.english_text: The women who found glory through fasting and suffering, O most pure one, having thee as their protectress, destroyed the bold dominion of the enemy!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвле́ніа чл҃ки свободи́выи, дꙋша́ вѣ́рно преста́вленныхъ, оу҆чини́ въ дво́рѣхъ ст҃ы́ ти, ѿню́дуже ѿбѣ́же вся́ка ско́рбъ и҆ весе́ліе водворя́ем.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [for the Departed]. Heirmos: O Thou Who didst enlighten the ends of...*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ра́й оу҆́бо и҆́же тобо́ю повѣ́шеномъ, я́кѡ ѡ҆ве́рзе: нн҃ѣ пріими́ дꙋша́ Влч̃ко, и҆́же кътебѣ́ вѣ́рою преста́вльшася, дая́ и҆́мъ, и҆ въ Цр҃кви пе́рвенецъ водвори́тися.
items.english_text: Thou didst accept death and blunt the sting of death; therefore give rest unto those whom Thou hast received, O Giver of life, by the entreaties of the martyrs!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆збавля́ющи, я́же на́ тя наде́ждꙋ держа́вꙋ и҆мꙋ́щи: къ приста́нищꙋ бж҃твенныа во́ля, ти́хо наста́ви, мт҃рній си де́рзновеніем къ Сн҃ꙋ своему́ Бг҃оневѣ́сто.
items.english_text: Thou Who didst free mankind from mortality: place the souls of those who have departed in faith in the courts of Thy saints, whence all sorrow hath fled and gladness abides!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пр(о)ркъ Іѡ́нѣ подо́бяся, вопію́: живо́тъ мо́й Бла́же, свободи́ и҆з тли́: и҆ спаси́ мя Сп҃се мі́ра, зовꙋ́ща: сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: As Paradise was opened unto him who was hung with Thee: receive now the souls of those who have departed unto Thee in faith, O Master, granting that they may dwell in the Church of the firstborn!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆медля́еми бы́вше, ра́нъ мно́ги навяза́ньми, жи́знь и҆стинную налѣ́до́васте вкꙋ́пѣ: моля́ще, спасти́ся всѣ́мъ на́мъ, Ст҃іи Мꙋ́нци.
items.english_text: Delivering those who hold fast their hope in thee: guide them quietly unto the haven of divine will by thy maternal boldness toward thy Son, O Bride of God!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Денни́ца свѣтоза́рнаа, позна́нни бы́сте на земли́, бл҃гоче́стіа свѣ́томъ ѡ҆заря́ете вѣ́рныа: пресла́вніи Хв̃ы ѡ҆рꙋ́жници, и҆ Ст҃ліе премꙋ́дріи.
items.english_text: *Imitating the Prophet Jonah, I cry: Deliver my life from corruption, O Good One, and save me, O Savior of the world, who cry: Glory to Thee!*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стра́нни ꙗ҆ви́стеся на земли́, и҆ гражда́не нб҃ніи, Бг҃оно́сніи по́стници, оу҆мертви́вше пло́ти мꙋдрова́ніа, воздержа́ніем и҆ емнире́ніемъ.
items.english_text: Being subjected to delay by the infliction of many wounds, ye inherited true life together, praying that we all may be saved, O holy martyrs!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Невече́рнемꙋ ти свѣ́тꙋ, и҆ пи́щи и҆стиннѣй, и҆́же преста́ви вѣ́рныа, покажи́ прича́стники чловеколю́бче: и҆ сты́хъ собо́рѡмъ си́хъ причти́.
items.english_text: Ye were recognized upon earth as radiant morning stars, illuminating the faithful with the light of piety, O glorious warriors of Christ and all-wise hierarchs!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пострада́вшаа крѣ́пко, и҆ порти́вшася те́плѣ: тебѣ́ всенепоро́чнѣи, приведо́шася Хв̃и, всепѣ́таа Бгороди́тельнице, Вели́ческихъ Цр҃ь.
items.english_text: Ye were revealed as strangers upon earth and citizens of heaven, O God-bearing ascetics, having put to death the wisdom of the flesh through abstinence and humility!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ милосе́рдъ, преста́вленнымъ да́рꙋй прегрѣше́ніа проще́ніе, и҆ вѣ́чное наслажде́ніе подава́я: и҆́деже сїя́етъ лицꙋ́ твое́го свѣ́тлость, и҆ ѡ҆заря́етъ страстоте́рпца твоя́.
items.english_text: Show those whom Thou hast translated in faith to be partakers of Thine unwaning light and true delight, O Lover of mankind, and number them with the choirs of the saints!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Кро́вію и҆́же ѡ҆ ре́бра твое́го и҆сте́кшею, мі́ръ и҆скꙋпи́лъ еси́, вѣ́рою оу҆со́пши оу҆́бо Хе, и҆зба́ви тлѣ́ною стр(ас)теи твои́хъ: ты́ бо кꙋ́пнꙋ за всѣ́хъ себе́ дал еси́.
items.english_text: Those women who suffered valiantly and strove fervently were brought unto Christ through thee, O all-immaculate and all-hymned Mother of God, the Queen of glorious deeds!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...пе́рвѣе, и҆ дх҃а дарова́вый, и҆ къ земли́ низпа́дша лю́тѣ, па́ки ѡ҆бнови́выи краснѣ́йше: нн҃ѣ дꙋ́ша преста́вльшихся са́мъ поко́и.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [for the Departed]. Heirmos: The lowest abyss hath compassed us about, and...*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ ѡ҆дѣя́нная ч(ис)таа, ея́же ра́ди на́мъ восіѧ́, сѣдя́щымъ въ тмѣ́ и҆ сѣ́ни сме́ртнѣ, пра́вды незаходи́мое сл҃нце: ты́ бо на́шего спасе́ніа хода́таица была́ еси́.
items.english_text: As Thou art merciful, grant unto the departed remission of sins and bestow eternal delight, where the brightness of Thy countenance shines and illuminates Thy passion-bearers!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ пещи́ ѻ҆́трокъ твои́хъ Сп҃се, неприкосну́ся, ни вреди́ и҆́хъ ѻ҆́гнь, тогда́ тріе́ я́кѡ еди́нѣми оу҆сты поя́хꙋ, и҆ бл҃гословля́хꙋ, гл҃юще: бл҃гослове́нъ Бг҃ъ ѡ҆ц҃ъ на́шыхъ.
items.english_text: With the blood that flowed from Thy side Thou didst redeem the world; therefore deliver those who have fallen asleep in faith from corruptible passions, O Christ, for Thou didst give Thyself as a ransom for all!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆скꙋси́вшеся я́ко зла́то въ ѻ҆гни́, Мꙋ́нницы, всѣ́ми мꙋ́ками, свѣ́тлѣйшіи вся́каго зла́та, я́ве бж҃ію бж҃твенною яви́шася: я́ко сокро́вищахъ нб҃сныхъ съхране́ни бы́ша.
items.english_text: Thou Who in the beginning didst fashion me with Thine all-pure hands and didst bestow a spirit, and when I had fallen grievously unto the earth didst renew me most beautifully: now do Thou Thyself give rest unto the souls of the departed!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ Сщ҃енницы, я́кѡ бж҃тве́нніи служи́теліе бы́вше, вси Ст҃ліе Сщ҃енніи: принесо́сте Бг҃ꙋ же́ртвы безкро́вныа, и҆ лю́ди оу҆па́се: и҆́дѣже вели́кій па́стырь велича́етеся.
items.english_text: We hymn thee, O pure one clad with glory, through whom the unwaning Sun of Righteousness shone forth unto us who sit in darkness and the shadow of death: for thou wast the Mediatress of our salvation!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Покори́вшеся стра́стем пло́ти, безстра́стіемъ я́ко крѣ́постію, Преподо́бніи ѡ҆болче́шеся, сожи́теліе А́ггломъ яви́шася, и҆́хже мл҃твами Хе, и҆зба́ви на́съ ѡ҆ нахожде́ній.
items.english_text: *The fire did not touch nor harm Thy children in the furnace, O Savior; then the three sang as with one mouth, and blessed, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́дѣже пи́ща е́стъ та́иннаа, и҆ и҆́дѣже сїя́етъ свѣ́тъ лица́ твое́го Хе, и҆́же ѡ҆ на́съ преста́вльшаяся въ вѣ́рѣ, бл҃года́тели всели́: сла́вити бл҃гоче́стно твою́ благосты́ню.
items.english_text: Tried as gold in the fire by every torment, O martyrs, ye were manifestly revealed more radiant than any gold by divine grace, being preserved in the heavenly treasuries!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Тебе́ вси ст҃аѧ преч(ис)таа, ст҃ы́ѧ жены́...
items.english_text: Being priests and divine ministers, all ye holy hierarchs offered unbloody sacrifices unto God, and shepherded the people where the Chief Shepherd is magnified!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Тебе́ вси ст҃аѧ преч(ис)таа, ст҃ы́ѧ жены́...
items.english_text: Subduing the passions of the flesh and clad with dispassion as with strength, the venerable ones were revealed as companions of the Angels; by their prayers, O Christ, deliver us from assaults!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Тебе́ вси ст҃аѧ преч(ис)таа, ст҃ы́ѧ жены́...
items.english_text: Where the mystical food is, and where the light of Thy countenance shines, O Christ: settle those who have departed from among us in faith, O Benefactor, that they may piously glorify Thy goodness!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...жены́ и҆ мꙋ́же добро́тꙋ: ликꙋ́я съ А́гглы ра́достно, и҆ Бг҃а славосло́вятъ ро́жшагося пло́тію и҆з тебе́, за мл҃рдіе мно́гое.
items.english_text: Thee, O holy, most pure one, do all the holy women both women and the beauty of men, dancing in chorus with the Angels, joyfully praise God Who was born in the flesh of thee out of great loving-kindness!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Лꙋча́ми преч(ис)тыа сла́вы твое́ѧ ѡ҆зари́тися Хе, и҆́же тебе́ ра́ди мнѡ́стіа, ктебѣ́ ѿше́дшымъ дава́й, не подо́би сꙋмнѣ́нки възыва́ти тебѣ́: хвали́мый ѡ҆ц҃емъ Бг҃ъ бл҃гослове́нъ еси́.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [for the Departed]. Heirmos: Thee, O Mother of God, we faithful perceive...*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́мкъ Ада́мъ въи́стинꙋ бы́стъ, Ада́мовъ содѣ́телю: и҆́же я́кѡ ѡ҆у҆́бо Ада́мовъ еди́нъ потреби́лъ еси́, тѣ́мъжетя мо́лимъ: преста́вленнымъ поко́й въпи́щи ра́нѣтчи Хе, я́кѡ еди́нъ многосе́рдъ.
items.english_text: Grant unto those who have departed unto Thee to be illuminated with the rays of Thine all-pure glory, O Christ, that they may cry unto Thee without doubt: Blessed art Thou, O God praised by the fathers!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же на́шꙋ есте́ственную не́мощь, еди́нъ свѣ́дый Хе Бг҃ъ, бл҃гъже и҆ мл҃тивъ: въ цр҃тви преста́вль еси́, и҆́деже свѣ́тъ незаходи́мый присвѣ́тлаетъ лица́ твое́го, оу҆чини́ Хе: хвали́мый ѡ҆ц҃емъ, Бже и҆ препросла́вле.
items.english_text: Thou didst truly become Adam, O Creator of Adam, and didst abolish the debt of Adam, therefore we pray Thee: grant rest unto the departed, crying unto Thee, O Christ, for Thou alone art greatly merciful!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Зако́нꙋ сѣ́ни, и҆ дре́вніа гада́ніа, твои́мъ преидо́ша рождество́мъ, Бг҃ома́ти, ты́ бо на́мъ бж҃твенныа бл҃года́ти свѣ́тъ възія́ла еси́: и҆́мже дре́внихъ и҆зба́вихомся, възпѣва́юще Бг҃а препросла́вленнаго.
items.english_text: Thou Who alone knowest our natural weakness, O Christ God, good and merciful: place the departed in Thy Kingdom, where the unwaning light of Thy countenance shines, O Christ: praised by the fathers, O God highly exalted!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Е҆го́же оу҆жаса́ются А́ггли, и҆ вся́ во́инства, я́ко тво́рца и҆ Гд̃а, по́йте сщ҃енніи: просла́вите ѡ҆тро́цы: бл҃гослови́те лю́діе: и҆ превозноси́те его́ въвѣ́ки.
items.english_text: The shadow of the Law and the ancient riddles passed away through thy birthgiving, O Mother of God, for thou didst cause the light of divine grace to shine forth unto us, whereby we were delivered from the ancient things, hymning God Who is highly exalted!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Лько́ва зе́ліа преидо́ша невре́дно, и҆ коно́бокъ врѣ́ніа претеко́ша крѣ́пко, мꙋ́нцы вси: прохлажда́еми ѡ҆гне́мъ бж҃твеннаго...
items.english_text: *Him before Whom Angels and all the hosts tremble as their Creator and Lord: priests, hymn Him; children, glorify Him; people, bless and highly exalt Him unto all ages!*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Дал Пр(о)рко́м своимъ предвѣ́дѣтъ да́льная, и҆ ст҃ла своя́ оу҆мꙋдри́лъ еси́ Сщ҃енно, тѣ́хъ моли́твами Хе Бж҃е, просвѣти́ срца вѣ́рно пою́щихъ тя.
