items.english_text: All the martyrs passed through the herb-potions unharmed, and steadfastly endured the boiling caldrons, being gloriously refreshed by the fire of the divine Spirit! pre-eminently of the Spirit!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Распе́нше себе́ Поще́ніи миро́ви, жи́вотъ премі́рный нашѣдо́васте вои́стиннꙋ: я́коже ѡ҆ вѣ́ка, и҆́же всѣ́хъ Бг҃у, оу҆годи́вшимъ, пр(и)сно и҆ пра́ведно.
items.english_text: Thou didst give unto Thy prophets to foresee things far off, and didst sacredly make wise Thy hierarchs; by their prayers, O Christ God, enlighten the hearts of those who faithfully hymn Thee!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же созда́выи чл҃вка ѡ҆ земля́ бг҃одѣ́лно: я́же ѿземля́ преста́ви вѣ́рныя, я́ко бл҃гъ, пи́щи ра́йстѣи сподо́би: вся́ презира́ѧ, я́же ѡ҆ни́хъ согрѣше́ніа.
items.english_text: Having crucified yourselves unto the world by fastings, ye truly inherited transcendent life, even as from the ages all who have pleased God have done, ever and righteously!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Добро́тꙋ тя́ и҆ непоро́чнꙋ ч(ис)таѧ въжена́хъ, жены́ пострада́вшаа, зна́юще тебѣ́: моли́твы ты́я тобо́ю къ Бг҃у, ср(ѣ)тиша всѣ́дъ, рабѡ́мъ ти Дв̃о.
items.english_text: Thou Who didst fashion man from the dust in a manner worthy of God: as Thou art good, account the faithful whom Thou hast translated from earth worthy of the delight of Paradise, overlooking all their transgressions!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Предста́теля Сп҃се де́сныѧ, вѣ́рою ѡ҆правда́въ, моли́твами страстоте́рпецъ, я́же преста́ви вѣ́рныа, покажи́, пою́щихъ: вся́ дѣла́ Гд̃на, Гд̃а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те его́ въвѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Knowing thee to be the beauty and undefiled among women, O pure Virgin, the women who suffered offered their prayers through thee unto God, meeting all the needs of thy servants!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Скве́рнꙋ вся́ ткои́хъ ра́бъ оу҆со́пшыхъ, твое́го чл҃колю́біа росо́ю ѡ҆мы́въ, до́бри тя́ восхвали́ти, пою́щихъ: бл҃гослови́те вся́ дѣла́ Гд̃на Гд̃а, по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те его́ въвѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [for the Departed]. Heirmos: The children in the furnace...*

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же сме́рти и҆ живо́тꙋ, и҆ ме́жи вся́кꙋю вла́стъ, я́же в̾вѣ́рою оу҆со́пшыа, твое́го зва́ніа полꙋчи́ти бл҃говоли́, зовꙋ́щихъ: бл҃гните вся́ дѣла́ Гд̃на Гд̃а, по́йте и҆ превозноси́те его́ въвѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Having justified them by faith, O Savior, by the prayers of the passion-bearers, show those whom Thou hast translated to be of the right hand, singing: Hymn the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and highly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Спасе́нію хода́таица на́мъ бы́стъ всенепоро[чная]...
items.english_text: Having washed away every defilement of Thy departed servants with the dew of Thy love for mankind, grant them to praise Thee worthily, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn and highly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: В СУББОТУ ВЕЧЕРЪ НА МАЛОЙ ВЕЧЕРНИ НА ГД̃И КО ЗВАХЪ:
items.english_text: Thou Who hast dominion over death and life, and between all things: deign that those who have fallen asleep in faith may obtain Thy calling, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, hymn and highly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office:
ON SATURDAY: CANON TO THE HOLY MARTYRS, HIERARCHS, VENERABLE ONES, AND THE DEPARTED
*Composition of Saint Joseph.*[^43]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хиры воскресны, на д҃. Гласъ, в҃.
items.english_text: Thou wast the Mediatress of salvation unto us, O all-immaculate one...

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пе́рвовѣчномꙋ ѿ Ѻц҃а, ро́ждшемся Бж҃ію Сло́вꙋ, вопло́щшемся ѿ Дв҃ы Марїа, прїиди́те поклони́мся: распя́тіе бо претерпѣ́въ, погребе́нію предаде́ся, я́ко са́мъ восхотѣ́: и҆ воскре́се и҆зме́ртвыхъ, спасе́ мя блꙋжда́ющаго чл҃ка.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Stichera, on 4, Tone 2:*[^44]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Хс̃ Сп҃съ на́шъ, пригво́ждься на Кр(ес)тѣ, е́же на́ны рꙋкописа́ніе растерза́: и҆ сме́рти держа́вꙋ оу҆праздни́ е́стъ. Покланя́емся тридне́вномꙋ е҆го́ воста́нію.
items.english_text: Unto the pre-eternal Word of God born of the Father, Who was incarnate of the Virgin Mary, come, let us bow down: for having endured crucifixion, He was committed unto burial as He Himself willed; and He rose from the dead, and saved me, wandering man!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Съ Арха́гглы воспое́мъ Хв̃о воскресе́ніе: то́й бо е́стъ и҆збави́тель, и҆ Сп҃съ дꙋша́мъ на́шым: и҆ въ сла́вѣ стра́шнѣй и҆ крѣ́пцѣй си́лѣ, па́ки гряде́тъ сꙋди́ти мі́рꙋ, е҆го́же созда́.
items.english_text: Christ our Savior, being nailed upon the Cross, tore up the handwriting against us, and abolished the dominion of death: we bow down before His third-day resurrection!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Вели́каго та́инъства ви́дя чꙋдеса́, проповѣ́даю Бж҃тво: ви́дя стр(ас)ти, не ѡ҆мета́юся чл҃ве́чества. Емману́илъ оу҆́бо е҆сте́ствѣ две́ри ѡ҆ве́рзе я́ко чл҃къ, дѣ́вства же затво́ры неразве́рзе...
items.english_text: With the Archangels let us hymn the resurrection of Christ: for He is the Redeemer and Savior of our souls, and in fearful glory and mighty power He comes again to judge the world which He created!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...я́кѡ Бг҃ъ, но та́ко и҆зложе́нъ про́йде, я́коже слꙋ́хомъ вни́де: та́ко и҆ роди́ся, я́коже и҆ зача́ся: безстра́стно вни́де, и҆ не и҆зрече́но и҆зы́йде, по глаго́лемꙋ Проро́кꙋ: та́ две́рь затворена бꙋ́детъ, е҆́юже никто́же про́йдетъ, то́кмо еди́нъ Гд̃ь Бг҃ъ Іи҃левъ: и҆ мѣ́яй ве́лію мл҃ть.
items.english_text: Beholding the wonders of the great mystery, I proclaim the Godhead; beholding the passions, I deny not the humanity. For Emmanuel opened the gates of nature as man, but as God He unloosed not the bars of virginity but He passed through in like manner as He was formed, even as He entered through hearing; and in like manner He was born as He was conceived: impassibly He entered, and ineffably He came forth, according to the Prophet who said: "This gate shall be shut, and no man shall pass through it, save only the Lord God of Israel, Who hath great mercy!"

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Воскрніе твоє́ Хе Сп҃се, всю́ просвѣти́ вселе́ннꙋю: и҆ призва́ свое́ созда́ніе, всеси́лне Гд̃и сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: Thy resurrection, O Christ Savior, enlightened the whole universe and recalled Thine own creation: O All-powerful Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ины стіхи́ры Бци, Гласъ, то́иже. Подо́бенъ: Егда́ ѡ҆ дре́ва:
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Theotokos, Tone 2.*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...[ѡ҆ѕло́]бленнымъ покро́въ и҆ застꙋпле́ніе, и҆ же́злъ слѣпы́мъ, Мт҃и Бг҃а вы́шняго, ты́ еси́ преч(ис)таа: потщи́ся, мо́лимъся, спасти́ся рабо́мъ ти́.
items.english_text: The joy of all who sorrow, protectress of the wronged, feeder of the hungry, consolation of travelers, haven of the tempest-tossed, visitor of the sick, shelter and defense of the afflicted, and staff of the blind: thou art all these, O Mother of the Most High God, most pure one; hasten, we pray thee, to save thy servants! shelter and defense of the afflicted, and staff of the blind: thou art all these, O Mother of the Most High God, most pure one; hasten, we pray thee, to save thy servants!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ. Лицꙋ́ твое́мꙋ помоля́тся бога́тіи лю́дстіи.
items.english_text: No other refuge unto God and the Good One have we acquired, save thee, O Virgin, Bride of God: cast us not away from thy protection, nor put us to shame who run with love unto thy patronage, O Mother of God; therefore hasten to our aid, and grant relief unto us, O Savior!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́но прибѣ́жище чл҃цы къ Бг҃у, и҆ бл҃гѣ не стяжа́хомъ мы́, ра́звѣ тебе́ Бг҃оневѣ́сто, не ѡ҆верзи́ на́съ ѿ твое́го застꙋпле́ніа, ниже́ посрами́, любо́вію прибѣга́ющихъ предста́тельствꙋ твое́мꙋ, Мт҃и Бг҃а на́шего: его́же ра́ди потщи́ся напо́мощъ, и҆ ѡ҆трати́ на́съ Сп҃се.
items.english_text: The fear of many-formed temptations and dire distresses now tempest-toss me, and the deep of despair drowns me; the winter of my transgressions grievously troubles me: anticipate and deliver me who am tempest-tossed, O only calm of the faithful, and lead me up unto the haven of the high divine calling!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ. Помянꙋ́ и҆́мя твое́ въ вся́комъ ро́дѣ и҆ ро́дѣ.
items.english_text: Thou prayest for all, O Good One, who run with faith unto thy mighty protection: for we sinners have no other refuge unto God, in perils and sorrows an ever-present deliverance, laden with many sins, O Mother of the Most High God; therefore we fall down before thee: deliver thy servants from every distress![^45]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стра́хъ мно́го ѡ҆бра́зныхъ и҆скꙋше́ній, и҆ нꙋ́жныхъ бѣ́дъ, нн҃ѣ мя́ ѡ҆бурева́ютъ, и҆ глꙋбинна по[топля́етъ...]
items.english_text: Then, "Now lettest Thou depart": Trisagion. Troparion: "When Thou didst descend unto death..." Theotokion: "All beyond comprehension..." And the dismissal. all-immaculate one, and abiding in brightness unto endless ages: therefore, O pure Virgin, do we ever bless and highly exalt all Thy works unto all ages!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...топля́етъ мя́ ѿчаа́ніа: зи́ма прегрѣше́ній мои́хъ лю́тѣ мя́ смꙋща́етъ: предвари́ и҆ и҆зба́ви мя́ ѡ҆бурева́ема, еди́на вѣ́рны[мъ] тишино́: и҆ къ приста́нищꙋ вы́шняго Бж҃твеннаго зва́ніа възведи́.
items.english_text: *The life-receiving, ever-flowing fountain, the radiant, all-golden lampstand, the animate Church, the all-pure tabernacle more spacious than heaven and earth: as the Theotokos, let us, the faithful, magnify!*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: За всѣ́хъ мо́лишися Бл҃гаѧ, прибѣга́ющихъ съ вѣ́рою, въ держа́вныи ти покро́въ: и҆́но бо прибѣ́жище неи́мамы грѣ́шніи къ Бг҃у, въ бѣ́дахъ и҆ ско́рбехъ при́снѡ и҆збавле́ніе, ѡ҆бремене́ніи грѣхы́ мно́гими, Ма́ти Бг҃а вы́шняго, тѣ́мже ти́ припада́емъ, и҆зба́ви ѡ҆ вся́каго ѡ҆бстоя́ніа рабы́ своя́.
items.english_text: Let us honor the sacred roots of the sacred martyrs, rejoicing: their sufferings and wounds, nailings and banishments, and blessed slaughter, whereby they were revealed as heirs of Christ!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Та́жъ, Нн҃ѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: Тр(свя)тое, тропа́рь: Е҆гда́ сни́де къ сме́рти: Бг҃ро: Вся́ па́че смы́сла: И ѿпꙋ́стъ.
items.english_text: As priests of God, the divine servants clothed themselves in righteousness, living ever in holiness; having finished their course in the midst of torments, they rejoice, magnifying Christ!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...всенепоро́чнаѧ, и҆ бнепрехо́димыѧ вѣ́ки, пребыва́ющее въ свѣ́тлости: тѣ́м тя Дв҃о ч(ис)таѧ, пр(и)сно всѧ дѣ́ла бл҃вимъ, и҆ превозно́симъ въвѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Having become the divine lips of the Lord, all the Prophets pre-announced His light unto all; with them now rejoice also the women who struggled valiantly and pleased God by fasting!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Живопріе́мный исто́чникъ приснотекꙋщъ: свѣтоно́сный свѣ́тилникъ всезлатыи: Цр҃ковь ѡ҆дꙋшевленꙋю: сѣ́нь пр(е)ч(ис)тꙋю, нб҃се и҆ земли пространнѣйшꙋю: Бг҃ꙋ вѣ́рніи велича́емъ.
items.english_text: O Power that rulest over all: show those whom Thou hast translated from earth to be partakers of Thy Kingdom with Thy saints, and in Thine exceeding goodness overlook the deeds committed by them, O God of all!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃енныхъ мꙋ́никъ почте́мъ сщ҃еннаа коре́ніа, ра́дꙋющеся: страда́ніаже, и҆ ра́ны, пригвожде́ніа, и҆ и҆згна́ніа, и҆ заколе́ніе бл҃же́нное: и҆́мже Хр(ис)тꙋ наслѣ́дници яви́шася.
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear the natural and timeless Light: loose all my temporal transgressions by thy prayers, and enlighten my mind that is ever darkened by slothfulness, that I may hymn thee and faithfully magnify thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ Сщ҃енницы Бж҃іи ѡ҆блеко́шася въ пра́вдꙋ, бж҃твенніи оу҆го́дницы, я́ко въ при́снѣ пожи́вше, и҆́же въпо́стѣ мꙋ́къ сконча́вшіися, ра́дꙋются ХА велича́юще.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [for the Departed]. Heirmos: The image of the pure...*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆стнѣ́ бж҃твеннаѧ Гд̃ня бы́вше, Про́рцы вси, всѣ́мъ его́ пребо́вѣстноша свѣ́тъ: сни́миже нн҃ѣ веселя́тся и҆ же́ны, крѣ́пко подвиза́вшіися, и҆ по́стомъ Бг҃ови оу҆годи́вшаа.
items.english_text: Spare Thine own creation, O God, as Thou art the Lover of mankind and merciful, and give rest unto all Thy servants where all the martyrs rejoice: those who have departed from temporal things in faith, O greatly merciful One!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же всѣ́ми цр(с)твꙋющаѧ си́ло, твое́го цр҃твіа покажи́ прича́стники, съ ст҃ы́ми твои́ми, и҆́же ѡ҆ земля́ преста́вилъ еси́, и҆ содѣ́ланнаа и҆́ми, Бж҃е всѣ́хъ, пре́зри премного́ю блг҃отію.
items.english_text: Possessing an abyss of mercy that overflows the transgressions of Thy servants: receive those whom Thou hast chosen, O Lover of mankind, and give them rest in the bosom of Abraham, and show them in Thy light with Lazarus!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же свѣ́тъ ро́жшіа е҆сте́ственныи безлѣ́тный, вся́ моя́ разрѣши́ лѣ́тнаа согрѣше́ніа, во́ими мольба́ми: и҆ оу҆́мъ мо́й просвѣти́, ѡ҆мрача́емый при́нѡ лѣ́ностію: да тя пою́ и҆ вѣ́рно велича́ю.
items.english_text: Having become the Redeemer and Savior of the human race by reason of the Crucifixion: as the Benefactor, account those who have now departed from among us worthy of divine delight, and of incorruptible life, and gladness, and brightness!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пощади́ я́кѡ Бг҃ъ чл҃колю́бецъ и҆ ми́лостивъ, твое́ созда́ніе: и҆ поко́й всѣ́хъ ра́бъ твои́хъ, и҆́деже Мꙋ́нци вси веселя́тся: вѣ́рою преста́вленныя ѡ҆ вре́менныхъ, многоми́лостиве.
items.english_text: O the wonder of thy wonders that are beyond understanding! For thou alone, O Virgin, hast given all under the sun to understand the newest wonder, O most pure one, of thine incomprehensible birthgiving; therefore we all magnify thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆мѣ́яй ми́лостемъ бе́зднꙋ, преисполня́ющꙋю, ра́бъ твои́х прегрѣше́ніа: пріи́мъ и҆́хже и҆збра́, поко́й, А҆враа́мꙋ на ло́нѣ чл҃колю́бче, и҆ съ Ла́зарем, въ свѣ́тѣ твое́мъ яви́ли.
items.english_text: Passion-bearers of Christ, come, all ye people, let us honor them with spiritual songs and hymns: the luminaries of the world and preachers of the faith, the ever-flowing fountains from which healings pour forth unto the faithful! By their prayers, O Christ our God, grant peace unto Thy world, and great mercy unto our souls!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...[бы́ша], про́сятъ ѿ Сп҃са смире́ніа, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ве́лію ми́лости.
items.english_text: These warriors of the great King opposed the decrees of the torturers, manfully disregarding torments, and trampled down all deceit: worthily were they ask of the Savior peace, and great mercy unto our souls!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ва́съ прехвальніи Мꙋ́ннци, ни ско́рбъ, ни тѣснота́, ни гла́дъ, ни гоне́ніе, ниже́ ра́ны, ни я́рость звѣ́ре́й, ни ме́чь, ниже́ ѻ҆́гнь прѣтя́й, разлꙋчи́ти ѡ҆ Бг҃а возмого́ша, любо́вію же па́че я́же къ не́мꙋ, я́кѡ въ чꙋжи́хъ подви́гшеся теле́сѣхъ: естества́ забы́сте, и҆ сме́ртъ презрѣ́сте. тѣ́мже досто́йно трꙋдѡ́мъ ва́шымъ мздꙋ прія́сте, небе́сному Царствію наслѣ́дницы бы́вше: Хв̃и моли́теся ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шыхъ.
items.english_text: O all-lauded martyrs, neither tribulation, nor distress, nor famine, nor persecution, nor wounds, nor rage of wild beasts, nor sword, nor threatening fire were able to separate you from God; but rather by the love which ye had toward Him, as though contesting in bodies not your own, ye forgot nature and despised death! Therefore ye worthily received the reward of your labors, having become heirs of the Kingdom of Heaven: pray Christ for our souls!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Всехвальніи Мꙋ́нци ѡ҆ Гд̃ѣ: я́кѡ подвиго́мъ до́брымъ подвиза́стеся: проти́вистеся Цр҃ем, и҆ мꙋчи́теля побѣди́сте: ѻ҆гня́ и҆ меча́ не оу҆страши́стеся, и҆ звѣре́й диви́ихъ, снѣда́ющихъ тѣлеса́ ваша: Хв̃и съ А́ггелы пѣ́снь возсыла́юще, съ нб҃се вѣ́ньца прія́сте, испроси́те, дарова́тися на́мъ ве́ліей ми́лости.
items.english_text: All-lauded martyrs in the Lord: for ye contested with a good contest; ye opposed kings and conquered torturers; ye feared not fire nor sword, nor savage wild beasts that devoured your bodies! Sending up hymnody unto Christ with the Angels, ye received crowns from heaven: entreat that great mercy may be granted unto us!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сло́вомъ Сп҃се мо́й я҆вля́еши, я́кѡ ты́ еси́ всѣ́хъ Воскр(ес)ніе: сло́вомъ Сло́ве Ла́заря ѡ҆ ме́ртвыхъ возста́вилъ еси́. тогда́ ме́ртвіи ѡ҆ гро́бъ воскресо́ша, врата́ же а҆́дова сокрꙋши́шася. тогда́ со́нъ чл҃кѡмъ сме́ртъ я҆вля́шеся. но на спасе́ніе своего́ созда́ніа, а҆ не на ѡ҆сꙋжде́ніе прише́дый, и҆́хже избра́ поко́й, я́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: By Thy word, O my Savior, Thou dost reveal that Thou art the Resurrection of all; by a word, O Word, Thou didst raise Lazarus from the dead! Then the dead arose from the tombs, and the gates of Hades were shattered; then death appeared unto men as sleep! But Thou Who camest for the salvation of Thine own creation and not for condemnation: give rest unto those whom Thou hast chosen, for Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дуйся ѡ҆ на́съ ст҃ая Бц̃е Дв̃о: чи́стый совꙋ́де все́й вселе́ннѣй:
items.english_text: Rejoice on our behalf, O holy Virgin Theotokos, pure vessel of the whole universe: unquenchable lampstand, dwelling-place of the Uncontainable One, indestructible Church: Rejoice, from whom was born the Lamb of God, Who takes away the sins of the whole world!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: свѣ́ще не оу҆гаси́маѧ: вмести́лище невмѣсти́маго: Цр҃кви неѡбори́маѧ: Ра́дуйся, и҆з̾нея́ же роди́ся А҆́гнецъ Бж҃іи, взе́мляй грѣхи́ всего́ мі́ра.
items.english_text: Unto Thee, O Savior, we pray: account the departed worthy of Thy sweet communion, and settle them in the mansions of the venerable ones, with Thy saints and in the heavenly habitations, in Thy tender mercy overlooking their iniquities and granting them rest!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Поко́йны, Гласъ, а҃. По: Прехвальніи мꙋнцы:
items.english_text: Higher than visible things are Thy promises, O Savior, which eye hath not seen, and ear hath not heard, neither have entered into the heart of man; account the departed unto Thee worthy to obtain Thy sweet communion, and grant them rest!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ́ Сп҃се мо́лимъся, твое́го сла́дкаго прича́стіа, преста́вльшыяся сподо́би: и҆ всели́, въ ѡ҆би́телехъ Прпдбныхъ, съ ст҃ы́ми твои́ми, и҆ въ нб҃ная жили́ща: бл҃гоꙋтро́біемъ свои́мъ, презира́я беззако́ніа, и҆ пода́я и҆́мъ поко́й.
items.english_text: Rejoicing in Thy Cross, and hoping in Thy Cross, Thy servants have departed unto Thee, O Lover of mankind: grant them now forgiveness of their transgressions through Thy Cross and the blood poured out for the life of the world, in Thy loving-kindness forgiving their sins and enlightening them with the light of Thy countenance!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃і. Блажени я́же избра́ и҆ прія́ и҆́хъ Гд̃ь.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Па́че ви́димыхъ, твоя́ Сп҃се ѡ҆бѣща́ніа: и҆́хже ѡ҆́ко не ви́дѣ, и҆ оу҆́хо не слы́ша, и҆ на ср́це не взы́иде чл҃кꙋ. и҆́хже сла́дкаго ти прича́стіа, полꙋчи́ти сподо́би, ктебѣ́ преста́вльшыхся, и҆ пода́ждь и҆́мъ поко́й.
items.english_text: Entreat Christ, Whom thou didst bear, O Virgin Mother, to grant forgiveness of sins unto all who faithfully hymn thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ. Дꙋ́ша и҆́хъ во бл҃ги́хъ водворя́тся.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 2:*[^46]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Кр(ес)тꙋ́ твоемꙋ веселя́щеся, Кр(ес)тъ твое́мꙋ надѣ́ющеся раби твои, кътебѣ́ преста́вишася чловеколю́бче, я́же ны́нѣ я́зва кле́ніе, тѣ́хъ прегрѣше́ніемъ, Кр(ес)тъ тво́й да́рꙋй, и҆ кро́вь пролія́нную за мі́рскіи живо́тъ: бл҃госе́рдіемъ свои́мъ проща́я согрѣше́ніа, и҆ просвѣща́я свѣ́томъ лица́ твое́го.
items.english_text: *Composition of Saint John of Damascus.*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Хр(ис)та́ оу҆моли́, твое́ рожде́ніе, Мт҃и Дв̃о: согрѣше́ніемъ прощ[еніе...]
items.english_text: Unto the pre-eternal Word of God born of the Father, Who was incarnate of the Virgin Mary, come, let us bow down: for having endured crucifixion, He was committed unto burial as He Himself willed; and He rose from the dead, and saved me, wandering man!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: В СУББОТУ ВЕЧЕРЪ НА ВЕЛИЦѢЙ ВЕЧЕРНИ НА ГД̃И КО ЗВАХЪ:
items.english_text: Christ our Savior, being nailed upon the Cross, tore up the handwriting against us, and abolished the dominion of death: we bow down before His third-day resurrection!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пе́рвовѣчномꙋ ѿ Ѻц҃а, ро́ждшемся Бж҃ію Сло́вꙋ, вопло́щшемся ѿ Дв҃ы Марїа: прїиди́те поклони́мся, распя́тіе бо претерпѣ́въ, и҆ погребе́нію предаде́ся, я́кѡ са́мъ восхотѣ́: и҆ воскре́се и҆з̾ме́ртвыхъ, спасе́ мя блꙋжда́ющаго чл҃ка.
items.english_text: With the Archangels let us hymn the resurrection of Christ: for He is the Redeemer and Savior of our souls, and in fearful glory and mighty power He comes again to judge the world which He created!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Хс̃ Сп҃съ на́шъ, пригво́ждься на Кр(ес)тѣ, е́же на́ны рꙋкописа́ніе растерза́: и҆ сме́рти держа́вꙋ оу҆праздни́ е́стъ. Покланя́емся тридне́вномꙋ е҆го́ воста́нію.
items.english_text: *Other Eastern Stichera. Composition of Anatolius, Patriarch of Constantinople. Tone 2:*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Съ Арха́гглы воспое́мъ Хв̃о воскресе́ніе: то́й бо е́стъ и҆збави́тель, и҆ Сп҃съ дꙋша́мъ на́шым: и҆ въ сла́вѣ стра́шнѣй и҆ крѣ́пцѣй си́лѣ, па́ки гряде́тъ сꙋди́ти мі́рꙋ, е҆го́же созда́.
items.english_text: Thee Who wast crucified and buried, the Angel proclaimed, O Master, and said unto the women: "Come and see where the Lord lay! For He is risen as He said, for He is all-powerful!" Therefore we bow down before Thee, the only Immortal One: O Giver of life, Christ, have mercy on us!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ины стїхы востѡчны. Твореніе Анатоліа Патріарха Цариграда. Гла, тоиже.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross Thou didst abolish the curse of the tree; by Thy burial Thou didst put to death the dominion of death; and by Thy resurrection Thou didst enlighten the human race: therefore we cry unto Thee: O Benefactor, Christ our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...вен вдо́мъ Гд̃нь, и҆ припаде́мъ гл҃юще: и҆́же на дре́вѣ распны́йся, и҆ и҆зме́ртвыхъ воскре́съ, сы́й въ нѣ́дрѣхъ Ѻ҆́тчихъ, ѡ҆чи́сти грѣхи́ на́ша.
items.english_text: The guards were terrified, O Lord, and the gates of death and the gatekeepers of Hades were afraid when they beheld Thee: for Thou didst shatter the brazen gates and didst crush the iron bars, and didst lead us forth from darkness and the shadow of death, and didst break our bonds asunder! Singing a song of victory, we cry: enter into the house of the Lord, and let us fall down, saying: Thou Who wast crucified upon the Tree, and didst rise from the dead, and art in the bosom of the Father: cleanse our sins!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пре́йде сѣ́нь зако́ннаѧ, бл҃гти прише́дши, я́коже бо кꙋпи́на не сгора́ше ѡ҆паля́ема: та́кѡ и҆ Дв̃а родила́ еси́, и҆ Дв̃ою пребы́стъ. възмѣ́сто столпа́ ѻ҆́гненнаго, пра́ведное возсіѧ́ сл҃нце, въмѣ́сто Мѡѵсе́а Хс̃, спасе́ніе дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion (Dogmatikon):*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Воскресе́ніе твоє́ Хе Сп҃се, всю́ просвѣти́ вселе́ннꙋю, и҆ призва́ свое́ созда́ніе: всеси́льне Гд̃и сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: The shadow of the Law passed away when grace arrived: for as the bush burned with fire and was not consumed, so as a Virgin thou didst give birth, and a Virgin thou didst remain; instead of a pillar of fire, the Sun of Righteousness hath shone forth; instead of Moses, Christ, the Salvation of our souls![^47]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сті. Гд̃ь воцари́ся, въ лѣпо́тꙋ ся ѡ҆блече́:
items.english_text: Thy resurrection, O Christ Savior, enlightened the whole universe and recalled Thine own creation: O All-powerful Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Дре́вомъ Сп҃се, оу҆праздни́лъ еси́, я́же ѡ҆ дре́ва кля́твꙋ: держа́вꙋ сме́рти, погребе́ніемъ твои́мъ оу҆мертви́лъ еси́, просвѣти́лъ же еси́ ро́дъ на́шъ, воста́ніемъ свои́мъ, тѣ́мже вопіе́мъ ти́: живода́вче Хе Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: By the Tree, O Savior, Thou didst abolish the curse of the tree; the dominion of death Thou didst put to death by Thy burial, and Thou didst enlighten our race by Thy resurrection: therefore we cry unto Thee: O Giver of life, Christ our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сті́хъ. И҆́бо оу҆тверди́ вселе́ннꙋю, я́же не подви́жится.
items.english_text: Thou wast seen nailed upon the Cross, O Christ, reforming the beauty of creation; the soldiers indeed showed cruelty, piercing Thy ribs with a spear, and the Jews asked to seal the tomb, not knowing Thy power: but in Thy tender mercy Thou didst accept burial, and on the third day Thou didst rise: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пови́лся Хе пригвожда́ешися еси добро́тꙋ зда́ніе: ѡ҆со́тіе оу҆́бо во́инни пока[заша], копіе́м ре́бра твоя́ про[бодоша], Евре́и же печа́тлѣти [гробъ просиша], твоя́ вла́сти [не ведяще]: но за е҆зꙋми́ленное [милосердие], прія́лъ еси по[гребение, и] тридне́вно воскре́с[лъ еси]:
items.english_text: O Christ, Giver of life, Thou didst voluntarily endure passion for the sake of the dead; and descending into Hades as Mighty, Thou didst snatch away those who were awaiting Thy coming there, as from a mighty beast, and didst grant them to dwell in Paradise instead of Hades: therefore grant unto us also who glorify Thy third-day resurrection cleansing of sins and great mercy!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сті. До́мꙋ твоемꙋ подоба́етъ ст҃ыни Гд̃и въ долготꙋ дн̃іи.
items.english_text: O new wonder, greater than all ancient wonders! For who hath known a Mother to give birth without a man, and to carry in her arms Him Who contains all creation? Born is the Word of God, Whom as an infant, O most pure one, thou didst bear in thine arms, and having maternal boldness toward Him, unceasingly pray for those who honor thee, to have compassion and save our souls!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Живода́вче Хе, во́льною стра́сть подъя́тъ ме́ртвыхъ ра́ди: въ а҆́дъ же соше́дъ я́кѡ Си́ленъ, я́же та́мо прише́ствіа ча́ющыя твое́го, и҆схити́лъ еси́, я́кѡ ѡ҆ звѣ́ря держа́вна: и҆ ра́й в̾мѣ́сто а҆́да жи́ти дарова́лъ еси́. тѣ́мже и҆ на́мъ сла́вящымъ, тридне́вное твоє́ воста́ніе, да́рꙋй ѡ҆цѣще́ніе грѣхѡ́въ, и҆ ве́лію мл҃ть.
items.english_text: When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal, then didst Thou slay Hades with the brightness of Thy Godhead; and when Thou didst raise the dead from the nethermost parts, all the heavenly powers cried aloud: O Giver of life, Christ our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ чꙋдесе но́ваго, па́че всѣх дре́вних чꙋде́съ! кто́ бо позна́ Мт҃рь безмꙋ́жа ро́ждьшꙋю, и҆ на рꙋкꙋ́ нося́щꙋ, и҆́же всю́ тва́рь содерж́ащаго; Бж҃іе е́стъ сло́во роже́нъное, е҆го́же я́кѡ младе́нца Прч(ис)таа на рꙋкꙋ́ свое́ю поноси́вши, и҆ ма́терне дерзнове́ніе къне́мꙋ и҆мѣ́ющи, непреста́н моля́щи, ѡ҆ чтꙋ́щи тя́: оу҆щедри́ти и҆ спасти́ дꙋша на́ша.
items.english_text: All beyond comprehension, all all-glorious are thy mysteries, O Theotokos: sealed in purity and preserved in virginity, thou wast known to be a true Mother, having given birth unto the true God; pray Him that our souls may be saved!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Е҆гда́ сни́де къ сме́рти, животе́ безсме́ртный: тогда́ а҆́да оу҆мертви́лъ еси блиста́ніемъ Бж҃тва. е҆гда́же оу҆ме́ршыа, ѡ҆ преиспо́днихъ воскреси́лъ еси́: вся́ си́лы нб҃сныа взыва́хꙋ, живода́вче Хе Бж҃е, сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: *He Who submerged of old in the deep: let us hymn the three-personed, single-principled essence of the Godhead, singing: Possessing essentially an inexhaustible abyss of mercy: have compassion and save those who bow down before Thee, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Вся́ па́че смы́сла, вся́ пресла́внаа твоя́ Бц̃е та́инъства, чистото́ю запеча́тлѣнна, и҆ Дѣ́вство храни́ма, Мт҃и позна́ся нело́жна, Бг҃а ро́жши и҆́стиннаго, того́ моли́ спасти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Being the cause, the source and root of the Father in the Son and Thy Holy Spirit, of the consubstantial Godhead: enlighten my soul with the three-sunned Light, and illuminate me by communion!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: В НЕДѢЛЮ, НА ПОЛꙊНОЩНИЦI, КАНОНЪ ТР(ОИ)ЧЕНЪ.
items.english_text: Divinely granting me brightness, O three-radiant Unity, single in principle: heal the passions in the wounds of my sins by Thy luminous rays, and by sweet communions make me partaker of Thine unapproachable glory, O animate womb and tabernacle!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Въ глубинѣ́ потопи́ дре́вле: трꙋное единонача́лное естство Бж҃тва, пѣ́снно воспое́мъ гл҃юще: мл҃ти пꙋчи́нꙋ неисчерпа́емꙋю, сꙋще́ственнꙋю я́кѡ и҆мꙋ́щи: тебѣ́ кланя́ющихъся оу҆ще́дри и҆ спаси́, я́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: The stream of actions of our nature, having suffered unworthily and slipped into corruption, O most pure Virgin: the Lord the Word, being incarnate from thy womb, lovingly recalled and mystically taught the all-bright Godhead!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же исто́чникъ, и҆ ко́рень Ѻц҃а сы́й вино́венъ, въ Сн҃ѣ и҆ ст҃ѣ́мъ твоемꙋ Дс҃ѣ, соище́ственнаго Бж҃тва: трисо́лнечный свѣ́тъ мое́мꙋ просвѣти́ свѣ́тъ, и҆ прича́стіемъ ѡ҆зари́.
items.english_text: *Establish me upon the rock of faith: the Godhead, first principle of nature, glorifying Thee with equal honor in three Persons; for Thou, proceeding as Life from Life, art without corruption our only God, and none is holy save Thee, O Lord!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃одѣ́тенъ мнѣ́ сїя́ніем, трисія́ннаа еди́нчице: сгонача́лнаѧ, я́же въ я́звахъ грѣхо́въ мои́хъ стра́сти, я́же свѣ́тлыми зари́ми вои́нми: и҆ сла́дкими причаще́ньми сотвори́ мя твое́ѧ неприкоснове́нныя сла́вы. Чре́во и҆ стѣ́нь ѡ҆дꙋшевле́ннꙋю.
items.english_text: Thou hast not instructed the bodiless ranks to praise Thy goodness, O Trinity, undivided Monarchy, unceasingly unto Thee; but accept now also the praise from our clay lips!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: То́къ дѣꙗ́ніи естества́ на́шего, пострада́вши неподо́бнѡ, и҆ къ тли́ поползши́ся Прч(ис)таа: вопло́щься и҆з̾ оу҆тро́бы твое́ѧ Гд̃ь Сло́во, чл҃колю́бнѣ воззва́, и҆ Бг҃онача́лію присвѣ́тломꙋ на́тайно наоу҆чи́.
items.english_text: Establish upon the rock of faith, and broaden in the ocean of Thy love, the heart and mind of Thy servants, O three-sunned Unity: for Thou art our God, hoping in Whom we are not put to shame!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: На ка́мени мя вѣ́ры оу҆тверди́: а҆́лѳоткомъ естества́ Бг҃онача́ліе, еди́ноч(ес)тное сла́вя тя́ ли́цы, живо́тъ бо ѡ҆ живота́, ты́ произше́дши: без̾ тла́ еси́ еди́нъ Бг҃ъ на́шъ, и҆ нѣ́стъ ст҃ъ па́че тебе́ Гд̃и.
items.english_text: He Who constituted the substance of creation before all things: united Himself unto thy womb through unfeigned goodness, O Sovereign Lady; and He shone forth unto all in three-sunned light, of one Godhead and Dominion!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ты чи́ны невеще́ственныя нена[ставилъ еси...]
items.english_text: O Holy Trinity, have mercy on that which Thou hast created, and deliver us from fire and every condemnation, for Thou canst do all things, as Thou art the compassionate and greatly merciful God; therefore we fall down before Thee, crying: We have sinned, forgive, O Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...твоя́ доброты́, Тр(ои)це: нераздѣ́лное единонача́ліе, пѣ́ти непреста́нно тебѣ́: но и҆ нн҃ѣ на́шꙋ, ѡ҆бре́нны оу҆́стъ, пріими́ хвалꙋ.
items.english_text: Thy servants are filled with many wounds, wounded by invisible arrows, and lying upon the bed of despair we cry unto thee, O Sovereign Lady, praying unceasingly on our behalf, who run unto thee in faith!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆тверди́ на ка́мени вѣ́ры, и҆ расши́ри лю́бве твое́я пꙋти́ною, срца и҆ мы́сль твои́хъ ра́бъ, еди́нице трисо́лнечнаа: ты́ бо еси́ Бг҃ъ на́шъ, на́ньже оу҆пова́юще непосрамля́емся.
items.english_text: *I hymn Thee, having heard, O Lord, Thy report... to understand the mystical ranks: even as the bodiless Angels cry unto Thee with fear, O unoriginate Trinity: so we also with clay tongues cry unto Thee: Creator of creation...*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...моє́ ви́дяши нб҃е, я́кѡ всеси́лде неможе́ніе, тѣ́мъже оу҆ще́дри раба́ своего́, и҆ къжи́зни лꙋ́чшей па́ки возведи́.
items.english_text: ...beholding my heavenly weakness, O Almighty One: therefore have compassion on Thy servant, and lead me back unto better life!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Е҆дини́ци нача́льныа, несмѣ́сна три́ лица́ воспѣва́емъ: я́кѡже со́вственнѣ и҆мꙋ́щаяся, раздѣ́лнѣ же соста́вы: но оу҆́бо совъкꙋпле́на и҆ нераздѣ́лна, въ совѣ́тѣ же, и҆ сла́вѣ, и҆ бж҃твѣ.
items.english_text: Of the primordial Unity, let us praise the unconfused three Persons, having individual hypostases, yet united and undivided in counsel, in glory, and in Godhead!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ тя́ чи́стъ и҆ пренепоро́чнꙋ при́нѡ Дв̃о Бц̃е, Зижди́тель ѡ҆брѣ́те еди́нꙋ я́кѡ ѡ҆ вѣ́ка, въ ню́же всели́ся, воѡбрази́ человѣ́ческое естество́, я́кѡ чловеколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: The Creator found thee alone from the ages as a pure and all-immaculate temple, O Virgin Theotokos; dwelling in thee, He formed human nature, as He is the Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣще́ніе въ тмѣ́ лежа́щій: я́кѡ вели́чіи на вся́ сꙋ́щая твоего́ промышле́ніа, ми́ да́рꙋющаа простира́ѧ лꙋча́ и҆ спасе́ннаѧ, Цр҃ю оу҆мире́ніа, собляди́ма въ вѣ́рѣ твое́мъ: ты́ бо еси́ живо́тъ, и҆ ми́ра всея́ческомꙋ.
items.english_text: *Enlightenment of those lying in darkness: as the greatness of Thy providence over all things, extending rays of salvation unto me, O King of peace: preserve us in Thy faith, for Thou art the Life and Peace of all!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́вися въ кꙋпинѣ́ я́кѡ Моѵсе́а, въ видѣ́ніи ѻ҆́гненнѣ: А́гглъ нарече́ся Ѻ҆́тче Сло́во, е́же нн҃ѣ твое́ предвѣ́дѣ прише́ствіе: и҆́мже всѣ́мъ я́вѣ возсвѣти́лъ еси́, держа́вꙋ Бг҃онача́ліа еди́наго, трисоста́внꙋю.
items.english_text: Appearing in the bush unto Moses in a fiery vision, the Word of the Father was named an Angel, foreseeing Thy coming; whereby Thou didst clearly illuminate unto all the dominion of the one Godhead in three Persons!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Не е҆сте́ственнꙋю, соприсносꙋ́щ[ную]... сла́вꙋ прело́жши, еди́ная Тр(ои)це ст҃а́я: воспѣва́ющихъ тя правосла́вною вѣ́рою, твое́я сла́вы ви́дѣти при́нѡ, безнача́льнꙋю и҆ еди́нꙋ трисо́лнечнꙋю.
items.english_text: Not altering the natural and co-eternal glory, O single Holy Trinity: grant unto those who hymn Thee with Orthodox faith ever to behold Thy glory, unoriginate and single, in three suns!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Тебе́ е҆ди́нꙋ по е҆ще́ствꙋ сы́[й]... всѣ́мъ и҆скꙋси́ма: въ грѣсѣ́ твоемъ...
items.english_text: Being one by nature, yet tried in all things: calling unto the union of the one Dominion

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...призыва́я къ сово́кꙋпле́нію еди́наго Гд̃ьства.
items.english_text: *Held fast in the abyss of sin, O Creator of mercy, have mercy: Thou Who art the calm of the faithful, O God of three suns: save us from innumerable transgressions and from passions!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй ѡ҆держи́мъ, сотвори́телю мл҃ти, поми́лꙋй: и҆́же бꙋ́ря вѣ́рꙋющыхъ, Бже трисо́лнечне: и҆ прегрѣше́ніи неисче́тныхъ, и҆ ѡ҆ страсте́й на́съ спаси́.
items.english_text: By the ineffable deep of goodness, by the uncontainable of Thy brightness and sent Godhead: grant me the light-giving ray!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Неизглаго́ланною пꙋчи́ною бл҃гости, невмѣсти́мымъ твое́го сїя́ніа, и҆ присла́ннаго бж҃тва́, свѣтода́тельною зарю́ да́рꙋй ми́.
items.english_text: Ineffably, O Virgin, the Most High became man incorruptibly: clothed in the garment of man, illuminate me with three-sunned light!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Неврече́ннꙋ Дв̃о вы́шніи чл҃къ бы́стъ нетлѣ́: въ чл҃ка пове́смꙋ ѡ҆бо́лкся, и҆ свѣ́том мя́ трисл҃нечнымъ ѡ҆за[ри].
items.english_text: O Christ God, only Most Good, Who didst pour out Thy blood for our sake, being hung upon the Cross by the counsel of Thy Father and the Spirit: therefore we cry aloud: Remember Thy flock, O Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Хе Бж҃е еди́не пребл҃гіи, и҆́же кро́вѣ свое́й на́съ ра́ди и҆злія́выи, Кр(ес)тѣ повѣ́шенъ, совѣ́томъ Ѻ҆ц҃а твое́го, и҆ Дх҃а, сего́ ра́ди оу҆зля́юще зове́мъ: помяни́ ста́до свое́ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: O pure one, have mercy on thy servants, and deliver from fire and every torment those who cry day and night unto thy Son, O most pure one: despise not thy flock, by thy prayers, O Mother of Christ!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ко ч(ис)таѧ поми́лꙋй рабы́ своя́, и҆ и҆зба́ви ѻ҆гня́ и҆ вся́кіа мꙋ́ки, въ но́щи и҆ въ дни́, зовꙋ́щихъ твое́мꙋ Сн҃ꙋ преч(ис)таа: непре́зри ста́до свое́, мл҃твами Хе тебе́ ро́ждшая.
items.english_text: *Concerning the golden image on the plain of Dura: The Prophets establish that the angelic Godhead is unchanging, O Lord Who alone art immutable and in three Persons: show my heart also ever unchanging, that I may fervently glorify Thee and piously hymn Thee!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ тѣ́лѣ зла́тѣ на по́ли Деи́рѣ: Оу҆ставля́еши пр(о)р(о)къ, А́ггльскаа Бж҃тва къ непреложе́нію, еди́не сы́й, неизмѣ́нне и҆ трїсоста́вне Гд̃и: покажи́ оу҆́бѡ и҆ мое́ ср́це непрело́жно всегда́, вое́же сла́вити тя́ те́плѣ, и҆ воспѣва́ти бл҃гоче́стно.
items.english_text: The noetic ranks of bodiless essences are illuminated by Thy rays, O God of single dominion and three suns, being by position secondary lights; show them forth as light, as Thou art the ever-living Giver of light!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ли́ци оу҆́мныи невеще́ственныхъ сꙋще́ствъ, твои́ми лꙋча́ми Бж҃е единонача́льнее, и҆ трисо́лнечне, ѡ҆заря́еми бываютъ, положе́ніемъ вто́ріи свѣ́тове, и҆́хже покажи́ свѣ́тъ: я́кѡ свѣтода́тель присножи́зенъ.
items.english_text: Illuminated by three-radiant rays, O Most Holy Trinity, in one dominion preserve Thy singers from adverse assaults, that we may unceasingly glorify Thee: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, in one Godhead!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Три́свѣтлыми заря́ми ѡ҆вѣща́еми, Тр(ои)це прест҃а́я, въ еди́ной держа́вѣ, храни́ своя́ пѣвца́ ѡ҆ проти́вныхъ напа́стей: да тя́ непреста́нно сла́вимъ, Ѻ҆́тче, и҆ Сн҃е, и҆ прест҃ы́й Дш҃е, въ еди́номъ Бж҃твѣ.
items.english_text: Restoring us and raising us up unto heavenly things without departure: He Who out of ineffable love for mankind became man from the Virgin's womb loved thee, and deified man, and sits with the Father upon the throne of glory!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И҆справля́я на́съ и҆ возвыша́я къ нб҃нымъ неисхо́днѣ, тебе́ любля́щꙋ и҆́же за неизрече́ное чл҃колю́біе бы́стъ чл҃къ ѡ҆ оу҆тро́бѣ Дв̃ыя: и҆ ѡ҆божи́ чл҃ка, и҆ на престо́лѣ сла́вы съ Ѻц҃ем сѣ́дай.
items.english_text: *In the likeness of gold: O ever-existing Trinity, co-eternal, unoriginate, sole ruler, unchanging unto ages: apart from Thy light-bearers, destroy all the evil assaults of adversaries and disturbances among men; keep Thy servants unharmed ever, O Lord of all!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: В подо́біи зла́тѣ неразроши́: Присносꙋ́щнаа Тр(ои)це, соприсносꙋ́щнаа, събезнача́льнаа, его́ нача́льнаа, неизмѣ́ннаа во вѣ́кꙋъ, кро́мѣ свѣтоно́сныхъ своихъ, весь лꙋка́вый оу҆празни́ споста́тныхъ то́кетъ, и҆ смꙋще́ніа въ чл҃вѣкахъ, невреди́ рабы́ своя́ при́нѡ, Гд̃и вся́ческихъ.
items.english_text: Ever-existing and Almighty, uncircumscribed, three-sunned Monarchy, Who didst constitute the world and dost preserve it by Thy power: grant unto the all-perfect, O All-powerful One, to hymn and glorify Thee with the angelic choirs unto all ages! of falsehood, and of the divine natural and unchanging nature: Thou didst assume human nature and didst teach us to honor the Trinity as Dominion unto all ages!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Присносꙋ́щныи и҆ всемогꙋ́щіи, неѡписа́нное, трисо́лнечное единонача́ліе, соста́вльшее мі́ръ, и҆ соблюда́ющее твое́ю си́лою: сотвори́ всесоверше́нномꙋ всеси́лне, пѣ́ти и҆ сла́вити тя́ съ ли́ки А́ггльскими во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Directing righteousness and wisdom: by Thy standings, therefore, singing unto God, and radiant, O most pure one: bless all ye works, hymn and highly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...[непостижи́мая] ло́жности, и҆ бж҃твенаго есте́ственнаго неизмѣ́ннавъ чл҃чкое восприя́лъ еси́ естество́ Тр(ои)цꙋ чести́ научи́лъ еси́, я́кѡ госпо́дствꙋ въсел вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *He Who before the sun was God, the Luminary... of the unoriginate Light: by His radiance the Son, Light and natural, shone forth with light; ineffably born of the earth, together appearing without departure...*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пра́вость и҆ мꙋ́дрости направля́ющіа: возстоя́ніи, тѣ́мже и҆ свѣтоно́снꙋю, преч(ис)таа, Бг҃а пѣ́сносло́вяще, и҆ бл҃гослови́те вся́ дѣла́, по́йте и҆ превозноси́те его́ въвѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Shine forth in Orthodox hearts the light of the Godhead; rising, grant understanding, and give understanding to comprehend and behold the good and perfect hymnody, to magnify and glorify Thee!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ...мꙋ: и твое стадо со[блюди], [Б]ца млтвами.
items.english_text: O Trinity uncircumscribed in nature... with unsearchable joy, Who art our Creator before creation: have compassion on Thy servants! Thee: and [preserve] Thy flock, [by the prayers of the Mother of] God.[^49]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [При]стахъ Агглъ, вопия[ше... гробѣ:]
items.english_text: *God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us: in the same Tone, Troparion: Resurrectional:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [что мертвымъ есть прили[чно... мир-]
items.english_text: *Beyond comprehension. Then, the Kathisma of the Psalter.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Слава: но возопійте, [воскресе Гдь:]
items.english_text: The noble Joseph, having taken down Thine immaculate Body from the Tree: wrapped It in pure linen, and with spices, enclosed It in a new tomb and laid It to rest; but on the third day Thou didst arise, O Lord, granting great mercy unto the world. *Glory:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: When the stone was sealed at the sepulchre by the Jews: the Stone of faith, Thou didst arise, being truly existent; Thou hast granted unto all: glory to Thee! *Both now: Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Thou art highly glorified, O Theotokos; we hymn thee, for by the Cross of thy Son, Hades was overthrown, and death was put to death; we who were dead have arisen, and have been deemed worthy of life; we have received Paradise, the ancient delight. Therefore, giving thanks, we cry aloud unto thee: Rejoice, O Virgin full of grace, the Lord is with thee!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Myrrh-bearers. Tone 2:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: The angel stood by, crying aloud at the sepulchre: "[What is proper unto the dead, even myrrh, is not fitting for Him; for Christ was shown to be foreign to corruption.]" *Glory: "Nay, cry aloud: [The Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!]"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: The company of Thy disciples, together with the Myrrh-bearing women, rejoices in concord: for we celebrate a common feast with them, unto the glory and honor of Thy Resurrection. And through them, O Lord, Lover of mankind, grant Thou great mercy unto Thy people.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: The laws of nature were concealed by thy divine childbearing; thou didst unite virginity with childbirth. For thou alone didst bear Him Who was timelessly begotten before thee. Therefore, O Theotokos, we magnify thee.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Having gone unto the sepulchre after the Passion to anoint Thy Body, O Christ God, the women beheld angels in the sepulchre and were dismayed; for they heard a voice from them: "The Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: *The Gradual Hymns (Anabathmoi), Tone 2.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Unto heaven do I raise the eyes of my heart, unto Thee, O Savior: save Thou me by Thine illumination.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Have mercy upon us who have sinned greatly against Thee, at every hour, O my Christ; and give me a pattern of repentance unto Thee before the end.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit it belongs to reign, to sanctify, and to animate creation: for He is God, consubstantial with the Father and the Word.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Except [the Lord had been among us, who could have been preserved whole from the enemy] and man-slayer together?

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: [Deliver not Thy servant, O Savior, unto their teeth: for like unto a lion my foes rise up against me...]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: [...against me] my foes rise up.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit belong dominion and honor:[^50] for all created things, as He is God, He by His power preserves from the Father, through the Son.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: They that trust in the Lord are become like unto the holy mount: which can by no means be shaken by the assaults of the enemy.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Let not them that live godly stretch forth their hands unto iniquity: for Christ will not leave His rod upon His inheritance.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit every wisdom pours forth; from Him comes grace unto the Apostles, and by their suffering the Martyrs are crowned, and the Prophets behold.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Arise, O Lord my God, in the commandment which Thou hast commanded: and the congregation of the people shall compass Thee. *Verse: O Lord my God, in Thee have I put my trust. Then: Let every breath. The Gospel, and the rest in order.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: *THE RESURRECTIONAL CANON*[^51]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: *The all-conquering power submerged the entire Pharaonic cavalry in the deep of old; and the incarnate Word abolished the prevailing sin, the all-glorious Lord: for He is gloriously glorified.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: The Prince of this world, O Good One, unto whom we had enrolled ourselves, having disobeyed Thy commandments, was condemned by Thy Cross; for rushing upon Thee as mortal, [he was cast down by the dominion of Thy power, and his weakness was reproved.]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: The Deliverer of mankind, and the Author of incorruptible life: Thou hast come into the world. By Thy Resurrection Thou didst tear asunder the swaddling bands of death, which all of us hymn in doxology: for He is gloriously glorified.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Having appeared higher than all visible and invisible creation, O pure and ever-Virgin: for thou didst bear the Creator, as He well-pleased, to become incarnate in thy womb. Him do thou beseech with boldness, to save our souls.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: *Having traversed an untrodden, uncustomary, waterless sea path, the chosen Israel cried aloud: "Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously glorified!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: Thou hast become the strength of the infirm, the Resurrection of the fallen, and incorruption for the dead, O Christ God, who didst honor Thy passion: for He is glorified.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: [Having raised up] the fallen image, [O Creator, and restored that which was] broken: [O God and greatly merciful, Thou wast made manifest unto all:] for He is glorified.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [сохраненъ бы] был[ъ цѣлъ ѡтъ врага]
items.english_text: The angelic [ranks marvelled at thy childbearing, which is] beyond [nature: for thou didst give birth unto God and the Lord.]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Воскреслъ еси ѿ гроба Спсе всесильне:
items.english_text: ...obtain: for thy Son is slaughtered as a Lamb for all.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [при]шед и спас[лъ] еси своею кровію,
items.english_text: We all cry aloud unto thee, O true Mother of God: deliver thy servants who have provoked God to wrath; for thou alone hast boldness before the Son.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [съ нимъ купно хвалимъ, и прославляемъ Бгъ ѡцъ нашихъ.]
items.english_text: *Kontakion. Tone 2:*[^52]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Thou didst arise from the tomb, O all-powerful Savior: and Hades, beholding this wonder, was dismayed; and the dead arose. And creation, beholding it, rejoices with Thee; and Adam exults together with us. And the world, O my Savior, unceasingly hymns Thee.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Thou art the Light of the darkened, Thou art the Resurrection of all, and the Life of men: and Thou didst raise all up with Thyself. Thou didst overthrow the power of death, O Savior, and didst shatter the gates of Hades, O Word; and the dead, beholding this wonder, were astonished, and all creation together rejoices in Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind. Therefore, we all glorify and hymn Thy condescension. And the world, O my Savior, unceasingly hymns Thee.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: *The god-opposing decree of the lawless tyrant raised a high flame. But Christ spread a spiritual dew upon the pious children: Blessed and highly glorified is the God of our fathers.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: [The Master did not] endure to behold man tormented by sins: but [having come,] Thou didst save [him] by Thy Blood; [together with him we praise and glorify the God of our fathers.]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: The garment of vengeance: the gatekeepers of Hades shuddered at the servant of the senseless tyrant, for Thou didst come to slay him: Blessed and highly glorified is the God of our fathers.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: We know thee to be holier than the holy, for thou alone didst bear the immutable God, O undefiled Virgin, unwedded Mother: for unto all the faithful thou hast poured forth incorruption by thy divine childbirth.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: *The all-wise youths were revealed as orators of old; for from a god-inspired soul they theologized, singing: "O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: He judged of old the disobedience of our forefather in Eden: but He was willingly judged, loosing the transgressions of the transgressor: O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Thou didst save him who was wounded by the tongue through the envy of the man-slayer, by voluntary biting in Eden: for by Thy voluntary passion Thou didst heal him: O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Walking in the shadow of death, Thou hast called me unto the light: having encompassed dark-visaged Hades with the radiance of divinity: O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Jacob beheld in the night, as in an enigma, God incarnate: and from thee He appeared in brightness unto them that sing: "O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: [He united Himself] unto men, O pure one: O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Abominable is he who preaches Thee not as the Son of the Father and the Virgin, having sung away the Greeks, crying with unhesitating faith and tongue: "O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:*[^53]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: *The fiery furnace in Babylon once divided its operation by the divine decree: burning the Chaldeans, yet cooling the faithful as they sang: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Beholding the garment of Thy flesh reddened with blood, O Christ, the angelic ranks marveled with trembling at Thy great longsuffering, crying: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Thou hast clothed my mortal nature in immortality by Thy Resurrection, O Compassionate One; therefore, rejoicing, Thy redeemed people sing in thanksgiving, O Christ, crying: "Death hath been swallowed up in victory!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Having conceived in thy womb without seed the inseparable Father, an impossible bridal chamber, thou didst bear ineffably, O most pure Mother of God; therefore we hymn thee as the salvation of us all.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: *The thrice-rich youths did not bow down unto the golden image, beholding the unchangeable living image of God; in the midst of the flames, singing together: "Let all creation praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: [He] was seen nailed upon the Cross, He Who is rich in mercy; He was willingly buried, and on the third day He arose; and Thou hast delivered all earthly beings, O Lover of mankind, who sing in faith: "Let all creation praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Having descended into the nethermost parts, O Word of God, to deliver from corruption man whom Thou didst fashion, O Christ, by Thy divine power, and having made him incorruptible, Thou didst make him a partaker of Thine ever-existing glory: "Let all creation praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: He was seen upon the earth through thee, and lived among men, He Who is ineffable in goodness and power; unto Whom all of us the faithful sing, crying: "Let all creation praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: Truly preaching thee as pure, we glorify thee, O Theotokos; for thou alone didst bear the Incarnate One of the Trinity; unto Whom with the Father and the Spirit we all sing: "Let all creation praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [о твоего причастія, плодъ... живо-]
items.english_text: *The Lord, Who is co-unoriginate with the Father, having become incarnate from the Virgin, hath appeared unto us: to enlighten the darkened, and to gather together the dispersed; therefore the all-hymned Theotokos do we magnify.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Весь еси желаніе, ве[сь] сладо[сть], Сл[ове]
items.english_text: As in Paradise the thrice-blessed Tree was planted upon the Cross, O Savior: the fruit of Thy communion hath blossomed forth unto us.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [Якоже изволилъ еси Влко, пріими...]
items.english_text: Being crucified, Thou didst cast down the mighty, as Thou art all-powerful; and having raised up human nature that lay below in the stronghold of Hades, Thou didst seat it upon the Father's throne. Together with which, as Thou comest, we worship Thee and magnify Thee.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Singing in Orthodox faith the Trinity consubstantial, a Unity in three Persons, we the faithful glorify: the indivisible, super-divine Nature, the thrice-radiant, unwaning Dawn, the single incorruptible Light that hath shone forth upon us.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: *Thou art wholly desire, Thou art all sweetness, O Word of God, Son of the Virgin, God of gods, O all-holy Lord of the holy; therefore all of us with her that bare Thee do magnify Thee.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: The knees of the heavenly ones bow unto Thee, O Jesus: and of the earthly, as unto the Creator, and of the subterranean, as unto God Who was crucified in the flesh; and all of us, theologizing, magnify Thee.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: [Him Whom] Thou didst snatch from the hands of the [bonds of fetters, the Great One, do Thou now also deliver us from the present tormenting hands: that being so delivered we may magnify Thee.]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: [An image of strength is given unto corrupt nature, the Word of God in thy womb, O pure Virgin; and having raised this up again, which had slipped down unto Hades: therefore all of us magnify thee as the Theotokos.]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: [As Thou hast willed, O Master, receive...]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: ...that all of us may magnify Thee as Benefactor.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: *AT THE PRAISES: STICHERA*[^54]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Let every breath and all creation glorify Thee, O Lord; for by the Cross Thou didst abolish death, that Thou mightest show unto the people Thy Resurrection from the dead, as the only Lover of mankind.[^55]
