items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Let the Jews declare how the soldiers lost the King Whom they guarded; for why did the stone not keep the Rock of life? Either let them produce Him that was buried, or let them worship Him that is risen, saying with us: "Glory to the multitude of Thy compassions, O our Savior, glory to Thee!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Rejoice, ye people, and be glad! An angel sitting upon the stone of the sepulchre, he brought good tidings unto us, saying: "Christ is risen, the Savior of the world, and hath filled all things with fragrance!" Rejoice, ye people, and be glad!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: An angel indeed brought the greeting "Rejoice!" unto her that was full of grace before Thy conception, O Lord; and an angel rolled away the stone of Thy glorious sepulchre at Thy Resurrection. The one, in place of sorrow, brought tokens of gladness; while the other, in place of death, proclaimed unto us the Master, the Giver of life. Therefore we cry aloud unto Thee: O Benefactor of all, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: The women poured forth myrrh with tears upon Thy sepulchre: and were filled [of Christ] our God, Who willingly endured the Cross for our sake, and spent three days in Hades: and let them worship His third-day Resurrection, whereby the ends of the whole world were enlightened.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Thou wast crucified and buried, O Christ, as Thou didst will; Thou didst despoil death, and didst arise in glory, as God and Master, granting eternal life unto the world, and great mercy.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Truly, ye lawless ones, having sealed the stone, ye have made us worthy of a greater miracle: the guards know it, having come forth today from the sepulchre; and they said: "Say ye that while we were asleep, His disciples came and stole Him." And who steals a dead body, and especially a naked one? He arose by His own power as God, leaving behind His burial wrappings in the tomb. Come, behold, O Jews, how He hath not broken the seals, He Who hath trampled down death, and granted unending life unto mankind, and great mercy!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: *ON SUNDAY EVENING, AT LORD, I HAVE CRIED:*[^57]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Having the Wellspring of loving-kindness, the inexhaustible abyss of mercy, and the torrents of compassions, O Father all-good, and Son, Word of the Father: and *AT THE LITURGY*[^56]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: We bring unto Thee the voice of the thief, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: We offer Thy Cross for the remission of transgressions, which Thou didst receive for our sake, O Lover of mankind.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: By Thy death, O Lord, Thou didst slay death; and by Thy Resurrection, O my Savior, Thou didst enlighten the world.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: We worship Thy burial, O Master, and Thy rising, whereby Thou didst deliver the world from corruption, O Lover of mankind.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Meeting the Myrrh-bearing women, risen from the tomb, Thou didst tell them to proclaim Thy rising unto the disciples.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: As Thou didst raise Adam from the tomb, O All-Good One: so as God, by the Tree Thou didst save the world. *Glory:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Let us glorify the Father, let us worship the Son, and let all of us the faithful hymn the Holy Spirit. *Both now:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гла, в. по: Егда ѡ древа:
items.english_text: Rejoice, fiery Throne; rejoice, Mother unwedded; rejoice, O Virgin, who didst bear God unto men!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: ...and Holy Spirit, uncreated Nature: receive our supplication and prayer, granting forgiveness unto all that are in transgressions! as God, Compassionate and Lover of mankind.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: Thou hast by nature, as God, a womb of compassions, and mercy of goodness. Therefore we pray Thee, O Christ our Savior, and falling down we call unceasingly, crying: grant unto Thy servants remission of their many transgressions, and forgiveness unto all, which all of us have committed: for Thou art God, compassionate and the Lover of mankind.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: Wishing to save all, O Savior, as God, for whose sake Thou didst become incarnate and was revealed as man: save us who worship Thy commandments. For Thou didst not come, O Lover of mankind, to save the righteous, but to loose us who are bound in transgressions by many sins, through the grace of divine baptism: as Thou art compassionate and the Lover of mankind.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Bodiless Hosts.*[^58]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: Thrones, Cherubim, and Seraphim, Dominions, Powers, honorable Authorities, Angels, Archangels, and Principalities with them: they who sing an unceasing hymn in concord unto Him Who constituted their incorruptible nature, teaching all to honor one Essence in the Trinity: equally unoriginate, equally honorable, and sharing one throne.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: The first of the immaterial choirs, receiving the beams of the divine Sovereignty with glad-tidings illuminations of outpourings, according to their rank impart the divine splendors unto the rest, and bring unto us saving in purity with diligence.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: On high unto the heights, O soul, on high the eye of the heart and the spiritual aspirations, having divine love, let us ever stretch forth in our souls: so that, being enlightened by the rays from thence, we may escape the darkness of passions, hoping with the Angels to stand before the dreadful throne of the Creator, and to be transformed from light to light.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: The multitude of Angels, O pure one, sings unto thy Son with thrice-holy voices: as unto Him Who hath a fiery throne and an animate palace; the divine Bridge who ever leads from earth unto Him. Rejoice, O full of grace, crying aloud unto thee in concord with the Archangel Gabriel: for thou didst bear the Wellspring of joy!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: I have sinned against Thee, O Savior, as the Prodigal Son: receive me, O Father, as I repent, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: I cry unto Thee, O Christ Savior, with the voice of the Publican: cleanse me as Thou didst him, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: The Passion-bearers, not shaken by earthly pleasures, were accounted worthy of heavenly blessings, and became fellow-citizens with the Angels. O Lord, by their prayers, have mercy and save us!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Mother Theotokos, invincible Church, protection and rampart: as the Prophet cries: "Zion, Church of God, in which righteousness hath appeared unto us!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: *ON MONDAY AT MATINS.*[^59]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: As waves of the sea have my iniquities risen up against me; as a ship in the abyss, I alone am submerged by many transgressions: but unto the calm haven of repentance, guide me, O Lord, and save me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: I am a barren tree, O Lord, bearing no fruit of repentance whatsoever; and I fear being cut down, and I dread that unquenchable fire. Therefore I beseech Thee: before that extremity, turn me and save me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: Being the Wellspring of loving-kindness, vouchsafe mercy unto us, O Theotokos: look down upon a sinful people; show forth, as ever, thy power: for trusting in thee, we cry "Rejoice!" unto thee, as of old Gabriel, the Archistrategos of the Bodiless Hosts.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: "Have mercy on me," said David; and I cry unto Thee: "I have sinned, O Savior; cleanse my sins through repentance, and have mercy on me!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: "Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me!" For two sins David wept; but I cry unto Thee concerning myriads of transgressions: he soaked his bed with tears, but I have not acquired a single tear. In terror I pray: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: *[Martyricon: Having yielded their body, the holy martyrs...]*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: ...having the holy garment in the world: they endured tortures from the lawless, and abolished the idolatrous deceit; by their prayers deliver us also from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save us!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: We magnify thee, O Theotokos, crying: Rejoice, Cloud of unwaning Light; Him didst thou carry in thy bosom, the Lord of glory!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: In ignorance and with knowledge I sin, by night and by day. Thee do I provoke to wrath, O Christ, I alone upon earth by my lawlessness; O only Good and Sinless One, turn me and save me, through the entreaties of Thine Angels, Thou Who didst come in loving-kindness to call sinners unto repentance!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: O unwedded and pure Theotokos, who without seed didst bear the Master of all: Him do thou entreat with the Angels, that we may be delivered from every perplexity, and that He may grant compunction and light unto our souls, and cleansing of transgressions, as thou alone dost swiftly protect!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: *THE CANON OF REPENTANCE*[^60]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: *Come, ye people, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea and led the people whom He had brought out of Egyptian bondage: for He is glorified.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [я]же, по чинꙋ ихъ прочіи препо[да-]
items.english_text: Being incarnate, O Word, and not having come to call the righteous, as Thou didst say, but sinners unto repentance: receive me who have sinned greatly, and save me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: I alone am enslaved unto sin; I alone have opened the doors unto the passions. O only Good Changer, turning me, save me in Thy loving-kindness. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: At Thy judgment-seat, O Lord, wearing crowns, the Passion-bearers stand: having vanquished the audacity of the evil one, and being enriched with immortality. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Pouring forth streams of healings unto us, the Passion-bearers ever dry up the corrupt passions of our flesh, by the power of the Holy Spirit. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: O Maiden who didst bear the Wellspring of dispassion: heal me who am wounded by passions, and snatch me from eternal fire: O only one full of divine joy!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: *Having traversed an untrodden, uncustomary, waterless sea path...*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: O god-bearing Coal, kindled by the radiance of Thy nature: Thou hast revealed the Bodiless choirs who glorify Thee, O Christ, as all-powerful.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: The Angels acquired the power of incorruption and the granted glory of immortality, O Christ; by drawing near unto Thee they are illuminated.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: The Angels appeared as light-bearers, showing forth the immaterial and natural, in forms, O Christ; sensibly fashioning purity. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: The angelic ranks serve thy childbearing which is beyond nature, rejoicing, O pure one: for thou didst bear their God and Lord.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: *Establish us in Thyself, O Lord, Who by the Tree didst put transgressions to death: and plant Thy fear in our hearts, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: O Christ Who didst enter the incorruptible womb: renew my soul which is corrupted by passions through repentance, and reveal it filled with Thine ever-existing light!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: I hearkened unto the enemy who provokes Thee to wrath, and I committed all sins; and senselessly I provoked Thee to wrath, O Lover of mankind, the only Long-suffering One. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Girt with the Cross, the invincible weapons and martyrs of the Savior, like walls, destroyed the deceitful fortifications in God. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Having strengthened your weakness by divine power, O noble Passion-bearers: ye surrendered the strength of the adversary unto utter destruction. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: O Mary, golden Censer: drive away the stench of my passions, and establish me who am shaken by the assaults of the deceitful adversary!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: *The bow of the mighty is broken by Thy dominion, O Christ: and the weak are girded with strength.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: God, Who is immortal by nature, wisely working in goodness, makes manifest the immortal armies.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Standing now with supreme longing before Christ: O Angels, pray ye that all of us may be saved! *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Having received a temporal beginning, truly from thee: He Who is the Maker of the ages, O Mother ever-Virgin.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: *I hymn Thee, for by hearing, O Lord, I heard...*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: ...[He came,] seeking me who had gone astray; therefore I glorify Thy great dispensation towards me, and renewal.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: I have fallen into the mire of sin, and have lost the former comeliness, O Lord, and I fear torment: therefore, by the beauty of repentance, enlighten my humble soul!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: With deceitful words, the subtle one stole me away from Thee, and made me food for himself, O God of all: snatch me from his malice, and call me back by the patterns of repentance. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Delivered over as food unto beasts, and burned with fire, O Martyrs, and flayed, and dismembered in your limbs: ye did not deny Christ, your Helper and Might; Him do ye fervently beseech on behalf of me, the wretched one. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Honoring one Nature, and the Trinity in Persons, the uncreated Godhead: not honoring creation in any way, ye were known as the Martyrs of Christ; therefore ye endured great tortures. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: He is incarnate of thy pure blood, and is united unto men by His will, O all-immaculate Lady: and He receives the penitent who of old were submerged in sins, being inclined by thy supplications, O pure one.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: *I heard, O Lord, of Thy glorious dispensation: I bring unto Thee the bodiless intercessors; receiving whom in Thy compassion, as Thou art tender-hearted, deliver me from sins!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Drawing near unto the All-causing Mind, the divine minds being purified, are illuminated the divine ornaments of the heavenly hierarchy, being adorned by the Holy Spirit, are preserved immutably. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Perceiving thee from afar, O Virgin, carrying upon thy hands God incarnate, Isaiah foretold.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: *O Giver of light and Creator of the ages, Lord, in the light of Thy commandments guide Thou us: for beside Thee, we know no other God.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Thou Who didst enlighten the eyes of the blind: enlighten my blinded soul; and strengthen it to work good deeds, taking care utterly to hate slothfulness.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Heal my soul, O only Savior, which is wounded by the grievous wound of willful sin: Thou Who of old didst heal the wounds of him that fell among thieves. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: The assembly of honorable Sufferers put to shame the council of lawless persecutors, having endured manifold pains; and now, with the sacred angelic choirs, they ever rejoice. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: As stars of manifold light, sending forth the radiance of endurance, and enlightening the souls of the faithful with the Holy Spirit: the most radiant Martyrs were revealed. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: Newly as an Infant unto us, thou didst bear the pre-eternal Son, twofold in wills and operations: as man, and together as God, O all-hymned one.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пою тя, слꙋхомъ бо Гди оуслы[шахъ...]
items.english_text: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos: The coal of Isaiah...*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: ...Seraphim, with brightness, with the exalted Thrones: god-like do they enlighten the rest.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: As the Giver of all effusion of light, Thou hast drawn Thine illumination, O Word of God, unto the light-resembling mirrors, receiving it with joy and undeviating understanding.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Joy unto thee, which looses the lamentation of the ancestors, Gabriel, the sacred Archangel, having flown down from heaven, proclaimed, O pure Bride of God.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: *Held fast in the deep of sin, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy loving-kindness: lead me up from corruption, O my God!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: I have fallen by the malice of the serpent: I lie upon the bed of despair. O Christ Who didst raise the paralytic by Thy word, raise me up also!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Tossed by the serpent's winds, and ever submerged by the waves of sin: save me, as Thou didst Peter, O Lord, Lover of mankind!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Having surpassed the bounds of nature, ye endured torments that are beyond nature; therefore ye were deemed worthy of blessings that surpass the mind, O Martyrs. *Martyricon:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: As noble, as fair, as honorable: ye were united unto the fair Benefactor; ever praying on our behalf, O all-glorious Martyrs. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: From all generations He chose thee, the beauty of Jacob, which the Creator loved, O all-immaculate one; and having shone forth from thee, He appeared.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: ...having hearkened unto my soul, O Master, deliver me from fierce things: for Thou alone art the cause of our salvation.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: The divine places of Thy glory, O Master Christ, Light of the beginning, kindled with light-flashing splendors, abide eternally in light-resembling radiance.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Strengthened by divine power, the Seraphim, calling with unceasing voices the thrice-holy hymn: lifting them up to revere the three-hypostatic Nature. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: As the Lord swore in truth of old unto David: having come forth from thy womb He fulfilled it; for thou, O Maiden, didst bear Him Who reigns over heaven and earth.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: *Unto the golden image worshipped in the plain of Dura, Thy three youths took no heed of the godless command; but cast into the midst of the flames, being bedewed they sang: "Blessed is the God of our fathers!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: By mental perversion and demonic assaults, being filled with every shame: I was far from Thy commandments, like the Prodigal; but now turning, I cry: "I have sinned like him; abhor me not, O Jesus, Who wast incarnate for my sake!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: O God of all: the Ninevites, having repented of old, Thou didst save from the decree that brings forth death; likewise, O only Lover of mankind, deliver from fierce torments my heart defiled by manifold prodigality, which now turns unto Thee. *For the Martyrs:* blessed divine Martyrs, and remained unhealed; but unto all the faithful your wounds were revealed as healing, wounded by the assaults of the ancient deceiver.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Neither fierce beasts, nor the threats of torturers, nor fire, nor wounds, nor the cutting sword, nor incandescent vessels did ye fear: but as in alien bodies, ye endured all things, O great Martyrs; therefore ye were crowned. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: A dwelling of immaterial Light was thy womb, with splendors of divine understanding, which set fire unto godlessness, O all-pure Bride of God, Maiden; Whom singing we call: "Blessed is the God of our fathers!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos: The youths were revealed as orators:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Around the throne of Thine ineffable glory, the immaterial minds ever dancing, with unceasing mouths sing: "O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: When the angelic ranks beheld Thee being carried up unto heaven with the flesh, they opened the heavenly gates unto Thee, singing: "O God of our fathers, transcendent in divinity, blessed art Thou!" *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Gabriel, showing thee, O Maiden, to be the beginning of the Law and the Prophets, cried aloud: "Behold, thou alone, all-hymned one, dost give birth unto the God Who is transcendent in divinity unto our fathers and us!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: *Unto God Who descended into the fiery furnace unto the Hebrew children, and changed the flame into coolness: sing, all ye works, as unto the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: [I have fallen unto the evil one,] and became enslaved by his wiles; and beholding me in great negligence, he boasts through deceit. Snatch me from him, O Compassionate One, Who art the conversion of them that have gone astray!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Loose me who am held fast by indissoluble bodily bonds, Thou Who didst loose the indissoluble from eternal bonds; and guide me to run unto the saved paths, O Christ, Savior of the world! *Martyricon:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: He that works passions hath wrought all malice upon me, the humble one; O blessed Martyrs, who were truly conformable unto the passions of Christ: deliver me from the adversary's injury!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: Not bowing their knees unto idols, ye were cast into the furnace of wounds of old, like the youths; and being revealed unburnt by divine dew, O all-praised Martyrs, sing ye Christ unto all ages! *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: My wretched soul, grown weak through many assaults of the evil one, O Mother of God, make healthy by thy healing supplications, O Virgin, that I may glorify thee unto all ages!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: *The thrice-rich youths took no heed of the golden image, beholding the unchangeable living image; but in the midst of the flames they sang: "Let all creation praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [нымъ, звати: священная да поетъ...]
items.english_text: According to the likeness of Thy goodness, Thou didst constitute the Angels, fulfilling Thy commandments with strength, O Word, and helping all the faithful to cry: "Let all the works of the Lord praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: [мя Хе прежде конца: подаждь ми обращенія слезы. Мчн:]
items.english_text: With divine virtues Thou hast adorned the heavenly life of the holy Angels, enlightening their hierarchy unto Thee, O Christ, who cry: "Let all creation praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ввесь еси желаніе, ввесь сладо[сть,]
items.english_text: Rejoicing brightly, let us sing the divine song of the Bodiless Hosts, without failing; and blessing the Master, let us cry aloud the hymn: "Let all creation praise the Lord, and supreme exalt Him unto all ages!" *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: В ПОНЕДѢЛОК В ВЕЧЕРЪ. НА ГИ [КО ЗВАХЪ:]
items.english_text: Righteousness, which wisely governs all things, worthily loved thee, the all-pure Virgin; ineffably, O all-holy Theotokos, having dwelt within thee: Whom unceasingly glorifying, as Lord and Master we supreme exalt Him unto all ages.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: *The Word of God, God of God, Who by ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam, who fell grievously into corruption through eating: ineffably incarnate of the Holy Virgin for our sake, we the faithful magnify in songs of one mind.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Behold the time of working: why sleepest thou foolishly, O soul, in deep despair? Arise, illuminate thy lamp with tears; make haste, the Bridegroom of souls draws near: delay not, lest thou remain outside the divine doors!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: O how dreadful is Thy judgment-seat, revealing every naked deed before Angels and men! O the fierce sentence which Thou art about to give unto them that have sinned! From which deliver me, O Christ, before the end: grant me tears of conversion. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Marked with the divine blood of the Lamb and Shepherd, O glorious divine Sufferers: being slaughtered ye rejoiced, like innocent lambs; and now ye enlighten the holy Church of the first-born in heaven. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Having appeared like lamps of solar radiance, by the rays of your sufferings ye illuminate every soul, and drive away every darkness of deceit, O noble Sufferers: therefore in faith ye are worthily blessed. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Spare me, O Lord, spare me when Thou art about to judge: and condemn me not unto fire, neither reprove me in Thy wrath; the Virgin who bare Thee, O Christ, entreats Thee, and the multitude of Angels, and the assembly of Martyrs.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: *Thou art wholly desire, Thou art all sweetness, O Word of God, Son of the Virgin, God of gods, O all-holy Lord of the holy; therefore all of us with her that bare Thee do magnify Thee.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Appearing white-robed, the Angels in radiant form spoke unto Thy divine disciples, proclaiming Thy second coming, O Christ: with whom blessing Thee, we magnify Thee.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: As the Benefactor of every rational nature: Thou didst make these first rays a second brightness, by reason of Thine extreme goodness; therefore, giving thanks, all of us magnify Thee. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Perceiving thy radiant virginity, O all-pure one, and marveling: the divine Archangel brought joy unto thee...

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: *AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA*[^61]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Contemplating the measureless evils of my deeds, I flee unto Thy compassions: resembling the Publican, the weeping Harlot, and the Prodigal Son. Therefore, I also fall down before Thee, O Merciful One: before Thou judgest me, spare me, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Overlook my transgressions, O Lord Who wast born of the Virgin, and cleanse my heart, making it a church for Thy Holy Spirit; cast me not away from Thy presence, Thou Who hast immeasurable great mercy!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Ye suffered for Christ even unto death, O Passion-bearing Martyrs: for ye have your souls in the hand of God in heaven, and your relics are honored throughout the whole world; Hierarchs and kings bow down, and all people rejoicing, we cry aloud as is customary: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: In thee have I placed my hope, O Theotokos: let us not fall away from our expectation; save...

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: *ON MONDAY EVENING, AT LORD, I HAVE CRIED:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: I have surpassed all in sin, what repentance shall I learn? If I sigh like the Publican us from perils, O Helper of the perplexed; and overthrow the counsels of adversaries: for thou art our salvation, O blessed one.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: We bring unto Thee the voice of the thief, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: Save me, O Lord God, and make me a partaker of the portion of them that love Thee from the soul!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: All the heavenly armies serve Thee with fear, as God; by their prayers save us! *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: With the weapon of faith, O Sufferers, ye conquered the armies of the enemy, and were brought unto God.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: The spiritual ranks with the human race honor the simple Trinity, the Godhead of one essence.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стіры покаянны, гласъ, в. по: [Егда ѡ древа:]
items.english_text: O all-pure Lady, who without seed didst bear God: pray Him that we may be saved!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: ...I do not presume to weigh down the heavens. If I weep like the Harlot, with my tears I defile the earth: but grant me remission of sins, O God, and have mercy on me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: I have committed every sin; I have surpassed all in prodigality. If I desire to repent, I have no streams of tears. If I live negligently even now, I shall be condemned unto torment. But grant me correction, O only Good God, and have mercy on me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Grant me a shower of tears of divine compunction, O Christ, as Thou art compassionate: that weeping, I may wash away the defilements of my transgressions, which come from pleasures, and be shown cleansed, when Thou, the Judge, shalt come from heaven to judge mankind: as Thou art the only righteous Judge.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy John the Forerunner.*[^62]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: O Preacher and Baptist of Christ, Angel, Apostle, Martyr, Prophet, Forerunner, Lamp, close Friend, Seal of the Prophets, most honorable of the born, Mediator of the Old and New grace, bright voice of the Word: by thy sacred intercessions direct our prayerful deeds unto God the tender-hearted!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: "Behold the Lamb of God, that takes away the sin of the world!" didst thou cry aloud, O holy Prophet and Forerunner, when thou didst behold Christ walking upon earth. Him do thou entreat, to grant remission of sins unto them that honor thee. For thou hast, in truth, great boldness before Him, O Baptist, as mediator of the Law and grace.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Make haste, and rescue me from temptations by which the bitter demons assault me, seeking to seize the soul of thine unworthy servant, like a bird; leave me not unto the end: that they may know more from deeds that thou art my refuge!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: As having natural kinship and concord in prayer, breathing as one, O Mother of the King of all, and divine Forerunner: make supplication together on behalf of the servant who hath greatly provoked the Good and Merciful One: so that, being inclined by your intercessions, He may show compassion and save, and deliver me from kinship with fire.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: I have sinned against Thee, O Savior, as the Prodigal Son: receive me, O Father, as I repent, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: I cry unto Thee, O Christ Savior, with the voice of the Publican: cleanse me, as Thou didst him, and have mercy on me, O God!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: When the holy Martyrs pray for us, and hymn Christ: all deceit ceases, and the human race is saved by faith.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: O impassable Door, mystically sealed, blessed Theotokos: receive our prayers, and bring them unto thy Son and our God, that for thy sake He may save our souls.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *ON TUESDAY AT MATINS.*[^63]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: ...[against] me my iniquities; and as a ship in the abyss, I alone am submerged by many transgressions: but unto the calm haven of repentance, guide me, O Lord, and save me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: I am a barren tree, O Lord: I have brought forth no fruit of repentance whatsoever; and I fear being cut down, and I dread that unquenchable fire. Therefore I beseech Thee: before that calamity, turn me and save me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: We have become partakers of the divine nature through thee, O Theotokos Virgin: for thou didst bear God incarnate for us; therefore as is due, all of us piously magnify thee.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns: Tone 2:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: "Have mercy on me," said David; and I cry unto Thee: "I have sinned, O Savior; having cleansed my sins through repentance, have mercy on me!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: "Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me!" For two sins David wept; but I cry unto Thee concerning myriads of transgressions: he soaked his bed with tears, but I have not acquired a single drop. In despair I pray: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Apostles, Prophets, and Martyrs, Hierarchs, Venerable and Righteous: who have fought the good fight, and kept the faith, having boldness before the Savior: entreat Him on our behalf, as He is good, that our souls may be saved, we pray!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: ...[protection] and help which comes from thee: for in thee hath my soul trusted, and have mercy on me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns: Tone 2:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: For the sake of the mercy of loving-kindness, O Good One, Christ came to save His creation: having bowed the heavens by His descent. Therefore, hymning Thy dreadful dispensation, we cry unto Thee: by the entreaties of Thy Forerunner, grant us cleansing of sins, as Thou alone art tender-hearted. *Glory:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Thou Who didst enlighten Thy saints more than gold, and art glorified in Thy venerable ones as Good One: being entreated by them, O Christ God, pacify our life, as Lover of mankind; and direct our prayer like incense, Thou Who alone restest among the saints. *Both now: Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: O fervent Protectress of Christians: pray unceasingly unto thy Son, O Theotokos, to deliver us from every malicious assault and bitter grief of the adversary; and to grant us forgiveness in those things wherein we have sinned, for the sake of the mercy of His compassions: through thy prayers, O Virgin Mother.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *THE CANON OF COMPUNCTION*[^64]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *Having received the song of Moses, cry aloud, O soul: "A Helper and a Protector is He become unto me for salvation: this is my God, and I will glorify Him!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Let us weep bitterly for ourselves, brethren, before our departure: that with good tears we may escape the tears of torment which will then profit nothing to them that have them.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Myriads of times, O Christ, I promised to repent: but having an unfeeling soul, I fall into transgressions; have compassion, O Savior, upon my weakness. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: The Passion-bearers of Christ, having endured the fire of torment by divine bedewing: deliver me, who lie in grievous passions, from the fire of Gehenna. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Having appeared mighty against the enemies by divine power: ye cast down their unpowerful strength, O worthily blessed Martyrs. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: O fiery Tongs, which Isaiah once beheld: burn up the material passions of my heart, O Virgin Mother, and consume them utterly.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *The all-conquering power submerged the entire Pharaonic cavalry in the deep of old...*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: O Baptist and Forerunner of Christ: being ever submerged by bodily pleasures, strengthen my mind, and calm the waves of passions: that being in divine calm, I may ever glorify thee.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Having been enlightened with incomprehensible illumination, like a star of manifold light, thou didst run before the spiritual Orient: pray Him, O Baptist, to illuminate my heart, which is darkened by all demonic assaults.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: In the river, O all-wise one, thou didst once submerge the abyss, with grace that inundates every transgression: but I pray thee dry up the torrents of my transgressions, O most rich one, by thy divine intercession. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Thou wast a kinsman of the pure Virgin who bare God incarnate, O blessed Forerunner: with her we honor thee and pray, who now live in thy divine temple: make us temples of the Spirit!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *Show my barren mind to be fruitful, O God: Cultivator of souls, and Planter of good things, by Thy loving-kindness.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: I have weighed down my soul with slothful slumber: raise me up, O Christ, unto the vigil of repentance, to do Thy commandments!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Reveal me not put to shame, O Jesus, in the dreadful day: but before the end, turning me, deliver me from fierce torments! *Martyricon:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Having well imitated the passions of Christ in divine manners, O honorable Passion-bearers: heal the bitter passions of my soul! *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: That ye might be deemed worthy of the ever-existing blessings in heaven, O Passion-bearers: ye steadfastly endured every temptation of fierce things upon earth. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Mother-like thou dost feed with milk the Nourisher of all, and thou carriest Him upon thine arm, O pure one, Who ever holds all things in His hand.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *Having established me upon the rock of faith, Thou hast enlarged my mouth against my enemies; for my spirit rejoiced when singing: "There is none holy as our God, and none righteous beside Thee, O Lord!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: He that hath my mind darkened enlighten my mind darkened by slothfulness, by thine intercession, O Forerunner of the Lord: and deliver me from great adverse circumstances, I pray.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Thou didst loose the barrenness of her that bare thee, being born by the providence of God, O all-wise Prophet: make my barren heart fruitful now by thine intercession, to bring forth the blossoms of virtues.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Pray that they who with love built the temple of God may obtain the life above; and they that serve in thy temple in faith, make them temples of the Holy Spirit, O Baptist and Forerunner, by thy prayers. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: The Forerunner, carried in his mother's womb, leaped and worshipped the Lord carried in thy womb, O Virgin full of divine joy: pray Him to deliver us from all sorrow.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: *Foreseeing Thy childbearing from the Virgin, the Prophet proclaimed, crying: "I heard Thy report and was afraid; for from Teman, from the holy shadowed mountain, art Thou come, O Christ!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Beholding me robbed on all sides and impoverished, O Word, the enemy rejoices in my destruction, the master of deceit; O Lord of glory and Enricher of the poor, rescue me from his malice!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: I have defiled my hands and eyes, O Lord, doing things unworthy to be done; and in foolishness I have provoked Thy compassions: grievously have I tried Thy longsuffering; but having compassion, save me as God! *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Wondrous is God in His saints, unto them that believe in Him, and who destroy the idols of destruction: and who have inherited the expanse of Paradise, from which Adam of old was cast out!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: By the shedding of your blood, O blessed ones, ye stopped the blood that was once offered unto demons, a destructive error: offered by men who were deceived unto destruction; therefore ye are ever blessed. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Taught by the Spirit, the glorious choir of Prophets prefigured thy mystery which is beyond understanding, O Theotokos, in manifold forms with sacred figures; whose fulfillment we behold from afar.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Unto Him Who bowed the heavens and mingled with men, thou didst bow thy head with thy right hand, O most rich one: by which preserve me, keeping my heart in peace.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: The impassable wilderness had thee as a citizen, O blessed Forerunner; therefore I cry unto thee: make my soul fruitful, which is destitute of all divine works!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Directing the divine Law, thou wast lawlessly slaughtered; therefore I pray thee: correct me who ever act lawlessly and am drowned in demonic delusions!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.english_text: Having built thyself as a temple of the Queen and Lady: thou hast now departed unto the divine habitations, O Forerunner; pray that they who built this all-holy temple unto thee may obtain them! *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Look down upon me who am sick, O all-immaculate one, and loose my fierce passions which are difficult to heal: that I may magnify thee who hast magnified all mankind!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: *Drive away the gloom of my soul, O my Savior, and enlighten me with the light of Thy commandments, as the only King of peace.*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Senselessly I add sins unto sins, and there is no lifting up in my death: woe is me, how shall I appear before Christ?

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Receiving peril like a ship: I have wasted my time which Thou gavest me, O Compassionate One; and now, having become poor, I cry: despise me not, O Christ! *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: As ye despised the earthly glory which is trodden underfoot, O Passion-bearers, ye were accounted worthy of heavenly glory, abiding with Christ. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Separating their mind from the love of the flesh by faith, the Passion-bearers lovingly embraced tortures, having appropriated themselves unto Christ. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Daniel beheld thee in the Spirit as a great mountain, O Theotokos: from which the Stone was cut out, crushing the idols of demons.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos: Illumination:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: In the streams of Jordan's water of incorruption, O Forerunner, having baptized Christ: pray Him to dry up the outpourings of my passions, and to inherit the torrents of delight, and the fair joy of the righteous.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Already I lament, and I shudder with fear, and am ever held fast by perplexity: considering my deeds, and the terror. O tender-hearted Lord, spare me, by the prayers of Thy Baptist!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Ordaining saving laws for the people, O Forerunner, having been in repentance of transgressions: thou didst stand between the Law and grace; therefore we pray thee: enlighten us with the patterns of repentance!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Grant me time for repentance, O Benefactor, unto me who have spent all the past in despair: having the great Forerunner John praying unto Thee for this, O Word, and all-comely preacher of repentance. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: By the snare and hunting of the deceitful one I was put to death, O all-immaculate Lady: make me alive, O Theotokos who didst bear the Life constituted for all: that I may piously hymn thee, the all-hymned one.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: *Held fast in the deep of sin, O Savior, and tempest-tossed in the sea of life: but as the Prophet Jonah, lead me up from the deep of passions, and save me!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
