items.english_text: As of old the Canaanite woman, I cry unto Thee, O Christ: "Son of David, having had mercy, show compassion upon me!" For I have a soul suffering in fierce things, and it will not come to its senses.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: The measureless waves of passions trouble me; as Thou didst rebuke the sea of old, and save Thy holy disciples: so raise me up, O Jesus, and save me! *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: The bodiless angelic choirs marveled at your endurance in the flesh, and praised Him Who gave you strength, O honorable Sufferers...

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: [staining...]

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: ...[burned] with the streams of your blood,[^65] and having your eyes gouged out, O Martyrs, and frozen by fierce cold: ye passed over unto the warmth of life, hymning Christ. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: As a Table containing the mystical Bread, of Which having eaten, we hunger no more, O all-hymned one: knowing thee in truth as the Mother and Nourisher of Christ, the God of all.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: *Heirmos: Held fast in the abyss of sin, O...*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Thou who didst proclaim the voice of the Word: pray that our voices may be received, and forgiveness of sins be granted unto them that sing unto thee in love.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Heal the crushing of my soul, and loose the burden of sins, and beyond hope save me, by thy prayers, O blessed Forerunner!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: O glorious Forerunner, pray Him Whom thou didst baptize with thine own hand, to deliver me by His hand, Who takes away sins, unto Him lifting up my hands ever on high. *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Slothful slumber holds me fast; sinful sleep weighs down my heart: by thy divine intercession, O all-pure one, raise me up and save me!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: *The youths resembling the Cherubim danced in the furnace, crying aloud: "Blessed art Thou, O God, for in truth and judgment hast Thou brought all these things upon us for our sins: all-hymned and highly glorified unto all ages!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: I have forsaken Thy laws, submitting unto brutish desires [deeds] unfitting, O Christ; and I am condemned in my senselessness, as no other among men upon earth: leave me not, therefore, O Savior, to perish, for the sake of Thy love for mankind!

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Behold, I was conceived in iniquities, O Lord, as David cries; and born upon earth; and as a servant provoking to wrath, I provoked Thee to wrath, the only existing true God: leave me not, therefore, O Savior, to perish, for the sake of Thy love for mankind! *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Manfully did the assembly of Sufferers contend, and wondrously were they crowned by the life-bearing right hand: for in truth they loved God, Who created all things by His Word; and now rejoicing in heaven, they take delight in divine enjoyment. *For the Martyrs:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Having their eyes gouged out, and the cutting off of hands and feet: the glorious ones sent forth a good course unto the heavenly journey, hindering the journeys of the single adversary; by their prayers save all, O Word, who glorify Thee! *Theotokion:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: The Cherubim glorify, the Seraphim hymn, the Thrones, Authorities, and Dominions unceasingly: thy childbearing which is beyond understanding, O all-hymned Mary: for thou alone didst bear God in the flesh; pray Him, O pure one, to save all of us who honor thee in love.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos: The god-opposing [decree]:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: дающаго вамъ, честніи стра[дальцы...]
items.english_text: Root out with the axe of thy prayer, cutting down the instigator of the passions of my heart; plant, O Forerunner, the fear of divine dispassion, estranging me from ignorance toward God, and from every malice.

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Въ струꙗ́хъ їѡрда́нскихъ, ꙗкѡ крⷭтилъ еси́, покрыва́ющаго вода́ми превы́спреннѧѧ гдⷭа, того́ моли́, во́дъ дарова́ти бж҃твеннаго оумиле́нїа при́нѡ, ѡчища́ющыма, сла́вный прⷮче.
items.english_text: "In the streams of Jordan, as thou didst baptize the Lord Who covers with waters the upper chambers:[^66] pray Him, O glorious Forerunner, ever to grant waters of divine compunction unto mine eyes that purify."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И́же ми́ръ взе́млющаго грѣхи́, а́гньца бж҃їа прⷮче проповѣ́да, того́ моли́, ѡ ко́злищъ ча́сти ꙗви́ти мѧ чю́жа, и десны́мъ его́ ѻвца́ мене́ сочести́ти сла́вне.
items.english_text: "O Forerunner, who didst preach the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world: pray Him, O glorious one, to show me a stranger to the portion of the goats, and to number me with the sheep on His right hand."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Непло́дная оутро́ба но́ситъ тѧ дв҃о, въ оутро́бѣ носи́вшую сло́во воплоще́нно, его́же бж҃твеннымъ взыгра́нїемъ, вели́кїй прⷮте́ча, непло́днымъ всѣ́стѡ прозлѣ́нїе познава́: ра́дваѧся поклони́ся.
items.english_text: "A barren womb bears thee, O Virgin, who didst bear the Word incarnate in thy womb; Whom by divine leaping the great Forerunner recognized in the womb as the enlightenment of the barren: and rejoicing, he bowed down in worship."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Въ купинѣ́ мѡѷсе́ю, дѣви́ческое чю́до, на сїна́йстей горѣ́, проѡбрази́вшаго дре́вле: по́йте, блгⷭвите, и превозноси́те въ всѧ́ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *"In the bush unto Moses on Mount Sinai, Him Who prefigured the virgin wonder of old: praise ye, bless, and highly exalt unto all ages!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Да ѡбожи́ши на́съ, воплощсѧ ми́лостивно: неразꙋмѣ́ю ника́кѡже, поврежда́ющыми слѧ́ми, ко́ею блгⷭтью, ѡбрати́ ма хрⷭте, иже всѣ́мъ обраще́нїе.
items.english_text: "That Thou mightest deify us, Thou wast mercifully incarnate; I understand not how, being damaged by sins, by what grace; convert me, O Christ, Who art the conversion of all."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ па́стырю до́брый сло́ве, закла́вшый на гора́хъ преступле́нїа, ѡкаꙗ́нную ми дш҃у, обрати́въ спаси́: да ма до конца́ вра́гъ льсти́вый непожре́тъ.
items.english_text: "Thou, O Word, art the Good Shepherd Who didst seek the sheep slaughtered upon the mountains of transgression: having converted my wretched soul, save me, lest the deceitful enemy devour me utterly!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стлнѣ́мъ му́жески вкꙋпѣ́, вопиꙗ́ху дрꙋ́гъ дрꙋ́гꙋ, крѣ́пцїи страда́лцы, ѡгражда́еми лю́тѣ: се хрⷭто́съ простира́етъ на́мъ вѣ́нца въ вѣ́ки. Му́чн.
items.english_text: "Manfully let us stand together, the stalwart Sufferers cried out one to another, being fiercely encompassed: 'Behold, Christ stretches forth crowns unto us unto ages!' *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пкими жи́лами, тве́рдыми ва́шими болѣ́знми, оудави́те змі́а, мнѧ́щагося ва и́стинно
items.english_text: "With robust sinews, by your steadfast sufferings, ye strangled the serpent who truly thought" "...to deceive you; and ye were shown forth as heirs of the delight of Paradise. *Theotokion:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: прельсти́ти: и ра́ностей пи́щи ꙗви́теся наслѣ́дници. Бг҃:
items.english_text: "That God might deify us, He was incarnate of thy pure blood, and became earthly, O Virgin Theotokos: Whom pray thou ever for them that hymn thee."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Да ѡбожи́тъ на́съ бг҃ъ, воплоти́ся и́зъ чи́стыхъ крове́й твои́хъ, и бы́сть зе́менъ дв҃о бцⷣе: его́же моли́ при́нѡ ѡ воспѣва́ющихъ тѧ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Forerunner]. Heirmos:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пе́щь ѻ́гненна ано́гда въ вавѵлѡ́нѣ, дѣ́тели раздѣлѧ́ше, бж҃твеннымъ велѣ́ніемъ, халде́а ѡпалѧ́ющи, вѣ́рныѧ же прохлажда́ющи, пою́ща, блгⷭслови́те всѧ́ дѣла́ гдⷭнѧ гдⷭа.
items.english_text: *"The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its operation by the divine command, burning the Chaldeans, but cooling the faithful who sang: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!' "*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Да́ждь денни́цꙋ мнѣ́, на земли́ лежа́щемꙋ прⷮче, и́же десни́цꙋ просте́рлъ, и ѡмы́лъ еси́ вода́ми, нескве́рнаго: и иꙁвлецы́ ма ѿ скве́рнъ тѣле́сныхъ, всего́ ма ѡчища́ѧ покаѧ́ніемъ: и спаси́ ма.
items.english_text: "Grant the day-star unto me who lie upon the earth, O Forerunner, who didst stretch forth thy right hand and wash the Immaculate One with waters: and draw me out of the defilements of the flesh, purifying me entirely by repentance, and save me."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Имꙋ́щи дш҃е вре́ма покаѧ́тиса, лѣ́ности тажкї́и ѿ штрѧси́, и спѣ́шно подви́гъ, вопїю́щи блгⷭцѣ свое́му: млⷭрде, ѡще́дри ма, крⷭтлѧ всего́ молѧ́щми.
items.english_text: "Having time to repent, O my soul, shake off the heavy burdens of sloth, and hasten unto the struggle, crying aloud unto thy Benefactor: 'O Merciful One, have compassion upon me, by the entreaties of the Baptist of all!' "

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пото́ци страсте́й, и во́ды зло́бы, до дша́ моеѧ́ внидо́ша, блж҃не прⷮче: пощнесѧ́ ско́ро иꙁѧ́ти ма, и́же рѣчны́ми стрꙋꙗ́ми иꙁмы́въ, безстра́стїа ти́хꙋю пучи́ну.
items.english_text: "The torrents of passions and the waters of wickedness have entered into my soul, O blessed Forerunner: hasten quickly to deliver me, thou who by river streams didst wash the quiet abyss of dispassion."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оувы́ мнѣ́ мно́га зла́ сотво́ршему: оувы́ мнѣ́ еди́номꙋ, прогнѣ́вавшему бг҃а преблг҃аго, крⷭтелю хв҃ъ помози́ ми: и пода́ждь прегрѣше́ніемъ мои́мъ разрѣше́ніе, и до́лго ѡсѣче́нїе, ходата́йствомъ си. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "Woe is me who have committed many evils! Woe is me alone, who have provoked the all-good God to wrath! O Baptist of Christ, help me, and grant remission of my transgressions and a cutting off of the debt, by thine intercession. *Theotokion:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Вы́шнаго бг҃а пло́тію поро́жши, ѻгно́ѧ ма возведи́ страсте́й, ѡскорблѧ́ющихъ ма, и лю́тѣ всего́ ѡснщшаго, бж҃твенными ѡбогати́ ма добродѣ́телми пречⷭтаꙗ: ꙗкѡ да пою́ тѧ спаса́емъ.
items.english_text: "Having borne the Most High God in the flesh: raise me up from the corruption of passions which afflict me and have grievously wounded me entirely, O all-pure one, and enrich me with divine virtues: that being saved, I may hymn thee."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ земноро́дныхъ кто́ слы́ша та́коваѧ, или́ кто́ ви́дѣ когда́, ꙗкѡ дв҃а ѡбрѣ́тесѧ въ чре́вѣ имꙋ́щи, и безболѣ́зни младе́нца породи́; та́ково ти́ е́сть чю́до: и тѧ́ чи́стаꙗ бг҃ороди́тельнице мр҃їе велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *"Who of earthborn men hath ever heard such a thing, or who hath ever seen, that a Virgin was found having conceived in the womb, and without pain gave birth to an Infant? Such is thy wonder: and thee, O pure Theotokos Mary, do we magnify!"*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Се́ сꙋди́ще твое́ стра́шное, нане́же хо́щꙋ сꙋ́дъ прїѧ́ти, и неꙋгаса́ющїи ѻ́гнь его́ стра́ха, блѣ́дности всѧ́ лѣ́та ижи́вшихъ, ѡбрати́ ма, еди́не всѣ́хъ цр҃ю, и́же манассї́ю ѡбраще́й согрѣши́вшаго.
items.english_text: "Behold Thy dread tribunal, before which I am to receive judgment, and the unquenchable fire of its terror; convert me who have spent all my years in vanity, O only King of all, Who didst convert Manasseh when he had sinned."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Оуста́ви хв҃е пото́ки, вопїю́ ти, безмѣ́рныхъ мои́хъ зо́лъ, стрꙋ́ѧ мнѣ́ да́ѧ слеза́мъ, къ ѡмыва́нїю скве́рнамъ, ꙗ́же поѧ́хъ безꙋ́мїемъ: и спаси́ ма млⷭтїю си, спаси́ влады́ко.
items.english_text: "Check the torrents of my measureless evils, O Christ, I cry unto Thee, granting me streams of tears for the washing of the defilements which I took upon myself in senselessness; and save me by Thy mercy, save me, O Master!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И́же ѡ дш҃а покаѧ́вшесѧ. Свѣтоза́рнаѧ бж҃тве́нный страда́лецъ па́мать, ꙗкѡ слн҃це на́мъ возсїѧ́вши, всѧ́ коньца́ земны́ѧ просвѣща́етъ: и прого́нитъ бж҃твеннымъ дх҃омъ, дꙋшетлѣ́нный мра́къ. М:
items.english_text: "O ye who have repented in soul: The radiant memory of the divine Sufferers, having shone forth upon us like the sun, enlightens all the ends of the earth: and by the Divine Spirit it drives away soul-corrupting darkness. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: По́лкъ че́стенъ, во́инѡ побѣдоно́сныхъ, и иꙁбра́нный гра́дъ, собо́ръ ст҃ы́хъ мч҃нкъ, ли́къ блж҃е́нный, ангелоѡго́дно сочета́емъ беспло́тныхъ, тѣ́хъ моли́твами хрⷭте, всѣ́хъ на́съ црⷭтвїа твоего́, прича́стники сотвори́. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "An honorable host, victorious warriors, a chosen city, the assembly of the holy Martyrs, a blessed choir, joined together in an angel-pleasing manner with the bodiless hosts: by their prayers, O Christ, make all of us partakers of Thy Kingdom. *Theotokion:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тлыми за́рами, и́же исчре́ва твоего́ возсїѧ́вшаго на́мъ: и безбо́жїа но́щъ потрѣ́бльшаго,
items.english_text: "With radiant beams, from Him Who shone forth unto us from thy womb and abolished the night of godlessness," "...O all-immaculate Mother Mary: enlighten all who honor thee in faith, and deliver them from the ineffable darkness and from condemnation."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: всенепоро́дителнице мр҃їе, просвѣти́ всѣ́хъ и́же вѣ́рою тебе́ чтꙋ́щихъ: и ѿ неисповѣди́мыѧ тмы́, изба́ви и та́ ѡсужде́нїа.
items.english_text: *Another Canon [to the Forerunner]. Heirmos: The Lord, Who is co-unoriginate with the Father...*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ка́ла ма изба́ви грѣхо́внаго гдⷭи, безгрѣ́шне, еди́не многомлⷭстиве, крⷭтла мольба́ми: и́же тебе́ проповѣ́да всемꙋ́ ми́рꙋ а́гнца бж҃їа, взе́млющаго чловѣ́кѡмъ грѣхи́.
items.english_text: "Deliver me from the mire of sin, O Lord, sinless and only abundantly merciful One, by the entreaties of the Baptist: who proclaimed Thee unto the whole world as the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of men."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ ши́покъ бл҃гово́ненъ, ꙗкѡ бл҃гоꙋха́нный кипари́съ, ꙗкѡ неꙋвѧда́емый кри́нъ, ꙗкѡ мѵ́ро чⷭтное, именꙋ́ тѧ, прⷮче: мои́хъ дѣ́лъ злосмра́дїа да изба́влюсѧ, мл҃твами твои́ми, прибѣга́я по кро́въ тво́й.
items.english_text: "Like a sweet-smelling rose, like a fragrant cypress, like an unfading lily, like precious myrrh do I name thee, O Forerunner: that I may be delivered from the foul stench of my deeds by thy prayers, fleeing beneath thy protection."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Непло́дствꙋюща ма безпло́діем, всеблаже́нне, сотвори́ дѣла́ добродѣ́телей бл҃года́тію при́нѡ приноси́ти, ча́до ма гдⷭне ко́рма, и прича́стника бж҃твенному црⷭтвїю, и ст҃ы́хъ собо́ра единожи́телѧ.
items.english_text: "Unto me who am barren in unfruitfulness, O all-blessed one, make me ever to offer the fruits of virtues by grace, nourishing me as a child of the Lord, and a partaker of the divine Kingdom, and a fellow-citizen of the assembly of the saints."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: На́мъ лю́бѧщымъ тѧ, и вѣ́рою блж҃а́щым, и въ бж҃твеннѣмъ хра́мѣ твое́мъ ликꙋ́ющымъ: пода́ждь свы́ше разрѣше́ніе лю́тымъ, прⷮче гдⷭнь, и житї́ю направле́ніе, и прегрѣше́ніѧмъ иꙁбавле́ніе. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "Unto us who love thee, and bless thee in faith, and dance in chorus in thy divine temple: grant from on high deliverance from cruel things, O Forerunner of the Lord, and direction for our life, and redemption from transgressions. *Theotokion:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: О́семь ко оутро́бѣ бг҃ома́терни: и́же всѧ́ носѧ́щаго мані́емъ, поклони́лся еси́: тѣ́мъ то́ моли́ прⷮче: смире́нней сп҃сти́сѧ дши́ мое́и, въ мно́гаа впа́дшаѧ повсѧ́ дни́ согрѣше́нїа.
items.english_text: "Leaping in the womb of the Mother of God: thou didst bow down in worship unto Him Who upholds all things by His nod; therefore pray Him, O Forerunner: that my humble soul may be saved, which falls into many transgressions day by day."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, стїхи́ры Покая́нни, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of Repentance, Tone 2:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Содѣ́ѧнныхъ мои́хъ зѡ́лъ, помышлѧ́ю безꙋ́мьстваѧ, какови́и принеглю́ щедро́тамъ: мы́тарю подоби́хся, и блудни́ци слези́вшей, и блу́дномꙋ сы́нꙋ. Тѣ́мже припада́ю ти млⷭтиве, преждеда́же не ѡсꙋ́диши мене́, пощади́ма бж҃е, и поми́лꙋй ма.
items.english_text: "Pondering the senselessness of my committed evils, what compassions shall I neglect?[^67] I have become like unto the publican, and the harlot who wept, and the prodigal son. Therefore I fall down before Thee, O Merciful One: before Thou judgest me, spare me, O God, and have mercy upon me!"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Беззако́нїа моѧ́ пре́зри гдⷭи, и́же ѿ дв҃ы рожде́йсѧ, и срⷣце мое́ ѡчи́сти, цр҃ковь сїе́ тво́ра ст҃о́мꙋ твоему́ дх҃у, не ѡве́рзи мене́ ѿ твоего́ лица́, безмѣ́рную имѣ́ѧй ве́лїю млⷭть. М:
items.english_text: "Overlook mine iniquities, O Lord Who wast born of the Virgin, and purify my heart, making it a temple for Thy Holy Spirit; cast me not away from Thy presence, Thou Who hast measureless great mercy. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭтъ хв҃ъ взе́мше ст҃ї́и мч҃нци, ѡрꙋ́жіе непобѣди́мое, всю́ дїа́волю си́лꙋ оупраздни́ша, и приꙗ́ша вѣ́ньца нб҃сныѧ: стѣ́на на́м бы́ша, ѡ на́съ молѧ́щеся.
items.english_text: "Having taken up the Cross of Christ, an invincible weapon, the holy Martyrs abolished all the power of the devil, and received heavenly crowns; they have become a wall for us, interceding on our behalf."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Спаси́ ѿ бѣ́дъ рабы́ своѧ́ бцⷣе дв҃о: ꙗкѡ вси́ по бз҃ѣ к тебѣ́ прибѣга́емъ, ꙗкѡ кнерꙋши́мой стѣнѣ́, и предста́телници.
items.english_text: "Save Thy servants from perils, O Virgin Theotokos: for under God we all flee unto thee, as unto an unbreakable wall and protectress."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Въ вто́р[ок] на Бл҃же́нна, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *On Tuesday at the Beatitudes (Blazhenna), Tone 2:*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ ти прино́си разбо́йничь, и мо́лимься: Помани́ на гдⷭи въ црⷭтвїи си.
items.english_text: *The voice of the thief we bring unto Thee, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!*

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Мно́гаѧ ми прегрѣше́нїа пре́зри чл҃колꙋ́бче, и прича́стника ма ꙗви́ цр҃твїа, вы́шней свѣ́тлости, погрꙋженый бе́зднꙋ милосе́рдїа въхо́дахъ прⷮче, зѡ́лъ мои́хъ бе́дну, мл҃твами си, иꙁсуши́.
items.english_text: "Overlook my many transgressions, O Lover of mankind, and show me a partaker of the Kingdom, of the celestial splendor; submerged in the abyss of compassion, O Forerunner, in thy goings dry up the abyss of mine evils by thy prayers."

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И́же прелѣ́стнаѧ тече́нїа, кро́вными стрꙋꙗ́ми иꙁсуши́вше, хв҃ы страстоте́рпци: досто́йно сла́вими есте́. Сла́ва:
items.english_text: "Having dried up the deceitful streams with streams of your blood, O Sufferers of Christ: ye are worthily glorified. *Glory:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Безнача́лней трⷪци тебѣ́ покланѧ́мсѧ, ѻц҃у, и сн҃у, и дх҃у пра́вомꙋ, естество́ трїѻзнаме́нницꙋ про́стꙋю и трїсоста́внꙋю. И ннѣ́:
items.english_text: "Unto Thee, the Trinity without beginning, do we bow down in worship: Father, and Son, and upright Spirit: a Nature thrice-signified, simple, and thrice-hypostatic. *Both now:*"

items.office:
ON SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE, TRIADICAL CANON
[f. 37rA] *Composition of Metrophanes.*[^48]
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Пло́дъ чре́ва твоего́ чⷭтаѧ: и́же плодо́мъ попо́лзшаѧсѧ, па́ки ра́енъ жи́телѧ содѣ́лалъ е́сть.
items.english_text: "The Fruit of thy womb, O pure one: hath again made him who slipped through the fruit to be an inhabitant of Paradise."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ВО ВТО́РОКЪ, В КЕ́ЧЕРЪ, НА ГИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: *Stichera of the Precious Cross, Tone 2.*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы́ры крⷭтны, Гла́съ, в҃. По: Егда́ ѿ дре́ва:
items.english_text: "Unable to endure the sight of the Sun, the luminaries were darkened when Thou, O Word, didst set upon the Cross; and the earth quaked, and the rocks were split; the temple's beauty was rent in twain; the tombs were opened, and the dead arose; and Hades, giving up all those below, proclaimed them in eternity, and as death was accounted unto all."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ти свѣти́ла не терпѧ́ще, ѡмра́чншаса, на крⷭтѣ́ заше́дшꙋ тебѣ́ сло́ве: землѧ́же подвиза́шеса, и ка́меніе распада́шеса: цр҃ко́вное бл҃голѣ́пїе раздира́шеса посредѣ́: гро́бы ѿверза́хуся, ме́ртвїи воста́ху: а́дъ иꙁда́въ ꙗ́же всѧ́ соу́щаѧ долѣ́: въ вѣ́нъ повѣжда́хꙋ, и ꙗ́коже всѣ́мъ вмѣна́шша сме́рть.
items.english_text: "When the noble thief beheld Thee upon the Cross, O Christ, the fruitful Vine: that man became the best and most sincere of thieves; and he received forgiveness for his ancient transgressions with a very devout and small voice, saying unto Him: 'Let us hasten to be Thine, crying out: Remember us also, O Lover of mankind!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Егда́ плодохи́тый тѧ́ хрⷭте єѵногра́дъ, разбо́йнїй бл҃гоѡбра́зный ви́дѣ, лꙋ́чшихъ бы́сть разбо́йникъ бл҃гои́скренъ: и оувѣрада́етъ проще́нїе дре́внимъ согрѣше́нїамъ зѣ́ло бл҃гочести́вѣнѣ мале́м гла́сомъ, томꙋ́ ре́кши: тебе́ бы́ти потщи́мся, е́же, Помани́ и на́съ чл҃колꙋ́бче, вси́ зовꙋ́ще.
items.english_text: "It shines like a star in heaven, in the Church the divine Cross..."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сїѧ́етъ ꙗкѡ звѣзда́ на нб҃си, въ цр҃кви бж҃твенны коне́цтинъ крⷭтъ
items.english_text: "...Thy Cross, O Christ: burning up the demons, but enlightening the faithful, and putting to shame the faces of them that crucified Thee; whose ancestors the Cross prefiguring by the tree, formerly delivered from servitude, and made honey flow from the rock, establishing them in goodness."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: крⷭтъ тво́й хрⷭте: ѡпалѧ́а оу́бѡ бѣ́сы, вѣ́рныѧ же просвѣща́ѧ, и посрамла́ꙗ ли́ца, и́же тебе́ распе́ншымъ, и́хъже природї́телѧ, дре́вомъ воѡбража́ющїи крⷭтъ, пре́жде ѿ рабо́ты иꙁведе́, и ѿ ка́мени ме́дъ истѣчи́, бл҃госта́нн сотвори́лъ еси́.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И́ны стїхи́ры прест҃ѣ́й бцⷣи. Гла́съ, и По: то́иже.
items.english_text: "As the protectress of all men: the present time is great; here as a good intercessor the Judge hath shown thee, who ineffably didst clothe Him Who took our mixture out of tender compassion, and endured the Cross and death for our sake; Him therefore pray unceasingly: to send down forgiveness of transgressions unto all, O Bride of God."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́мъ предста́телницꙋ тѧ́ чл҃кѡ: вре́ма престоѧ́щее вели́кое; всѣ́мъ зде́ су́дницꙋ тѧ́, показа́ бл҃гу́ю хота́иницꙋ, ꙗ́же не́гдетѣ въ на́ше смѣше́нїе ѡболо́къса бл҃гоꙋтро́бнѣ, и распѧ́тїе и сме́рть на́съ ра́ди подъѧ́тъ, того́ оу́бѡ моли́ непреста́нно: всѣ́мъ ѿпуще́ніе низпосла́ти прегрѣше́нїи, бг҃оневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: "Of old the Virgin and Ewe-lamb, beholding Him Who sprang from her womb suspended upon the Tree as one condemned, between two condemned ones: cried aloud, saying: 'O my Son and my God, a dread sight, a dread mystery! To comprehend the abyss of Thy wisdom, none is able: I hymn Thy longsuffering!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Дре́вле дв҃аѧ и а́гнница зра́щи, и́же иꙁчре́ва еа́ надревѣ́ повѣ́шена ꙗкѡ ѡсужде́на, со двѣ́ма ѡсꙋжде́ннома: восклица́ющши гла́ше, сн҃е и бж҃е мо́й, стра́шное види́мѡе, стра́шное та́инство; ѡбъѧ́ти мꙋ́дрости твое́ѧ бе́здну, испыта́ти никто́же мо́жетъ: пою́ твое́ долготерпе́нїе.
items.english_text: "Where is the comeliness of Thy countenance? Where hath the beauty of Thy form hidden itself, O Son? How is it that He Who in beauty made ineffable things, O God, fair in beauty, hangs upon the Tree dishonored and shameful for the sake of all men, having neither form nor comeliness, O Child?' the all-good Virgin cried aloud, groaning and weeping."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Гдѣ́ твоего́ видѣ́нїа бл҃голѣ́пїе: гдѣ́ красота́ сокры́ся доброты́ твое́ѧ сн҃е; ка́кѡ и́же доброто́ю, неизрече́ннаѧ сотвори́вый бж҃е, кра́сный въ добро́тахъ, за всѧ́ чл҃вки безсла́венъ, и бесче́стенъ на дре́вѣ ви́сиши, видѣ́нїа ни доброты́ неимѣ́ѧ ча́до; предо́браѧ дв҃а вопїѧ́ше, стенѧ́щи и пла́чꙋщи.
items.english_text: "The beam of the luminaries set, for He Who is suspended as the Noetic Light..."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: За́йде свѣти́ломъ за́рѧ, мы́сленымъ свѣ́томъ повѣ́кшагося,
items.english_text: "...was stripped naked upon the Cross; for the worse is ever overcome by the greater, and the lesser gives place unto the better; how then was it not fitting for the noetic beam to be hidden when Christ shone forth? Thus with worthy voices the all-pure one cried out, beholding Thee, the Beam of luminaries."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: ѡбнажи́вшаса на крⷭтѣ́, побѣжда́етъса оу́бѡ при́нѡ хꙋ́жшее бо́лшимъ, и лꙋ́чшему ме́ньшее дае́тъ мѣ́сто, ка́кѡ оу́бѡ не подоба́ше свѣтѧ́щꙋ хрⷭтꙋ, сокры́тисѧ зари́ мысле́нки: достѡ́йнымъ гла́ше, тѧ́ зра́щи пречⷭтаѧ, свѣти́ломъ зарꙋ́.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Precious Cross, Tone 2:*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, стїхи́ры Крⷭтны, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: "Save me, O Christ Savior, by the power of the Cross, Thou Who didst save Peter in the sea: and have mercy upon me, O God!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Спаси́ма хрⷭте сп҃се, си́лою крⷭтною, спасы́й петра́ въ мо́ри: и поми́лꙋй ма бж҃е.
items.english_text: "'Let Him be crucified!' they cried aloud who continually enjoyed Thy gifts; and in place of the Benefactor, they asked to receive a malefactor, a murderer of the righteous. But Christ was silent, enduring their fierceness: desiring to suffer and to save us, as the Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Да распне́тъса вопїѧ́хꙋ, и́же твои́хъ дарова́нїи при́нѡ наслажда́ющїисѧ; и злодѣ́ꙗ во бл҃года́телѧ мѣ́сто проша́хꙋ приꙗ́ти, и́же пра́ведниковъ оубї́йцꙋ. Мо́лчаше же хрⷭте́ терпѧ́ и́хъ ꙗро́вство: пострада́ти хотя́ и спасти́ на: ꙗкѡ чл҃колꙋ́бецъ.
items.english_text: "The ranks of the Martyrs opposed the tormentors, saying: 'We do battle for the King of the heavenly powers; though ye deliver us unto fire and torments, we renounce not the power of the Trinity!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ли́ци мч҃нчестїи, проти́вишасѧ мꙋчи́телемъ, глагѡ́люще: мы́ во́инствꙋемъ цр҃емъ си́ламъ, а́ще и ѻгню́ и мꙋ́камъ предасте́ на́съ; но не ѿмета́емса тро́ическїѧ си́лы.
items.english_text: "Having endured many pangs at the Crucifixion of thy Son and God, O all-pure one, she groaned with tears and cried aloud: 'Woe is me, sweet Child! How dost Thou suffer unjustly, desiring to deliver the earthborn descendants of Adam?' Therefore, O all-pure Virgin, we entreat thee in faith: make Him merciful unto us!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Болѣ́зни претерпѣ́вши мно́гїа, въ распѧ́тїи сн҃а и бг҃а твоего́ прⷭтаѧ, стена́ше слезѧ́щи, и восклица́ше: оувы́ мнѣ́ ча́до сла́дкое, безпра́вды ка́кѡ страда́еши, хотя́ изба́вити и́же ѿ ада́ма земноро́дныѧ; тѣ́мже прчⷭтаѧ дв҃о, тебѣ́ мо́лимъ вѣ́рою, ми́лостива на́мъ того́ содѣ́лай.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Precious Cross, Tone 2:*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Спасенїе содѣ́лалъ посредѣ́ землѧ́, хрⷭте бж҃е, на крⷭтѣ́ пречи́стїи рꙋ́цѣ свои́ просте́ръ: собра́лъ всѧ́ ꙗзы́ки, зовꙋ́щыѧ: гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: "Thou hast worked salvation in the midst of the earth, O Christ God; spreading Thine immaculate hands upon the Cross:[^69] Thou hast gathered all the nations, who cry aloud: 'O Lord, glory to Thee!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И́мже ѡ́бразомъ плѣни́лъ е́сть вра́гъ ада́ма, дре́вомъ снѣ́дны: та́кожде гдⷭь са́мъ плѣни́лъ еси́ ты́ врага́, дре́вомъ крⷭтнымъ, и сп҃ртїю свое́ю, на се́бо прїи́де вторы́й ада́мъ: взыска́ти заблꙋ́жшаго, и ѡживи́ти оуме́ршаго, бж҃е сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: "In the same manner as the enemy held Adam captive through the tree of eating: in like manner Thou, the Lord Himself, didst take the enemy captive through the Tree of the Cross and by Thy death; for unto this the second Adam came: to seek the lost one and to make alive him who had died. O God, glory to Thee!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ́ велича́емъ бцⷣе, вопїю́ще: ра́дуйсѧ же́зле, ѿ него́же безсѣ́менно бг҃ъ прозѧ́бе, и погуби́ на крⷭтѣ́ сме́рть.
items.english_text: "We magnify thee, O Theotokos, crying aloud: Rejoice, O Rod from which God budded forth without seed, and destroyed death upon the Cross!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: По в҃. стїхолосїи, Сѣда́лна Крⷭтны, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Precious Cross, Tone 2:*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Животворѧ́щїй крⷭтъ твое́ѧ бл҃гости, его́же дарова́лъ на́мъ недосто́йнымъ гдⷭи, тебѣ́ прино́симъ въ мл҃твꙋ: спаси́ цр҃ѧ и гра́дъ тво́й, молѧ́щїисѧ: бцⷣа ра́ди, еди́не чл҃колꙋ́бче.
items.english_text: "The life-giving Cross of Thy goodness, which Thou hast granted unto us who are unworthy, O Lord, we offer unto Thee in prayer: save the ruler and Thy city that entreat Thee, for the sake of the Theotokos, O only Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́вый земна́ѧ крⷭтомъ, и призва́вый на покаѧ́ніе грѣ́шныхъ, не ѡлучи́ мене́ ста́да твоего́, па́стырю до́брый: но взыщи́ мене́ заблꙋ́жшаго ꙗ́кѡ, и стѡ́мꙋ твоему́ ста́дꙋ сопричти́: и́же еди́не ми́лостиве, и чл҃колꙋ́бче.
items.english_text: "Thou Who didst enlighten earthly things by the Cross, and called sinners unto repentance: separate me not from Thy flock, O Good Shepherd: but seek me who am lost, and number me with Thy holy flock, O only Merciful One and Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: И́же просвѣти́вый ст҃ы́ѧ своѧ́ па́че зла́та, и просла́вивый преподо́бныѧ твоѧ́ ꙗкѡ бг҃ъ: ѿ ни́хже оумоле́нъ быва́ѧ, хрⷭте бж҃е, жи́знь на́шꙋ оумири́, ꙗкѡ чл҃веколю́бецъ, и мл҃твꙋ испра́ви ꙗкѡ кади́ло: и́же еди́не въ ст҃ы́хъ почива́ѧй.
items.english_text: "Thou Who didst enlighten Thy saints more than gold, and glorified Thy venerable ones as God: being entreated by them, O Christ God, give peace unto our life, as the Lover of mankind, and let our prayer be set forth as incense before Thee: Thou Who alone restest in the saints."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, И ннѣ́: Крⷭтобг҃о: По: Милосе́рдїа сꙋ́щи:
items.english_text: "The Virgin and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee stretched out dead upon the Cross, wept bitterly and said: 'O my Son, what is this dread mystery? Thou Who grantest eternal life unto all, how dost Thou die upon the Cross an ignominious death?' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́ва и мт҃и твоꙗ́ хрⷭте, на крⷭтѣ́ зра́щи тѧ́ ме́ртва просте́рта, пла́чꙋщи го́рко гла́ше: сн҃у мо́й, что́ стра́шное сїе́ та́инство; и́же всѣ́мъ да́рꙋѧй живо́тъ вѣ́чный, коли́ко на крⷭтѣ́ ка́кѡ оумира́еши, сме́ртїю поно́сною.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 2.*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: По г҃. ка́: Сѣда́лна Гла́с, в҃. По: Милосе́рдїа сꙋ́щи:
items.english_text: "Like the thief I confess, and I cry unto Thee, O Good One: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom, and count me worthy with them, Thou Who of Thine own will didst endure passions for our sake!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ разбо́йникъ исповѣ́даю, и вопїю́ ти бл҃го́мꙋ: Помани́ мѧ гдⷭи во црⷭтвїи твое́мъ, и сни́ми ма сопочти́, и́же во́лею стра́сти на́ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый.
items.english_text: "Thou Who didst endure crucifixion for our sake and didst become dead, O Jesus, Giver of life: that Thou mightest deliver the creation of Thine hands from the condemnation of death, as compassionate God and Lover of mankind, according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies: Thou Who alone art sinless!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA
items.slavonic_text: Распѧ́тїе претерпѣ́вый на́ ра́ди, и ме́ртвъ бы́ти іс҃е жизнода́вче: ꙗ́кѡ да рꙋкꙋ́ свое́ю созда́нїе, ѿ сме́ртнаго ѡсужде́нїа изба́виши, ꙗкѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ бг҃ъ, и чл҃колꙋ́бецъ, за мно́жество щедро́тъ: и́же еди́ный сы́й безгрѣ́шенъ.
items.english_text: "Preserved by the Precious Cross of thy Son, O pure Lady Theotokos, we easily overcome every assault of the adversary; therefore, as is meet, we bless thee as the Mother of God, the only hope of our souls."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Че́стнымъ крⷭтомъ сн҃а твоего́ сохранѧ́еми, влⷣчце чⷭтаѧ бцⷣе, всѧ́къ прило́гъ бори́тела, вси́ оудо́бнѣ побѣжда́е: сего́ ра́ди подо́бнѣ тѧ́ оублажа́емъ, ꙗкѡ ма́терь бж҃їю, еди́но оупова́ніе дꙋ́шамъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: "The first-created man transgressed the first commandment of old, and thence found death; by Thine elevation upon the Tree," "...O Immortal One, and having tasted of death, Thou didst grant immortality unto all men."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: КАНО́НЪ. Че́стномꙋ и животворѧ́щемꙋ крⷭтꙋ.
items.english_text: "When the Cross was planted upon the earth, the arrogance of the enemy fell down, and he was trampled underfoot; and man, who was formerly condemned, enters again into Paradise; glory to Thee, our God, Who alone hast thus been well pleased. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Престꙋпи́ пе́рвꙋю за́повѣдь дре́вле первозда́нный, ѿ тꙋ́да сме́рть ѡбрѣ́те, воздвиже́нїемъ на дре́во
items.english_text: "Like rams, like noetic lambs, ye were all slaughtered, and pitilessly severed limb from limb, O all-praised Martyrs: and ye were brought unto Him Who was slaughtered, like sheep; and now ye enlighten the Church of the firstborn saints. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: безсме́ртнаѧ, и сме́рти вкꙋси́въ, безсме́ртїе всѣ́мъ чл҃кѡ дарова́.
items.english_text: "Ever exercising steadfastness in suffering, O wise ones, ye cast down the cunning enemies, being severed by the sword, and cast into fire and water; therefore, O passion-bearers, ye were deemed worthy of a blessed end. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭтъ водрꙋзи́выйсѧ на земли́, низпаде́ шата́нїе врага́, и тѧ́ попре́нса, пре́жде же ѡсужде́нный чл҃къ, вра́й па́ки вхо́дитъ, сла́ва тебѣ́, и́же та́ко еди́ному бл҃гоизво́лившему бг҃у на́шему. Мч҃н.
items.english_text: "The sacred company of the Prophets named thee an impassable gate, a chosen land, and an unhewn mountain, O all-pure Lady: for thou didst bear the God of the ages, Who of His own will received crucifixion in the flesh."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ ѻ́вни, ꙗ́ко а́гнци слове́снїи, вси́ закала́еми, и на оу́ды невми́лостивно сѣкꙋ́еми, прехва́льнїи мч҃нци: и принесе́ни бы́сте закла́нномꙋ, ꙗкѡ ѻвчѧ́та; и ннѣ́ црⷭковь ст҃ы́хъ перворо́днїи просвѣща́ете. Мч҃н.
items.english_text: *"Come, ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea and led the people whom He brought out of the bondage of Egypt: for He hath been glorified!"*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пость въ гнѣда́нїи му́дрїи всегда́ твора́ще, лꙋка́выа враги́ низложи́сте, ме́чꙋ сѣкꙋ́еми, и въ ѻ́гнь и въ во́дꙋ въмѣта́еми, тѣ́мже блаже́ннѣй кончи́нѣ страстоно́сци сподо́бистеса. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: "Come, all ye faithful, with one accord let us hymn the Theotokos, for she bore God beyond human understanding; and she unceasingly prays to save us all."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нный тѧ́ прⷪро́ческїй ли́къ, нарица́ше, две́рь непроходи́мꙋ, зе́млю избра́нную, и го́ру неоско́рдомꙋ, прчⷭтаѧ влⷣчце: бг҃а бо вѣ́кꙋ родила́ еси́, и́же во́лею распѧ́тїе пло́тїю прїе́мшаго.
items.english_text: "He Who is the Image of the Father's hypostasis took from thee our mixture," "...O Theotokos Mary; He glorified the fallen image, and made it new."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Градѣ́те людї́е, пое́мъ пѣ́снь хрⷭту бг҃у, раздѣ́льшему мо́ре, и прове́дшему лю́ди и́хже изведѣ́, и́зъ рабо́ты егу́петскїѧ: ꙗкѡ просла́вися.
items.english_text: "Thou art more honorable than the Cherubim, and higher than the heavenly circles; for in thy womb, beyond understanding, thou didst dispassionately contain God. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Вси́ вѣ́рнїи прїиди́тє, согла́сно возпое́мъ бцⷣу, та́ бо бг҃а родила́ е́сть, па́че оума́ чл҃вчꙋ. И непреста́нно мо́личъ, спасти́ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_text: "Thou didst bear the Redemption for our sins, the Benefactor and Lord; having changed the mortality of our forefather Adam, thou didst raise our nature unto the heavens."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: И́же ѡ́бразъ ѻц҃а́ соста́ва, не́тебе
items.english_text: *"The barren church of the gentiles hath blossomed like a lily by Thy coming, O Lord: wherein my heart hath been established."*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: прїѧ́тъ смѣше́нїе, бг҃ородите́лнице мр҃їе, истрада́лшый ѡ́бразъ просла́ви, и его́ но́ва сотвори́.
items.english_text: "Being crucified, Thou didst shake all creation, O Lord, and didst establish it unto its ends, as it hymns Thy power and Thine ineffable condescension, O Word."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Херꙋвї́мъ честнѣ́йши есщи́, и нбⷭныхъ крꙋ́гъ превы́шши бы́сть, бг҃а бо па́че оума́ въ оутро́бѣ сво́ей, безстра́стно въмѣсти́ла еси́. Бг҃ро:
items.english_text: "Thou didst open Paradise by Thy Cross, O Master, and brought in the thief who recognized Thy Kingdom and the wealth of Thy divine compassion. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Иꙁбавле́ніе на́шымъ грѣхѡ́мъ родила́ еси́, бл҃года́телѧ гдⷭа, исмѣни́вши ме́ртвости пра́ѻтца ада́ма, возвела́ еси́ естество́ къ нб҃нымъ.
items.english_text: "The Martyrs blossomed forth like fragrant roses in the spiritual valleys, and drove away the foul-smelling deceit, and made fragrant the hearts of the faithful. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Процвѣла́ е́сть пусты́ни ꙗкѡ кри́нъ гдⷭи, ꙗзы́ческаа непло́дѧщаѧ цр҃ковь, прише́ствїемъ твои́мъ, ѡ не́мже оутверди́ся мое́ срⷣце.
items.english_text: "Luminaries of the universe, faithful saviors: O holy ones, enlighten all with radiant beams, as they worthily bless God."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Распина́емъ, поколеба́лъ еси́ всю́ тва́рь гдⷭи, и в коньцѣ́хъ оутве́рдилъ еси́, воспѣва́ющи си́лꙋ твою́, и неизрече́нное, сло́ве, съхожде́нїе твое́.
items.english_text: "Beholding the Giver of life lifted up upon the Tree, and of His own will dying, Who bestows life upon all: the all-immaculate one cried aloud in her maternal heart."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Златы́ѧ ꙗкѡ вои́стинꙋ кади́лницꙋ, и рꙋ́чко ма́нны, и бж҃їю го́рꙋ, и пала́тꙋ кра́сную бж҃твенꙋю, тѧ́ дв҃о имену́емъ.
items.english_text: "As truly the golden censer, and the jar of manna, and the mountain of God, and the fair divine palace do we name thee, O Virgin."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Цр҃ковь и сщ҃е́нное жили́ще сло́ва, бꙋ́щи бцⷣе: согрѣше́ніемъ ѡчисти́лище, пречⷭтаѧ, бꙋ́ди ми́, при́снѡ дв҃о.
items.english_text: "Being the church and sacred dwelling of the Word, O Theotokos: be thou ever an expiation for my transgressions, O all-pure Virgin."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ни ꙗзы́къ земноро́дныхъ, ни оу́мъ безпло́тныхъ, возмо́жетъ ро́жество твое́ сказа́ти: вы́ше естества́ бо и смы́сла бцⷣе, зижди́телѧ породи́ла еси́.
items.english_text: "Neither the tongue of the earthborn nor the mind of the bodiless hosts is able to declare thy childbirth: for beyond nature and understanding, O Theotokos, thou didst bear the Creator."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Оутверже́нїе бꙋ́ди и прибѣ́жище, и покро́въ дв҃о бг҃ороди́телнице, и́же вѣ́рою к тебѣ́ прибѣга́ющи, и бж҃їю тѧ́ мт҃рь провозвѣща́ющымъ.
items.english_text: "Be thou a confirmation, a refuge, and a protection, O Virgin Theotokos, unto them that flee unto thee in faith, and proclaim thee as the Mother of God."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Оупраздни́лъ еси́ нача́ло, лю́таго мироде́ржца, на дре́во возно́симъ: и клѧ́тву погре́блъ еси́, тѣ́мже тѧ́ сла́вимъ, и́же тебе́ ра́ди спасе́нни, еди́не гдⷭи.
items.english_text: "Thou didst abolish the dominion of the cruel prince of this world when Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, and didst bury the curse; therefore we glorify Thee, who are saved for Thy sake, O only Lord."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Распросте́рта на древѣ́ ви́дѧщи тѧ́ слнце, сокры́ свѣ́тъ: го́ры и ка́менїе распадо́шаса: и завѣ́са цр҃ко́внаа раздра́ся, всеси́льне.
items.english_text: "Beholding Thee stretched out upon the Tree, the sun hid its light; the mountains and the rocks were split, and the veil of the temple was rent in twain, O Almighty One."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Оумерщвлѧ́еми, врага́ до конца́ оумертви́сте, желѣ́зомъ ѡстрꙋ́жеми, ко́жнаго оумерщвле́нїа дебеле́ства совлеко́стеся, мч҃еници бж҃твеннїи, и сла́вою ѡблеко́стеса. Мч҃н:
items.english_text: "Being put to death, ye put the enemy completely to death; being scraped with iron, ye stripped off the thickness of carnal mortality, O divine Martyrs, and were clothed with glory. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Оусѣка́еми глава́ми мч҃ницы ѻужа́сно, лꙋка́вымъ си́лам главы́ оусѣко́ша: и преспѣва́ющꙋ сла́ву наслѣ́доваша ра́дующеся. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "Being dreadfully beheaded, the Martyrs cut off the heads of the cunning powers: and rejoicing, they inherited surpassing glory. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Восїѧ́ и́зъ оутро́бы твое́ѧ, ѡте́чче зарѣ́ніе хрⷭто́съ, и просвѣти́ вселе́нꙋю распина́емъ, ѿпро́конїе неискисобра́чнаѧ, и бѣсо́вскꙋю тмꙋ́ потрѣби́лъ е́сть.
items.english_text: "From thy womb the paternal Effulgence, Christ, shone forth; and being crucified, He enlightened the universe, O unwedded Maiden, and abolished the demonic darkness."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ка́плю ми оумиле́нїа ѡдожди́ бл҃дце, взе́млющи всѧ́къ соу́ца моего́ зно́й, и дрѣма́нїа моего́, мꙋ́тны пото́ки оуставлѧ́ющи.
items.english_text: "Rain down upon me a drop of compunction, O Lady, taking away all the burning heat of my heart, and checking the turbid streams of my slumber."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Орꙋ́жїемъ ма сласте́й оумрщви́на, и лежа́ща ѡбра́нєна, пречⷭтаѧ, не пре́зри: но исцѣли́, копіе́м и кро́вїю распѧ́таго сн҃а бж҃їего, и бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: "Despise me not, O all-pure one, who am slain by the weapon of pleasures and lie wounded: but heal me by the spear and blood of the crucified Son of God and our God."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Обогати́вши бж҃ество́мъ всю́ тва́рь, лю́тѣ ма ѡбнища́вша, бл҃года́ти бж҃твеннѣй сподо́би, ꙗкѡ да велича́ю тѧ́, ꙗкѡ благꙋ́ю мою́ предста́телницꙋ, всенепоро́чнаѧ. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "Thou who hast enriched all creation with divinity: vouchsafe me who am grievously impoverished to attain divine grace, that I may magnify thee as my good protectress, O all-immaculate one. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Прохлади́ ма дв҃це покла́нїем, и ѡдожди́ срⷣце мое́, ꙗ́коущее зно́емъ страсте́й, излива́ющи на́мъ ма́сло исцѣле́нїа, млⷭти твоѧ́.
items.english_text: "Refresh me, O Maiden, by repentance, and rain down upon my heart which burns with the heat of passions, pouring out upon us the oil of healing, even thy mercies."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: На крⷭтѣ́ пригвожде́нъ бы́въ, земна́ѧ основа́нїа поколеба́лъ еси́, и копі́емъ пробода́емъ, змі́а началозло́бнаго закла́лъ еси́: и ка́плю спасе́нїа всѣ́мъ хрⷭте источи́лъ еси́.
items.english_text: "Being nailed unto the Cross, Thou didst shake the foundations of the earth; and being pierced with the spear, Thou didst slay the dragon who is the originator of evil: and Thou didst pour forth a drop of salvation unto all, O Christ."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Нетерпѧ́ше зрѣ́ти заблꙋжда́ема, его́же созда́ рꙋка́ма: рꙋ́цѣ распросте́рлъ еси́ сло́ве, на древѣ́ оумерщвлѧ́емь: и ѡживи́лъ еси́ сего́, дре́во дре́вле оуме́ршаго.
items.english_text: "Enduring not to see him go astray whom Thine hands had formed: Thou didst stretch forth Thine hands upon the Tree, O Word, being put to death: and Thou didst quicken him who had died of old through the tree."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Дрꙋ́зи хв҃ы те́плыи, чл҃кѡм застꙋ́пници, цр҃ква́мъ чⷭтні́и, преоудо́бреннїи сосꙋ́ды дх҃а, мꙋ́дрїи страстоте́рпци,
items.english_text: "Fervent friends of Christ, intercessors for men, venerable unto the churches, all-adorned vessels of the Spirit: the wise passion-bearers" "...are worthily blessed. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: страстоте́рпци, досто́йнѣ оублажа́ютъса. Мч҃н.
items.english_text: "Lawfully did the choir of Thy holy sufferers contend; they put the lawless to shame, O only Lawgiver, by Thy power: and having finished the course, they were victoriously crowned. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Зако́нно пострада́, ли́къ ст҃ы́хъ твои́ страда́лєцъ, беззако́нны посрами́, еди́не законода́вче, си́лою кое́ю: и сконча́въ тече́нїе, побѣ́дно вѣнча́ся. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: "Thou wast shown forth incorrupt after childbirth, O pure Virgin, for God was incarnate and born of thee; beholding Whom crucified, unable to bear it, she cried aloud in maternal grief."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗви́са чⷭтаѧ по ржⷭтвѣ́ нетлѣ́нна, бг҃ъ бо и́с тебе́ роди́ся воплоща́е, его́же оузрѣ́вши распина́ема, нетерпѧ́щи, оутро́бною болѣ́знїи восклица́ше.
items.english_text: "We the faithful know Thee to be incarnate of thee, O Theotokos, who didst bear the Son without seed: true God, and man by nature: therefore we glorify thee."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Воплоще́на и́с тебе́ бг҃ородите́лнице, вѣ́рнїи позна́хомъ, безсѣ́мене сн҃а ро́ждьша, бг҃а и́стинна, и чл҃ка естество́м: тѣ́мже тѧ́ сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: "Fleeing ever in faith unto thy protection and intercession, O all-pure Virgin, for thy sake we are delivered from great and cruel distress."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Покро́въ тво́й пречⷭтаѧ и застꙋпле́ніе, вѣ́рнїи всегда́ прибѣга́юще вѣ́рою, тебе́ ра́ди дв҃о, избавлѧ́емса, вели́каго лю́таго шерто́жїа.
items.english_text: "Deliver us from temptations, and from perilous thoughts, O all-pure one: from great wrath, and from great sin, from famine and pestilence, and from eternal torment, O Virgin. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Изба́ви на́съ искꙋше́нїй, и бѣ́дъ помышле́нїй пречⷭтаѧ, вели́каго гнѣ́ва, и вели́каго грѣха́, гла́да же и гꙋби́тельства, и вѣ́чнаго дв҃о мꙋче́нїа. Бг҃оро:
items.english_text: "Be thou our protectress, salvation, and hope, O Lady, unto Christians: save them that ever faithfully hymn thee in love, O all-praised Virgin."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Предста́телница на́ша, спасе́ніе и оупова́нїе, влⷣчце, христїа́ном бꙋ́ди: спаса́и и́же любо́вію тѧ́ при́снѡ вѣ́рно воспѣва́ющихъ, дв҃о вспѣ́таѧ.
items.english_text: *"In the sea-monster, Jonah cried aloud: 'Lead me up from the depth of Hades, O Master, that as unto the Deliverer, in the voice of praise and in the spirit of truth, I may sacrifice unto Thee!' "*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Въ кї́тѣ ѡ ки́та їѡ́на вопїѧ́ше, та́й ма возведи́, изглу́бны а́да, влⷣко: да ꙗкѡ исбави́телю, въ гла́сѣ хвале́нїа, и́стинным же дх҃омъ пожрꙋ́ ти.
items.english_text: "Laying his hands across their heads of old, Jacob prefigured the Cross:"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: На ѻ́ныхъ глава́х, поло́жъ дла́нн ино́гда їа́кѡвъ, крⷭтъ прописа́ваше:
items.english_text: "...upon which, O Word, Thou didst stretch forth Thy palms: and from the hand of the deceitful warrior Thou didst deliver mankind, O Christ."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: прописа́ваше: нане́мже сло́ве, распросте́ралъ еси́ дла́нн: и ѿ рꙋки́ льсти́ваго борца́, изба́ви хрⷭте члове́чество.
items.english_text: "When Thou of Thine own will wast crucified, O Christ, King of all, reigning sin was buried; and Adam, who of old was expelled from Paradise, is settled therein again, hymning Thee."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Распе́ншꙋтиса хрⷭте, всѣ́хъ цр҃ю во́лею, црⷭтвꙋющїи грѣ́хъ погребе́са, ада́мъ же и́же дре́вле и́зъ ра́а изгна́нный, в го́и вселѧ́етъса па́ки, тебе́ воспѣва́а.
items.english_text: "Still covered with blood in sacred wounds, who were adorned with heavenly beauty: the truly beloved Martyrs of the Lord I hymn with an unwavering heart. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Кро́вленъ еще́ въ ра́нах сщ҃енныѧ, и́же бл҃голѣ́пїемъ оукраси́вшаса небⷭнымъ, вои́стинꙋ возлю́бленныѧ гдⷭни мч҃ники, несомнѣ́нный срⷣцем воспою́. М:
items.english_text: "The divine Martyrs preserved their lamp unquenchable, having richly replenished it with their own blood: and rejoicing, they received entrance into the divine bridal chamber."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Не ѡугаси́момь свѣ́щꙋ свою́ соблюдо́ша, бж҃твеннїи мч҃ници, напои́вше бога́тнѡ кро́вьми свои́ми: и бж҃твенаго черто́га получи́ша вхо́дъ, ра́дꙋющеся.
items.english_text: "We hymn thee, O all-praised one, who didst bear the all-hymned God, Who upon the Tree destroyed the adversary enemy: and delivered us who hymn His sufferings."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ тѧ́ всенепѣ́таѧ, ꙗкѡ бг҃а ро́ждшꙋ препѣ́таго, и́же на дрѣ́вѣ сопротивобо́рца врага́ погꙋ́бльшаго: и на́съ изба́вльшаго, воспѣва́ющихъ того́ страда́нїа.
items.english_text: "He Who by His will fashions all things was well pleased to dwell within the womb of the unwedded Maiden: and now by a mystery He hath enriched them that cry aloud with incorruption, as an infant."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: И́же во́лею всѧ́ содѣ́лаваѧй, изво́ли въ чре́во неискꙋсобра́чныѧ всели́тися: и ннѣ́же та́инїемъ вола́ющїи, нетлѣ́нїемъ ѡбогати́ е́сть, ꙗкѡ мла́дъ.
items.english_text: "Thou art higher than the celestial powers, and more holy, O all-immaculate one: having supernaturally received into thy womb the Word Whom nothing can contain."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Превы́шши вы́шний си́лъ, и ст҃ѣ́йши еси́ пренепоро́чнаѧ: па́че естества́ вземлѣти́вши, некомѣсти́мое сло́во во чре́во свое́.
items.english_text: "Guide me unto the path of repentance, O Lady: who have gone astray upon the way of life, and often fall into sinful trackless wastes. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: на тѧ́ возло́жый наде́ждꙋ ра́бъ твои́хъ: прибѣ́жище бо влⷣчце, и дꙋша́м оутѣше́нїе, ты́ еси́.
items.english_text: "Despise not our supplications, O pure one, who" "...hast placed the hope of thy servants upon thee: for thou art a refuge, O Lady, and comfort unto our souls."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Орꙋ́жїе е́же пре́жде ѡбраща́емое, пле́щи мнѣ́ дае́тъ: ѡне́льже копі́емъ прободе́ся, на крⷭтѣ́ воздви́женный, бл҃гоꙋтро́бне гдⷭи, тѣ́мже велича́ю тѧ́, твое́ю чⷭтною стрⷭтїю, ѡбрѣ́тъ безстра́стїе.
items.english_text: "The turning sword of old turns its back upon me, ever since Thou, lifted up upon the Cross, wast pierced with the spear, O compassionate Lord; therefore I magnify Thee, having found dispassion through Thy precious Passion."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Змі́и, и́же моѵсї́омъ воздвиза́емый на дре́во: бж҃твенное воздвиже́нїе проѡбража́ше хв҃о; и́же лести́ваго змі́а оумертви́ша: всѣ́хъ же ѡжи́вльшаго на оумертви́вшаго престꙋпле́ніе.
items.english_text: "The serpent lifted up upon the tree by Moses prefigured the divine elevation of Christ; which put the deceitful serpent to death, and made all alive, putting to death our transgression."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Сы́нове быва́сте бж҃твенны прїѡбще́нїемъ, безнача́лна роди́телѧ сн҃у безнача́лнꙋ, ст҃ї́и: стрⷭти пречи́стѣи ꙗкѡ оуподо́блешася, тѣ́мже брїа́тїю вы́ нарица́етъ, и насле́дники црⷭтвїа его́. Мч҃нк:
items.english_text: "Ye became divine sons by communion with the Son Who is without beginning from the Father without beginning, O holy ones: having been conformed unto His all-pure Passion; therefore He calls you brethren and heirs of His Kingdom. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: На крⷭтъ воздвиже́нїем, ꙗ́коже влⷣка: и копі́емъ пробода́еми, и ме́чн сосѣка́еми: на ѻ́гнь же и во́дꙋ раздѣлѧ́еми, и содро́блаеми ко́лем, бг҃оно́сныи мч҃нци ра́довахꙋся. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "By elevation upon the cross, like the Master, and pierced with the spear, and severed with the sword: divided between fire and water, and crushed upon wheels, the God-bearing Martyrs rejoiced. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Гро́зда созрѣ́вша, его́же небодѣ́ланно чⷭтаѧ возрасти́ла еси́: на дре́вѣ ꙗкѡ оузрѣ́ повѣ́шенна, вопиꙗ́ше: чю́до сла́дкое, мѵ́ста искапи́: и́мже страсте́й пїа́нство ѡти́метса.
items.english_text: "Beholding the Cluster of grapes which thou didst cultivate without tillage, O pure one, hanging upon the Tree, she cried aloud: 'O sweet Wonder, drip forth sweet wine, whereby the drunkenness of passions may be taken away!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пость моѧ́ и пѣ́нїе и спасе́нїе, и извѣ́стное застꙋпле́ніе, и стѣна́ неѡбори́маѧ, ты́ еси́ влⷣчце: борꙋ́щыѧ ма дѣ́моны
items.english_text: "My strength, and hymn, and salvation, and sure protection, and unassailable wall art thou, O Lady: conquer the demons that war against me," "...who ever seek to put my soul to death."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: побѣди́, при́нѡ и́щꙋщихъ дш҃у мою́ оумертви́ти.
items.english_text: "Thou who didst incarnate God from thy virginal blood, Who made mankind alive of old: deliver me by thy prayers, who am defiled by passions and have fallen through the wiles of the enemy."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃а вопло́щши ѿ дѣ́твенныхъ свои́хъ крове́й, ѡжи́вльшаго дрво члове́чество, тѣ́мже ма страстьми́ ѡскверне́ннаго, и испа́вша вра́жїими ко́зньми: изба́ви мл҃твами си.
items.english_text: "The furnace prefigured thy childbirth, O all-immaculate one, for it burned not the Children; even as the divine Fire burned not thy womb; therefore pray thou to deliver thy servants from eternal fire."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Пе́щь проѡбража́ше твое́ ро́жество всенепоро́чнаѧ, ѻ́троки бо не ѡпали́: ꙗ́коже ни оутро́бꙋ тво́ю ѻ́гнь бж҃твенны, тѣ́мже моли́, рабы́ своѧ́ ѻгнѧ́ вѣ́чнаго изба́вити.
items.english_text: "By the blood that dripped from Thy pure ribs, O Longsuffering One, creation was sanctified, and the rivers of polytheism were dried up: and the cloud of piety was magnified, trampling down the deluge of deceit."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Кро́вїю и́с твои́хъ ре́бръ нетлѣ́нныхъ иска́павшею долготерпѣ́ливе, тва́рь ѡст҃и́сѧ, рѣ́ки же многобо́жїа иꙁсуше́ни бы́ша: тꙋ́ча же ме́ншася бл҃гоче́стїа, пре́лести вездꙋ́ждїе попре́вльющи.
items.english_text: "At Thy Crucifixion the sun was ashamed, and hid its beams; the rocks were split, and Hades below was terrified: and the souls of the righteous leaped for joy, awaiting utter deliverance, O Word."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Распѧ́тїа твоего́ слнце оустыдѣ́ся, и своѧ́ лꙋча́ сокры́: камени́ꙗ же распада́шася, и а́дъ ни́зꙋ оустраши́ся: пра́ведныѧ же дш҃и, возигра́шася: члю́ще всеконе́чнаго сло́ве избавле́ніа.
items.english_text: "The relics of the passion-bearers pour forth healings unto the faithful, and ever heal the wounds of diseases that are difficult to cure; 'Wondrous art Thou, O Lord, in Thy holy Martyrs!' we cry aloud with thanksgiving. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Исцѣле́нїа вѣ́рнымъ то́чатъ ѡста́нки моще́й страстоте́рпецъ, и вся́гда вре́ды, не оудо́бь исцѣли́мыхъ болѣ́зней исцѣлѧ́ютъ, ꙗкѡ ди́венъ еси́ гдⷭи, зове́мъ бл҃года́рно, въ ст҃ы́хъ свои́хъ мч҃нцехъ. Мч҃нк:
items.english_text: "Having your mouths muzzled, and your limbs bound fast, and enduring the freezing cold, the weight of burning heat, the tearing of nails, bitter imprisonments, and a violent death, O passion-bearers: ye are therefore glorified with Christ."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Оуста́ закрѣ́мъ, и крѣ́пка коньца́м, померза́нїа же срⷣдечне, та́жить зно́а, но́гтем истѧза́нїа претерпѣ́сте крѣпча́йши и затворе́нїа, и нꙋ́жнꙋю сме́рть страстоте́рпци, тѣ́мже со хрⷭто́м
items.english_text: "...*Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Пло́тъ и́зъ твое́го чре́ва прїе́мле хотя́й: и ви́димъ быва́етъ неви́димый: и распѧ́тїе претерпѣ́ клѧ́тва: и клѧ́тва нарица́ется, ѿ кла́твы изима́ѧ всѣ́хъ, сн҃ъ тво́й бг҃ора́дованнаѧ влⷣчце.
items.english_text: "Desiring to take flesh from thy womb, the Invisible One becomes visible; and He Who is the curse endured crucifixion and is called a curse, delivering all from the curse, even thy Son, O Lady full of divine joy!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: И́же дре́вле ѡроси́вшаго евре́йскїа ѻ́троки въ ѻгни́: и ѻпа́льшꙋ гдⷭь халде́а пресла́вно нѣ́мъ, восхва́лимъ, гл҃юще: блгⷭвите всѧ́ дѣла́ гдⷭна гдⷭа, по́йте и превозноси́те его́ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *"Unto Him Who of old bedewed the Hebrew Children in the fire, and wondrously burned the Chaldeans: let us sing praises, saying: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and highly exalt Him unto all ages!' "*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Жи́во и не зави́стно спасе́ніе на́мъ земноро́днымъ, нескве́рнаѧ а́гнице, ꙗ́же породи́ а́гньца бж҃їа: непре́зри мене́ зовꙋ́ща, блгⷭслови́те всѧ́ дѣла́ гдⷭна гдⷭа, по́йте, и превозноси́те его́ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: "Living and unstinting salvation unto us earthborn, O immaculate Ewe-lamb, who didst bear the Lamb of God: despise me not who cry: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and highly exalt Him unto all ages!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твенное твое́ пречⷭтаѧ ро́жество, ѡбнови́ на́съ: и вскꙋ́хъ чѧ́да показа́, и сн҃и днї́и и свѣ́тꙋ, и спа́сшеса возыва́е: блгⷭвите всѧ́ дѣла́ гдⷭна гдⷭа, по́йте и превозноси́те егѡ́ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: "Thy divine childbirth, O all-pure one, renewed us, and showed us to be children and sons of the day and of light; and being saved, we cry aloud: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and highly exalt Him unto all ages!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ ложе́снъ дв҃ческихъ: и ѡчта́вле́ніе источи́ла еси́, ѿ не́тожи во́дꙋ породи́ла еси́ чⷭтаѧ, ни исцѣле́нїй вѣ́рны: тѣ́мже вси́ зове́м: блгⷭвите всѧ́ дѣла́ гдⷭна гдⷭа, по́йте и превозноси́те его́ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: "From thy virginal loins thou didst pour forth remission; whence thou didst bring forth water, O pure one, for the healing of the faithful: therefore we all cry aloud: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and highly exalt Him unto all ages!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Гро́здъ зрѣ́лый жи́зни, ты́ возрасти́ла еси́ чⷭтаѧ, лозѣ́бо еси́ оувлажа́ющїи зе́млю бл҃ги́ми, ю́же пою́ще, зове́мъ: блгⷭвите всѧ́ дѣла́ гдⷭна гдⷭа, по́йте и превозноси́те его́ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: "The ripe Cluster of life hast thou brought forth, O pure one: for thou art the Vine that waters the earth with good things; hymning which, we cry aloud: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise and highly exalt Him unto all ages!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: и гдⷭь: вопло́щься ѿ дв҃ы, наꙗви́са, ѡмра́чны просвѣти́ти, и сокра́ти расточе́нныѧ, тѣ́мже всепѣ́тую бцⷣу велича́ем.
items.english_text: *"The Son of the Father without beginning, God and Lord:"*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Исцѣли́ сокрꙋше́нїе и ѡкаꙗ́нство мое́, твое́ю ра́ною, еди́не неисцѣлова́ние: и погребе́нный ѡ́бразъ лꙋка́выми страстьми́, ѡчи́сти стрⷭтїю свое́ю влⷣко, бж҃е спасе́нїа моего́.
items.english_text: "...being incarnate of the Virgin, hath appeared unto us, to enlighten the darkened and to gather together the dispersed; therefore the all-hymned Theotokos do we magnify!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ви́денъ бы́сть возноси́мъ, на кипари́сѣ влⷣко, и на пе́вкѣ и ке́дрѣ, ра́ди бл҃гости, еди́нъ сы́й ст҃ы́ѧ трⷪца, еди́нъ соста́въ имѣ́й, во дво́ю естествꙋ́, да спасе́ши чл҃вчество. М:
items.english_text: "Heal my brokenness and my wretchedness by Thy wound, O only Physician: and the image buried by cunning passions, purify by Thy Passion, O Master, God of my salvation!"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭто́мъ ꙗ́коже щито́м ѡбо́лкшеся мч҃еницы: невреди́ми ꙗви́стеся, всѣ́ми стрѣла́ми содѣ́тела зло́бы, тѣ́мже мы́слїю того́ попира́ете: томꙋ́ рꙋга́ющеся, ꙗ́ко хꙋдѣ́и пти́ци всегда́. Мч҃нк:
items.english_text: "Thou wast seen lifted up upon the cypress, O Master, and upon the pine and cedar, for the sake of Thy goodness: being One of the Holy Trinity, having one Hypostasis in two natures, that Thou mightest save mankind. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Землѧ́ оу́бѡ зѣ́мными, кро́вн ва́ша, прїѧ́тъ: нб҃о же, бж҃твенныѧ прїѧ́тъ дх҃и, со ѻ́гненными чи́ньми бж҃твенномꙋ прⷭтолу предстоя́щими: страстоте́рпцы мч҃ници, церко́внїи столпы́ непоколе́блемїи. Кг҃о:
items.english_text: "Clothed with the Cross as with a shield, O Martyrs, ye were shown forth unharmed by all the arrows of the author of evil; therefore in thought ye trample him underfoot, mocking him as a feeble sparrow evermore. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
