items.slavonic_text: Истлѣ́вшее ѡбнови́ла еси́ естество́ пра́ѻтчее, па́че естества́ ро́жши и дѣ́твꙋющи, естествꙋ́ всемꙋ́ созда́телѧ, его́же на крⷭтѣ́ повѣше́нна дре́вле ви́дѧщи, восклица́ше пречⷭтаѧ мт҃и дв҃о.
items.english_text: "The earth received your blood among earthly things, but heaven received your divine spirits, standing before the divine Throne with the fiery ranks: O passion-bearing Martyrs, unshakable pillars of the Church! *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: И́же ѡ бг҃а бг҃а сло́во, неизрече́нною мꙋ́дростїю, прише́дшаго ѡбнови́ти ада́ма, ꙗдї́ю тлѣ́нїа па́дшаго лю́тѣ, ѿ ст҃ы́ѧ дв҃ы, неизрече́нно вопло́
items.english_text: "Thou hast renewed the corrupted nature of our forefathers, having supernaturally given birth while remaining a virgin unto the Creator of all nature: Whom beholding hanging upon the Cross of old, the all-pure Virgin Mother cried aloud."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: И́же ѡ бг҃а бг҃а сло́во, неизрече́нною мꙋ́дростїю, прише́дшаго ѡбнови́ти ада́ма, ꙗдї́ю тлѣ́нїа па́дшаго лю́тѣ, ѿ ст҃ы́ѧ дв҃ы, неизрече́нно вопло́
items.english_text: *"God the Word from God, Who by ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam, who had fallen grievously through the eating of corruption: ineffably incarnate of the holy Virgin for our sake:"*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: дв҃ы неизрече́нно вопло́щьшася на́съ ра́ди, вѣ́рнїи, еди́номудрено пѣ́сньми велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *"...with one accord we the faithful magnify Him in hymns!"*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Оувлюче́нїа ма бж҃твеннаго сподо́би, ѻтрокови́це, ꙗ́же еди́на чл҃колю́бца бг҃а пло́ть ѿ тебе́ заимова́вша, неизгла́но ро́жши, изба́ви ма бꙋ́дꙋщаго пла́мене, и мꙋ́ки вся́кїа, и́же любо́вію тебе́ сла́вѧщаго.
items.english_text: "Vouchsafe me divine radiance, O Maiden, who alone didst ineffably give birth to the Lover of mankind, Who borrowed flesh from thee: deliver me from the coming flame and from every torment, who glorify thee in love."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ тве́рдое предста́тельницꙋ, ꙗкѡ оупова́нїе и стѣ́нꙋ, и наде́жду, и покро́въ тве́рдъ, и неѡбори́мое оутвержде́нїе: и небꙋ́рное приста́нище, стѧжа́вше тѧ́ вси́: спаса́еми ви́чнѣ та́ бцⷣе.
items.english_text: "Having acquired thee, O Theotokos, as a firm protectress, as a hope and a wall, an expectation and a steadfast shelter, an unassailable confirmation and a harbor sheltered from storms: all of us are eternally saved."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ ро́ждши бж҃твенный: мно́гими помрачи́вшаго страсте́й наведе́нїи, и помышле́нїи чꙋжда́го, срⷣце мое́ просвѣти́ ѻтрокови́це, ка́плю подаю́щи ми́ при́нѡ: ѿ скве́рнъ грѣха́ дв҃о ѡчища́ющꙋю ма.
items.english_text: "Having borne the Divine Light: enlighten my heart, O Maiden, which is darkened by the many assaults of passions and thoughts of the stranger, ever granting me a drop that purifies me from the defilements of sin, O Virgin."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, стїхи́ры Крⷭтны, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Precious Cross, Tone 2:*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭта твое́го дрѣ́во хрⷭте бж҃е: дрѣ́во живо́тное показа́ на́мъ, вѣ́рꙋющїи въ та́, и ни́мъ оупраздни́ и́же держа́хꙋ и мꙋ́щаго смрⷭти, ѡживи́лъ же еси́ на ѻумерщве́нныѧ грѣхо́м, тѣ́мже вопїе́мъ ти́, бл҃года́телю всѣ́хъ гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: "The Wood of Thy Cross, O Christ God, hath been shown forth as the Tree of life unto us who believe in Thee; and thereby Thou didst abolish him that held the power of death,[^71] and didst make us alive who were dead through sin; therefore we cry aloud unto Thee: 'O Benefactor of all, Lord, glory to Thee!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Во́лею ѡсннща́вша: ѡсннща́нїа ра́ди ада́мова, хрⷭте бж҃е, прише́лъ еси́ на зе́млю, ѿ дв҃ы вопло́щьса: и распѧ́тїе прїѧ́тъ, да на́съ свободи́ши ѿ рабо́ты вра́жїа: гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ́. Мч҃нк:
items.english_text: "Having voluntarily become poor for the sake of Adam's poverty, O Christ God, Thou camest upon earth, incarnate of the Virgin; and Thou didst receive crucifixion, that Thou mightest free us from the bondage of the enemy: O Lord, glory to Thee! *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїа гра́да и страна́, чтї́тъ мо́щи ва́ша, ст҃ї́и страстоте́рпцы
items.english_text: "Every city and country honors your relics, O holy passion-bearing Martyrs:"

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: мч҃ници, вы́ бо зако́нно пострада́вше, вѣ́нца съ нб҃се прїѧ́сте, и сего́ ра́ди ст҃и́телемъ есте́ похвала́: цр҃квамъ побѣ́да, и цр҃квамъ бл҃голѣ́пїе.
items.english_text: "...for having lawfully contended, ye received crowns from heaven; and therefore ye are the boast of hierarchs, the victory of churches, and the beauty of churches."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: И ннѣ́: Крⷭтобг҃о: По: Егда́ ѿ дрѣ́ва:
items.english_text: "The all-ripe Cluster, Whom thou didst carry untilled in thy womb, when thou didst behold Him hanging upon the Tree, O pure one: sobbing, she cried aloud and called out: 'O Child, drip forth sweetness, whereby all drunkenness of passions may be taken away, O Benefactor: for the sake of me who bore Thee, by divine supplications, as Thou art compassionate!' "

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Гро́здъ всесозрѣ́лый чⷭтаѧ, его́же невоздѣ́ланно въ оутро́бѣ носи́ла еси́, на древѣ́ ꙗкѡ оузрѣ́ сего́ повѣше́нна: рыда́ющи восклица́ше и возыва́ше: ча́до, сла́дость искапа́й, е́юже ѿи́метса пія́нство всѧ́кое страсте́й, бл҃года́телю, мене́ ра́ди тебе́ ро́ждшыѧ, бж҃твенными мольба́ми ꙗ́кѡ, мл҃рдъ.
items.english_text: *On Wednesday at the Beatitudes (Blazhenna), Tone 2:*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ ти прино́симъ разбо́йнїй, и мо́лимся: Помани́ на́съ гдⷭи въ цр҃твїи сво́емъ.
items.english_text: *The voice of the thief we bring unto Thee, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!*

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: На крⷭтъ возне́сшисѧ сп҃се, совознеслъ еси́ все́ чл҃чкое естество́: непреста́нно пою́щее тѧ́.
items.english_text: "Lifted up upon the Cross, O Savior, Thou didst raise up all human nature with Thyself, which unceasingly hymns Thee."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ада́мово рꙋкописа́нїе, копіе́мъ си раздра́лъ еси́, того́ написа́въ въ кни́зѣ живы́и чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: "The handwriting against Adam Thou didst tear in pieces with Thy spear, inscribing him in the book of the living, O Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Подо́бници бы́вше, распѧ́тїе претерпѣ́вшему: того́ ѡбѣ́щници и сла́вѣ бы́сте, мꙋ́ченици.
items.english_text: "Having become imitators of Him Who endured crucifixion: ye became partakers of His glory, O Martyrs."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Отц҃ъ пребезнача́лный: сн҃ъ собезнача́лный, да пое́тся въ еди́ной че́сти и сла́вѣ, кꙋ́пно со дх҃омъ.
items.english_text: "The Father without beginning, and the Son co-beginningless, let them be hymned in one honor and glory, together with the Spirit."

items.office: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: На крⷭтѣ́ ꙗкѡ ви́дѣвши, его́же безсѣ́менн роди́ла еси́: того́ долготерпѣ́ніе ѻтрокови́це, воспѣва́ше слезѧ́щи.
items.english_text: "Beholding Him upon the Cross Whom thou didst bear without seed: the Maiden hymned His longsuffering with tears."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хи ст҃ы́мъ апл҃ѡмъ, гл҃, в҃. По: Егда́ ѿ дрѣ́ва:
items.english_text: *Stichera to the Holy Apostles, Tone 2.*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Всю́ напои́сте зе́млю, ꙗ́коже рѣ́ки, раздѣ́льшеся дх҃о́вныѧ и́зъ еде́ма: и́же и пожра́вше, кре́сте спасе́нное проповѣда́нїе, и кла́съ бл҃гопло́денъ пожа́сте му́дрїи: дш҃а спасе́нныѧ си́хъ мы́сленныхъ сокро́вищный сокрыва́юще, ѻу́чници гдⷭни, ꙗкѡ многоуче́нное бога́тство.
items.english_text: "Ye watered all the earth like spiritual rivers flowing forth from Eden; and having offered sacrifice, ye preached the saving preaching, and reaped a fruitful harvest, O wise ones: hiding the saved souls of these within noetic treasures, O disciples of the Lord, as a multi-instructed wealth."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ тмы́ страсте́й и сласте́й, многостра́стное ми́ срⷣце свободи́те, свѣти́лницы сꙋ́ще восто́ка мы́сльнаго, и просвѣти́телїе пресвѣ́тлыи, слнца всѣ́мъ возсїѧ́юще, разо́рьшаго ле́сть но́щї зло́бїѧ, его́же оумо́лѣте, и на́ша просвѣти́ти смы́слы, ꙗкѡ самови́дцы его́.
items.english_text: "From the darkness of passions and pleasures, deliver my much-suffering heart, ye who are luminaries of the noetic East, and all-radiant enlighteners, shining forth the Sun unto all, Who dissolved the deceit of the night of malice; pray Him, as His eyewitnesses, to enlighten our minds also."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Но́выѧ вои́стиннꙋ бл҃гти, бы́ скрижа́ли бг҃оначерта́нныѧ, таи́нници и свѣ́тци оудѡвльены́и ꙗви́стеся: сло́во спасе́нное но́саще, напи́санное дх҃о́внымъ пе́рстомъ, тѣ́мже проидо́сте вся́ коньца́, вѣ́рꙋ правосла́внꙋю, и ко не́й сте́зю ведꙋ́щꙋю, всѣ́мъ члове́кѡмъ ꙗ́вѣ пока́зꙋюще.
items.english_text: "Ye were shown forth as truly new tablets of grace inscribed by God, initiates of mysteries and sufficient witnesses: bearing the saving Word, written by the Finger of the Spirit; therefore ye traversed all the ends of the earth, clearly showing forth unto all men the Orthodox faith and the path that leads unto it."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Въ мѵ́рехъ пожи́въ оувѣтше́нно: мѵ́ро вои́стиннꙋ ꙗви́лся еси́, мѵ́ромъ пома́за бы́въ мы́сльнымъ, ст҃е никола́е, ст҃лю хв҃ъ, и оуха́нїи безсме́ртнꙋю во́ню, бл҃гоуха́нїа, вѣ́рою притѣка́ющимъ по кро́въ тво́й, разрѣша́ѧ си́хъ ѿ напа́стей и бѣ́дъ и скорбе́й ѻч҃е, и́же къ гдⷭу твои́ми мл҃твами.
items.english_text: "Having lived in Myra as a venerable one: thou wast truly shown forth as myrrh, being anointed with noetic myrrh, O holy Nicholas, hierarch of Christ; and exhaling an immortal fragrance of sweet savor unto them that flee beneath thy protection in faith, releasing them from misfortunes, perils, and afflictions, O father, by thy prayers unto the Lord."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Мно́жествомъ напа́стей содержи́мъ: и треволне́нїемъ жите́йскимъ ѡбходи́, волна́ми же потоплѧ́емъ ѡ лютѣ́йши, и печа́льми ѡбла́гаемъ, на та́ наде́ждꙋ мою́ всю́ возлага́ю, ѻч҃е никола́е, всѣ́хъ лю́тыхъ пода́ждь ми́ разрѣше́нїе, моли́твами свои́ми блаже́нне, и́же къ влⷣцѣ и бг҃у на́шему.
items.english_text: "Held fast by a multitude of tribulations, and tossed by the storm of life, and most grievously submerged by waves, and encompassed with sorrows: upon thee do I place all my hope, O father Nicholas: grant me deliverance from all cruel things by thy prayers, O blessed one, which thou offerest unto our Master and God."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Мра́комъ и потемне́нїем помышле́нїй, и бѣсо́вскими лестьми́ ѡсноси́ма, и плотски́ми страстьми́ ѡсвѣжа́ема, и зако́номъ побѣжда́ема грѣхо́внымъ, почти́, гнѣ́въ ма ѡзари́, свѣ́тъ бл҃года́ти, свѣ́тъ бо еси́ вми́рѣ, бж҃твенною просвѣща́емь зарю́, достоблаже́нне никола́е.
items.english_text: "Beset by the gloom and darkening of thoughts, and borne away by demonic deceits, and inflamed by carnal passions, and overcome by the law of sin: illuminate me with the light of grace, for thou art a light in the world, enlightened by a divine ray, O Nicholas worthy of all blessedness."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Сло́во, е́же ѻц҃ꙋ и ст҃мꙋ дх҃у равноче́стное сн҃ъ: ꙗкѡ вели́кое слнце и́зъ дв҃ы егоутро́бницы, возсїѧ́вше на земли́: въ послѣ́днѧѧ посла́ ва́ ꙗкѡ зарѧ́, сла́внїи апл҃и, свѣ́том вѣ́ры просвѣща́ющнх всѧ́ чловѣ́ки, и́же въ мра́кꙋ пре́лести:
items.english_text: "The Word, the Son consubstantial with the Father and the Holy Spirit: like a great sun shining upon earth from the Virgin's womb: in the last times sent you forth like rays, O glorious Apostles, enlightening all men with the light of faith, who were in the gloom of deceit:"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: и тѣ́хъ к не́и оуче́ньми боже́ственными приводѧ́ще.
items.english_text: "...and bringing them unto Him by divine teachings."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, стї́ры Апл҃скїа, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Apostles, Tone 2:*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Возвели́чилъ еси́ сп҃се вселе́ннѣи, верхо́вныхъ апл҃ъ имена́, навико́ша бо не́нымъ, неизрече́нна да́ша земны́мъ исцѣле́нїа, и сѣ́ни и́хъ еди́ны, неду́ги оуврачева́ху, и́же ѿ ры́барей чꙋдотвора́ше, и и́же ѿ їюде́и, бг҃осло́ваще бл҃года́ти оуче́нїа, и́хже ра́ди милосе́рде, да́ждь на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: "Thou hast magnified the names of the chief Apostles throughout the universe, O Savior; for they were instructed in heavenly and ineffable things, and granted healings unto earthly men; and their mere shadows healed diseases, working wonders from among the fishermen; and from among the Jews, theologically declaring the teachings of grace; for their sake, O Merciful One, grant us great mercy!"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: И́же ѡ непра́ведныхъ дѣла́нїй всегда́ бори́мн: и к тебѣ́ прибѣга́юще вои́стиннꙋ сꙋ́щему бг҃у, гла́съ твои́хъ оу́ченикъ прино́симъ ти́, гла́ще: спаси́ ны́ наста́вниче погиба́емъ, покажи́ на́мъ врагѡ́мъ на́шым мо́лимъса: ꙗкѡ покрыва́еши лю́ди, и спаса́еши ѿ бѣ́дъ: моли́твами апл҃ъ презира́ѧ грѣхи́, за мно́гꙋю бл҃готы́ню гдⷭи.
items.english_text: "Being ever assailed by unjust deeds, and fleeing unto Thee, Who art truly God: we offer unto Thee the cry of Thy disciples, saying: 'Save us, O Master, we perish! Show Thyself unto our enemies, we pray Thee: for Thou coverest Thy people and savest them from perils: overlooking our sins through the prayers of the Apostles, for the sake of Thy great goodness, O Lord!' "

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїа сла́ва, ю́же стѧжа́сте ст҃ї́и вѣ́рою, не то́кмо бо въ страсте́хъ врага́ побѣди́ли есте́: но и по сме́рти дꙋ́хы прого́ните, недꙋ́жныѧ исцѣлѧ́ете, дша́мъ и тѣлѡ́мъ враче́ве, моли́теся къ гдⷭу, поми́ловати са дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: "Great is the glory which ye acquired by faith, O holy ones; for not only in your sufferings did ye conquer the enemy, but even after death ye drive away spirits and heal the sick, physicians of souls and bodies: pray unto the Lord, that our souls may find mercy!"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ плодови́таѧ масли́на дв҃а, ѡрасти́ тебе́ пло́да живо́тнаго, плодоно́сит ми́рови ве́лїю и бога́тꙋю ми́лость.
items.english_text: "Like a fruitful olive tree, O Virgin, thou didst put forth the Fruit of life for us, bearing great and rich mercy for the world."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: По а҃. стїхолосїи, Сѣда́лна Апл҃скїа, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Apostles, Tone 2:*[^73]

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: И́же оумꙋ́дривый ло́вца па́че ры́торовъ, и посла́въ ꙗ́коже проповѣ́дники по все́й земли́, неизгла́ннымъ чл҃колꙋ́бїемъ си хрⷭте бж҃е, тѣ́хъ ра́ди оутверди́ цр҃ковь свою́: и вѣ́рнымъ низпосли́ блгⷭве́ніе твое́; еди́не въ ст҃ы́хъ почива́ѧй.
items.english_text: "Thou Who didst make fishermen wiser than rhetoricians, and sent them forth as preachers throughout all the earth: by Thine ineffable love for mankind, O Christ God, for their sake establish Thy Church, and send down Thy blessing upon the faithful: Thou Who alone restest in the saints."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Препрости́ бж҃їа срⷣце оу́чницы, и самови́дцы: прїи́рыхъ и ры́торѡвъ ꙗкѡ не мꙋ́дрꙋю мꙋ́дрост оухꙋди́ша, простото́ю про́повѣди ꙗзы́ки оумꙋ́дривше, бж҃твеннїи апл҃и: правосла́вно воспѣва́ти содѣ́телѧ еди́наго и гдⷭа.
items.english_text: "The all-simple disciples and eyewitnesses of God: brought to naught the unwise wisdom of philosophers and rhetors, making the nations wise by the simplicity of their preaching, O divine Apostles: that they might orthodoxly hymn the one Creator and Lord."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ́ велича́емъ бцⷣе, вопїю́ще: Ра́дꙋйсѧ незаходи́маго свѣ́та ѻ́блаче, того́ бо носи́ла еси́ въ нѣ́дрѣхъ свои́хъ, сла́вы гдⷭа.
items.english_text: "We magnify thee, O Theotokos, crying aloud: Rejoice, O Cloud of the unwaning Light, for thou didst bear the Lord of glory in thy womb!"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: По в҃. стїхолосїи, Сѣда́лна Апл҃скїа, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Apostles, Tone 2:*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Оулови́вше ло́вци мре́жею дх҃а ꙗзы́ки, и навꙋ́чша коньца́ земны́ѧ, тебѣ́ кла́нѧтиса, съ ѻц҃е́мъ и дх҃омъ хрⷭте бж҃е, тѣ́хъ ра́ди оутверди́ цр҃ковь свою́, и вѣ́рнымъ низпосли́ блгⷭве́ніе твое́: и́же еди́не ми́лостиве и чл҃колꙋ́бче. Мч҃нк:
items.english_text: "Having caught the nations with the net of the Spirit, the fishers taught the ends of the earth to bow down in worship unto Thee, with the Father and the Spirit, O Christ God: for their sake establish Thy Church, and send down Thy blessing upon the faithful, O only Merciful One and Lover of mankind. *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Страстоно́сци гдⷭни, блаже́нна зе́мла напи́вшаѧся кро́ви ва́шеѧ: и ст҃ы́и хра́мы прїе́мшии телеса́ ва́ша, на сꙋди́щи бо врага́ ѡблꙋчи́сте: и хрⷭта́ со дерзнове́ніемъ проповѣ́дасте, того́ ꙗкѡ бл҃га́ моли́те, спасти́ся молѧ́мсѧ дꙋша́мъ на́ши.
items.english_text: "O passion-bearers of the Lord, blessed is the earth that was drenched with your blood, and holy are the temples that received your bodies! For at the tribunal ye vanquished the enemy, and preached Christ with boldness: pray Him as the Good One, we entreat you, that our souls may be saved."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твеннаго бы́хомъ естества́ ѡбщници
items.english_text: "We have become partakers of the divine nature..."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: ѡбщници, тобо́ю бцⷣе при́сно дв҃о, бг҃а бо на́ воплоще́нна родила́ еси́, тѣ́мже тѧ́ по до́лгꙋ, вси́ бл҃гоче́стно велича́е.
items.english_text: "...through thee, O Theotokos, ever-Virgin: for thou didst bear God incarnate for us; therefore, as is meet, we all devoutly magnify thee."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: По г҃. стїхолосїи: Гла́с, в҃. По: Милосе́рдїа сꙋ́щи:
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 2.*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: И́же свѣти́ла свѣ́тлаѧ, ст҃ы́ѧ своѧ́ оу́чнки сло́ве въ ми́ръ посла́въ: и просвѣти́лъ еси́ по́солнечною, тмы́ неразꙋ́мїа избавлѧ́ѧ, тѣ́хъ моли́твами при́нѡ оумоле́нъ быва́ѧ, ꙗ́кѡ да тѣ́мъ дш҃у мою́ просвѣти́ чл҃колꙋ́бче, и спаси́ ма.
items.english_text: "Having sent forth Thy holy disciples into the world as radiant luminaries, O Word: Thou didst enlighten the world beneath the sun, delivering men from the darkness of ignorance; being ever entreated by their prayers, enlighten my soul thereby, O Lover of mankind, and save me."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Лꙋча́ми чꙋде́съ никола́е просвѣща́еши вселе́ннꙋю всю́: и раздрꙋша́еши мра́къ скорбе́й и бѣ́дъ, ѡго́ниши наше́ствїе, предста́тель сы́й теплѣ́йшій.
items.english_text: "With the rays of wonders, O Nicholas, thou dost enlighten the whole universe: and thou dissolvest the gloom of sorrows and perils, driving away their assault, being a most fervent protector."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-GIVING CROSS
*Work of Joseph.*[^70]
items.slavonic_text: Неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ прчⷭтаѧ, ст҃а́ѧ бцⷣе безневѣ́стнаѧ, сн҃а своего́, его́же па́че естества́ пло́тїю родила́ еси́, съ а́плы при́снѡ моли́, согрѣше́нїем проще́нїе, и житї́ю направле́ніе, и стра́сте премѣне́нїе, дарова́ти всѣ́мъ пою́щымъ тѧ́.
items.english_text: "O unwedded and all-pure, holy Theotokos and Bride unwedded: together with the Apostles ever entreat thy Son, Whom thou didst bear in the flesh beyond nature: to grant forgiveness of transgressions, direction for our life, and a change of our passions, unto all that hymn thee."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Work of Theophanes.*[^74]
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́та бж҃твеннаго, мо́лнїи ꙗ́кѡ бы́вше: свѣтови́дныи сп҃совы апл҃и, всего́ ма просвѣти́те, ѡмрача́ема сласте́й черно́тїю, и клѣ́пности всю́ мое́ житї́е проше́дша.
items.english_text: "Having become like lightnings of the Divine Light, O radiant Apostles of the Savior: enlighten me wholly, who am darkened by the blackness of pleasures, and have spent all my life in vain pursuits."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Work of Theophanes.*[^74]
items.slavonic_text: Оучени́ци и дрꙋ́зи хв҃ы: дрꙋ́га ма бы́вша врагꙋ́, злы́хъ ра́ди прикоснове́нїа: ѡ сего́ ма изба́
items.english_text: "O disciples and friends of Christ: deliver me from the enemy whose friend I became through contact with evil things, making my spirit worthy of adoption through Him Who loved the human race out of goodness."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Work of Theophanes.*[^74]
items.slavonic_text: влѧ́йте, сподоблѧ́юще мои́ дꙋ́хъ клѣ́нїи, и́же возлюби́вшагѡ ро́дъ чл҃вчь, бл҃готы́ни ра́ди.
items.english_text: "O my humble soul, hasten to repent before death, and weep for thyself who art dead: that He Who raised the four-days-dead Lazarus, as He is compassionate, may raise thee also by the entreaties of the Apostles."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
CANON TO THE HOLY APOSTLES
*Work of Theophanes.*[^74]
items.slavonic_text: Смире́ннаѧ дше моꙗ́, пре́жде сме́рти потщи́ся покаѧ́тиса: и себе́ оумерщве́нꙋ пла́чи: ꙗ́кѡ да, и́же ла́зара четверодне́внаго воскреси́вый, ꙗкѡ мл҃рдъ: и тебе́ воскреси́, а́плъ мольба́ми.
items.english_text: "Having borne the good God Who works good in all things, O all-pure one: entreat Him, O all-immaculate one, together with the Prophets, Martyrs, and Apostles: to deliver from all perils them that are held captive by distress."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃га́го ро́ждши бг҃а прчⷭтаѧ, во все́мъ бл҃готво́ращаго, и́же плѣне́нїемъ содержи́мым, того́ моли́ пренепоро́чнаѧ, съ пррⷪки и съ мч҃ники, и съ а́плы, и́же плѣне́нїемъ ѡзло́бленныѧ, изба́вить всѣ́хъ напа́стей.
items.english_text: *"Come, ye peoples, let us sing a song:"*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Всегда́ бж҃твенному престо́лу бл҃года́ти, предстоя́ никола́е, бл҃года́ть и ми́лость дарова́ти моли́сѧ, и́же тебе́ призыва́ющимъ вѣ́рою, рабѡ́мъ твои́.
items.english_text: "Ever standing before the divine Throne of grace, O Nicholas: pray that grace and mercy may be granted unto thy servants who invoke thee in faith."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: На земли́ вели́ка предста́телѧ, та́ показа́ бг҃ъ бл҃годѣ́твꙋющи, тѣ́мже ми́ преста́нни вно́щи и въ дни́: сохранѧ́ѧ ма ѡ собла́знъ ко́рца.
items.english_text: "God hath shown thee forth, O father Nicholas, as a great benefactor and protector upon the earth; therefore, unceasingly night and day, preserve me from the snares of the deceiver."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́коже дневнꙋ́ю звѣ́здꙋ оувѣ́дѣ тѧ́, твои́ми свѣтоза́рными лучáми, тмы́ да изба́влюса, и искꙋше́нїй, и бѣ́дъ, и ве́лкаго грѣха́: ѻч҃е никола́е. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: "As a day-star have I known thee: by thy radiant beams may I be delivered from darkness, and temptations, and perils, and great sin, O father Nicholas. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Теле́сныхъ болѣ́зней изба́ви ма: и дшы́ мое́й исцѣли́ недовѣ́домыѧ стрꙋ́пы, и ѻгнѧ́ вѣ́чнаго исхити́ ма, еди́на его́ бл҃года́тнаѧ.
items.english_text: "Deliver me from bodily sicknesses, and heal the unfathomable wounds of my soul, and snatch me from eternal fire, O only full of grace!"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Оучи́тела стѧжа́вше ст҃ї́и, премꙋ́дрость ѿч҃ю ду́хом: е́ллинскꙋю ѡсꙋди́ша премꙋ́дрость, егови́дци достосла́внїи.
items.english_text: "Having acquired as their Teacher the Father's Wisdom through the Spirit: the glorious eyewitnesses condemned the wisdom of the Greeks."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Непло́дїе дꙋ́ша мое́ѧ раздрѣши́те всехва́льнїи: и бл҃гоча́дїе дѣ́ланїй, в добродѣ́телехъ приноси́ти сотвори́те, ꙗкѡ сло́вꙋ самови́дци достоблаже́ннїи.
items.english_text: "Loose the barrenness of my soul, O all-praised ones: and cause me to bear the good fruit of deeds in virtues, as worthy and blessed eyewitnesses of the Word."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Лю́тѣ мѧ́ оуꙗ́звена, ꙗдови́тымъ оуграже́нїем вра́жіим: исцѣли́ мольба́ми апл҃ъ твои́хъ: бл҃года́телю всѣ́хъ многомлⷭтиве.
items.english_text: "Grievously wounded by the poisonous bite of the enemy: heal me by the supplications of Thine Apostles, O abundantly Merciful Benefactor of all."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃а преблг҃аго оумоли́ пречⷭтаѧ, съ а́плы всѣ́ми: ѡ всѧ́каго вре́да, и ѡбстоѧ́нїа и бѣ́дъ, изба́витися чтꙋ́щымъ тѧ́.
items.english_text: "Entreat the all-good God, O all-pure one, with all the Apostles: that they who honor thee may be delivered from every harm, distress, and peril."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Оутверди́ на́съ собо́ю гдⷭи, и́же дре́вомъ оумерщве́й грѣ́хъ: и стра́хъ тво́й въсади́ въ срⷣца на́ша, ꙗкѡ чл҃колꙋ́бецъ.
items.english_text: *"Establish us in Thee, O Lord, Who by the Tree didst put sin to death: and plant Thy fear in our hearts, as Thou art the Lover of mankind."*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Исцѣле́нїй исто́чникъ сы́й ст҃е: стра́сти оуврачꙋ́й дши́ моє́й: и жи́знь мою́ соблюди́, невре́дна ма сохранѧ́ѧ, раба́ твое́го.
items.english_text: "Being a fountain of healings, O holy one: heal the passions of my soul, and preserve my life, keeping me, thy servant, unharmed."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Оума́ моего́ побѣжде́нїа непра́веднаго, ѡ вре́да ви́димыхъ и неви́димы борꙋ́щихъ ма спаси́, ꙗкѡ предста́тель мои́ вели́кїй никола́е.
items.english_text: "Save me from the unjust vanquishing of my mind, from the harm of visible and invisible foes warring against me, as my great protector, O Nicholas."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И́же еди́нъ бл҃гї́й: тѧ́ бл҃га́ застꙋ́пника чл҃кѡ даде́ блаже́нне, сего́ ра́ди молю́ тѧ, ѡ вели́кых ма зо́лъ свободи́. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "He Who alone is good gave thee as a good intercessor unto men, O blessed one; therefore I entreat thee: free me from great evils. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пость моѧ́ и ра́дость, и весе́лїе и стѣна́ тве́рдаѧ, и предста́телница, ты́ еси́ всенепоро́чнаѧ, искꙋше́нїй и бѣ́дъ избавлѧ́ющи ма.
items.english_text: "My strength, and joy, and gladness, and steadfast wall, and protectress art thou, O all-immaculate one, delivering me from temptations and perils."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Алчꙋ́ща ма всегда́, и гла́домъ истаева́ема, спасе́нїа снѣдьми́ насы́ти, еди́не чл҃колꙋ́бче, бж҃твенными мольба́ми а́плъ, и́же во все́мъ ми́рѣ проповѣ́давшихъ тѧ́.
items.english_text: "Unto me who ever hunger and pine away with famine, satisfy me with the food of salvation, O only Lover of mankind, by the divine entreaties of the Apostles who preached Thee throughout the whole world."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: На мо́ре мїрско́е наве́лъ еси́ всѣ́хъ, ꙗкѡ ко́на чл҃колꙋ́бче, сла́вныѧ а́плы твоѧ́, того́ возмꙋща́юще сла́ныѧ невѣ́рствїа, го́рькїѧ во́ды.
items.english_text: "Upon the sea of this life Thou didst lead Thy glorious Apostles like steeds, O Lover of mankind, stirring up the salty and bitter waters of unbelief."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Слнца хрⷭта́ сꙋ́щымъ въ тмѣ́ возсвѣти́вше: въ тмѣ́ ма лежа́ща грѣхо́внѣй просвѣтѣ́те, а́пли прехва́льнїи, возбрана́юще лꙋка́вымъ по́мысломъ, се́рдца моего́. Бг҃оро:
items.english_text: "Having caused Christ the Sun to shine upon them that were in darkness: enlighten me who lie in the darkness of sin, O all-praised Apostles, restraining the wicked thoughts of my heart. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Всепѣ́таѧ, ꙗ́же бг҃а препѣ́таго ро́ждьша: ѡ пою́щихъ тѧ́, со а́плы моли́, ꙗкѡ да изба́вимся ѡ грѣхо́въ и бѣ́дъ, и ѡзлобле́нїа.
items.english_text: "O all-hymned one, who didst bear the all-praised God: pray with the Apostles for them that hymn thee, that we may be delivered from sins, perils, and afflictions."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Оукраси́въ присто́лъ добродѣ́тельми никола́е, оукраше́нїе ꙗви́лся еси́ ст҃и́телемъ чⷭтно́е, тѣ́мже молю́тисѧ, нелѣ́потꙋ дши́ мое́й оукраси́: и ѡ мїрскі́й собла́знъ спаси́ ма.
items.english_text: *"I hymn Thee, for by hearing, O Lord:"*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Сте́зю ꙗ́же та́мѡ ведꙋ́щꙋю, оугла́ди ми́ преблже́нне, жите́йскихъ во́лнъ ѡ легчи́ ми: и къ приста́нїщꙋ жи́зни возведи́ никола́е, и́же тебе́ предста́телѧ вели́каго ѡбогати́вшемся.
items.english_text: "Having adorned thy throne with virtues, O Nicholas, thou wast shown forth as a precious adornment of hierarchs; therefore I entreat thee: adorn the unseemliness of my soul, and save me from worldly snares."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ бж҃твенныхъ послꙋ́шателю, оуслы́шавъ ми́ гла́съ: изба́ви ма ѡ бѣсо́вскихъ собла́знъ, и незако́нныхъ мꙋжї́й, и вели́кихъ ѡбстоѧ́нїй находѧ́щихъ,
items.english_text: "Make smooth for me the path that leads yonder, O all-blessed one, lighten for me the waves of this life, and lead me unto the haven of life, O Nicholas, who have enriched myself with thee as a great protector."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃а́ѧ бцⷣе влⷣчце: вно́щи ма и въ дни́ ѡст҃и́ и сохрани́: и наста́ви къ спасе́нїю, мно́гими грѣ́хи па́дающа: и прило́гъми бѣсо́вскими низрѣва́ема.
items.english_text: "O hearer of divine words, having heard my voice: deliver me from demonic snares, and from lawless men, and from great afflictions that assail me," "...O great Nicholas. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Вели́кїй па́стырь посредѣ́ во́лкѡвъ, посла́ ꙗкѡ ѻвца́, бж҃твенныѧ оу́чнки своѧ́: тѣ́хъ прекорѧ́юща бж҃їею си́лою крще́нїа, и доброто́ю слове́съ.
items.english_text: "O holy Lady Theotokos: sanctify and preserve me night and day: and direct me unto salvation, who fall into many sins and am cast down by demonic assaults."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твеннымъ свѣ́томъ, и́же въ тмѣ́ пре́лести просвѣти́сте а́пли срⷣца, тѣ́мже молю́ вы́, ѡмраче́ннаго ма сластми́ дше́вными, просвѣти́те бг҃облаже́ннїи.
items.english_text: "The great Shepherd sent forth His divine disciples like sheep in the midst of wolves, subduing them by the divine power of baptism and the beauty of their words."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Окаꙗ́ннаѧ дше́, пре́жде конца́ потщи́ся и пока́йся, гдⷭви зовꙋ́щи: согрѣши́хъ ти́ влⷣко, прости́ а́плъ ра́ди, и спаси́ ма, ꙗкѡ млⷭрдъ. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "With divine light ye enlightened the hearts of them that were in the darkness of deceit, O Apostles; therefore I entreat you: enlighten me who am darkened by sensual passions, O blessed of God."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́томъ ма твои́мъ, и́же въ тмѣ́ лежа́ща ѡзари́, свѣ́тꙋ жили́ще: и со а́плы моли́сѧ пренепоро́чнаѧ, ѡ вся́кїа нꙋ́жда изба́вити ма.
items.english_text: "O wretched soul, make haste and repent before the end, crying unto the Lord: 'I have sinned against Thee, O Master, forgive me for the sake of the Apostles, and save me, as Thou art compassionate!' *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Зако́на бж҃їа исполни́телю: мл҃и бл҃га́го бг҃а, зако́ны бж҃твенныѧ ми́ соблюда́ти, и беззако́ньнующихъ вра́гъ изми́ ма, и ст҃ѣ́йшаго вре́да, всеблаже́нне никола́е.
items.english_text: "With Thy light illuminate me who lie in darkness, O Dwelling-place of light: and pray with the Apostles, O all-immaculate one, to deliver me from every necessity."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́коже дре́вле предста́въ сп҃се, и ка́ꙗла ю́ноша три́: си́це и мене́ ѡ вели́каго грѣха́ изба́ви, твои́ми къ бг҃у моли́твами, бг҃омꙋ́дре никола́е.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos: O Giver of light:*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́ннодѣ́лателю хв҃ъ, грѣ́шникѡмъ испорꙋ́чниче, вели́кїй чꙋдотво́рче, бл҃годавца моли́ бг҃а, да непосрами́тъ мене́ въ ча́съ су́дный. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: "Fulfiller of the law of God: entreat the good God that I may keep the divine laws, and deliver me from lawless enemies and from the most grievous harm, O all-blessed Nicholas."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Городи́телнице чⷭтаѧ, ѡбла́даема ма мно́гими стра́ми, ꙗкѡ бл҃га́ преста́вши изба́ви, ꙗкѡ да тѧ́ воспѣва́ю, дше́ю и срⷣцемъ и ꙗзы́ко, спаса́емъ.
items.english_text: "As of old Thou didst appear, O Savior, and deliver the three youths: so also deliver me from great sin by thy prayers unto God, O God-wise Nicholas."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И́же во́дꙋ живо́тнꙋю но́саще: тле́мую дш҃у мою́ зно́емъ грѣхо́внымъ, молю́сѧ, оучени́ци сп҃совы напо́ите.
items.english_text: "Sacred celebrant of Christ, surety of sinners, great wonderworker: pray unto God the Giver of good, that He put me not to shame in the hour of judgment. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Нб҃са́ мы́сьлнаѧ бы́вше, бг҃оза́рнїи а́пли: сла́вꙋ бж҃їю исповѣ́даете неизрече́ннꙋю, ея́же оулꙋчи́ти на́м всѣ́м моли́теся.
items.english_text: "O pure Mother of God, who art good: stand by and deliver me who am held by many passions, that being saved, I may hymn thee with soul, heart, and tongue."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Въ пучи́нѣ лю́тѣ волнꙋ́ющеся: к тебѣ́ и́же всѣ́хъ ѡкорми́телю прихождꙋ́, ра́ди а́плъ твои́хъ, къ спасе́нномꙋ приста́нїщꙋ напра́ви ма. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "Bearing the water of life: water my soul which is consumed by the heat of sin, I pray you, O disciples of the Savior."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Со всѣ́ми вы́шними си́лами, со пррⷪки и а́плы и съ мч҃нки: ѡ на́съ моли́ сн҃а своего́, дв҃о бг҃оневѣ́сто.
items.english_text: "Having become noetic heavens, O God-radiant Apostles: ye declare the ineffable glory of God; pray ye that all of us may attain unto it."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И́же мурѧ́нѡмъ бы́въ первопресто́лникъ никола́е, и ѡсе́лго оухꙋ́лъ еси́ вѣ́рныхъ составле́нїа, бл҃ги́ми ти́ дѣла́ніи: ѡ злосмра́дна прегрѣше́нїа изба́ви ма.
items.english_text: "Tossed grievously upon the deep: unto Thee, the Pilot of all, do I come; for the sake of Thine Apostles, direct me unto the haven of salvation. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтлѣ́йше слнца стѧжа́въ ѻч҃е срⷣце: всего́ ма просвѣти́ искꙋше́ній и скорбе́й, ѡго́нѧ тмꙋ́ никола́е.
items.english_text: "With all the heavenly powers, with the Prophets, Apostles, and Martyrs: entreat thy Son for our sake, O Virgin Bride of God."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтлѣ́йше слнца стѧжа́въ ѻч҃е срⷣце: всего́ ма просвѣти́ искꙋше́ній и скорбе́й, ѡго́нѧ тмꙋ́ никола́е.
items.english_text: "Having been primate of the people of Myra, O Nicholas, thou didst establish the assemblies of the faithful with thy good deeds: deliver me from foul-smelling transgressions."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтлѣ́йше слнца стѧжа́въ ѻч҃е срⷣце: всего́ ма просвѣти́ искꙋше́ній и скорбе́й, ѡго́нѧ тмꙋ́ никола́е.
items.english_text: "Having acquired a heart brighter than the sun, O father: enlighten me wholly, driving away the darkness of temptations and sorrows, O Nicholas."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтлѣ́йше слнца стѧжа́въ ѻч҃е срⷣце: всего́ ма просвѣти́ искꙋше́ній и скорбе́й, ѡго́нѧ тмꙋ́ никола́е.
items.english_text: "Deliver me from all distress:"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: простра́нство ꙗкѡ имѣ́ѧ ми́лости никола́е, тѣ́снымъ ше́ствовати ма оукрѣпи́ путе́м къ гдⷭу. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "...as thou hast an abundance of mercy, O Nicholas; strengthen me to walk the narrow path that leads unto the Lord. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: На вся́ко вре́ма тебе́ призыва́ющаго прчⷭтаѧ, да ѡбрѧ́щꙋ тѧ́ помо́щницꙋ, изима́ющꙋ ма ѡ вели́каго ѡзлобле́нїа, и стра́шныхъ му́къ.
items.english_text: "Unto me who call upon thee at every time, O all-pure one: may I find thee as a helper, delivering me from great distress and from dread torments."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Огне́мъ бж҃твеннаго дх҃а превозжже́ни бы́вше а́пли: пре́лести оу́глїа оугаси́те, бж҃їе же раче́нїе въ оумѣ́хъ всѣ́хъ вѣ́рныхъ восплани́те, тѣ́мже велегла́сно ва́съ чте́мъ.
items.english_text: "Kindled by the fire of the Divine Spirit, O Apostles: ye quenched the coals of deceit, and kindled the divine love in the minds of all the faithful; therefore with loud voices we honor you."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Мї́ра возненави́дѣсте, и и́же въ ми́рѣ: хрⷭта́ возлю́бисте, въ ми́ръ пло́тїю чл҃кꙋ примѣ́ншаса, его́же моли́те бж҃е́ственнїи а́пли, и́же въ жи́зни ма всѣ́хъ лю́тыхъ свободи́ти.
items.english_text: "Ye hated the world and all that is in the world: and loved Christ, Who came into the world in the flesh as man; pray Him, O divine Apostles, to free me from all cruel things in this life."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Судї́и пра́ведне оуще́дрче: и́же еди́нъ сокрове́ннаа вѣ́дыи моꙗ́ согрѣше́нїа, въ ча́съ сꙋ́да не ѡсꙋди́ мене́: ниже́ ѡсле́шн ма въ ѻ́гнь, мольба́ми а́плъ твои́хъ. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "O righteous and compassionate Judge, Who alone knowest my hidden transgressions: in the hour of judgment condemn me not, neither cast me into the fire, by the supplications of Thine Apostles. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Огне́мъ бж҃тва́ неопали́са, неизрече́нно ро́жши дв҃о, брꙋ́кꙋ неискꙋше́наѧ, тѣ́мже со а́плы моли́сѧ, чⷭтаѧ: вѣ́чнаго ма пла́мене свободи́ти, тебе́ слава́щаго.
items.english_text: "Unconsumed by the fire of the Godhead, having ineffably given birth, O Virgin unwedded Maiden: therefore pray with the Apostles, O pure one: to free me from the eternal flame, who glorify thee."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: О́сню искꙋше́ній на вся́къ днь примѣша́ема, ѿте́ никола́е, посредѣ́ сѣ́тїи ми́мо хожда́ ꙗ́коже ѻ́гнь, по твои́ ще́дры покро́въ притѣка́ю, невре́дна ма сохрани́, бл҃га́го мола́ бг҃а и гдⷭа.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos: Unto the golden image:*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Глагѡ́лъ мои́хъ оуслы́шавъ спѣ́шно ѻч҃е никола́е, потщи́ся прїити́ ми́ на помо́щь, ѡбрє́ваемꙋ ско́рьдьми, и нꙋ́ждами жите́йскими, и бѣсо́вскими ѡзлобле́нїи, ꙗкѡ да спаса́емъ, пою́ предста́телство твое́.
items.english_text: "Tossed every day by a storm of temptations, O father Nicholas, passing through the midst of snares like fire: beneath thy generous shelter do I flee; preserve me unharmed, entreating the good God and Lord."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И́же дре́вле ꙗ́влься въ снѣ́ цр҃ю, непови́нныѧ имꙋ́щаѧ оумре́ти изба́влаѧ, напа́стей ма изба́ви находѧ́щихъ всегда́: и недꙋ́гъ тѣле́сныхъ и душе́вных болѣ́зней, ѻч҃е никола́е. Кг҃:
items.english_text: "Having heard my words swiftly, O father Nicholas, hasten to come unto my aid, who am tossed by sorrows, and worldly necessities, and demonic afflictions: that being saved, I may hymn thy protection."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Тебе́ еди́нꙋ прчⷭтаѧ приноша́ю помо́щницꙋ, тебе́ напне́но мнѣ́ всѣ́хъ житї́а храни́телницꙋ, непре́зри мене́ раба́ своего́, еди́на предста́телнице моꙗ́, но спаси́ ма пою́ща тѧ́: блгⷭве́нъ бг҃ъ ѻц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: "Thou who of old didst appear in a dream unto the emperor, delivering the innocent who were about to die: deliver me from the perils that ever assail me, and from bodily ailments and diseases of soul, O father Nicholas. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Тыловнда́нѣ на ва́съ наше́дши, въ ѻ́гненном зра́цѣ оутѣши́тельны дх҃ъ: содѣ́ла ꙗ́ко свѣти́ла, попалѧ́юща всѧ́ безбо́жїе: просвѣща́юща же вся́ бл҃гоче́стїа сло́ва, бж҃твенїи сло́ва а́пли.
items.english_text: "Thee alone do I offer as my helper, O all-pure one; unto thee who hast been given unto me as the guardian of all my life; despise me not, thy servant, my only protectress, but save me who sing unto thee: 'Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Страстьми́ лю́тѣ ѡбурева́емое, неисправле́ное срⷣце мое́, исцѣли́ ще́дре молю́сѧ, дш҃у мою́ просвѣти́, и оу́мъ мо́й напра́ви, прекло́ньшися на зло́бу: оу́чнка твои́хъ мольба́ми.
items.english_text: "Descending upon you in the likeness of fire, the Comforter Spirit in fiery form made you as luminaries, burning up all godlessness: and enlightening all with the words of piety, O divine Apostles of the Word."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Воздохни́ дше́ моꙗ́ и прослези́ся крѣ́пцѣ: и по́жде конца́ вопла́чисѧ, преждеда́же непости́гнет тебе́ пла́чъ не оутѣши́мый, и возопї́й зижди́телю: ꙗкѡ оуще́дри ма, мл҃твами а́плъ твои́хъ. Бг҃оро:
items.english_text: "Grievously tempest-tossed by passions, heal my uncorrected heart, O Compassionate One, I pray Thee; enlighten my soul and direct my mind, which hath inclined toward evil: through the entreaties of Thy disciples."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: твое́ рождество́, проѡбража́ше дв҃о всенепоро́чнаѧ, сего́ ра́ди молю́ тѧ: съ а́плы моли́сѧ, и во вре́ма сꙋ́дное: ѻгнѧ́ гее́нны изба́вити ма.
items.english_text: "Sigh, O my soul, and weep bitterly; and lament before the end, before inconsolable weeping overtake thee; and cry aloud unto the Creator: 'Have compassion upon me, through the prayers of Thine Apostles!' *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Взѧ́ти и рѣша́ти прїе́мъ вла́сть ѿ бг҃а, ѻч҃е бг҃омꙋ́дре никола́е, зо́лъ мои́хъ сооу́зы разрѣши́, твои́ми мл҃твами: и бж҃твенны ми́ привѧжи́ любви́, и́же воулучи́тел восхотѣ́вшаго влады́ки.
items.english_text: "The furnace which burned not the Children of old prefigured thy childbirth, O all-immaculate Virgin;" "...therefore I entreat thee: pray with the Apostles, in the time of judgment, to deliver me from the fire of Gehenna."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Посѣще́нїемъ си́ бж҃твеннымъ, въ дни́ и вно́щи посѣща́й ма, оуглажа́ѧ стези́ смире́ннѣи ми́ дши́, и сохранѧ́й ма, ст҃е никола́е, невреди́мна ѿ находѧ́щихъ лꙋка́ваго собла́знъ.
items.english_text: *"Into the fiery furnace with the Children:"*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Рꙋ́ку ми́ пода́ждь, къ бж҃тїей помо́щи, лю́таго ма исхити́ врагѡ́въ тла́нїа, и́же ю́ноша ино́гда сме́рти го́ркїа изба́вль: да тѧ́ почита́ю ꙗкѡ бла́гаго предста́телѧ.
items.english_text: "Having received power from God to bind and to loose, O God-wise father Nicholas: loose the bonds of my sins by thy prayers, and bind me unto the divine love of the Master Who desired to save me."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Егда́ сѧ́деши бж҃е на прⷭто́лѣ стра́шнѣ, сꙋди́ти мі́ру, невни́ди всу́дъ съ ра́бомъ твои́мъ: но я́сти сподо́би спаса́емыхъ, мл҃твами никола́а. Кг҃о:
items.english_text: "By thy divine visitation, visit me day and night, making smooth the paths of my humble soul; and preserve me, O holy Nicholas, unharmed from the assaults of the cunning deceiver."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Па́че естества́ твои́мъ ро́жество бг҃ороди́телнице, возвели́чила еси́ на́съ, ѡумале́нныхъ вели́кими неисче́тными злы́ми, тѣ́мже мо́литиса пречⷭтаѧ, возвели́чи къ на́съ бога́тыѧ твоѧ́ мл҃ти.
items.english_text: "Stretch forth thy hand unto divine help, snatch me from the cruel corruption of enemies, thou who of old didst deliver the youths from bitter death: that I may honor thee as a good protector."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Оу́чнцы сп҃совы: проповѣ́дници премꙋ́дрїи: ѡ вся́каго ма изба́вите вре́да: вели́каго гнѣ́ва: вели́каго грѣха́: вели́каго престꙋпле́нїа, и разли́чьныхъ напа́стеи.
items.english_text: "When Thou, O God, shalt sit upon Thy dread Throne to judge the world: enter not into judgment with Thy servant, but vouchsafe me to be among the saved, by the prayers of Nicholas. *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ме́не ѡсужде́ннаго: ме́не неисправле́ннаго: твои́хъ повеле́нїй небрѣ́гшаго, и всѣ́ческыми прельще́нїамъ оумоврѣ́дно послѣ́довавша: возврати́и гдⷭи, моли́твами а́плъ твои́хъ.
items.english_text: "Beyond nature by thy childbirth, O Theotokos, thou hast magnified us who were brought low by great and countless evils; therefore we entreat thee, O all-pure one: magnify thy rich mercies toward us."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Дш҃у неиспра́вленнꙋ приношꙋ́: и со́вѣст погребе́ннꙋ вещеми́ прегрѣше́нїй, и ѡскве́рнено срⷣце, и по́мыслъ ѡкала́нъ: вопїю́ ти чл҃колꙋ́бче: а́плъ ра́ди, ѡще́дри ма млⷭтїю си. Кг҃:
items.english_text: *"The Son of the Father without beginning:"*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: А́плъ пречⷭтаѧ, во́его сн҃а проповѣ́даша все́мъ ми́рꙋ, бг҃а и чл҃ка, тѣ́мже сни́ми мл҃и са, въ стра́шном дни́ сꙋ́да изба́витьсѧ мы́къ, и́же вѣ́рою тебе́ велича́ющимъ.
items.english_text: "O glorious choir! O blessed Apostles!"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И́же ѡ бг҃а, бг҃а сло́во, неизрече́нною мꙋ́дростїю прише́дшаго, ѡбнови́ти ада́ма, ꙗдї́ю тлѣ́нїа па́дшаго лю́тѣ: ѿ ст҃ы́ѧ дв҃ы, неизрече́нно вопло́щьшаса на́ ра́ди, вѣ́рнїи единомꙋ́дрно, пѣ́сньми велича́е.
items.english_text: "Disciples of the Savior, all-wise preachers: deliver me from every harm, from great wrath, from great sin, from great transgression, and from various perils!"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нство пра́вило, и кро́тости ѡ́бразъ, вѣ́ма тѧ́ никола́е премꙋ́дре, воста́ющꙋ повса́ дни́ бꙋ́рю стра́стеи и бѣ́дъ, оукроти́ моли́твами си: и соблюди́ ма неврежде́нна.
items.english_text: "Me who am condemned, me who am uncorrected, who have neglected Thy commandments, and followed harmful deceits: turn me back, O Lord, by the prayers of Thine Apostles!"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ сщ҃е́ннѣйшій сосꙋ́дъ прїѧ́тенъ, бж҃твеннаго му́ра: мл҃твами излїа́вшагосѧ на земли́: всѣ́мъ на́мъ оувѣ́го
items.english_text: "I bring an uncorrected soul, a conscience buried beneath the weight of transgressions, a defiled heart, and a wretched mind: I cry unto Thee, O Lover of mankind: for the sake of the Apostles, have compassion upon me by Thy mercy! *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ сщ҃е́ннѣйшій сосꙋ́дъ прїѧ́тенъ, бж҃твеннаго му́ра: мл҃твами излїа́вшагосѧ на земли́: всѣ́мъ на́мъ оувѣ́го
items.english_text: "The Apostles, O all-pure one, preached thy Son unto all the world as God and man; therefore with them pray thou that they who magnify thee in faith may be delivered from torments on the dread day of judgment."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ сщ҃е́ннѣйшій сосꙋ́дъ прїѧ́тенъ, бж҃твеннаго му́ра: мл҃твами излїа́вшагосѧ на земли́: всѣ́мъ на́мъ оувѣ́го
items.english_text: *"God the Word from God, Who by ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam, who had fallen grievously through the eating of corruption: ineffably incarnate of the holy Virgin for our sake: with one accord we the faithful magnify Him in hymns!"*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗкѡ сщ҃е́ннѣйшій сосꙋ́дъ прїѧ́тенъ, бж҃твеннаго му́ра: мл҃твами излїа́вшагосѧ на земли́: всѣ́мъ на́мъ оувѣ́го
items.english_text: "A rule of priesthood and pattern of meekness do we know thee to be, O all-wise Nicholas; calm by thy prayers the storm of passions and perils that rises up day by day, and preserve me unharmed."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: оуха́нїи срⷣца: мура́нѡмъ бы́въ мꙋ́дре первост҃е́ль, искꙋше́ній злово́нїе ѡгони́, мл҃твами си.
items.english_text: "As a most sacred vessel receptive of the divine myrrh, which through thy prayers was poured forth upon the earth: unto all of us" "...giving fragrance to our hearts: having been the wise primate of Myra, drive away the foul stench of temptations by thy prayers."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ мои́ оутѣши́ш ѻч҃е дш҃ѣ: неви́димо мно́жествомъ ѡзло́бленнꙋю лю́тѣ, ты́ бемкра́нал ми́ оукроти́ искꙋше́нїа: ꙗ́же лести́вый подви́жетъ ми́ въ дни́ и вно́щи: бл҃гї́и мои́ предста́тель ꙗ́влься никола́е.
items.english_text: "Thou art the comfort of my soul, O father; invisible amidst a multitude of cruel afflictions, do thou boundless calm my temptations, which the deceitful one stirs up against me day and night, appearing as my good protector, O Nicholas."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Стра́шный влады́чнїи днь, при двере́хъ приближа́етъса, что́ сотвори́ши ѡ дш҃е, грѣхо́въ мно́жество и́мꙋщи: потщи́ся оу́бѡ пре́жде конца́, и возопї́й гдⷭи прилѣ́жно, моли́твами никола́а ст҃и́телѧ твое́го спаси́ ма. Кг҃о:
items.english_text: "The dread day of the Master approaches at the doors; what wilt thou do, O my soul, having a multitude of sins? Make haste therefore before the end, and cry unto the Lord diligently: 'By the prayers of Nicholas Thy hierarch, save me!' *Theotokion:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Пощади́ ма гдⷭи пощади́, егда́ хо́щеши сꙋди́ти: и не ѡсꙋди́ мене́ въ ѻ́гнь: ниже́ ꙗ́ростїю твое́ю ѡбличи́ мене́, мо́литъ тѧ́ дв҃а ро́ждшаѧ тѧ́ хрⷭте, и а́гг҃лъ мно́жество, и сла́вный никола́а.
items.english_text: "Spare me, O Lord, spare me when Thou art about to judge; and condemn me not unto the fire, neither rebuke me in Thy fury: the Virgin who bore Thee entreats Thee, O Christ, together with the multitude of angels and the glorious Nicholas."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, стїхи́ры Апл҃ѡмъ, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Apostles, Tone 2:*[^75]

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Возвели́чилъ еси́ сп҃се повеле́нїемъ, верхо́вныхъ а́плъ имена́, навико́ша бо не́нымъ, неизрече́ннымъ, да́ша земны́м исцѣле́нїа, и сѣ́ни и́хъ еди́ны, неду́ги оуврачева́ху, и́же ѿ рыба́рей чꙋдотвора́ше: и и́же ѿ їюде́и бг҃осло́ваше бл҃года́ти оуче́нїа, и́хже ра́ди милосе́рде, да́ждь на́мъ ве́лїю млⷭть.
items.english_text: "Thou hast magnified by Thy command the names of the chief Apostles, O Savior; for they were instructed in heavenly and ineffable things, and granted healings unto earthly men; and their mere shadows healed diseases, working wonders from among the fishermen; and from among the Jews, theologically declaring the teachings of grace; for their sake, O Merciful One, grant us great mercy!"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И́же ѡ непра́ведныхъ дѣла́нїй всегда́ бори́ми: и к тебѣ́ прибѣга́юще, вои́стиннꙋ сꙋ́щему
items.english_text: "Being ever assailed by unjust deeds, and fleeing unto Thee, Who art truly God:"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: бг҃у, гла́съ твои́хъ оу́ченикъ прино́симъ ти́, гла́ще: спаси́ ны́ наста́вниче погиба́емъ, покажи́ на́мъ врагѡ́мъ на́шым мо́лимъса: ꙗкѡ покрыва́еши лю́ди, и спаса́еши ѿ бѣ́дъ: моли́твами а́плъ презира́ѧ грѣхи́, за мно́гꙋю бл҃готы́ню гдⷭи. М:
items.english_text: "...we offer unto Thee the cry of Thy disciples, saying: 'Save us, O Master, we perish! Show Thyself unto our enemies, we pray Thee: for Thou coverest Thy people and savest them from perils: overlooking our sins through the prayers of the Apostles, for the sake of Thy great goodness, O Lord!' *For the Martyrs:*"

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ мно́жество, мо́литъ тѧ́ хрⷭте, поми́лꙋй и спаси́ на́, ꙗкѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: "The multitude of Thy saints entreats Thee, O Christ: have mercy and save us, as Thou art the Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Все́ оупова́ніе мое́ на та́ возлага́ю, мт҃и бж҃їа сохрани́ ма въ свое́мъ си́ кро́вѣ.
items.english_text: "All my hope do I place upon thee, O Mother of God: preserve me under thy protection."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: В ЧЕТВЕРТО́КЪ. На Бл҃же́нна, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: *On Thursday at the Beatitudes (Blazhenna), Tone 2:*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ ти прино́си разбо́йничъ, и мо́лимся: Помани́ на́ гдⷭи въ црⷭтвїи си.
items.english_text: *The voice of the thief we bring unto Thee, and we pray: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!*

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Мрѣ́жа конца́ проше́дше а́пли: ѡ тмы́ злоче́стїа пре́лести, чл҃ки избавлѧ́н есте́ премꙋ́дрїи бл҃года́ти, къ глубинѣ́ вѣ́жества всѣ́хъ чл҃къ, оу́чнци сп҃совы му́дре возвели́ есте́.
items.english_text: "Traversing the ends of the earth with their net, the Apostles delivered men from the darkness of the deceit of impiety; all-wise preachers of grace, the disciples of the Savior wisely guided all men unto the depth of knowledge."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: И́же тече́ніе сконча́вшаѧ, и вѣ́ру соблю́дшаѧ, мч҃нки гдⷭна, согла́сно вѣ́рнїи воспое́мъ.
items.english_text: "Having finished the course and kept the faith, let us the faithful hymn the Martyrs of the Lord with one accord."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Равнодѣ́телна роди́телю, сн҃а съ ду́хомъ проповѣда́вше: воспое́мъ трⷪцꙋ несозда́ннꙋю.
items.english_text: "Equal in operation unto the Father, having preached the Son with the Spirit: let us hymn the uncreated Trinity."

items.office: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: А́плѡмъ похвала́: страда́лцем оудобре́нїе, ты́ еси́ прчⷭтаѧ дв҃о, и ми́рꙋ спасе́ніе.
items.english_text: "The boast of the Apostles, the adornment of the sufferers art thou, O all-pure Virgin, and the salvation of the world."

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ ЧЕТВЕРТО́КЪ В ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, НА ГИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: *Stichera of the Precious Cross, Tone 2.*

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи́ры крⷭтꙋ, гла́съ, в҃. По: Егда́ ѿ дрѣ́ва:
items.english_text: "O Son, when Thou wast nailed unto the Cross: the sun beheld it and was darkened for fear of Thee; and the veil of the temple was rent in twain; the earth quaked, and the rocks likewise were split in trembling: unable to bear the sight of their Creator and God suffering unjustly of His own will upon the Tree, and insulted by the lawless."

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Сн҃е, къ крⷭтꙋ пригвожде́н бы́въ: слнце ви́дѣ, помрачи́ся ѡ стра́ха твое́го: и завѣ́са церко́внаа раздра́ся: землѧ́же потрясе́ся: и ка́менїа та́коже, тре́петно распадо́шася: зрѣ́ти не терпѧ́щи зижди́телѧ своего́ и бг҃а, на дрѣ́вѣ стра́ждꙋща непра́веднѣ во́лею: и ѡ беззако́нныхъ досажда́ема.
items.english_text: "The all-cunning serpent was cast down entirely upon the earth; he was utterly brought to naught, and lies in a marvelous fall, when Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Lover of mankind; and Adam is loosed from the curse and saved, who was formerly condemned; therefore we also pray: 'Save us, have compassion upon all of us, and vouchsafe us Thy Kingdom!' "

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь низло́же бы́сть на земли́: ве́сь оуничи́же, и лежи́тъ паде́нїемъ чꙋде́снымъ, змі́и вселꙋка́вый, вознесе́нну ти́ бы́вшу на дре́во чл҃колю́бче, ада́мъ же ѡ клѧ́твы разрѣша́етса: и спасе́нъ быва́етъ: и́же пре́жде ѡсужде́нный, тѣ́мже и мы́ мо́лимъся: спаси́ и оуще́дри всѣ́хъ на́съ, и ца́рствїю твое́му сподо́би.
items.english_text: "When Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, and Thy side was pierced with a spear, O Sinless One: the sun hid itself, not wishing to see it, O Savior; the earth was shaken, and the rocks were split in terror at that time while Thou wast insulted; and all creation cried aloud: 'Glory to Thy Crucifixion, O Word, whereby Thou hast saved all, O Lover of mankind!' "

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Егда́ воздви́жеся на крⷭтъ, и въ ре́бра прободе́нъ бы́сть ко́піе безгрѣ́шне: слнце сокрыва́шеса зрѣ́ти нехотѧ́ сп҃се, и землѧ́ колеба́шеся, и ка́меніе стра́хо тогда́ распада́хꙋся, досажда́емꙋ тебѣ́: тва́рь же вопїа́ше вся́: сла́ва распѧ́тїю ти́ сло́ве: и́мже всѣ́хъ спа́слъ еси́ чловеколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera of the Cross and Theotokos (Stavrotheotokia):*

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: На дрѣ́вѣ крⷭтнѣ́мъ та́ іс҃е, водвиже́нна зра́щи неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ, пла́каше и гла́ше: ча́до сла́дкое: въскꙋ́ю ма ѡста́вилъ еси́, еди́ну ро́ждьшую тѧ́, свѣ́те непристꙋ́пный, пребезнача́лнаго ѻц҃а, потщи́ся и просла́ви, ꙗкѡ да сла́вꙋ полꙋ́чат бж҃твеннꙋю, и́же бж҃твенныѧ стрⷭти твоѧ́ сла́вѧщии.
items.english_text: "Beholding Thee, O Jesus, lifted up upon the Tree of the Cross, the unwedded Maiden wept and said: 'O sweet Child, why hast Thou forsaken me who alone gave Thee birth, O Light unapproachable of the Father without beginning? Hasten and be glorified, that they who glorify Thy divine sufferings may obtain divine glory!' "

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Егда́ на древѣ́ жи́во оумира́ющъ зра́ше дв҃о: и копі́емъ болѣ́зненно пробода́ема, пла́чꙋщи возыва́ше: сн҃е и бж҃е мо́й: что́ ти воздаде́ собо́ръ безбл҃года́тный; оувы́ мнѣ́, болѣ́зни не терпѧ́, снѣда́юса оу́тробою, ви́дѧщи, ꙗ́ко стра́ждꙋща тѧ́ влады́ко.
items.english_text: "When the Virgin beheld Him Who is Life dying upon the Tree, and grievously pierced with the spear: weeping, she cried aloud: 'O my Son and my God, what hath the ungrateful assembly repaid Thee? Woe is me, unable to bear the sorrow, I am consumed in my maternal heart, seeing Thee suffer, O Master!' "

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Егда́ ѿ дрѣ́ва сн҃а ви́дѣ снємле́ма, ѻтрокови́ца неискꙋсомꙋ́жнаѧ: просте́ртъ же поло́жена бездыха́нїа на земли́ ꙗкѡ чл҃ка, внѣ́дрехъ ѡбе́мши, и цѣлова́зающи оустнѣ́же и ѻ́чи: томꙋ́ возыва́ше ди́вно, ка́кѡ всѧ́ ѡживла́ѧй, безгла́сна недви́жима ннѣ́ зрю́ тѧ; констї́инꙋ чю́до ве́лїе.
items.english_text: "When the unwedded Maiden beheld her Son taken down from the Tree, stretched out and laid lifeless upon the earth like a mortal man: embracing Him in her bosom and kissing His lips and eyes, she cried aloud unto Him in wonder: 'How is it that Thou Who quickenest all art now seen by me speechless and motionless? In truth, a great wonder!' "

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: Егда́ нескве́рнаѧ а́гница, ви́дѣ своего́ а́гнца: на заколе́ніе ꙗ́ко чл҃ка во́лею вле́кома, пла́чꙋщи гла́ше: безча́дствовати ма ннѣ́ тщꙋ́шися хрⷭте ро́ждшую тѧ.
items.english_text: "When the immaculate Ewe-lamb beheld her Lamb led of His own will unto the slaughter like a man: weeping, she said: 'Dost Thou now make haste to leave me childless, O Christ, who gave Thee birth?' "

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section:
ANOTHER CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Work of Joseph.*
items.slavonic_text: ...та. Что́ се сотвори́лъ еси́: и́же благи́тель всѧ́чєскимъ. Ѡ́баче воспѣва́ю и сла́влю твою́, ꙗ́же па́че оу́ма и сло́ва, кра́йнюю блгⷭть чл҃вколю́бче.
items.english_text: [...Thee: 'What is this that Thou hast done, O Benefactor] of all? Yet I hymn and glorify Thy supreme loving-kindness, which is beyond mind and word, O Lover of mankind!' "

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, стїхи́ры Крⷭтны, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: "Save me, O Christ our Savior, by the power of the Cross, Thou Who didst save Peter in the sea: and have mercy upon me, O God."

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Спаси́ мѧ Хе҃ сп҃се си́лою Крⷭтною: спасы́й Петра́ въ мо́ри: и поми́лꙋй мѧ Бж҃е.
items.english_text: "Having willed to be crucified: they who ever enjoyed Thy gifts received a malefactor instead; they chose deceit and asked to receive him. The Judges of the righteous prayed, O Christ, enduring their bitterness, willing to suffer and save us, as Thou art the Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Да́ распя́тисѧ восхотѣ́въ. И́же твои́хъ дарова́нїй при́сно наслажда́ющеся, и злѡ́дѣꙗ воспрїя́ша, пре́лести мѣ́сто, проша́хꙋ прїя́ти. И́же пра́ведникомъ сꙋди́цы, молѧ́шеся Хе҃, терпя́ и́хъ гѡ́рькое то́: пострада́ти хотѧ́ и спасти́ ны, ꙗкѡ чл҃вколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: "Having not loved earthly pleasures, O passion-bearing Sufferers: ye were counted worthy of heavenly good things, and became fellow-dwellers with the Angels. By their prayers, have mercy upon us and save us."

items.office: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I CALL:"
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлюби́вше страда́лцы стра́сти: нбⷭнымъ блг҃ѡмъ сподо́бистеся, и Ан́гглѡмъ сожи́телє бы́ша. Тѣ́хъ мл҃твами и́хъ, поми́лꙋй и спаси́ на́съ. Му́чн.
items.english_text: "When the lawless people lifted Thee up upon the Tree, O Savior, the Life of all: then Thine all-pure and immaculate Mother, standing by and weeping, cried aloud: 'O my sweet Child, Light of mine eyes, woe is me! How didst Thou endure to be nailed upon the Cross in the midst of malefactors, Thou Who didst hang the earth upon the waters?' "

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Сла́: И ны́нѣ: Крⷭтобг҃: Подо́: Егда́ ѿ дре́ва та:
items.english_text: *After the 1st Psalter Stichology, Sessional Hymns (Sedalna) of the Cross, Tone 2:*[^77]

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Егда́ тѧ беззако́ннїи лю́дїе сп҃се, жи́знь всѣ́хъ на дре́во вознесо́ша: тогда́ чⷭтаѧ и пренепоро́чнаѧ Мт҃и твоѧ́, предстоя́щи рыда́ющи, возглаша́ше: ча́до моѐ сла́дкое, свѣ́те мои́ма ѡчи́ма, оувы́ мнѣ́, ка́кѡ посредѣ́ злодѣ́ю на Крⷭтѣ́ пригвозди́тися претерпѣ́; и́же зе́млю повѣ́шей на вода́хъ.
items.english_text: "Thou didst work salvation in the midst of the earth, O Christ God: stretching out Thine all-pure hands upon the Cross, gathering all the nations who cry: 'O Lord, glory to Thee!' "

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: В ПА́ТОКЪ НА ОУ́ТРЕНИ. По а҃. стїхоло́гїи, Сѣда́лна Крⷭтꙋ, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: "In the manner wherein the enemy led Adam captive, deceived by the tree, O Lord: so likewise hast Thou Thyself, the second Adam, led the enemy captive by the Wood of the Cross: seeking him who had gone astray, and quickening him who was dead; O God, glory to Thee!"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Спасенїе содѣ́лалъ посредѣ́ землѧ̀, Хе҃ Бж҃е: на Крⷭтѣ́ пречⷭтыи
items.english_text: "The Virgin and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee stretched out dead upon the Tree, weeping bitterly, said: 'O my Son, what is this dread mystery? How dost Thou, Who grantest eternal life unto all, die of Thine own will upon the Cross by a reproachful death?' "

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: рꙋ́цѣ свои́ распросте́ръ, собира́ѧ всѧ́ ꙗзы́ки, зовꙋ́щыя: Гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Psalter Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 2:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: И́мже ѡ́бразомъ плѣни́лъ е́сть вра́гъ Ада́ма, дре́вомъ пре́льщеный Гдⷭи: та́кожде и ты́ са́мъ, плѣни́лъ еси́ вра́га, дре́вомъ Крⷭтнымъ вторы́й Ада́мъ: возыска́ти заблꙋ́ждшаго, и ѡживи́ти оуме́ршаго, Бж҃е сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: "Unassailable is Thy Cross, O Christ, which Thou alone hast granted unto us who are unworthy: we bring it unto Thee in prayer; save our Emperor and Thy city, who pray unto Thee."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́ва и Мт҃и твоѧ́ Хе҃, на дре́вѣ зря́щи тѧ́ ме́ртва просте́рта: пла́чꙋщи го́рько, гла́голаше: Сн҃ꙋ мо́й: что́ стра́шное сѐ та́инство; и́же всѣ́мъ да́рꙋѧй живо́тъ вѣ́чный, во́лею на Крⷭтѣ́ ка́кѡ оумира́еши, сме́ртїю поно́сною;
items.english_text: *Other [Kathisma Hymns]: O Only Lover of mankind:*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: По в҃. стїхоло́гїи, Сѣда́лна: Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: "We bow down before Thine all-pure icon, O Good One, asking forgiveness of our transgressions, O Christ God: for of Thine own will Thou wast well pleased to ascend the Cross, that Thou mightest deliver them whom Thou hadst fashioned from the bondage of the enemy. Therefore, giving thanks, we cry aloud unto Thee: 'Thou hast filled all things with joy, O our Savior, Who didst come to save the world!' "

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Нєѡбори́мый Крⷭтъ тво́й е́сть хрⷭте́, его́же дарова́ намъ не досто́йнымъ еди́нъ: тѣ́бѣ прино́симъ въ мл҃твꙋ, спаси́ цр҃ѧ и гра́дъ тво́й, молѧ́щихъся.
items.english_text: "Fervently having Him Who decks the heavens with clouds as their raiment in the world, the holy ones endured torments from the lawless, and abolished the deceit of idols. By their prayers, deliver us also from the invisible enemy, O Savior, and save us."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
items.slavonic_text: Пречи́стому твое́мꙋ ѡ́бразꙋ покланѧ́емься бл҃гі́и, прося́ще проще́нїа согрѣше́ніямъ на́шымъ Хе҃ Бж҃е, во́лею бо бл҃гоизво́лилъ еси́, взыти́ти на Крⷭтъ: да иꙁба́виши и́хже созда́, ѿ рабо́ты вра́жїа. Тѣ́мже бл҃годарѧ́ще, вопїе́мъ ти́: ра́дости испо́лнивый всѧ́, Сп҃се на́шъ прише́дый спасти́ мі́ръ.
items.english_text: "Standing by Thy Cross, she who bare Thee without seed, unable to bear the sight of Thee suffering unjustly, wept with lamentation and cried aloud unto Thee: 'How sufferest Thou, Who art dispassionate by nature, O sweetest Son? I hymn Thine endless goodness!' "

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE CROSS
