items.english_text: "Thy great and ineffable tender compassion, the measureless abyss of Thy love for mankind: grant remission of transgressions unto the departed, O Christ, and show them cleansed by Thy goodness. *Theotokion:*"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́лникъ была̀ еси́ бж҃твенныѧ сла́вы, сїя́нїе нося́щи Дѣ́це, Дх҃омъ пло́тїю на́мъ ꙗ́вльшагося, и а́довꙋ мглу, свѣ́тлостїю бж҃тва своего́ потре́блѧ. Бгорадо́ваннаѧ.
items.english_text: Thou wast a lamp of divine glory, carrying the radiance, O Maiden, of Him Who appeared unto us in the flesh by the Spirit, and destroyed the gloom of Hades by the brightness of His Godhead, O full of God's joy!"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: И́же въ кꙋпинѣ́ Мѡѵсе́ю Дѣ́вы чꙋ́до, на Сїна́йстей горѣ́ проѡбрази́вшаго ано́гда: по́йте блгⷭвите, и превозноси́те єгѡ̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *"Unto Him Who prefigured of old the virgin wonder unto Moses in the bush on Mount Sinai: sing, bless, and highly exalt Him unto all ages!' "*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе кро́ви ва́шеѧ, ст҃і́и всю̀ тва́рь страстоте́рпцы, ѡчи́стивши ꙗ́ко иꙁли́нїе преле́сти: и вѣ́чнꙋю дш҃а напои́ бога́тно.
items.english_text: "The stream of your blood, O holy passion-bearing Martyrs, having cleansed all creation like an outflow of deceit, richly watered souls with eternal life."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́вися ли́къ по́стническїй, Ст҃и́телей же собо́ръ, и Же́нъ ст҃ы́хъ, и Пррⷦкъ сла́вныхъ, єди́ноче́тѣ Ан́гглѡмъ: Ан́гглски на земли́ дх҃омъ пожи́вше.
items.english_text: "The ascetic choir, the assembly of Hierarchs, and holy Women, and glorious Prophets were shown to be equal in honor with the Angels, having lived on earth angelically in the Spirit."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Иꙁба́вите всѣ́хъ на́съ стра́стнояща Гдⷭни, первосщ҃енницы, и Пррⷦцы, и Прпⷣбныхъ мно́жество, и же́нъ ст҃ы́хъ: ѡ стрѣ́лъ вра́жїихъ, и́же ва́съ восхваля́ющихъ. Покои́:
items.english_text: "Deliver all of us from the passions, O chief priests of the Lord, and Prophets, and multitude of Venerables, and holy women: from the arrows of the enemy, who praise you. *For the Dead:*"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: И́хже ѿ на́съ Сп҃се прїя́тъ, въ ло́нѣхъ Авраа́мовѣхъ оучини́, и съ Ла́зарыми поко́й: пода́й грѣхѡ́мъ и́хъ всѣ́мъ, ꙗ́ко всеще́дръ разрѣше́нїе. Бг҃:
items.english_text: "Those whom Thou hast received from among us, O Savior, establish in the bosom of Abraham, and grant rest with Lazarus: give remission of all their sins, as Thou art all-compassionate. *Theotokion:*"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Бгороди́телнице чⷭтаѧ, совсѣ́ми ст҃ы́ми Пррⷦки, и Мꙋ́ники, и по́стными Жена́ми, и Сщ҃енномꙋ́ченники: оуще́дрити на́съ Сп҃са моли́.
items.english_text: "O pure Mother of God, together with all the holy Prophets, and Martyrs, and ascetic Women, and Hieromartyrs: pray the Savior to have compassion upon us."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Пе́щь ѻ́гненна ано́гда въ Вавѵлѡ́нѣ, дѣ́йства раздѣля́ше, бж҃твеннымъ велѣ́нїемъ: Халде́а ѡпаля́ющи, вѣ́рныѧ же прохла́-
items.english_text: *"The fiery furnace of old in Babylon divided its operation by the divine command: burning the Chaldeans, but cooling the faithful who sang: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!' "*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: жда́ющи пою́ща: блгⷭви́те вся̀ дѣла̀ Гдⷭна Гдⷭа.
items.english_text: "Thou hast shown unto us the untrodden paths of hostile death, as Thou art immortal, by Thy divine power, and hast revealed the entrances of life, O Immortal One; which Thy Martyrs have now worthily obtained."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Показа́лъ еси́ на́мъ вра́ждьныѧ сме́рти, нехоже́нїа ꙗ́кѡ безсме́ртенъ, бж҃твенною си́лою твое́ю, въхо́ды же сказа́лъ еси́ живота̀, безсме́ртне: его́же Мꙋ́ннци твои́, ннѣ́ досто́йно полꙋчи́ша.
items.english_text: "Vouchsafe the departed to enjoy Thy noetic beauty, driving away from thence the ugly sorrow of sin, O Master, as Thou art the Lover of mankind; for Thou alone wast shown to be free from sin."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Доброты́ оу́мныя твое́ѧ наслади́тися, преста́вленныхъ сподо́би: ѿтꙋ́дꙋ злоѡ́бразнаго оу́нꙋщаѧ, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃вколю́бецъ грѣха̀ Влⷣко: еди́нъ бо то́кмѡ ты́ яви́ся еси́ грѣха̀ ско́бо.
items.english_text: "Thou hast set upright us who had fallen into the dust of death, O Christ: granting life by Thy death, and endless food, and everlasting joy; which vouchsafe the departed now to obtain, as Thou art merciful."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Испра́вилъ еси́ на́ Хе҃ па́дшыхся въ пе́рсть сме́ртнꙋю: сме́ртїю свое́ю, живо́тъ да́рꙋя, и пи́щꙋ безконе́чнꙋю, и ра́дость присносꙋ́щнꙋю, ея́же ннѣ́ преста́вленыя, ꙗ́кѡ ми́лости сподо́би.
items.english_text: "Great and dreadful is the mystery of thy birthgiving, O Mother of God; for thou gavest birth unto God, Whom death could not endure, and the grave could not corrupt: therefore all nations glorify thee, O all-pure one."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїя и стра́шна е́стъ Бгома́ти твое́го ро́жества та́йна, Бг҃а бо роди́ла еси́, его́же сме́рть непретерпѣ́, и гро́бъ нерастлѣ́н: тѣ́мже тѧ̀, Пречⷭтаѧ, вси́ ꙗзы́цы сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: *"Unto Him Who shone forth from the Father before all ages, the Word conceived in the womb beyond nature in the flesh: in unceasing hymns do we the faithful magnify!"*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́же па́че є́стества пло́тїю, заче́ншꙋю во чре́вѣ, и́зъ Ѻц҃а́ пре́ждевѣ́къ, возсїя́вшаго Сло́ва: въ пѣ́снехъ немо́лчныхъ вѣ́рніи велича́емъ.
items.english_text: "Strong against passions, mighty against enemies were ye shown to be, O passion-bearers: ye carried away the victory, having suffered lawfully, and were crowned by Christ."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пци на стра́сти, си́лни на враги́, ꙗви́стеся страстоте́рпци: ѡ́нѣбосте побѣ́дꙋ, пострада́вше зако́нно, и вѣнча́стеся ѿ Ха́.
items.english_text: "Having been divine ministers of God, and imitators of the Good Shepherd: ye shepherded His sheep piously, O glorious chief hierarchs."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Бж҃їи сщ҃еннодѣ́лателїе, и па́стырѧ добраго подо́бници бы́вше: оупасо́сте того́ ѻ́вца прпⷣбнѣ, сщ҃еннонача́лници сла́вныи.
items.english_text: "With the Venerable ascetics, and the sacred Churches, let us honor the multitudes of women who suffered, and cast down the enemy by fasting."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Съ Прпⷣбными по́стники, и Цр҃ки Сщ҃енными, почти́м женъ пострада́вшихъ мно́жества, и по́стѡ низложи́вшй вра́га.
items.english_text: "The most glorious multitude of Thy saints, O Christ, unceasingly entreats Thee: them whom Thou hast translated in faith, O Lord, show to be partakers of eternal life. *Theotokion:*"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Пресла́вное мно́жество ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ Хе҃, непреста́нно мо́литъ тѧ̀, и́хже преста́вилъ еси́ въ вѣ́рѣ Гдⷭи, прича́стники ꙗви́ вѣ́чнаго живота̀. Бг҃.
items.english_text: "Having given birth in the flesh unto the tenderly compassionate God, together with all the saints ever entreat Him to save us from perils, O pure Virgin Mother."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Щедролюби́ваго Бг҃а ро́ждшїа пло́тїю, со ст҃ы́ми всѣ́ми моли́ того́ при́снѡ, ѡ бѣ́дъ на́съ спасти́, Мт҃и Дв҃о чи́стаѧ.
items.english_text: *"She who shone forth before the sun, the Dayspring, Who came unto us in the flesh from her womb, having ineffably incarnate God: O blessed and all-pure one, thee, O Theotokos, do we magnify!"*

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́же пре́жде слн҃ца Денни́ца, возсїя́вши, пло́тїю къ на́мъ прише́дшаго, и́зъ бо́кꙋ си Дѣ́вꙋ, неизрече́нно воплоти́вшаа, блгⷭве́ннаѧ Пречⷭтаѧ, тѧ̀ Бцⷣе велича́емъ.
items.english_text: "Having authority over the living and the dead, O Prince of life: grant a heavenly inheritance unto them that have passed over from the earth unto Thee, and the brightness of the Saints, O Master, and of Thy most glorious passion-bearers."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Имѣ́яй вла́сть живы́хъ и ме́ртвы́хъ, живота̀ нача́льниче: и́же ѿ землѧ̀ ктебѣ́ преше́дшым, наслѣ́дїе нбⷭное пода́ждь: и свѣ́тлость Ст҃ы́хъ Влⷣко, и́ пресла́вный страстоте́рпецъ тво́й.
items.english_text: "Being the Word, Who gavest me being of old, most life-originating; and gavest again well-being: in the beloved bosom of Abraham the Forefather settle Thy departed servants, as Thou art merciful."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Сло́во сы́й, е́же дре́вле бы́ти ми́ пода́л, живнонача́лнѣйшее: и е́же до́брѣ бы́ти, па́ки дарова̀, въ ло́нѣхъ желанны́хъ Авраа́ма Пра́ѡца, преста́вльшася рабы́ твоѧ́, ꙗ́кѡ мл҃тивъ всели́.
items.english_text: "Thou art all sweetness, O my Savior, the desire of all, an insatiable longing; with the streams of Thy food and the waters of forgiveness, prepared, water them that unceasingly glorify Thee. *Theotokion:*"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь еси́ Сп҃се мо́й сла́до, всѣ́хъ жела́емое, всѣ́хъ жела́нїе ненасыща́емое, пото́ки твоѧ́ пи́щи, и воды̀ ѡставле́нїа, оу́готована напо́й, непреста́нно тебѐ сла́вѧщаѧ. Бг҃.
items.english_text: "Thee who art worthy do we the faithful now bless: following thy God-inspired words, for Thou alone didst bear God for the earthborn, Who destroyed the power of death, O Virgin Mother."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ бꙋ́дꙋ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ннѣ́ блажи́мъ: Бгодохнове́ннымъ слове́семъ твои́мъ послѣ́дꙋюще, ты́бо еди́на, земны́мъ
items.english_text: "Having suffered for Christ even unto death, O passion-bearing Martyrs: your souls indeed are in the hand of God in the heavens; and throughout all the world your relics are honored: Hierarchs and Kings bow down, and all peoples rejoicing, we customarily cry aloud: 'Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones!' "

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃а роди́ла еси́: сме́рти разо́ршаго си́лꙋ, Мт҃и Дв҃о.
items.english_text: "Great cities and countries honor your relics, O passion-bearing Martyrs; for having suffered lawfully, ye received heavenly crowns: and for this reason ye are the boast of Priests, the victory of Kings, and the beauty of Churches."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: НА ХВАЛИ́ТЕ: СТЇХИ́РЫ Мꙋ́нкѡмъ, Гла́съ, в҃.
items.english_text: "Taking up the Cross of Christ, an invincible weapon, the holy Martyrs abolished all the power of the devil, and received heavenly crowns; they became a wall for us, praying for our sake."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: По Хрⷭтѣ пострада́вше да́же до сме́рти, ѡ́ страстоте́рпци Мꙋ́ченнци, дꙋ́ша оу́бѡ има́те на нб҃се́хъ въ рꙋцѣ́ Бж҃їи: и по мі́рꙋ все́мꙋ почита́еми сꙋ́тъ мо́щи ва́ша, Ст҃лїе и Цр҃їе покланя́ются: и лю́дїе вси́ ра́дꙋющеся, ѡбы́чно вопїе́мъ: Со́нъ че́стенъ пре́ Гдⷭемъ, сме́рть прпⷣбныхъ єгѡ̀.
items.english_text: "The multitude of Thy saints entreats Thee, O Christ: have mercy and save us, as Thou art the Lover of mankind."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Ве́лїя гра́дъ и стра́на, чтꙋ́тъ мо́щи ва́ша, ѡ́ страстоно́сци Мꙋ́нци, ви́ бо зако́нно пострада́вше, вѣ́нца нбⷭныѧ прїѧ́сте: и сегѡ́ ра́ди, Сщ҃енникѡмъ есте́ похвала̀, Цр҃емъ побѣ́да, и Це́рквамъ бл҃голѣ́пїе.
items.english_text: "All my hope do I place in thee, O Mother of God: preserve me beneath thy protection."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭтъ Хв҃ъ взе́мше ст҃і́и Мꙋ́ченнци, ѡрꙋ́жїе непобѣди́мое: всю̀ дїа́волꙋ си́лꙋ оупраздни́ша, и прїя́ша вѣ́нца нбⷭныѧ, стѣ́на на́ бы́ша, ѡ на́ моля́щеся.
items.english_text: "The onset of death and corruption hast Thou cast down by Thy life-giving death, O Master; and unto all Thou dost well forth eternal life, and unto the dead of the earth Thou hast granted resurrection."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: нїе дарова̀. Тѣ́мже ти ся мо́ли Сп҃се: и́же вѣ́рою ктебѣ́ преста́вльшїяся поко́й, и нетлѣ́ннѣй твое́й сла́вѣ, си́хъ сподо́би чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: unto them. Therefore we pray Thee, O Savior: give rest unto them that have departed unto Thee in faith, and vouchsafe them Thine incorruptible glory, O Lover of mankind."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Стїхъ. Блаже́ни и́же иꙁбра́лъ и прия́тъ и́хъ Гдⷭь.
items.english_text: "That Thou mightest make men partakers of Thy divine Kingdom, O Christ: Thou didst endure crucifixion and willingly accept death; therefore we pray: by Thy tender compassion show them that have departed in faith to be partakers of Thy Kingdom, and vouchsafe them the beauty of Thy glory, O Lover of mankind."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Да чл҃ки ѡ́бщники, бж҃твеннаго ти́ Црⷭтвїа, содѣ́лаеши Хе҃: рапя́тїе претерпѣ́лъ еси́, и сме́рть во́лнꙋю прїя́тъ. сегѡ́ ра́ди мо́лимъся: твои́мъ милосе́рдїе, прича́стники ꙗви́ црⷭтвїа твое́го, вѣ́рою преста́вльшихся: и сла́вїа доброты́ твоеѧ̀, си́хъ сподо́би, чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: "Desiring to save Thine own creation, Thou didst joyfully accomplish the dread mystery of the dispensation in truth, as Thou art supremely Good, and by Thy precious blood Thou didst ransom the whole world; therefore we pray: vouchsafe them that have departed unto Thee redemption with all the Saints."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Стї. Дꙋша́ и́хъ воблг҃и́хъ водвори́тся.
items.english_text: "When my soul is about to be separated from life from the bond of the flesh:

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Спасти́ своѐ созда́нїе восхотѣ́въ, смотре́нїа же вои́стиннꙋхъ стра́шное та́инство, ра́дꙋяся соверши́лъ еси́ ꙗ́кѡ преблагі́и, и цѣно́ю искꙋпи́лъ еси́ вве́сь мі́ръ, чⷭтною ти́ кро́вїю. тѣ́мже мо́лимъся: и́же ктебѣ́ преста́вльшіся, со всѣ́ми ст҃ы́ми, иꙁбавле́нїа сподо́би.
items.english_text: then stand by me, O Lady, and destroy the counsels of bodiless enemies, and crush their jaws who seek to devour me unsparingly: that I may pass without hindrance through the princes of darkness who stand in the air, O Bride of God!"

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Егда́ пло́тскаго соꙋ́за, хо́щет дша́ моѧ̀ ѿ житїа́ разлꙋчи́ти
items.english_text: "We bring unto Thee the voice of the thief, and pray: 'Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!' "

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: ся: тогда́ ми́ предста́ни Влⷣчце, и безпло́тныхъ врагѡ́въ, совѣ́ты разори́, и си́хъ челю́сти сокрꙋши́, и́щꙋщій мѧ̀ поже́рти неща́дно: ꙗ́кѡ да невозбра́нно пройдо̀, и́же на воздꙋ́сѣ стоя́щїа кнѧ̑зѧ тмы́, Бгоневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: "Having been assimilated unto the sufferings of Christ, O Martyrs: ye ever heal the diverse passions of men."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ ти́ прино́симъ разбо́йничь, и мо́лимъся: Помяни́ на́съ Гдⷭи въ Црⷭтвїи си.
items.english_text: "With the Prophets, Apostles, and Venerable teachers: they well pleased the Creator of all."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Хв҃ымъ стрⷭтемъ, оуподо́бльшееся Мꙋ́нци: стра́сти чл҃чєскїа разли́чныѧ, при́но исцѣля́ете.
items.english_text: "With all Thy saints, O Lord Who lovest mankind, we pray: establish all Thy servants who have departed in faith."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Съ Пррⷦки, А́плы, съ Прпⷣбными же оучи́тели: содѣ́телю всѣ́хъ до́брѣ оу́годиша.
items.english_text: "O consubstantial Trinity, have compassion upon them that honor Thee; snatch them from the deceit of the enemy, ever delivering them."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Со всѣ́ми ст҃ы́ми твои́ми, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ Гдⷭь, вся̀ и́же вѣ́рою преста́вльшася, оучини́ рабы́ своѧ̀ мо́лимся.
items.english_text: "Despise not the supplications of thy servants, O all-immaculate one, saving us from all tribulations and sorrows."

items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪце единосу́щнаѧ, чтꙋ́щихъ тѧ̀ оуще́дри, пре́лести вра́жїѧ исхити́, изба́вляющи при́но.
items.english_text: **END OF THE SECOND TONE.**[^84]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Мо́льбы ра́бъ свои́хъ непре́зри, всенепоро́чнаѧ, спаса́ющи на́съ ѿ вся́кихъ бѣ́дъ, и скорбе́й.
items.english_text: *At "Lord, I call:" Stichera of the Resurrection, Tone 3:*[^85]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: В СꙊББОТꙊ ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ НА ВЕЛИЦѢЙ ВЕЧЕРНИ НА ГИ ВОЗЗВА
items.english_text: "By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, the dominion of death was destroyed, and the deceit of the devil was brought to naught; and the human race, being saved through faith, ever brings a hymn unto Thee."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Твои́мъ Крⷭто́мъ Хе҃ Сп҃се, сме́рти держа́ва раздрꙋши́ся: и дїа́вола ле́сть оупраздни́ся, ро́дъ же чл҃ческїй вѣ́рою спаса́емъ: пѣ́снь ти́ всегда̀ прино́ситъ.
items.english_text: "All things were enlightened by Thy Resurrection, O Lord, and Paradise was opened again; and all creation, praising Thee, ever brings a hymn unto Thee."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́шася вся́ческая, Воскресе́нїем твои́мъ Гдⷭи, и ра́й па́ки ѡ́тверзе́ся, вся́же тва́рь восхваля́ющи тѧ̀: пѣ́снь ти́ всегда̀ прино́ситъ.
items.english_text: "I glorify the power of the Father and the Son, and hymn the authority of the Holy Spirit: the undivided, uncreated Godhead, the consubstantial Trinity, reigning unto ages of ages."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Сла́влю Ѻц҃а̀ и Сн҃а си́лꙋ, и Ст҃а́го Дх҃а пою̀ вла́сть: нераздѣ́лно и несозда́нно Бж҃етво, Трⷪцꙋ единосу́щнꙋю: црⷭтвꙋющꙋю въ вѣ́ки вѣкѡ́мъ.
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, Anatolian (Eastern), Tone the same:*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И́ны стїхи́ры восто́чны, Гла́съ, то́йже.
items.english_text: "Before Thy precious Cross we bow down, O Christ, and Thy Resurrection do we sing and glorify; for by Thy wound were we all healed."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭтꙋ̀ твое́мꙋ чⷭтно́мꙋ, покланя́емъся Хе҃: и Воскресе́нїе твоѐ, пое́мъ и сла́вим: ра́ною бо твое́ю, мы̀ вси́ исцѣлѣ́хомъ.
items.english_text: "We hymn the Savior Who was incarnate of the Virgin; for for our sake was He crucified, and on the third day He arose:

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ Сп҃са, и́же ѿ Дв҃ы вопло́щшагося: на́съ бо ра́ди распѧ́тъ ся, и тре́тїй дн҃ь воскре́се:
items.english_text: granting unto us great mercy."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Сꙋ́щымъ въ а́дѣ, сше́дъ Хс҃, бл҃говѣстѝ: дерза́йте глаго́ля: ннѣ́ побѣди́хъ, А́зъ е́смь Воскресе́нїе, А́зъ вы̀ возведꙋ̀, разори́въ сме́ртнаа врата̀.
items.english_text: "Having descended unto them that were in Hades, Christ proclaimed good tidings, saying: 'Be of good cheer, now have I conquered! I am the Resurrection, I will lead you up, having destroyed the gates of death!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: И́же недосто́йнѣ стоя́ще, въ пречⷭтѣмъ до́мꙋ твое́мъ, вече́рнее пѣ́нїе возсыла́емъ: и́зъ глубины́ взыва́юще, Хе҃ Бж҃е, просвѣти́вый мі́ръ трїдне́внымъ Воскресе́нїемъ свои́мъ: иꙁми́ лю́ди твоѧ̀, и́зъ рꙋки́ вра̑гъ твои́хъ, чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: "Standing unworthily in Thine all-pure house, we send up an evening hymn, crying from the depths, O Christ God, Who didst enlighten the world by Thy three-day Resurrection: deliver Thy people from the hand of Thine enemies, O Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ка́кѡ недиви́мся, Бгомꙋ́жному рождествꙋ̀ ти́ Пречⷭтаѧ; искꙋше́нїа бо мꙋ́жеска непрїе́мши, всенепоро́чнаѧ: роди́ла еси́ без̾ Ѻц҃а, Сн҃а пло́тїю: и́же пре́жде вѣ́къ ѿ Ѻц҃а рожде́ннаго, без̾ Мт҃ре, ника́коже претерпѣ́вша измѣне́нїа, или́ смѣше́нїа, или́ раздѣле́нїа: но ѡбою́хъ сꙋ́ществъ свойство цѣ́ло со
items.english_text: *Glory: Both now: Theotokion (Dogmatikon):*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: Ка́кѡ недиви́мся, Бгомꙋ́жному рождествꙋ̀ ти́ Пречⷭтаѧ; искꙋше́нїа бо мꙋ́жеска непрїе́мши, всенепоро́чнаѧ: роди́ла еси́ без̾ Ѻц҃а, Сн҃а пло́тїю: и́же пре́жде вѣ́къ ѿ Ѻц҃а рожде́ннаго, без̾ Мт҃ре, ника́коже претерпѣ́вша измѣне́нїа, или́ смѣше́нїа, или́ раздѣле́нїа: но ѡбою́хъ сꙋ́ществъ свойство цѣ́ло со
items.english_text: "How should we not marvel at thy God-manbearing childbearing, O all-honored one? For not having accepted the trial of man, O all-immaculate one, thou gavest birth in the flesh without a father unto a Son Who was begotten of the Father without a mother before the ages, having suffered neither change, nor mingling, nor division; but preserving intact the property of each nature."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA FOR THE DEPARTED
items.slavonic_text: хра́нша. Тѣ́мже Мт҃и Дв҃о Влⷣчце, того́ моли́ спасти́ся дꙋша́мъ, и́же правосла́вно Бцⷣꙋ исповѣ́дающихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: Therefore, O Virgin Mother and Lady, pray Him to save the souls of them that orthodoxly confess thee to be the Mother of God."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: НА СТЇХО́ВНѢ, СТЇХИ́РЫ Воскрны, Гла́съ, г҃.

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Стрⷭтїю твое́ю Хе҃, ѡмра́чивый Слн҃це, и свѣ́томъ твое́го Воскресе́нїя, просвѣти́вый вся́ческая: прїими́ на́шꙋ вече́рнюю пѣ́снь, чл҃вколю́бче.
items.english_text: "By Thy passion, O Christ, Thou didst darken the sun, and by the light of Thy Resurrection Thou didst enlighten all things: accept our evening hymn, O Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Живнода́тельное ти́ воста́нїе Гдⷭи, вселе́ннꙋю всю̀ просвѣти́: и своѐ созда́нїе истлѣ́вшее, призва̀. Тѣ́мже клѧ́твы Ада́мовы вси́ измѣ́ньшеся, вопїе́мъ: всеси́лне Гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: "Thy life-giving arising, O Lord, enlightened the whole inhabited world, and recalled Thine own corrupt creation. Therefore, loosed from the curse of Adam, we cry aloud: 'All-powerful Lord, glory to Thee!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ сы́й неизмѣ́ненъ, пло́тїю стражда̀ измѣни́ся, его́же тва́рь нетерпя́щи коче́ща зрѣ́ти, стра́хомъ прекланя́шеся: и стенꙋ́щи пое́тъ твоѐ долготерпѣ́нїе, соше́дъ же въ а́дъ, трїдне́вно воскре́се: жи́знь дарова̀ мі́рови, и ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_text: "Being God immutable, Thou didst change in suffering flesh, which creation unable to bear to see, bent down in fear; and groaning, it hymned Thy long-suffering; and having descended into Hades, Thou didst arise on the third day, granting life unto the world and great mercy."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Да ро́дъ на́шъ ѿ сме́рти Хе҃ изба́виши, сме́рть претерпѣ́лъ еси́: и пе́рвенецъ и́зъ ме́ртвыхъ воскре́съ: съсобо́ю возста́вилъ еси́, и́же тѧ̀ Бг҃а позна́вшыхъ: и мі́ръ просвѣти́лъ еси́, Гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ́.
items.english_text: "That Thou mightest deliver our race from death, O Christ, Thou didst endure death, and having arisen as the firstborn from the dead, Thou didst raise up with Thyself them that acknowledged Thee as God; and Thou didst enlighten the world, O Lord, glory to Thee!"

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Без̾сѣ́мене ѿ Бж҃твеннаго Дх҃а, совѣ́томъ Ѻ́тчимъ, зачала̀ еси́ Сн҃а Бж҃їа, ѿ Ѻц҃а̀ без̾ Мт҃ре, пре́жде вѣ́къ сꙋ́ща, на́съ ра́ди, нетлѣ́ без̾ Ѻц҃а бы́вша, пло́тїю родила̀ еси́, и младе́нца млеко́м пита́ла еси́, тѣ́мже непреста́й
items.english_text: "Without seed, from the Holy Spirit, by the Father's good pleasure, thou didst conceive the Son of God, Who is from the Father without mother before all ages; and for our sake, without father from thee, thou didst bear Him in the flesh, and didst nourish the Infant with milk: therefore cease not to pray, that our souls may be delivered from tribulations."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: моля́щи, иꙁба́витисѧ ѿ бѣ́дъ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Then: "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart..." Trisagion. After "Our Father...":*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Та́жъ. Ннѣ́ ѿпꙋща́еши раба́: Трїст҃о́е. По Ѻ́ч҃е на́шъ:
items.english_text: "Let the heavenly things rejoice and the earthly things be glad, for the Lord hath wrought dominion with His arm: He hath trampled down death by death, He hath become the firstborn from the dead; He hath delivered us from the belly of Hades, and hath granted unto the world great mercy."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Да веселя́тся нб҃наѧ, и да ра́дꙋются земнаѧ, ꙗ́кѡ сотвори́ держа́вꙋ мы́шцею свое́ю Гдⷭь: попра́лъ сме́ртїю сме́рть, пе́рвенецъ и́з̾ ме́ртвыхъ бы́сть, и́з̾ чре́ва а́дова изба́вилъ е́стъ на́съ: и пода́стъ мі́рови ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_text: "Thee who didst mediate the salvation of our race do we hymn, O Theotokos Virgin: for in the flesh assumed from thee, Thy Son and our God, having accepted suffering through the Cross, hath delivered us from corruption, as He is the Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ хода́таившꙋю спасенїе ро́дꙋ на́шему воспѣва́емъ Бцⷣе Дв҃о, пло́тїю бо нетлѣ́ прїѧ́тою, Сн҃ъ тво́й и Бг҃ъ на́шъ, Крⷭтно́ю прїе́мъ стра́сть, изба́вилъ е́стъ на́съ иꙁ̾ нетлѣ́нїа, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: *"He Who of old by His nod gathered the waters into one gathering: and O one Trinity, source of Godhead, vouchsafe me the light of Thy thrice-radiant light, that I may sing of Thee in unceasing hymns. Triadikon:"*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: В НДѢ́ЛЮ, НА ПОЛꙊ́НОЩНИЦЫ, Кано́нъ Тро́ичнъ. Творе́нїе Митрофа́ново. Гла́, г҃.
items.english_text: "The immaterial ranks sacredly sing, standing with trembling before the primary Light of the Trinity, as written in the book of creation, and we earthborn with one mouth faithfully glorify Thee with sacred sacrifices."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: И́же во́ды дре́вле мані́емъ, спостигна́вшаѧ еди́на въ дома́хъ наѧ, и еди́но Тро́ическое Бгоначя́лїе, трїсїѧ́ннаго свѣ́та мѧ твое́го сподо́би, ꙗ́ко да воспою́ тѧ̀, въ пѣ́снехъ непреста́нно. Тро:
items.english_text: "Of the Mind, and the Word, and the Spirit, so great as they call the unoriginate and eternal generation unto Thy Word, from the unbegotten Father: O Son, signifying God, Son of the sole beginning, together with the procession of the Holy Spirit."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃енно невеще́ственні́и чи́нове пою́тъ, ꙗ́кѡ тво́рчески во кни́зѣ еди́нъсткїннꙋ тре́петнѣ предстоѧ́ще, нача́лнѣйши Трⷪце свѣ́тꙋ, и́же согла́сно пое́мъ: и чл҃чскаѧ мы́ же́рвта вѣ́рно сла́вимъ, еди́ными оусты́.
items.english_text: "The supreme Light of the one Godhead, having most gloriously shown forth unto all, O pure Virgin who gavest Him birth."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: ели́цꙋ при́нꙋю и Сло́вꙋ твою̀ наричꙋ́тъ, безстра́стно рожество̀, ѡ́ непорожде́ннаго Ѻц҃а̀: Сн҃ꙋ зна́менающїи, Бж҃е еди́нонача́лне Сн҃ве, вкꙋпѣ́ и бж҃твеннаго Дх҃а исхоже́нїе.
items.english_text: *"He Who brought all things out of nothing: to divide the waters of old, He commanded, watering the earth; prefiguring unto all the Trinitarian hypostasis of the sole Godhead and Dominion."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Еди́нонача́лнѣйшїй Свѣ́тъ, еди́наго Бж҃тва, препросла́вленнѡ всѣ́мъ показа́въ, ро́ждши тѧ̀ Дв҃ꙋ Прчⷭтꙋю.
items.english_text: "The nature of earthborn minds sings of Thee, the one and thrice-radiant immutable Creator, and we cry unto Thee: 'Deliver me from every assault, and save me!' *Glory:*"

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: И́же ѿ неси́щныхъ вся̀ приве́: трои́ти дре́вле водꙋ́, повелѣ́б Пл҃а напоѧ́хꙋ: ѡ́бразно прояви́ всема̀ Трⷪчный соста́въ еди́нственнаго Бж҃їа Гдⷭонача́лїа.
items.english_text: "As in the utterances of prophetic words, and of the all-wise Apostles, preachers of the faith, we glorify Thee as the equal-acting Trinity in one God of all. *Both now:*"

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Ви́нное є́ститво пое́тъ тѧ̀ земны́хъ оума́, еди́наго и трїсвѣ́тлаго соꙁда́телѧ неизмѣ́ннаго, и вопїе́м ти́ ꙗ́ко: вся́каго ма напра́снѡства изба́ви, и спаси́ ма. Сла́ва:
items.english_text: "From the exalted throne descended the Word, lifting up man, as He is the Lover of mankind, through thee, O all-pure one, and the thrice-sunny light shone forth upon all."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ въ вѣща́юще словесе́й Пррⷦческыхъ, прєму́дрыхъ А́плъ же и́ проповѣ́дникъ вѣ́рѣ, равнодѣ́тельнꙋ тѧ̀ Трⷪцꙋ славосло́вй въ еди́н. Бж҃е всѣ́хъ. И ннѣ́:
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn (Sessional Hymn), Tone 3.*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Съ прⷭто́ла высо́каго сни́де Сло́во: чл҃ка возвыша́ѧ, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ, тобо́ю Прчⷭтаѧ, и трїсо́лнечный свѣ́тъ всѣ́мъ возсїѧ̀.
items.english_text: "O undivided and inseparable Trinity, remember us who bow down before Thee, and who piously hymn and unceasingly call upon Thee: save them whom Thou hast fashioned for the sake of the abundance of Thy tender compassion, in Thy holy Church, which Thou didst acquire by Thy power; for Thou knowest, O Merciful One, the weakness of our heart."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, Гла́съ, г҃. По́: Красотѣ дѣ́тва:
items.english_text: "I am wholly changed through my lack of self-control, and through my senseless fearlessness I have become wretched; I cannot bear the day whereat all visible and invisible things tremble; O Lady, help me, and dispel the perplexity of my heart; for thou thyself art the hope and protectress of thy servants."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪце нераздѣ́лнаѧ, и неразлꙋ́чнаѧ, на́съ помяни́й покланя́ющихъ ти сѧ, и воспѣва́ющихъ бл҃гоче́стно, и зовꙋ́щихъ непреста́нно тебѣ́: спаси́ и́хже со-
items.english_text: *"Thou hast set firm love toward us: the Father indeed toward Thee, O Father, as a shoot from the root, the Son and the right Spirit, natural shoots and God-planted flowers without beginning, so as to be luminaries of the Godhead in spiritual essences; unceasingly they hymn Thee, the unfathomable God, with whom we also glorify, saying: 'O transcendent Trinity, preserve Thy servants, as Thou art merciful!' "*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: зда́лъ еси́ милосе́рдїа ра́ди мнѡ́гостїи въ Це́ркви ст҃ѣ́й твое́й: є́же стяжа́ держа́вꙋ твою̀, нбо вѣ́сꙋ мл҃тиве, и́же срⷣца на́шего не́мощь.
items.english_text: "Thou didst save us from great peril, O abundantly merciful Word of God, Who wast incarnate for our sake, and mystically revealed the thrice-sunny Godhead, Whom we glorify."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: лицѣхъ славословима. причти ми гласы. Серафімъ посланъ бысть проповѣдати яже трисвѣтлое существо: и единицу трисолнечную.
items.english_text: "The image of the one Sovereign Ruler, as Isaiah saw God: the ranks of three Angels..." Persons. Join my voices thereto: a Seraph was sent to proclaim the thrice-radiant Essence and the thrice-sunny Unity.[^88]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Иже невидимыхъ и видимыхъ естество, ѡ не сущихъ прежде составльшая, единице трисолнечная. иже единаго тя Бга вѣрою вопиющихъ, ѡ всякихъ напастей избавляй: Коей славѣ подобен:
items.english_text: "O Thrice-sunny Unity, Who of old didst bring into being out of non-existence the nature of things visible and invisible: deliver from every assault them that cry unto Thee in faith as the one God, to Whose glory Thou art like."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтилникъ свѣтоносенъ и чти Дво, бывши Бгу, воспѣваем тя любовію, и блажи. истчесе бо родися Хс, въ существахъ и хотѣніихъ ѡбою: иже единый ѡ Трца: и славися с нимъ и Гдь.
items.english_text: "Having become a light-bearing lantern and vessel of honor unto God, O Virgin, we sing of thee with love and bless thee: for from thee was Christ born, in two natures and two wills, Who is One of the Trinity; and the Lord is glorified with Him."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Преславныхъ силъ образми, подобием образно воспріяти, въ ѡбразѣ оубо Гда, въ трехъ лицѣхъ, вещественна человѣческими зраки.
items.english_text: "Through the figures of the most glorious Powers, in a manner resembling an image, to receive an image of the Lord in three Persons, material in human forms."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Очиститель сый срца своихъ рабъ, къ свѣту неприступномъ, ѡ трисолнечне Гди, и твоея славы сіяніе, сподобь душам нашим, коеже желателне быти Божественною добротою неизреченною.
items.english_text: "Being the purifier of the hearts of Thy servants, unto the unapproachable light, O Thrice-sunny Lord, and the radiance of Thy glory, vouchsafe unto our souls that which is desirable by Thine unutterable divine beauty."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Отверзи мнѣ двери свѣта, рождшаягося ѡ оутробы твоея Пречтая: да зрю трисвѣтлаго свѣта Бжтва: и славлю тя яко всѣхъ влдчцу.
items.english_text: "Open unto me the gates of the light born of thy womb, O all-pure one: that I may behold the thrice-radiant light of the Godhead, and glorify thee as Lady of all."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Сѣдаленъ, гласъ, г. Подобен: Красотѣ дѣвства:
items.english_text: "Having cleansed him as Thou art merciful, deliver Thy righteous servant from those ages, and cast him not into the fire of Gehenna: for Thou alone, O Christ, art abundantly merciful."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Очистивъ я́ко млтивъ, и избави вѣкувъ тѣхъ раба твоего праведнаго. и непосли на въ огнь геенскій: яко единъ Хе многомлтивъ.
items.english_text: "Grant me teaching of groaning, as unto the Publican, O Virgin, and tears of the harlot: that bringing forth Thy judgment, I may cry: 'Have mercy on me, O all-merciful one, and lead me forth from my perplexity by this thy grace, granting me a stream of compunction; for unto thee have I fled, O all-pure one!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Стенаніе оучи ми даруй, якоже Мытарю Дво: и блудници слезы: да твой судъ приношяй, и зову: Помилуй мя всемлтивая. и возведи изъ недоумѣніе мое блгодати си: оумиленія току ми подающи, к тебе бо прибѣгохъ Пречистая.
items.english_text: "Show forth the God-originating, divine Abraham of threefold Person, whose good is higher than grievous sinful darkening and passions; by which grace-bestowing mysteries: 'O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Иже древле покажи Бгоначална блжію, триличнаго, егоже благо, грѣховнаго омраченія лютаго, и страсти вышша. блгодатным коими тайники, Бже ѡцъ наших блги еси.
items.english_text: "Let us alone desire the harvest of Thy life for me, in three Hypostases and distinct properties, of Father and Son and Spirit, crying together: 'O God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Житва твоего за мнѣ единъ возжелаем, въ трехъ составахъ и раздѣлныхъ свойствѣхъ, Отца и Сна и Духа, вкупѣ си зовуще: Бже ѡцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: "Abraham of old, seeing God in three Hypostases near the oak of Mamre, received Isaac as the reward of hospitality for mercy, Whom we also now glorify as the God of our fathers."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Видя Авраамъ Бга въ трехъ составах, оудѣя древле Мамврійскаго, страннолюбія мзду, Ісаака воздая за млть, егоже и ннѣ славимъ яко Бга ѡцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: "Having been born on earth, a man, the Creator: in a God-befitting manner and in virginity, O all-pure one, of thy womb, and He deified us, O blessed, all-immaculate, and all-pure Theotokos."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Внея на земли, бывъ члкъ содѣтель: еголѣпно и Дѣвости я Пречтая ти оутробы, и насъ ѡбожи, блгвенная Всечтая, Бце Пречтая.
items.english_text: "The unoriginate Father, as root, the Word, and the Spirit, being co-unoriginate by nature, as the clarity of the super-essential Godhead, showed forth the one glory and power of the Trinity, Whom we all sing of, strengthen unto the ages."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Безначална Отца, яко закорени Слово, и Духъ, събезначалны
items.english_text: "Thou dost direct by Thy bright ranks the heavenly orders to sing unceasingly with thrice-holy divine hymns: O Father, Word of like form, and Spirit, the thrice-radiant and equal-in-power dominion; therefore we sing of Thee unto all ages."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: по естеству суща, яко оуясни пресущественнаго Бгоначаліа, показаша Трци славу едину и силу, иже поемъ вси вкрѣпи въ вѣки.
items.english_text: "The prophetic utterances, having seen thy childbearing from afar, O Theotokos, praised it as unutterable, and the God born above nature: and in harmony with this we sing of Him as the Lord, and we honor thee who gavest Him birth, O Virgin, unto all ages."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Оуправляєши воими свѣтлыми чины неныл, воспѣвати немолчно, тристыми пѣсньми Бжтвенными: Оче, Слове соѡбразне, и Дше, трисвѣтлую державу и раномощную, тѣмже тя поем въ вся вѣки.
items.english_text: "The God-beholding ranks of the incorporeal ones, wishing to ascend on high as with material wings to behold the glory of the Thrice-radiant One: yet being greatly unable to comprehend that Godhead by reason of the light, they unceasingly cry out a hymn, with whom in harmony, O unique Trinity, we glorify Thee."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Прореченія Прроческая, твое рожество издалеча видѣвше Бце, восхвалиху, яко неизреченни, и паче естества рождшагося Бгуще: и согласно сего поемъ яко Гда: и тебе рожшую чту Дво, въ вся вѣки.
items.english_text: "With love, the nature upon earth, having received Thee with an intelligent soul in speech, we hymn Thee, O Master, God Almighty, the one nature in truth and the Trinitarian Persons, from our whole heart; therefore, O Bountiful One, as Thou art abundantly merciful, have compassion on us."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT THE APOSTICHA, STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION
items.slavonic_text: Видѣти славу трисіяннаго, Бговидніи безплотныхъ чинове, нѣк веществеными крилы, восходити желаютъ горѣ: но тоя Бготъ зѣло пренепостижима свѣтомъ, и пѣніе непрестанно вопіютъ, съ ними согласно Единственная Трце тя славимъ.
items.english_text: "Show me forth as a temple of Thy monarchical and all-bright Godhead, O Knower of all things: teach me to serve Thee, the Creator of the ages, and spiritually to behold Thine unutterable glory, through the intercessions of the only Theotokos, whom worthily, as most glorious, we magnify."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Естество любовію иже на земли, оумною дшею тя тебе пріемъше, въ словесію, тебе поемъ Влко, Бже Вседержителю, единственное естество воистинну: и Трчное лицы, ѡ всего срца, тѣмъже щедре, яко многомилостивъ оущедри насъ.
items.english_text: *"God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us..." in Tone 3. And we say the Resurrection Troparion:*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Храмъ мя покажи, Единоначалнаго, и присвѣтлаго твоего Бгоначаліа всѣхтовѣдче: оучитися служити тебе зиждителю
items.english_text: "Let the heavenly things rejoice..." *Glory: Both now: Theotokion:* "Thee who didst mediate..." *Then the customary reading of the Kathismata of the Psalter.*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: вѣкухъ: я не изреченую ти славу оумно зрѣти, молитвами единыя Бца, юже достойно, яко преславную величаем.
items.english_text: *After the First Kathisma, Resurrection Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*[^89]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Бгъ Гдь и явися намъ: на гла, г. И глем Тро, воскресны:
items.english_text: "Christ is risen from the dead, the firstfruits of them that slept, the firstborn of creation, and Maker of all things that have come to be; the corrupted nature of our race hath He renewed in Himself. No longer dost thou have dominion, O death; for the Master of all hath destroyed thy dominion."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: И ннѣ: Бгоро: Тебе исходотаившую. Таж, ѡбычная стіхос, псалтыри.
items.english_text: "At Thine immutable Godhead and voluntary passion, O Lord, Hades was dismayed and wailed aloud, saying: 'I tremble at the flesh of an incorruptible hypostasis; I behold the Invisible One secretly warring against me; therefore also those whom I hold cry out: Glory, O Christ, to Thy Resurrection!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: По а, стіхос, сѣдална воскресны, Гласъ, г.
items.english_text: "With great love the heavenly ranks were refreshed, and the earth was dismayed with trembling, when the all-pure voice came upon thee, O Theotokos; for it became a single festival unto both, when the bodiless joy was brought unto thee; therefore with the Angel we cry unto thee: 'Rejoice, O pure dwelling-place of God!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Хс ѡ мертвыхъ воста, начатокъ оумершимъ, первенецъ твари, и содѣтель всѣмъ бывшимъ, истлѣвшее естество рода нашего, собою ѡбнови. нектому смерти ѡбладаеши, ибо всѣхъ Влка, державу твою разруши.
items.english_text: *After the Second Kathisma, Resurrection Sessional Hymns:*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Плотію смерть вкусивъ Гди, горесть смертную пресѣче востаніемъ своимъ, и члѣка наню оукрѣпи, первыя клятвы ѡдолѣніе призывая, защитниче жизни нашея, Хе Бже слава тебѣ.
items.english_text: *Resurrectional, Tone 3:*[^90]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Непостижимое распятіе: и неисказанное востаніе, бгословимъ вѣрніи, неизреченное таинство, днесь бо смерть и адъ плѣненъ бысть, родъ же члѣческій вънетлѣніе ѡблечеся, тѣмъже, и благодарнѣ вопіем: слава Хе Воскресенію твоему.
items.english_text: "Having tasted death in the flesh, O Lord, Thou didst cut off the bitterness of death by Thy rising, and didst strengthen man against it, calling back the overthrow of the ancient curse, O Defender of our life: O Christ God, glory to Thee!"

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Непостижимаго и неописаннаго, единосущнаго невидимому Оцу, въ оутробѣ своей тайно вмѣстила еси Бце, едино и несмѣсно ѡ Трца Божество, познахомъ ржтво твое въ мірѣ славити, тѣмже и благодарственно вопіемъ ти: радуйся ѡбрадованная.
items.english_text: "Thy comprehension-surpassing Crucifixion and unutterable Resurrection do we faithful glorify, an ineffable mystery; for today death and Hades have been despoiled, and the human race hath put on incorruption; therefore also with thanksgiving we cry aloud: Glory, O Christ, to Thy Resurrection!"

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Оудивляя видѣніемъ, ѡрошая глаголы: блистаяся Агглъ, Мѵроносицамъ глаше: что живаго ищете въгробѣ, въста испразднивый гробы, тли премѣнителю, разумѣйте непремѣннаго, рцѣте Бгови, коль страшна дѣла твоя, яко родъ спаслъ еси члѣческій.
items.english_text: "Incomprehensible and uncircumscribed, consubstantial with the invisible Father, thou didst secretly contain in thy womb, O Theotokos; one and unconfused Godhead of the Trinity, we have recognized how to glorify thy childbearing in the world; therefore also with thanksgiving we cry unto thee: 'Rejoice, full of grace!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Плѣнъ Сіѡнь, ты изятъ ѡ Вавулѡна: и мене ѡстрастей, къ животъ привлецы Слове.
items.english_text: *Hypakoe, Tone 3:*[^91]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Въ югъ сѣющіи слезами бжтвенными, жнутъ класы радостію, пѣнію животныя.
items.english_text: "Marveling in appearance, dewing with words, the Angel shining forth said unto the Myrrh-bearing women: 'Why seek ye the Living among the dead? He is risen, having emptied the tombs! Understand the Transformer of corruption, and say unto God: How awesome are Thy works, for Thou hast saved the human race!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Стімъ Духу всяко блгодареніе, якоже Оцу и Сну соѡблистает, ѡнемже всяческая живутъ и движутся.
items.english_text: *The Anabathmoi (Antiphons of the Steps), Tone 3.*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Аще не Гдь созиждетъ домъ добродѣтелей: вотще труждаемся, дшя же покрывающе, никтоже нашъ разори градъ.
items.english_text: "The captivity of Sion hast Thou delivered from Babylon: and draw Thou me also out of passions unto life, O Word."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Плода чревнаго, Духомъ сынотворени ти сють Христе якоже и Оцу, Стіи всегда.
items.english_text: "They that sow in the south with divine tears shall reap sheaves of life with joy and singing."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Стімъ Духомъ, провидится всяка стыни премудрость: осуществляетъ бо всяку тварь, тому послужимъ: Бг бо якоже Оцу и Слову.
items.english_text: "To the Holy Spirit is every thanksgiving, as He shines forth together with the Father and the Son, in Whom all things live and move."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Боящіися Гда блаженни, въ путь ходяще заповѣдей, снѣдятъ бо живодающее великоплодіе.
items.english_text: "Except the Lord build the house of virtues, in vain do we labor; and unless He protect the soul, no one can destroy our city."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Окрестъ трапезы твоея, возвеселися: зря твоя, пастыреначалниче исчадіа: носяща вѣтви блгодѣланіа.
items.english_text: "Of the fruit of the womb, by the Spirit, are the saints made Thy sons, O Christ, as unto the Father, at all times."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Стімъ Духомъ, всяко богатство славы: ѡнегоже блгать и животъ всякои твари: со Отцемъ бо воспѣваемь есть и со Словомъ.
items.english_text: "By the Holy Spirit is all holiness and wisdom foreseen; for He brings every creature into being: let us serve Him, for He is God, as unto the Father and the Word."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Рцыте въ языцехъ яко Гдь воцарися, ибо исправи вселенную яже неподвижится.
items.english_text: "Blessed are they that fear the Lord, walking in the way of the commandments; for they shall eat the life-giving, great fruitfulness."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Стіхъ. Воспойте Гдви пѣснь нову, всяко дыханіе. Стіх. Хвалите Бга въ стыхъ его.
items.english_text: "Round about Thy table rejoice, seeing Thy offspring, O Chief Shepherd, bearing the branches of good works."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Иже воды древле, маніемъ Божественымъ, въ едино сонмище совокупльший, и раздѣливый море Ійльскимъ людемъ, Сей Бгъ нашъ, препрославленъ есть: тому единому воспоемъ, яко прославися.
items.english_text: "By the Holy Spirit is all wealth of glory, from Whom is grace and life unto every creature; for He is sung together with the Father and with the Word."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Иже землю ѡсудивъ, преступльшему потомъ изнести плода терніе: ѡ терніа же, вѣнецъ изъ руки законопреступныхъ, Сей Бгъ нашъ, плотію пріятъ, клятву разрѣшилъ есть, яко прославися.
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 3:*[^92]

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Побѣдитель и ѡдолѣтель смерти, иже смерти ѡболксяся, явися, страстную бо плоть, ѡдушевленую пріемъ: Сей Бгъ нашъ, и брався съ мучителемъ, вся совоскреси, яко прославися.
items.english_text: "Say among the heathen that the Lord reigns, for He hath established the world so that it cannot be moved."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Истинную Бцу вси языцы славят тя, яже безсѣмени рождшую, сошедъ бо въ оутробу ѡсщенную твою: Сей Бгъ нашъ, иже по насъ ѡсуществовася, Бгъ же и члкъ нетлѣне родися.
items.english_text: *"He Who of old by His divine nod gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, and He is exceedingly glorious; unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Родъ чловѣчъ подпадающымъ мучителемъ грѣхоловнымъ, кровію бжтвенною Хс искупи: и ѡеготворныхъ обновилъ есть, яко прославися.
items.english_text: "He Who judged the earth to bring forth thorns for the transgressor by the sweat of his brow: from thorns a crown at the hands of the lawless, this is our God, He received in the flesh, and He hath loosed the curse, for He hath been glorified."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Иже оубо смертенъ, смерти хотяще, иже животъ сокровище, Хс виденъ, и я́кѡ безсмертенъ бжтвенством: мертвыя ѡживотворилъ есть, яко прославися.
items.english_text: "A victor and defeater of death, having clothed Himself in death, He appeared, having received passible, ensouled flesh: this is our God, and having fought against the tormentor, He raised up all with Himself, for He hath been glorified."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канонъ престѣй Бци. Гласъ, г. Ірмосъ тоиже.
items.english_text: "All nations glorify thee, the true Theotokos, who gavest birth without seed; for having descended into thy sanctified womb: this is our God, Who became consubstantial with us, and as God and man was He born incorruptibly."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Колѣна прикланяе всяко естество нбных Дво, воплощшемуся нетлѣ: со земными же достолѣпно преисподная, яко прославися.
items.english_text: *"Let us sing a new song, O ye peoples:"*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Изменъ иже втебѣ: блгихъ ко, не завистный податель, отцу Бгъ: Духъ вжтвны подавый намъ, плоть же ѡ тебе Отроковице приятъ, яко прославися.
items.english_text: "The human race falling under the sin-catching tormentor, Christ redeemed with His divine blood, and He hath renewed them that were His own creation, for He hath been glorified."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Иже ѡ не сущихъ, вся привед[ый] словомъ, созидаемая и совершаема Духомъ, Вседержителю Влко, къ любви своей оутверди мене.
items.english_text: "Christ was seen mortal indeed, willing death, He Who is the treasury of life; and as immortal in Godhead, He hath quickened the dead, for He hath been glorified."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Кртомъ твоимъ постыдѣся нечестивый, сотворивый бо емъ яму юже ископа, впадеся, смиреннымъ же, воздвиже Хс рогъ, въ своемъ Воскресеніи.
items.english_text: "Every nature of heavenly beings bows the knee, O Virgin, unto Him Who was incarnate incorruptibly, together with earthly beings and suitably the nethermost, for He hath been glorified."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Блговѣстія проповѣданіе языкомъ, яко вода покры море члѣколюбче, воскресъ бо ѡ гроба, Трческій ѿкрылъ еси свѣтъ. Бго:
items.english_text: "The changes which are in thee: the ungrudging Giver of good things, God the Father: having given us the divine Spirit, and from thee, O Maiden, having received flesh, for He hath been glorified."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Преславная речена быша, ѡ тебѣ граде ѡдушевленный, присно цртвующаго, тобою бо Влчце сщымъ на земли, Бгъ съпожилъ есть.
items.english_text: *"He Who brought all things out of nothing by His Word, which are fashioned and perfected by the Spirit: O Almighty Master, establish me in Thy love."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Чистота пречтая Крсте, Ідолоскимъ еси нечистотам, яко Хс прежтвенный, на тебѣ руцѣ распростерлъ есть, и вси вѣрніи Бгоприемный гробъ, тебѣ покланяемся, погребшаго тя
items.english_text: "By Thy Cross was the ungodly one put to shame; for the pit which he dug and made, therein did he fall; but Christ raised up the horn of the humble in His Resurrection."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Чистота пречтая Крсте, Ідолоскимъ еси нечистотам, яко Хс прежтвенный, на тебѣ руцѣ распростерлъ есть, и вси вѣрніи Бгоприемный гробъ, тебѣ покланяемся, погребшаго тя
items.english_text: "The preaching of the Gospel unto the nations, as water covers the sea, O Lover of mankind; for having risen from the tomb, Thou didst reveal the Trinitarian light."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Чистота пречтая Крсте, Ідолоскимъ еси нечистотам, яко Хс прежтвенный, на тебѣ руцѣ распростерлъ есть, и вси вѣрніи Бгоприемный гробъ, тебѣ покланяемся, погребшаго тя
items.english_text: "Most glorious things have been spoken of thee, O ensouled city of the Ever-Reigning One; for through thee, O Lady, hath God lived together with them that are upon the earth."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Чистота пречтая Крсте, Ідолоскимъ еси нечистотам, яко Хс прежтвенный, на тебѣ руцѣ распростерлъ есть, и вси вѣрніи Бгоприемный гробъ, тебѣ покланяемся, погребшаго тя
items.english_text: *"Thou hast shattered the bow of the enemy:"*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: во славѣ тебѣ, и воста Хс, бо истинный Бгъ нашъ.
items.english_text: "Thou art the all-pure purity of the Cross against idolatrous impurities; for Christ the pre-eternal stretched out His hands upon thee, and all we faithful bow down before thee, the God-receiving tomb of Him that buried thee," "unto Thy glory, and Christ is risen, for He is the true God."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Жезлъ искорене Іесеова, Пррчески прозябши Дво: цвѣтъ тя Хе, возсія намъ, Спсъ еси Гди.
items.english_text: "A rod from the root of Jesse, having prophetically budded forth, O Virgin: Christ as a flower hath shone forth upon us, Thou art the Savior, O Lord."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Да бжтвенномъ причастіи, земнородныя содѣлаеши, ѡ Двы плоть нашъ, ты ѡбновилъ еси пріе: Спсъ еси Гди.
items.english_text: "That Thou mightest make earthborn mortals partakers of the divine nature, taking our flesh from the Virgin, Thou hast renewed it: Thou art the Savior, O Lord."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Положилъ еси кнамъ, твердую любовь Гди, Единороднаго бо своего Сна, на ради на смерть даде, тѣмже ти зовем блгодарственно: слава силѣ твоей Гди.
items.english_text: *"Thou hast set firm love toward us, O Lord; for Thine Only-begotten Son didst Thou give unto death for our sake; therefore we cry unto Thee with thanksgiving: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!"*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Язвы Хе, и раны милостивно подъялъ еси, досадъ по ланитома оудареніи терпя, и долготерпѣливѣ ѡплеванія нося: имиже содѣлал мнѣ спасеніе, слава силѣ твоей Гди.
items.english_text: "Wounds and stripes, O Christ, didst Thou mercifully endure, suffering blows upon Thy cheeks with insults, and bearing spitting with long-suffering: by which Thou hast wrought salvation for me; glory to Thy power, O Lord!"

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Тѣломъ смертнымъ, животе смерти причастная еси, страсти ради нищихъ, и воздыханія оубогихъ, и растлѣвъ тлѣющаго прославленый, всѣх совоскресил еси, яко прославлен. Бго:
items.english_text: "In mortal body, O Life, didst Thou become partaker of death, for the sake of the affliction of the poor and the groaning of the needy; and having corrupted the corrupter, O Glorified One, Thou didst raise up all with Thyself, as Thou art glorified."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Помяни Хе, еже стяжал стадо страстію своею: препрославленныя твоея Мтре, милостивныя мольбы пріемъ, и посѣтивъ ѡзлобленное, избави силою своего Гди.
items.english_text: "Remember, O Christ, the flock which Thou didst acquire by Thy passion: accepting the merciful supplications of Thine all-glorious Mother, and having visited the afflicted, deliver it by Thy power, O Lord."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Создавый по образу своему [человѣка]
items.english_text: "Having fashioned [man] according to Thine image..."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Мертвы оубо, ихже пожре смерть во аде, разор[и]жеся и Адово тлетворное царство, воскресши ти из гроба Гди. Бго:
items.english_text: "...crucified on the Place of the Skull, Thou hast saved."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Мріе чтая, златаа кадилнице, неслиянно яко Единъ ѡ Трца въ тя сошедъ воплощься Бгъ Слово: миръ ѡблгоухае.
items.english_text: "The dead whom death swallowed up in Hades, and the corruptive kingdom of Hades was destroyed, when Thou didst arise from the tomb, O Lord."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Иже поставивый горы Влко, мѣриломъ Бжтвеннаго разума, ѡбрѣтъ еси ѡ Двнца, камень кромѣ рукъ, силѣ твоей слава чловеколюбче.
items.english_text: "O pure Mary, golden censer, unconfusedly as One of the Trinity the Word of God descended into Thee and was incarnate, filling the world with sweet fragrance."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Болящее исцѣлилъ еси, наше естество Влико, искоренивъ изъ Двы сію сокоупникъ оутѣлевъ, твое чтное Слове Бжтво,
items.english_text: *"He Who set fast the mountains, O Master, by the balance of divine understanding, Thou hast found from the Virgin a Stone cut without hands: glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Чистъ моя еси Гй, и наслѣдіе желанное, совокупивый мя к Двы, Слове изъ составъ своему, плотію бывъ составъ.
items.english_text: "Thou didst heal our diseased nature, O Master, having rooted it out from the Virgin, becoming incarnate as a companion; O Word, Thy precious Godhead."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Ктебѣ оутренюю везжественныхъ Ангеловъ, преимущемъ всякъ оумъ мирокъ, зане свѣтъ повелѣніа твоя: внихъже настави мя.
items.english_text: "Thou art my portion, O Lord, and desired inheritance, Who didst unite me from the Virgin, O Word, into Thy Hypostasis, having become a Hypostasis in the flesh."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Судіи неправедному, Еврейскою завистію предан бывъ, всевидяй, и всей праведнѣ судяй земли, Адама древняго изселналъ еси ѡсужденіа.
items.english_text: *"Unto Thee do I rise early in the morning, surpassing all immaterial angelic mind, a small world; for Thy commandments are light: wherein guide Thou me."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Твой миръ Церквамъ твоимъ Хе, непобѣдимою силою Крта твоего, измертвыхъ воскресый подаждь, и спаси душа наша.
items.english_text: "Handed over to an unjust judge through the envy of the Hebrews, Thou Who seest all things and judgest all the earth with righteousness, didst deliver ancient Adam from condemnation."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Скиніа стáя, и пространнѣйша нбсъ, паче нже кедръ во Ливанѣ богоизряднѣйша, явися
items.english_text: "Grant Thy peace unto Thy Churches, O Christ, by the invincible power of Thy Cross, Thou Who didst arise from the dead, and save our souls."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: На земли невидимый явися, и со члѣки волею поживъ непостижимый: и ктебѣ оутреннющу вопиемъ ти члѣколюбче.
items.english_text: "A holy Tabernacle, and more spacious than the heavens, far more God-chosen than the cedars in Lebanon, didst thou appear" "ever, having been shown forth alone, O Ever-Virgin."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Копіемъ въ ребро твое, ѡ Хе мое, прободенъ бывъ: ѡ ребра чловеча созданную, губителства всѣмъ члѣкомъ бывшую ходатаицу, клятвы свободи еси.
items.english_text: *"The Invisible One appeared upon earth, and willingly lived with men, the Incomprehensible One: and rising early unto Thee, we cry unto Thee, O Lover of mankind."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Равенъ Оцу существомъ сынъ, ѡщенный храмъ, пріятаго своего и нетлѣннаго телесе: изъ мертвыхъ воскресилъ еси Хе Спсе нашъ.
items.english_text: "Pierced with a spear in Thy side, O my Christ: from the rib fashioned of man, the mediatress of ruin that was unto all men, didst Thou free from the curse."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Слово Бжіе, Снъ твой Дво, Содѣтел Адама первозданнаго, несозданіе, аще плоть ѡдушевленную себе, ѡ тебе созда есть.
items.english_text: "Equal to the Father in essence, the Son, the consecrated temple of His assumed and incorruptible body: from the dead didst Thou raise up, O Christ our Savior."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Равенъ Оцу, Снъ твой Дво, Слово Бжіе, составъ соверше, всякои естествѣ, Іс Гдь, Бгъ совершенъ, и члкъ.
items.english_text: "O Word of God, thy Son, O Virgin, the Fashioner of Adam the first-formed, uncreated, though He fashioned ensouled flesh for Himself from thee."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Бездна послѣдняя грѣхѡвъ, ѡбииде мя, и изчезаетъ духъ мои: но простеръ Влко высокоую свою мышцу, яко Петра мя, окормителю спаси.
items.english_text: "Equal to the Father, thy Son, O Virgin, the Word of God, a perfect Hypostasis in every nature, Jesus the Lord, perfect God and man."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Бездна милости и щедротъ, ѡбят мя, милосерднаго снитіема ти, воплощ бо ся Влко, и бывъ въ рабіи зрацѣ, ѡбожи еси, и съсобою сопрославилъ.
items.english_text: *"The lowest depth of sins hath compassed me, and my spirit fails; but stretch forth Thy high arm, O Master, and as Thou didst Peter, O Pilot, save me."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Оумерщвеніе подятъ, оумертвитель, оумерщвленнаго, ѡживленна вида, твоея Воскресеніи спсъ Хе ѡбразы и стрстей
items.english_text: "The abyss of mercy and compassions hath compassed me by Thy merciful condescension; for having been incarnate, O Master, and being in the form of a servant, Thou didst deify and glorify me together with Thyself."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Претая, яже едина творцу и члѣкомъ, паче оума исходатаившая: Сна своего милостива, согрѣшившимъ рабомъ твоимъ, и поборника быти помолися.
items.english_text: "The slayer of death endured slaying, beholding the slain One revived; O Christ Savior, the images of Thy Resurrection and the wounds" "of Thy most pure sufferings."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Снітію Ісона, во преисподній ада, естественнаго образа бывъ, вопіяше: возведи истла живот мои, члѣколюбче.
items.english_text: "O all-pure one, who alone didst mediate beyond mind between the Creator and men: pray thy Son to be merciful unto thy servants that have sinned, and to be their defender."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Ранами ты изъязвихся, ѡ ада оураненныхъ, страстію Крта совозставилъ еси, тѣмже ти зову: возведи нетла живот мои, члѣколюбче.
items.english_text: *"At the descent of Jonah into the nethermost parts of Hades, having become an image of nature, he cried aloud: Lead up my life from corruption, O Lover of mankind."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Възапятъ ти ся Хе страхом врата Адова, сосуды вражіа восхищаемни сють, тѣмже тя жены срѣтоша, вмѣсто печали, радость пріемлюще.
items.english_text: "Thou wast wounded with wounds, and them that were wounded from Hades didst Thou raise up together with Thyself by the passion of the Cross; therefore I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O Lover of mankind."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Выѡбражается иже по насъ, ѡ нетлѣнныя Двы, иже образомъ неразлучным, ѡбразомъ бывъ, и вещію, непреложен Бжтвомъ члѣкъ.
items.english_text: "The gates of Hades shrank back in fear before Thee, O Christ, and the vessels of the enemy were despoiled; therefore the women met Thee, receiving joy instead of sorrow."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Бездны грѣхѡвъ, и буря страстей Пречтая избави мя, еси бо пристанище, и бездна чудесемъ, яже вѣрою притѣкающій ти.
items.english_text: "He Who is after our likeness from the incorrupt Virgin is depicted, Who in an inseparable form, having become in form and in deed, is man without change in Godhead."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Воскресл еси днесь из гроба щедре, и насъ возвелъ ѡ вратъ смертных, днесь Адамъ ликуетъ: и радуется Еѵа, купнѣ же и пророцы со Патріархи воспѣваютъ непрестанно
items.english_text: "Deliver me, O all-pure one, from the abyss of sins and the storm of passions; for thou art a haven and an abyss of wonders unto them that flee unto thee in faith."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Воскресл еси днесь из гроба щедре, и насъ возвелъ ѡ вратъ смертных, днесь Адамъ ликуетъ: и радуется Еѵа, купнѣ же и пророцы со Патріархи воспѣваютъ непрестанно
items.english_text: "Thou didst arise today from the tomb, O Compassionate One, and hast led us up from the gates of death; today Adam dances and Eve rejoices, and together the prophets and patriarchs [sing unceasingly of the divine power of Thine authority]."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Нбо и земля, днесь да ликоствуютъ: и Хрта Бга единомудрно да воспѣваютъ. яко оузники ѡ гробъ воскресивъ, вкупѣ радуется вся тварь, приносяще достойныя пѣсни, создателю всѣх и избавителю нашему: яко жизнодатель свободивъ, и на небеса съсобою вознесъ, и низложь вражіа возношеніа: и врата адовы сокрушивъ: Бжтвенною державою власти своеа.
items.english_text: "Let heaven and earth today keep festival, and with one mind sing of Christ God; for having raised up the prisoners from the tomb, all creation rejoices together, offering worthy hymns unto the Creator of all and our Redeemer: for as the Giver of life He hath freed them, and raised them up with Himself unto the heavens, and cast down the loftiness of the enemy, and shattered the gates of Hades by the divine power of His authority."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Якоже древле, блгочестивыя три отроки ѡросилъ еси, въ пламени Халдеистем: свѣтлым Бжтва огнемъ, и насъ ѡзари, блгословенъ еси зовущихъ: Бже ѡцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: *"As of old Thou didst bedew the three pious Children in the Chaldean furnace: with the bright fire of the Godhead enlighten us also, who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!"*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Раздразся црковнаа свѣтлая ѡпона, въ распятіи содѣтеля, сокровенную въ писаніи являя вѣрным истину, блгвнъ еси зовуще, Бже ѡцъ наших.
items.english_text: "The bright veil of the temple was rent at the Crucifixion of the Creator, revealing unto the faithful the truth hidden in the Scripture, who cry: 'Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Прободеннымъ ти ребръ капля Бготочныа животворящіа крове Хе, смотреніемъ каплющи на землю, сущихъ ѡ земли ѡбновилъ еси, блгвнъ еси зовущих, Бже ѡцъ наши.
items.english_text: "A drop of divine, life-creating blood from Thy pierced side, O Christ, dripping upon the earth by Thy dispensation, hath renewed them that are of the earth, who cry: 'Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Духа блгаго, съ Отцемъ прославимъ, и съ Сномъ единородным, едино въ тріехъ вѣрніи чтуще начало, и едино Бжтво, блгвнъ еси зовущи, Бже ѡцъ хъ.
items.english_text: "Let us glorify the good Spirit with the Father, and with the Only-begotten Son, we faithful honoring one Principle in three, and one Godhead, crying: 'Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: поправше семиричный пламень, пояху, блгвнъ еси Гди, Бже ѡцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: "having trampled the sevenfold flame, they sang: 'Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Непроста солнце, на Кртѣ повѣшена члѣка: но Бга воплощенна зря, помрачуется, емже и поемъ: блгвнъ еси зовуще, Бже ѡцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: "Not simply seeing a man suspended upon the Cross: but beholding God incarnate, the sun was darkened, unto Whom we also sing: 'Blessed art Thou who criest, O God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Крѣпкаго Бжтвомъ пріемъ адъ отвращивый, нетлѣніа подателя, дшя праведныхъ вопиющихъ извелъ, блгвнъ еси Гй, Бже ѡцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: "Hades turning away having received Him Who was mighty in Godhead, the Giver of incorruption, He led forth the souls of the righteous that cried: 'Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Сокровное блженіа многоцѣнное бысть, Прчтая, иже чтити хощемъ тебе исповѣдающимъ Бгородителницу, яко хотеся воплотися, Бгъ ѡцъ наших.
items.english_text: "A hidden treasure of great price hast thou become, O all-pure one, unto us who wish to honor thee, confessing thee to be the Mother of God; for He was pleased to be incarnate: 'Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Иже славѣ Тда дрожавъ имый горнихъ силъ, иже въ ѡцемъ сѣдяи: и Дннческими росама носимъ, блгвнъ еси Бже ѡцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: *"He Who possesses the power of the heavenly hosts, Who sits in the Father's bosom, and is borne upon the cherubic wings: blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers."*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Яра смерть: но си та причитаетнався погубилъ еси, и Адам Бгосозданна плоть бывши, блгвнъ еси вопіемъ, Бже ѡцъ нашихъ.
items.english_text: "Fierce was death, but it destroyed itself by drawing near; and Adam having become a body fashioned by God, we cry: 'Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Бцу вси тя Бга рожшую оувѣдѣхомъ: единаго бо иже ѡ Трца нетлѣ воплотившагося, родила еси, блгвнъ Пречтая плодъ твоего чрева.
items.english_text: "All we have known thee who gavest birth to God; for One of the Trinity, Who was incarnate incorruptibly, hast thou borne: blessed, O all-pure one, is the fruit of thy womb."

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Въ непостоянномъ огни сококубльшеся, иже блгочестіемъ притолціи юнѡша, пламени же невреждени: бжтвенную пѣснь пояху, блгословите вся дѣла Гдня Гда, пойте и превозносите его въ вѣки. Раздразся
items.english_text: *"Gathered together in the unenduring fire, yet unharmed by the flame, the youths pre-eminent in piety sang a divine hymn: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all unto the ages!' "*

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Раздразся црковная свѣтлость: егда Кртъ твои водрузися на лобнѣмъ, и тварь прекланяшеся страхомъ, воспѣвающи: блгвнт вся дѣла Гня Га, поите и превозносите его въвѣки.
items.english_text: "The brightness of the temple was rent when Thy Cross was planted on Calvary, and creation bowed down in fear, singing: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all unto the ages!' "

items.office: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT GREAT VESPERS
items.section: AT MATINS
items.slavonic_text: Воскресъ Хе из гроба, и падшаго ся прельщеніемъ древа, исправи сей бжтвенном силою, зовуща и глаща: блгословите вся дѣла Гдня Гда, пойте и превозносите его въ вѣки.
