items.english_text: Thou hast a mighty dominion, O Trinity, a single Lordship without beginning, and Thou rulest over heaven and earth; therefore, having ever inclined in love of mercy unto all, preserve him that chants: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Make me a partaker of Thy thrice-radiant brightness, O Lover of mankind, and join me unto the common hosts, and show forth invisible beauties and manifest a spiritual understanding in the flesh, O Master, my single-originating God and Lord of glory, that I may warmly hymn Thee unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: The God-originating Light that shone forth from Thy womb, O all-pure Mother of God, illumined all the world with light surpassing the sun, and showed forth the earth as another heaven, singing: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.english_text: Thee, the Mother of God above mind and nature:

items.english_text: Angels and children praise Thee worthily, Whom the Seraphim unceasingly hymn; unable in our clay garment to praise Thee as man, yet united in dominion, we chant: and we magnify God Who loves mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Deliver from bodily diseases and the darkening of the soul Thy faithful singers, O single and indivisible Trinity; and by Thine uninjured protection account them worthy to escape the affliction of worldly temptations, O equally-honored, God-originating, thrice-radiant One, almighty dominion, ineffable beauty, by the endowment of divine goodness, granting unto Thy servants remission of transgressions and deliverance from temptations and evils!

items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.

items.english_text: [Having assumed mind, spirit, and flesh, Thy pre-eternal Son became man; therefore, Thee who didst give birth unto God the Word do we unceasingly magnify!]

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: God is the Lord and hath appeared unto us: In Tone 7. And we say the Resurrection Troparion: Thou didst shatter death by Thy Cross: twice. Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion: As the treasury of our Resurrection: the same. The customary stichology of the Psalter.

items.english_text: While the tomb was sealed, O Christ God, Thou Life didst shine forth from the grave; and while the doors were shut, Thou didst come unto the Disciples, O Resurrection of all, renewing an upright Spirit in us through them, according to Thy great mercy!

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: By Thy foretold burial having despoiled death, and by Thy life-bearing Resurrection [having raised up incorrupt man, O Christ God, as Thou art the Lover of mankind: Glory to Thee!]

CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: [...reclining...]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: [...lying in the tomb...]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [4] [Ꙗ҆́кѡ] и҆мꙋ́щи млⷭрде напомощь на́шꙋ, и҆ зра́щи бѣ́дныхъ на землѝ, на́съ беспомо́щныхъ людї[й ѹ҆ми́лосердися, бл҃гослове́ннаѧ] Бцⷣе: [презри] поги́бше[го человѣ́ка, сотвори́] бл҃года́т[ь твою̀, на на́съ нбⷭнаго Спасе́нїѧ,] спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: НА ГРО́БѢ ОУ́ВѢ́ДѢ́ВШЕ ЖЕ́НЫ, СО СЛЕЗА́МИ
items.english_text: When the women came unto the tomb, bearing myrrh with tears, while the soldiers were guarding the King of all, they said among themselves: "Who shall roll away the stone for us?" The Angel of the Great Council is risen, having trampled down death! O almighty Lord: Glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: СПАСИ́ МѦ ВОСКРЕСЕ́НЇЕМЪ СИ ХЕ БЖ҃Е,
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: съ слеза́ми: сі́и [ра́достныѧ пожнꙋ́тъ]
items.english_text: Unceasingly pray unto Christ God, Who was crucified for us and is risen, and Who hath cast down the dominion of death, O Virgin Birth-giver of God, that He may save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: рукови̑ти, при́[снѡ живопита́тельныѧ.]
items.english_text: Hypakoe, Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: стѣ́блїе ви́дѧ исча́дїѧ сїѧ, ра́дуй-
items.english_text: Thou Who didst take upon Thyself our likeness and endure crucifixion in the flesh: save me by Thy Resurrection, O Christ God, for Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѧ и весели́сѧ, приводѧ̀ сїѧ Хрⷭтꙋ̀,
items.english_text: Degrees, Tone 7.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [разрѣши́лъ есѝ] Гдⷭи, чл҃вколю́бче:
items.english_text: Antiphon 1:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [воскр҃сивъ есте]ство̀ челове́ческое,
items.english_text: Having turned back the captivity of Sion from delusion: do Thou also make me alive, O Savior, delivering me from slavish passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ныѧ: воскре́съ тридне́внѡ. Бг҃ородиченъ:
items.english_text: They that sow in the south with tears of fasting sorrows: shall reap joyous sheaves that ever nourish life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: емꙋ̀, ꙗ́кѡ просла́висѧ. Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стрѣло́ю грѣхо́вною, оуѧзве́нъ бы́въ,
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit belongs the fountain of divine treasures; from Him proceed wisdom, understanding, and fear: unto Him be praise, glory, honor, and dominion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [вси́хъ бо] вла́дче. Тѣ́мъ [же Сп҃се]
items.english_text: Antiphon 2:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ ма̀ оу́несѝ ѿ ꙗ́звы, и́же [ѡ́чїю]
items.english_text: Except the Lord build the house of the soul, in vain do we labor; for from Him alone do well-pleasing works proceed; for before all things is the dominion of God over all, without Whom nothing is reconciled or given life unto all.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оубы́ше си́лꙋ Оу́ченикѡ́ Хе, оу́жасни
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit, the fruit of the womb is spiritually given as an inheritance, being fatherly adopted unto God.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Плѣне́нное ѡрꙋ́жїе кро́вїю ѡ́краси́ся
items.english_text: Antiphon 3:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и степе́нь, и́же ѡ́ ре́беръ, ѡ́де́ржетъ
items.english_text: They that fear the Lord, having found the path of life, are now and ever blessed with incorruptible glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [въ ра́й] со вратъ, а́да же врата̀ оубо
items.english_text: Round about thy table, beholding thy children like shoots, rejoice and be glad, bringing them unto Christ, the Chief of pastors!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [Инъ. Ірмо́съ: Воспрїѧ́лъ Ѽтрока̀ Своегѡ̀...]
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [Дн҃ь Хе пе́рвїе Себе ꙗвле́нїи пред̾оувѣ́рилъ]
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit is the depth of gifts, the richness of glory, and great profundity; for He is equally glorified with the Father and the Son, and equally worshipped!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: есѝ болѣ́знїи [... Архила́е... сокруши́лъ]
items.english_text: Prokeimenon, Tone 7 (Psalm 9:33):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hand be lifted up; forget not Thy poor unto the end!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Verse (Psalm 9:2): I will give praise unto Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Thy wonders!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Let every breath praise the Lord: The Resurrection Gospel. And the rest in order.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Resurrection Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: By Thy nod upon the earth, the image of the watery nature, which formerly flowed easily, was transformed, O Lord; therefore Israel, passing through dry-shod, chants unto Thee a song of victory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: That which was condemned of old by Thy nod, having fallen into slavery among the daughters of Adam through righteous death: Thou didst loose, O Lord and Lover of mankind, by Thy Resurrection, having raised up human nature without condemnation, chanting unto Thee a song of victory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: [Having slain the adversary beast, O Savior, Thou didst tear asunder the waves of death...]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: ...Thou didst tear asunder the billows of death, O Savior, rising on the third day!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: The pangs of our Fore-mother Eve were loosed, for having escaped travail, Thou didst give birth without knowing man; therefore, knowing Thee as the Birth-giver of God, O all-pure one, all we glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Another Canon of the Cross and Resurrection.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: He covered Pharaoh in the deep:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: On the Cross, the Savior poured forth life-bearing streams unto us from a fountain, even from His pierced side; therefore we cry aloud unto Him, for He is glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Having dwelt in the tomb and risen on the third day, O Christ, Thou didst bestow incorruptible praise upon mortals; therefore we chant unto Him, for He is glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: The order of nature was renewed in Thy childbearing, for Thou didst purely bring forth the Creator of the world; therefore we all cry unto Thee: Rejoice!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: *Tone 7. Heirmos: By Thy nod upon earth is fashioned the...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: O Virgin who didst bear the abyss of compassions: illumine my soul with light-bearing rays, that I may worthily hymn the abyss of Thy wonders, O all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Wounded by the arrow of sin, the Word, beholding us, had compassion as Benefactor; therefore He ineffably united Himself unto us, taking flesh upon Himself.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: The company of mortals was taken captive and made dead by death, O Master of all; therefore, O Savior, Thou didst strike down the curse by Thy death when Thou didst arise!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Resurrection Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: In the beginning, by Thy Word established by Thy Word, O Lord and Savior, and by the all-effective and Divine Spirit all their power was made firm: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Ascending upon the Tree, Thou didst heal the suffering race, O compassionate Savior, and enduring wounds, Thou didst become the Mediator of reconciliation and salvation unto the faithful, whereby through Thy mercy we all were reconciled unto Thy Father!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Thou didst rescue me from the wound, O Christ, who was slain by the venomous bites of the serpent, and Thou didst show forth light unto me who lay in darkness and corruption of old; for descending into hades through the Cross, Thou didst raise me up with Thyself!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: By the prayers of Thine all-pure Mother, grant peace unto the world, O Savior, and grant unto our rulers victory over opposing enemies, and account worthy of Thine ineffable glory those who glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Another [Canon]. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: The power of the Disciples was struck with awe, O Christ:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: The captive weapon was dyed red with blood, and the spear that pierced Thy side was held fast lawfully when blood and water were poured forth upon the Tree at Thy Crucifixion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: O Savior, Thou didst lead the Thief into Paradise, and breaking down the gates of hades, he rejoices, having received remission of sins through Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: [O all-pure Virgin, who remained unconsumed by the divine flame: pray that our souls may be saved!]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [есѝ ꙗ́ко Бл҃гоꙋтро́бный Бг҃ъ: тѣ́мже всѝ]
items.english_text: Another [Canon to the Theotokos]. Heirmos: He hath helped His servant:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ...гоже родила̀ есѝ Гдⷭа. Дѣ́тскымъ
items.english_text: [^280] Whom Thou didst bear as Lord! Having in the flesh given birth unto Him from a virginal womb, O pure one: through Thy maternal intercessions grant unto Thy servants that which is well-pleasing, for Thee alone do we know as a compassionate refuge unto God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: бл҃гослове́нъ пло́дъ твоегѡ̀ чре́ва,
items.english_text: Resurrection Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: разꙋ́мїѧ, Анге́льское Дв҃о и ми́ръ роди́ла
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: бл҃гощїи всѣ́хъ, но и́ исповѣда́нїемъ
items.english_text: [The Prophet Habakkuk, having perceived the divine and unsearchable counsel of Thine incarnation, O Christ, cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сла́вихъ тѧ̀, Еди́не Человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: бг҃ъ: и сꙋдѧ́й во пра́вдꙋ всю̀ [землю̀.]
items.english_text: The serpent creeping forth from Eden, deceiving me with the desire for deification, cast me down unto the earth; but He Who is by nature merciful and compassionate, having pity on our noble dignity, ascended upon Thy Tree and became like unto me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡде́ржимаѧ тлѣ́ю и добра́ѧ, ѡ́ста́в-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: O Virgin Mother, blessed is the fruit of Thy womb, for as Birth-giver of God Thou art the joy of all; for Thou didst give birth unto Joy for the whole world and vision unto those at the ends of the earth, dispelling the sorrow of sin, O Bride of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Eternal life, the light of the knowledge of God, angelic joy and peace didst Thou bear unto us, O Virgin, destroying the ancient warfare against the Father and God, stilling the enmity of all through the confession of grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross and Resurrection.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Without leaving the Father's bosom and having descended unto earth, O Christ God: I heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, the only Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Before the tribunal of the unjust judges, Thou, the Judge of all, didst stand as one condemned and guilty, and the Cross was prepared for Thee Who didst fashion man, O God, and Who judgest the whole earth in righteousness

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: As truly the Mother of God, pray Thou unto Thy Creator and Son to guide me unto the harbor of salvation, O all-immaculate one, according to His glorious will!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos: Beholding the Prophet:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Knowing no sin, Thou didst become for its sake that which Thou wast not, O Lord, receiving that which was alien, that Thou mightest save the world and extinguish the deceitful tyrant!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, and didst loose the sin of fallen Adam; therefore have I heard of Thy power, that Thou didst come in Thy goodness to save all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: From the all-pure mountain, the Virgin, having come forth, Thou wast enrolled with servants, delivering all from tyranny, ruling unto ages; therefore we glorify Her who gave Thee birth!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Another Canon. Same Heirmos: Without leaving the Father's bosom:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Held fast by corruption, human nature was rescued by God Who existed before the creation of all; in the flesh, O all-pure one, He hastened to save and enlighten the people!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Thou didst bear God unto men, O pure one, incarnate of Thy pure blood, delivering from grievous transgressions those who praise and honor Thee with love, O Virgin Mother!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: In an undivided manner the divine Nature was truly united in Thy flesh, in the ineffable mystery of Thy childbearing, O most blessed one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Resurrection Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Night is without light unto the unbelieving, O Christ, but unto the faithful it is illumination in the sweetness of Thy words; therefore I rise early unto Thee, and hymn Thy Divinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: For the price of a servant wast Thou sold, O Christ, and enduring a blow upon the cheek, Thou didst procure freedom for those who chant: I rise early unto Thee, and hymn Thy Divinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: By Thy divine power, O Christ, through the weakness of the flesh Thou didst cast down the strong one, and by Thy Resurrection, O Savior, Thou didst show me forth as conqueror of death!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Thou didst bear God incarnate, O pure Mother, being truly hymned in a manner befitting God, since Thou knewest not man, but didst bring forth from the Holy Spirit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross and Resurrection.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos: Entreat Him today:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: When Thou wast numbered with the lawless, being lifted up upon Golgotha, the luminaries were darkened, the earth was shaken, and the veil of the temple was rent in twain, foreshadowing the downfall of the Jews!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Thee Who didst shatter the power of the tyrant by the might of Thine unsearchable Godhead, and didst raise up the dead by Thy Resurrection, do we glorify with hymns!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: O all-hymned Birth-giver of God, Mother of the King and God: unto those who ever praise Thee with faith and love, send down through Thine intercessions estrangement from transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Night is without light unto the unbelieving, O...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Jacob beheld splendors confirmed by the oath, prefiguring Thee who art unceasingly glorious; for through Thee, O all-pure Sovereign Lady, God united Himself unto men!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Having found eternal redemption through Thee, O Virgin, we earnestly cry aloud: Rejoice, O Bride of God! And rejoicing in Thy Son, O all-pure one, we magnify Thee with hymns!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Finding Thee alone as a lily in the midst of thorns, O Virgin, shining with the brightness of purity and with the light of virginity, the all-hymned Bridegroom brought Thee forth!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Resurrection Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Sailing in the surge of the billows of life, and overwhelmed with the ship by sins, and cast before the soul-destroying beast, as Jonah, O Christ, I cry aloud unto Thee: Lead me up from the death-bearing depths!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: The souls of the righteous imprisoned in hades remembered Thee, and prayed for salvation from Thee, which Thou, O Christ, didst bestow through the Cross upon those in the underworld, having come as the compassionate One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: When Thine animate and unbuilt temple was destroyed by sufferings, the Apostolic choir of old looked thereon, but worshipping beyond all hope, they proclaimed Thy power!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: First receiving the joy of the glad tidings at Thy rising, O Giver of life, the Myrrh-bearing women rejoiced, proclaiming unto the Apostles: The decree of the curse is loosed, for Christ is risen from the dead!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и по лани́тѣ оударе́нїе претерпѣ́въ,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дуйсѧ, еѧ́же ра́ди тлѧ̀ ѡ́гна́нна
items.english_text: Who among men can declare the likeness of Thine ineffable childbearing, O all-immaculate Virgin Bride of God? For God the pre-eternal Word united Himself unto me, having become flesh from Thee![^281] Canon of the Cross and Resurrection.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ. Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: И́же въ нача́лѣ:
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: есѝ Гдⷭи Бж҃е Ѽц҃ъ на́шъ. Тро́иченъ:
items.english_text: I cried aloud unto the Lord in my affliction:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: по́йте, и превозноси́те егѡ̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Being crucified, O Master, Thou didst shake the whole earth, and as the good One didst heal its grievous contortions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: по́йте, и превозноси́те егѡ̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Death was destroyed and hades was despoiled, O Christ, when Thou didst arise, preparing a way for man through Thy Resurrection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Еди́наго безна́ча́:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: O all-pure Sovereign Lady, sure hope of those who hymn Thee with love: preserve us as truly the Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Sailing in the surge of the billows of...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: The types of the Law and the prophetic utterances clearly foretold Thee who wast to give birth unto the Benefactor of all creation, O pure one, Who in manifold portions and in diverse manners showed goodness unto those who faithfully magnify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Adam the first-fashioned, estranged of old by the counsel of the manslayer from the enjoyment of divine food, hast Thou, O Bride of God, led up again, having given birth unto Him Who delivered us from transgression!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: He Who by divine counsel and creative power brought all things into being out of nothingness came forth from Thy womb, O pure one, and appeared unto those in the darkness of death, illuminating them with God-originating rays!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Kontakion, Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: No longer can the dominion of death hold mortals fast, for Christ descended, shattering and destroying its powers! Hades is bound, and the Prophets rejoice with one accord, saying: The Savior hath appeared unto those in faith; come forth, ye faithful, unto the Resurrection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Ikos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: The underworld below trembled today, hades and death were afraid of the One of the Trinity; the earth was shaken, and the gatekeepers of hades, beholding Thee, were terrified! And all creation, rejoicing with the Prophets, chants unto Thee a song of victory, unto our Redeemer and God, Who hath now destroyed the power of death: let us shout aloud and cry unto Adam and unto those born of Adam: The Tree hath brought him back again; come forth, ye faithful, unto the Resurrection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Resurrection Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace to be dew-bearing, praising the one God and saying: O God of our fathers, supremely exalted and supremely glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: By a tree was Adam put to death, having willingly committed disobedience; but by the obedience of Christ is he made alive again, for for my sake the Son of God, the supremely glorified, is crucified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: All creation hymns Thee Who didst arise from the tomb, O Christ; for Thou didst blossom forth as life unto those in hades, resurrection unto the dead, and the supremely glorified Light unto those in darkness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Rejoice, O daughter of corrupt Adam! Rejoice, O only Bride of God! Rejoice, through whom corruption was driven away, for Thou didst give birth unto God: pray unto Him, O pure one, that we all may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross and Resurrection.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos: He Who in the beginning:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Having blunted the sting of sin upon the Tree of the Cross, and torn asunder the handwriting of Adam's transgression by the spear in Thy side: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Being pierced in Thy side, Thou didst cleanse the earth, which was defiled with the blood of idols, by the sprinkling of Thy divine blood: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: In an orthodox manner we theologically praise the indivisible Nature: God the Father without beginning, and the equally good Word and Spirit, crying: Blessed art Thou, O consubstantial Trinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Comforted by the proclamation, Thine unapproachable Creator and Lord magnified Thee, O Virgin: O God of our fathers, supremely exalted and supremely glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Being purified of old, O Maiden, Isaiah received the coal, beholding in a figure and symbolic sign Thy childbearing: O God of our fathers, supremely exalted and supremely glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Beholding all the symbolic figures of Thy divine childbearing, the divine Prophets joyfully cried aloud, chanting: O God of our fathers, supremely exalted and blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Resurrection Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: The Bush on Sinai that held communion with the fire without being burned revealed God unto Moses, who was slow of speech and stammering; and the zeal of God showed forth the three Children unburned in the fire, as chanters singing: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: The all-pure spiritual Lamb, slain for the world, caused the sacrifices offered according to the Law to cease, purifying these without transgressions as God, unto those who ever cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Our flesh, which before the Passion was not incorruptible, being assumed by the Creator, was made untouchable by corruption after the Passion and Resurrection, renewing those who were mortal: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Thy purity and all-immaculate state, O Virgin, cleansed that which was defiled and abominable in the world, and became the cause of our reconciliation unto God, O all-pure one; therefore all the works of the Lord hymn Thee, O Birth-giver of God, unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross and Resurrection.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos: The only unoriginate King:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Him Who willingly endured passions and was nailed unto the Cross by His own desire, and destroyed the power of hades: Praise Him, ye priests, and supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Him Who abolished the dominion of death and arose in harmony from the tomb, and saved the human race: Praise Him, ye priests, and supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: The only compassionate, pre-eternal Word, Who at the last was born of the Virgin and saved the human race: Praise Him, ye priests, and supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos: Unburned by fire:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ Канѡ́нъ. Ірмо́съ: Неѡпали́ма ѡгнем̀:
items.english_text: By the brightness of Thy childbearing, O Birth-giver of God, Thou didst wondrously enlighten the universe, carrying in Thine arms the existing God, Who illuminates those who faithfully cry: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́се Хѐ из̾ме́ртвыхъ: разрушѝ
items.english_text: Piously do we hymn [^282] Thy womb: which ineffably contained God Who was incarnate, Who granted unto all the faithful the illumination of the knowledge of God, who unceasingly cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Вра́та а́дова, сокруши́лъ есѝ Гдⷭи:
items.english_text: With the rays of Thy light, make bright those who hymn Thee, O Virgin Mother who didst bear the Light; for as the dwelling of the Word of Light, Thou dost enlighten the luminary for those who ever cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хъ: Воскреснѝ Гдⷭи Бж҃е мо́й, да
items.english_text: Resurrection Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: се́рдцемъ мои́мъ, повѣ́мъ всѧ̑ чудеса̀ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭи, егда̀ прїи́деши во црⷭтвїи сѝ.
items.english_text: Without knowing corruption Thou didst bring forth, lending flesh unto the all-wise Word, O Mother unwedded, Virgin Birth-giver of God, receptacle of the Uncontainable, dwelling-place of Thine uncircumscribed Creator: Thee do we magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Let all who ascribe suffering unto the Godhead be put to shame, holding the same error; for the Lord of glory was crucified in the flesh, but according to His divine Nature He was not crucified, as we magnify the One in two natures!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Ye who disbelieve the resurrection of bodies, go unto the tomb of Christ and learn: that the flesh of the Giver of life was put to death and rose again, as a pledge of the victorious resurrection, which hope we possess!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: We divide not the Trinity into three essences, nor do we reduce the Persons unto a single unit, but honoring the Godhead, we unite Them without confusion: rejecting those who dare to blend Them, Whom we magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross and Resurrection.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos: Mother of God and Virgin in childbearing:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Beholding in Christ the passions of the flesh and the might of the Godhead, let those who think of a single composite nature be put to shame; for as man He died, but as Creator of all He is risen!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Myrrh unto the dead, but hymns unto the Living; tears unto the dying, but faith unto Life: such was the song the women brought, who cried aloud as heralds of the Resurrection, blessing His rising!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Light of Light, shining forth from the Father, the splendor of His glory shone timelessly; and crying aloud unto Christ that He should dwell among mortals in darkness, He drove away the darkness: Whom we faithful unceasingly magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Same Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Truly hast Thou appeared unto us as the mediatress of eternal joy and gladness, O Virgin Maiden, having given birth unto the Redeemer, Whom those who honor Him in truth and by the Divine Spirit confess as God the Deliverer!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: David Thy forefather, O all-pure one, calls Thee the Ark of divine holiness, who contained beyond nature God Who sits in the bosom of the Father, Whom we faithful unceasingly magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Truly art Thou higher than all creation, O pure one, for Thou didst bear bodily unto us the Designer of all; therefore as Mother of the only Master, Thou dost heal the damage that befell all...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: AT THE PRAISES: STICHERA OF THE RESURRECTION. TONE 7.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Christ is risen from the dead: He hath broken the bonds of death; proclaim the glad tidings of great joy, O earth: hymn the glory of God, O ye heavens!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us worship the Holy Lord Jesus, the only sinless One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Ceasing not to worship the Resurrection of Christ, for He hath saved us from our iniquities: Holy is the Lord Jesus, Who revealed His Resurrection in the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: What shall we render unto the Lord for all that He hath accomplished for us? For our sake God appeared among men; for corrupt nature the Word became flesh and dwelt among us! Unto the ungrateful a Benefactor; unto captives a Liberator; unto those sitting in darkness the Sun of righteousness; upon the Cross the impassible One; in hades Light; in death Life; the Resurrection for the sake of the fallen: unto Whom let us cry aloud: O our God, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Other Stichera (Anatolian). Same Tone:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: The gates of hades hast Thou shattered, O Lord, and abolished the dominion of death by Thy mighty power, and didst raise up with Thyself the dead that had slept from the ages in darkness, by Thy divine and glorious Resurrection, as King of all and almighty God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Come, let us rejoice in the Lord, and let us be glad in His Resurrection, for He hath delivered the dead from the indissoluble bonds of hades and as God He granted eternal life and great mercy unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Verse (Psalm 9:33): Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hand be lifted up; forget not Thy poor unto the end!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Shining with brightness, the Angel sat upon the stone of Thy life-receiving tomb, and proclaimed glad tidings unto the Myrrh-bearing women, saying: The Lord is risen, as He said unto you before; proclaim unto His Disciples that He goes before you into Galilee, and bestows eternal life and great mercy upon the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Verse (Psalm 9:2): I will give praise unto Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Thy wonders!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Why have ye set at naught the cornerstone, O lawless Jews? Lo, He is the One Whom God placed in Sion, Who brought forth water from the rock in the wilderness, and poured forth immortality for us from His side! He is the stone cut out without human hands from the mountain of Daniel: the Son of man coming upon the clouds of heaven unto the Ancient of Days, as Daniel said, and His Kingdom is everlasting!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: The Matins Gospel. And thereafter spiritually, the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: AT THE LITURGY:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Beatitudes. Tone 7.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтъ вознесе́ся, ще́дре: Ада́мово
items.english_text: Fair and good for food was the fruit that brought death upon me; but Christ is the Tree of life, of which eating I die not, but cry aloud with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: стилъ есѝ: и спа́слъ есѝ ѿ ле́сти,
items.english_text: Being lifted up upon the Cross, O compassionate One, Thou didst wipe away the handwriting of Adam's[^283] ancient sin, and didst save the whole human race from delusion; therefore we cry aloud unto Thee, O Benefactor and Lord: Remember us, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Тридне́вно воскре́съ ѿ гро́ба Сп҃съ,
items.english_text: Being laid as dead in the tomb, O Christ, the Life of all, Thou didst shatter the gates of death; and Thou didst arise in glory on the third day as the mighty One, and didst enlighten all who hymn Thee and worship Thy rising!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И́злїѧ ꙗ́дъ змї́й въ слу́хъ Еѵ́ви [и́ногда...]
items.english_text: By Thy rising Thou art the Liberator of Adam, O Christ, the Giver of life, bestowing the ancient incorruption that was in Paradise; therefore I cry aloud with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ НЕДѢ́ЛЮ, ВВЕ́ЧЕРЪ. НА ГДⷭИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: The Savior, having risen from the tomb on the third day, granted peace unto the Disciples, as He had said, and sent them forth with glad tidings, saying: Bring all men into My Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хиры покаѧ́нны, гла́, з҃. По́: Дне́сь бди́тъ Ію́да:
items.english_text: The serpent poured forth venom into the ear of Eve of old but Christ upon the Tree of the Cross poured forth delight unto the world; therefore we cry aloud: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И́мѣюще на́съ оу́пова́нїе, всеси́льне
items.english_text: Glory: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: вый чл҃вколю́бче Гдⷭи, поми́луй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: Light is the Father, Light is the Son and Word, Light is the Holy Spirit, but one Light are the Three; for God is One in three Persons, one simple Nature, indivisible and unconfused, abiding eternally!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Thou didst give birth bodily for our sake unto the Son and Word of God, as He alone knows, O Birth-giver of God; therefore, O Virgin Mother, being deified through Thee, we cry aloud unto Thee: Rejoice, O Hope of Christians!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: ON SUNDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Lift up thine eye, O my soul, and look upon the dispensation and divine ordering of God! How He inclined the heavens and descended unto earth, that He might raise thee up from all the misery of passions, and set thee upon the rock of faith! O fearful wonder! Glory to Thy condescension, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Look upon thine iniquitous deeds, O my soul, and consider how the earth bears thee! How the lightning bolt doth not consume thee! How wild beasts devour thee not! And how the unwaning Sun ever shines upon thee! Arise, repent, and cry aloud unto the Lord: I have sinned against Thee, I have sinned, have mercy upon me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Having Thee as our hope, O almighty Lord, we pray Thee: deliver us from all perils and from the tempest of passions, that we may peacefully spend our life in peace, and reap eternity, finding Thee, O Master, well-pleased and merciful on the day of judgment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Bodiless Powers. Tone 7.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: By the vision of the illumination of the Trinity, do ye, O Archangels, enlighten those who hymn you in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Shown forth as secondary lights by participation, do ye stand before the Primal Light, praying for the perfect!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: With the shelter of your wings, preserve all the faithful from evil spirits, destroying their darkness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: All we with the Angels cry aloud unto the Birth-giver of God in hymns: for Thou didst bear the Savior of the world, and after childbearing didst remain a Virgin again; and by Thy childbearing Thou didst deliver the world from delusion, and didst bestow ineffable food upon us, nourishing with milk the Liberator of our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: As the Prodigal Son I have come, O compassionate One; receive me falling down before Thee, as one of Thy hired servants, O God, and have mercy upon me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: As one falling among thieves and wounded, so have I fallen through many sins, and my soul is wounded: unto whom shall I, the guilty one, flee, save unto Thee, the compassionate Physician of souls? Pour out upon us, O God, Thy great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Glory to Thee, O Christ God, the boast of Apostles and the rejoicing of Martyrs, whose preaching was the Consubstantial Trinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Crying unto Thee the "Rejoice" with the Angel, O Bride of God, we name Thee Bridal Chamber, Door, and Fiery Throne, the unhewn Mountain, and the Bush unburned!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: ON MONDAY, AT MATINS:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Possessing the medicine of repentance, O my soul, draw near weeping and crying with sighing: O Physician of souls and bodies, Lover of mankind, loose me from my many transgressions, number me with the Harlot, the Thief, and the Publican, and grant me, O God, forgiveness of mine iniquities, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: O Lord and Lover of mankind, Who didst cleanse Peter's denial with tears and didst forgive the sins of the Publican through sighing: have mercy upon me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: Higher art Thou than the heavenly hosts, for Thou wast shown to be the Divine Temple, O blessed Birth-giver of God, having given birth unto Christ, the Savior of our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́ннаѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ́кѡ ро́ждши Хрⷭта,
items.english_text: I have not emulated the repentance of the Publican, nor have I acquired the tears of the Harlot; for I am bewildered by blindness regarding such amendment: but by Thy compassions, O good One, save me, for Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу́тверди́ся срⷣце моѐ ѡ́ Гдⷭѣ, воз-
items.english_text: The abyss of life overwhelms me[^284] O Lord, and the billows of mine iniquities submerge me: but stretch forth Thy hand unto me, as unto Peter, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оуста̀ моѧ̀, возвесели́хся ѡ́ сп҃се́нїи
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: чл҃вколю́бче, да бл҃го́го сла́влю тѧ̀.
items.english_text: O Holy Martyrs, pray that forgiveness of our sins be granted unto us, and that we be delivered from expected perils and bitter death, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ъ есѝ Гдⷭи, спасла̀ дꙋша̀ на́ша.
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: More honorable than the glorious Cherubim art Thou, O Most Holy Virgin; for they, unable to bear the Divine Power, cover their faces with wings as they perform their ministry; but Thou, visibly beholding the Incarnate Word, didst bear Him in Thine arms: Him do Thou unceasingly entreat for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 7.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: The tempest of diverse passions and of my sins drowns me in the depth of despair; but by the prayers of Thine Angels, O most merciful Jesus, save me as the Prodigal!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Prepare thyself, O my soul, for thy departure, facing the life to come without wavering! For neither wealth, nor strength, nor friends, nor princes shall avail there: but only the display of deeds and the love of God toward mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: O immaculate Virgin Birth-giver of God: pray unto Thy Son together with the hosts on high, to grant us forgiveness of sins before our end, who faithfully glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: PENITENTIAL CANON.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Composition of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Unto God Who aided Moses in Egypt to deliver Israel: unto Him alone let us chant, for He is glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Having fallen into the deep of perils, I cry aloud unto Thee: stretch forth Thy hand unto me, O compassionate One, and save me as Thou didst Peter, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Wash me who repent, O Christ, as Thou didst the Harlot, from my many transgressions, by the maternal mercy of Thy compassion, that in faith I may glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: O Christ, Who didst enlighten Thy Holy Martyrs to endure manifold torments: by their prayers deliver me from the darkening of passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Being purified by the endurance of torments, the Holy Martyrs shone forth more brightly than the sun, putting the demonic band to shame!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: O all-hymned Virgin, protectress of the faithful and return unto God for those who sin: by Thine intercessions save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Bodiless Powers.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Composition of Theophanes.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos: Unto Him Who shook Pharaoh:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Ineffable Christ, with Thy light illumine my mind, that I may be inspired to hymn Thine Angels, for Thou art almighty!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Possessing steadfast radiance proceeding from the God-originating Fountain, ye heavenly ranks honor Christ with hymns!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Adorned with divine splendors, O pure one, the faithful, knowing Thee to be Mary, cry aloud unto Thee: Rejoice!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: My heart is established in the Lord, my horn is exalted in my God, my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies: I have rejoiced in Thy salvation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Held fast by the night of unmeasured transgressions, illumine me with the light of repentance, O Giver of light and Lover of mankind, that I may glorify Thee, the Good One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Shaking off all the difficult paths of life that cast me down into the abyss of pleasures, O Jesus, show unto me the divine paths of repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Having traversed their struggles with an unburdened spirit, the all-glorious Martyrs were accounted worthy of heavenly rewards, suffering for the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Having endured a multitude of afflictions, O victorious Passion-bearers, ye were accounted worthy of myriads of good things, being joined unto the myriads of bodiless powers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Having alone given birth unto the transcendent King, O Virgin: cast down the sin that dwells within me, and having compassion, save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos: Be established, O Church of Christ:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Being intercessors of divine boldness, ye angelic ranks cry aloud immaterially: Holy art Thou, O Lord, Who hast saved our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: By the law of love dispensing divine illuminations one to another, ye chant harmoniously unto Christ: Holy art Thou, O Lord, Who hast saved our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Emulating the first splendors and secondary lights in godly living, the faithful chant with one accord unto Christ: Holy art Thou, O Lord, Who hast saved our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: God, Who brought all things out of nothingness by His will, borrowed flesh from Thee, O Virgin: the Word becoming man in His compassion, as Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Thy virtue, O Christ God, hath covered the heavens through the dispensation of Thine ineffable wisdom, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
