items.english_text: O Thou Who desirest all men to be saved, O compassionate One: save me who have transgressed Thy commandments, O Word, and despise me not!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: I have subjected myself unto irrational passions and become like the beasts, wretched that I am: O compassionate Son of God, have pity and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Burning with divine fire, ye consumed delusion, inflamed with the zeal of piety, O Martyrs!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Ye appeared as a spiritual paradise, having in your midst the Tree of life, O blessed ones: Christ the Planter of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: As pure and full of divine grace, having bestowed grace upon my mind, completely free me from the darkness of ignorance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos: I heard Thy report:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: O angelic hosts standing before Christ as chosen ministers, entreat Him for the unyielding wounds of my soul!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: The armies of the Bodiless Powers reverently surround Thy throne, O Master, clearly crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: The angelic ranks were astonished, beholding Thee, O Christ, in the flesh upon earth, dwelling among mortal men!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ: хотѣ́нїемъ: ѡ́тебѐ Дв҃о, пло́ть
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: зи, зрѣ́ти свѣ́тъ повелѣ́нїй твои́хъ.
items.english_text: [^285] having ineffably given birth unto God in the flesh: pray Thou unto Him that we may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: возведи́ мѧ Сло́ве, ꙗ́коже и́ног[да]
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Пе́щь горѧ́щꙋю ѡ́роси́лъ есѝ Сп҃се:
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Rising early unto Thy glory and praise, O Christ, we unceasingly hymn the image of Thy Cross, which Thou hast given us as a weapon unto our aid!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: In slothfulness have I spent my life, and I tremble before the unavoidable judgment seat whereon I, the wretched one, must be judged: have pity upon me, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst enlighten the blindness of the blind: open the eyes of my soul that are grievously darkened, to behold the light of Thy commandments!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Confessing Christ with a steadfast mind, ye endured the torment of every affliction, O valiant sufferers: therefore ye are blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Having sailed across the sea of every contradiction of torments, ye reached the harbor of the Kingdom on high, filled with incorruptible peace, O Martyrs!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: God the Word, Who created all things by His will, ineffably took flesh beyond word: earnestly pray unto Him for all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos: Rising early unto Thee:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: With most holy and many-eyed mouths the Seraphim chant unto the supreme, unoriginate, and divine Principle, inflamed with immaterial splendors!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Covering themselves with most holy and all-radiant wings, not daring to gaze upon the Divine Splendor, the Cherubim spread forth the dwellings of the transcendent Godhead!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: With divine understanding, the glorious Thrones, enjoying the fairest radiances, are shown forth exceedingly as beholders of ineffable things!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: The transcendent Mind was united unto human nature, O all-pure one, in Thine immaculate and all-pure womb, united unconfusedly and indivisibly according to hypostasis!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Jonah cried aloud from the belly of hades: Lead up my life from corruption! And we cry aloud unto Thee: O almighty Savior, have mercy upon us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: The abyss of transgressions hath encompassed me, and I have sunk into the depth of destruction: lead me up from corruption unto life, O Word, as of old Thou didst Jonah!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: The storm of evil thoughts casts me down; guide me, O compassionate One, unto the harbor of true repentance, preserving my heart in peace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Protected by the shield of truth, the Holy Martyrs turned away the deceitful flatteries of tyrants, and were unwounded by the barbs of the enemy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Exalted by love toward God, hating the love of the world, the Martyrs appeared as friends unto the Creator of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: We hymn Thee, O all-pure Maiden, who didst bear the all-hymned Word, Whom all the heavenly hosts praise with unceasing voices!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Same Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Youthfully shining with splendors in the palace of the Lord, and chanting His ineffable glory, the Dominions ever appear!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Longingly gazing upon the might of the supreme Power, the Divine Powers abide in strength, visibly prevailing!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Having sprung from a royal tribe, O Virgin, Thou didst bear beyond nature and word the King of all, and didst truly remain a Virgin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Thou didst bedew the burning furnace, O Savior, and didst save the Children who sang and said: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Offer unto God the sacrifice of praise, O my soul! Hasten and repent while the festival of life endures, and the market of good works is open!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: The mortal cutting-down draws near, O my soul: bring forth worthy fruits, lest like an unfruitful tree thou be cast into the fire of Gehenna, and weep without avail!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Having extinguished the furnace of delusion with streams of blood, the Holy Martyrs cried aloud as the Children: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Ye were shown to be sons of light, O Martyrs, shining with fair light, and ye enlightened all that were in darkness, driving away the mist of delusion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: The unburned Bush prefigured Thee, O pure one, for Thou didst bear uncontainable Fire, O Virgin: therefore I cry unto Thee: consume my material passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Unswervingly blessing, surrounding Thy throne in spiritual choirs, the angelic ranks cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: The Princely Principalities earnestly encompass the one Principle immaterially encompassing Him with unceasing hymns, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: One Person in two natures, O Birth-giver of God, didst Thou seedlessly bear: Christ, the only Lover of mankind, Who accomplishes a fearful dispensation: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Being made like unto the Children in the furnace, having received the dew of the Spirit, let us cry aloud in faith: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; hymn and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: I received the Word as a shining lamp, but I, the wretched one, inclined unto irrational passions, and ever walked in evil darkness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: The judgment is near, as we know: make haste, O my soul, and despond not! Watch and cry aloud with vigilance: O compassionate Lover of mankind, save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Inflamed with the divine flame, ye endured bitter suffering, and now ye enjoy the divine rewards of the Word, O Martyrs!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Ye ascended unto the divine rest, having obtained the good things of piety, O all-praised Martyrs: therefore we worthily call you blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Human nature was loosed from the curse by Thy childbearing, O Virgin, for Thou didst give birth unto the All-blessed One Who blessedly adorns all unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еди́наго безнача́льнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы,
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos: The only unoriginate King of glory:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ти Ха̀, благословя́щихъ въвѣки вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Him Whom the heavenly hosts praise, and before Whom the ranks of Angels tremble: Praise Him[^286] ye priests, and supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ ПОНЕДѢ́ЛОКЪ ВВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, НА ГДⷭИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: Possessing all desire toward God and enjoying His radiances from on high, O Archangels: earnestly pray that forgiveness of sins may be granted unto us unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стї́хиры покаѧ́нны, гла́, з҃. по́: Дне́сь бди́тъ Ію́да:
items.english_text: O purest Minds, free from every alteration of material passion, O Angels: save all who praise Christ with love, blessing Him unto ages of ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Receiving the unapproachable Light ineffably into Thy womb, O Virgin Birth-giver of God, Thou didst enlighten those held fast in the darkness of life, that they may piously glorify Christ Who ineffably came forth from Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Thee Who art Mother beyond nature and Virgin according to nature, the only blessed one among women: in hymns, we the faithful magnify Thee as the Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Lo, the judgment draws near, and the deeds of condemnation terrify me: I tremble at all things; O righteous Judge, Christ God, condemn me not!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: As the faithful Canaanite woman, I cry unto Thee: Have mercy upon me! And as Thou didst the bowed-down woman of old, make me upright, that I may walk straight in Thy paths, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Having stripped yourselves of the garments of malice, ye adorned yourselves with the clothing of martyrdom, O Passion-bearers, obtaining the garments of all glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: The divine land of the living, Sion the heavenly city, received the holy sufferers as the first-fruits of good things, adorned with the beauty of their struggles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: With the light-giving rays of the Word Who shone forth from Thee O all-pure Virgin, illumine me who walk in the darkness of sins and passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Bodiless Powers].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos: O all-pure one, higher than the heavens:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Enjoying the splendors of the divine outpouring of light, all the angelic choirs unceasingly praise the supremely glorified God, and ever glorify and magnify Him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Unceasingly entreating the Redeemer: O Cherubim and Seraphim, Powers, Authorities, Angels, Archangels, Principalities, Thrones, and Dominions: earnestly pray unto Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: As the Mother having boldness now before Thy Son, O Birth-giver of God: deliver those who hymn Thee with love from grievous transgressions, diseases, and perils, that all we may ever magnify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: As the barren fig tree, cut me not down, O Savior, sinner that I am; but grant me forgiveness for many years, watering my soul with tears of repentance, that I may bring forth the fruit of prayer unto Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Being the Sun of righteousness, illumine the hearts of those who hymn Thee: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Celebrating the memory of Thy Holy Passion-bearers, we chant unto Thee, crying aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Stills the tumult of our life by the prayers of the Birth-giver of God, unto us who cry unto Thee: O Merciful One, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: ON MONDAY:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Beatitudes. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Fair and good...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Fair and good for food was the fruit that brought death upon me; but Christ is the Tree of life, of which eating I die not, but cry aloud with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: As the faithful Canaanite woman, I cry unto Thee from my heart: grant me relief from the sorrows of my heart; have mercy upon me, O Savior, for Thou art good: for my soul is in peril through the great wiles of the enemy, and is ever tempest-tossed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Cherubim and Seraphim and Thrones, Principalities and Powers together, Archangels and the Angelic hosts, Dominions and the councils of all-wise Authorities: all glorify Thee, O Benefactor and Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Raised up toward God, the holy sufferers utterly cast down the wicked arrogances of the enemy and appearing as conquerors, they dwell now in joy in the heavens, shining with incorruptible glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Glory: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Indivisible Trinity in Unity, one natural essence in three Persons: we worship Thee together with the hosts on high: O Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, one Godhead and one Power, one God, consubstantial Trinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Defiled by worldly pleasures, I have fled unto Thee, the immaculate Virgin: deliver my all-immaculate soul from every blemish and transgression, that I may ever call Thee blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: O all-compassionate Master and God: by whatever judgments Thou knowest, grant me to come unto contrite feeling! Grant me to love Thee with all my soul! Grant me to be angry against the deeds of the enemy, and to do Thy will unto salvation! For Thou art our God, Who didst say: Ask, and ye shall receive!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сѣчи́ менѐ, ꙗ́ко непло́дное дре́во,
items.english_text: Satan hath made me his mockery, an object of contempt unto men, a cause of weeping unto the righteous, of lamentation unto the Angels, a defilement unto the air, the earth, and the water: for I have defiled my body, and stained my soul and mind with irrational deeds, and have become an enemy of God! Woe is me, woe is me! O Lord, I have sinned against Thee, I have sinned: forgive me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ле́стїва, изба́ви мѧ̀ раба̀ твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: Accept the prayer offered for me, the unfruitful one, O long-suffering Master, and cut me not down as an unfruitful tree by the mortal cutting that casts into the fire; but be Thou entreated to make me fruitful, granting me time for repentance, as Thou art the Lover of mankind, that I may wash away[^287] O Savior, my many sins!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ся къ Гдⷭу, спасти́ся душа́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Other Stichera to the Holy Forerunner John. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: вый чл҃вколю́бче Гдⷭи, поми́луй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: Living blamelessly in the wilderness: my mind that hath fallen through sins, do Thou renew, O Forerunner!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: спаси́ мѧ Бл҃же, ꙗ́ко чл҃вколю́бецъ.
items.english_text: Knowing Thee as the fairest turtledove, O Forerunner, we glorify Thee: who didst proclaim unto those in the world the divine springtime!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: да́вый, и́з̾ глубинны̀ воздохну́вша:
items.english_text: O divine Forerunner, protector of my life and guardian of my soul: deliver me, Thy servant, from the deceitful tongue of man!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Tempest-tossed by the tumult of slothfulness: guide me unto the tranquil harbor of salvation, O Sovereign Lady!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: As the Prodigal Son I have come, O compassionate One; receive me falling down before Thee, as one of Thy hired servants, O God, and have mercy upon me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: As one falling among thieves and wounded, so have I fallen through many sins, and my soul is wounded: unto whom shall I, the guilty one, flee, save unto Thee, the compassionate Physician of souls? Pour out upon us, O God, Thy great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: O Holy Martyrs, who strove well and received crowns: pray unto the Lord that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Cloud of the spiritual Sun and Sovereign Lady of the earth! Rejoice, O radiant Candlestick! Rejoice all-golden crown of all! Through Thee, O all-pure one, mankind was delivered from the curse: but having boldness before Thy Son and Lord, through Thy maternal prayer preserve us unceasingly, O all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: ON TUESDAY, AT MATINS:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Possessing the medicine of repentance, O my soul, draw near weeping and crying with sighing: O Physician of souls and bodies, Lover of mankind, loose me from my many transgressions, number me with the Harlot, the Thief, and the Publican, and grant me, O God, forgiveness of mine iniquities, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: O Lord and Lover of mankind, Who didst cleanse Peter's denial with tears and didst forgive the sins of the Publican through sighing: have mercy upon me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Birth-giver of God, who didst contain in Thy womb Him Whom the heavens cannot contain! Rejoice, O Virgin, the proclamation of the Prophets, through whom Emmanuel shone forth unto us! Rejoice, O Mother of Christ God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: I have not emulated the repentance of the Publican, nor have I acquired the tears of the Harlot; for I am bewildered by blindness regarding such amendment: but by Thy compassions, O good One, save me, for Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: O Savior, Who didst receive the tears of the Harlot and of Peter, and didst justify the Publican who sighed from the depths: have compassion on me who despond because of my deeds, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Thy Saints, O Lord, having struggled upon earth, trampled down the enemy and abolished the delusion of idols: therefore, having received crowns from Thee, O good Lover of mankind, grant great mercy unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Rejoice, O Birth-giver of God, who didst contain in Thy womb Him Whom the heavens cannot contain! Rejoice, O Virgin, the proclamation of the Prophets, through whom Emmanuel shone forth unto us! Rejoice, O Mother of Christ God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 7.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: As the Harlot I fall down before Thee, O Lover of mankind, though I lack tears of compunction: by the intercessions of Thine all-pure Mother, have mercy through prayer, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: My soul being defiled, O Savior, through the intercession of Thy Mother wash me clean as the Good One: and purifying me from the filth of passions, have mercy upon me, O Master: save Thine own creation through the intercessions of Thine immaculate Mother, O only most merciful One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: A fervent protectress and helper art Thou unto Christians, O all-hymned Birth-giver of God: therefore, together with the Forerunner, pray Thou unto Thy Son that we may find mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: PENITENTIAL CANON.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Composition of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Unto Him Who shattered wars with a high arm, and drowned the captains and chariot-riders: let us chant unto Him, as our Deliverer and God, for He is glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: All the day have I sinned, and I feared Thee not, O Christ, Who hast long-suffering toward my repentance: grant me the thought of turning back, as Thou art good, and despise me not!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Adding sin unto sins, O Christ, I, the wretched one, can in no wise cease: O only Good and Sinless One, have pity and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: The valiant sufferers boldly cried aloud: Lo, the stadium is full of struggles; let us run, that Christ the Judge of contests may crown us with the wreath of conquerors over the enemy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Having adorned the brightness of your bodies with manifold wounds, ye clothed yourselves with the robe of incorruption, O Martyrs of Christ, becoming sons of compassion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Heal my soul that is afflicted with many sins, O Virgin Birth-giver of God, that with voices of thanksgiving I may earnestly and ever glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Forerunner John.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Composition of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos: By Thy nod upon the earth:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: оу́щедрѝ Сп҃се, и спаси́ мѧ. Мч҃нчнъ:
items.english_text: Adorned as the beauty of the Church, Thou didst appear, O blessed Forerunner: by Thy prayers ever save from all peril of heresies, O steadfast and unshakable one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: зо́лъ мои́: да́ти сла́влю, пребл҃га́го.
items.english_text: As an immaculate, holy sacrifice didst Thou offer Thyself unto the Creator, being slain, O divine Forerunner, as a gentle lamb[^288] therefore in faith I cry unto Thee: deliver me from all malice of the enemy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Heal our bodily and spiritual diseases, O all-blessed Forerunner, ever praying unto the Word, Who compassionately took upon Himself the infirmities and diseases of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: O Most Holy one, who didst bear the Incomprehensible Word: entreat Him in the flesh, as Lord, to save those who ever faithfully bless Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst establish the heavens by Thy Word, and strengthen the foundations of the earth upon many waters: establish my mind in Thy will, O only Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: O Thou Who overlookest the sins of men according to Thine abundant love for mankind, O Christ: do Thou alone, O Savior, overlook the multitude of mine evils, that I may glorify Thee, the supremely Good One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: That I might fulfill the desires of the flesh, I, possessing an insensible conscience, neglected Thy will, O Christ: deliver me, O Word, from the flaming torment thereof!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Partaking of bodily sufferings, the holy sufferers never looked down upon this sorrowful life: which they turned into joy, ever lightening the afflictions of the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: With the rays of your sufferings, O God-bearing ones, ye dissolved the grievous night of delusion, and passed over unto the unwaning light, ever taking away the darkness of our diseases!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: The Prophet foresaw Thee as the Gate of God, through which He alone passed as He knew, O all-pure Virgin: therefore open Thou unto me the gates of repentance through prayer!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Forerunner.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos: Those who assault us:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: With sun-like splendors Thou dost enlighten all creation, for Thou wast shown forth as the star of the spiritual Luminary, O Forerunner: earnestly pray unto Him to drive away the darkness of passions from our sorrowful hearts!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Standing between the Law and Grace, O divine Forerunner, Thou didst clearly show forth unto all: that the one should cease, and the other blossom forth, granting complete renewal of transgressions unto those who find it!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Deliver us, we cry aloud, O Baptist of Christ, from the wrathful assault of worldly temptations and from every sorrow: pray unto the Supremely Good One, and free us from future torment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: O God-like one, who ineffably didst bear God: together with His divine Baptist, unceasingly pray, O Sovereign Lady, for us who fall into the temptations of life and are held fast by sins!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Perceiving Thy bodily coming, O Christ, the Prophet Habakkuk cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: I have strayed from the path that leads unto life, and have fallen into the evil pit: O Savior, despise me not!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Send down streams of tears unto me, O Word of God, that I may wash away the filth of my many transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Led as lambs unto the slaughter, the Martyrs slew the tyrant enemy, being accounted worthy of glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: The streams of blood poured forth, O all-praised and divine Martyrs, prepared for you streams of delight!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: The Lord became incarnate of Thy pure blood, granting repentance unto mortals through Thine intercession, O Maiden!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Forerunner.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Without leaving the Father's bosom and having descended...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Having cast down the hosts of the enemy and valiantly shone forth, pray, O Baptist, that by Thy prayers the sin reigning within me may be cast down!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Thou didst appear as a spiritual lamp, O blessed one, showing forth upon earth Jesus, the great Sun of righteousness, by Whom the hearts of all are illumined!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: In iniquities was I conceived and born, awaiting the outer darkness and the end of torments there: have mercy upon me and rescue me, O Baptist, having entreated God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Having washed my prayers clean, present them now unto God, O Baptist, for me who honor Thee, that He may deliver all of us from every grievous circumstance and demonic harm!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: The shadows of the Law in manifold ways showed Thee forth as the one who was to bear God: Whom do Thou entreat, O all-immaculate one, to deliver me from every lawlessness and bodily passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Having driven away the dark night of passions, O Spiritual Light Who didst drive away the primal darkness from the abyss, and didst establish the first-created light for the world: O Creator of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Spare me, O Word, from Thy righteous wrath when Thou judgest the earth and having cleansed me through repentance from my many sins, show me forth as a temple of Thy goodness, O only Creator of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: With the grievous mist of passions have I blinded my mind, and with a troubled heart I know not what I do: turn me back, O Christ, and grant me repentance that cleanses all defilement!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Having youthfully run the course that was full of sweat, O holy sufferers, ye reached the unwaning splendor, having received the prize of victory from the life-originating Hand: therefore ye now rejoice!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: By the strong sinews of your sacred sufferings, O holy sufferers, ye truly strangled the prince of the malicious serpent, and were accounted worthy of heavenly food: therefore we praise you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: O radiant Cloud of the Sun, kindle within me the spiritual light of true repentance, and drive away the darkness of wicked thoughts, that in faith I may hymn Thee as the salvation of the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Forerunner.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos: The Lord our God:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Thou didst foresee the voice of him that cries in the wilderness, O all-wise one, preaching the knowledge of God: therefore I pray Thee, renew my soul that is made desolate by all manner of transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Having been shown forth as a radiant vessel, O divine Forerunner: by Thy prayers deliver me from dishonorable deeds, and entreat the Benefactor that I may obtain eternal honor!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Iniquities have drawn near unto us in the departure of slothfulness: establish me in the ways of repentance, O blessed Forerunner, that I may earnestly walk in the ways of the Lord, chanting unto Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: показа́ есѝ, Іс҃а вели́кое Со́лнце:
items.english_text: Put to death the earthly mind of my flesh...[^289]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Процвѣ́лъ є҆сѝ ѿпꙋ́стинца бл҃же́нн[е]
items.english_text: ...mind of the flesh, O Birth-giver of God, who didst bear the Life: by death having washed away death by divine power, O all-immaculate and pure one, destroying it!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ́хꙋ, и҆ бл҃гословля́хꙋ, гл҃юще: блгⷭо-
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слове́нъ є҆сѝ Бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́ши[хъ].
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: мч҃нцы, мїровнꙋ оу҆мертви́сте пре́лесть:
items.english_text: Into the deep of transgressions have I fallen, O Master; as Jonah from the whale, I cry unto Thee: Lead my life up from corruption, and save me, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: растерза́нїете пре́лестный оу҆зы: и҆
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ти сѧ бл҃женне: є҆з̾го́стри́вста є҆з̾ днꙋ̀,
items.english_text: A new prodigal have I appeared, having lived defiledly upon earth, and I have bowed down unto gluttonous passions: turn me back, O Christ my God, and save me, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Моле́бъ принеси́ блаже́нне, и҆́же на
items.english_text: Cry aloud, O my soul, that thou mayest be delivered from weeping and groaning: so that thou receivest not there unceasing tears in vain, in pain and torment having no profit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вся̑ вѣ́к[и].
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: да́ждь мѝ ѡ҆чище́нїе согрѣше́нї[й].
items.english_text: Fixed like precious stones set in the crowns of Christ's Church, ye were a beauteous adornment unto her, O venerable Great Martyrs!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Е҆гда́ болѣ́знь мꙋ́къ до́блїи копіѧ́хꙋ
items.english_text: Accounted worthy of an end worthy of God, O most wise ones, ye inherit boundless rewards of honey: therefore pray, O Martyrs, that our ends also may be in repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Инъ, І҆рмо́съ: Е҆ди́наго безнача́л[наго]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: From the deep of slothfulness and immeasurable evils lead me up, O good one, who didst bear the abyss of compassions; and grant unto me a fountain of tears continually, O Virgin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Forerunner].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos: Jonah cried from the belly of hades:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Having shone forth like the beams of virtues and through radiant martyrdom, O holy one, thou dost enlighten all creation with the spiritual Orient, blessed and noble one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Thou didst blossom forth from a barren mother, O blessed one therefore I cry unto thee: me who am grown old through many sins, renew by the beauties of repentance through thy prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: O lamp of the unwaning Light, divine Forerunner: kindle the extinguished lamp of my soul by thy prayers, and make me a partaker of the divine Light!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: As rain upon the fleece the Word came down into thy womb, Whom do thou entreat, O all-pure Virgin, by thy prayers to dry up the streams of my boundless evils!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: The Young Men in the furnace were untouched and unharmed by the fire; then the three, as with one mouth, sang and blessed, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Into shameful dishonor have I fallen, O Savior, likened unto brute beasts; and being darkened, I see not: O Word, Who art long-suffering in waiting for me, grant me time for conversion, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: In slothfulness have I finished my life, doing deeds that are unlawful to do; and lo, now I have drawn near unto the gates of hades, having no sense of feeling: despise me not, O Christ, Who alone art good!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Desiring eternal life, O Martyrs, ye put to death worldly deceit; and having utterly slain the enemy, ye took flight unto the heavens, ever praying for us, O sufferers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: By the tearing of your flesh ye loosed that bodily constraint of deceptive bonds; and bound in soul by the strong love of Christ, O Martyrs, ye proclaimed Him Who appeared in the flesh and destroyed corruption!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: The Prophet foresaw Thee as a new scroll, wherein the Father's Word was written; therefore, O pure one, I pray Thee: account me worthy to be written in the Book of the Living, tearing up the handwriting of my many evils!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Forerunner].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Grant me showers of tears, I pray thee, O blessed one, having sharpened my sorrow; thou who didst wash away the mud of the abyss with river streams, O Forerunner: cleanse me entirely from the defilement of flesh and spirit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Offer supplication, O blessed one, unto our God Who is over all: that He may have mercy also upon me, as He is compassionate, who have sinned much, and have no means of rising up!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: O barren soul, make haste to repent: lest the divine judgment suddenly cut thee down like a barren fig tree! Cry aloud unto God: O God, have compassion upon me, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Having acquired a deadened soul through grievous, wicked transgressions: unto Thee, who by thy childbearing didst put hades to death, I pray, O Good One: make me alive by the ways of repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Him Who is unceasingly praised by the Angels and glorified as God: let the heavens of heavens, the earth, the mountains, the hills, and the abyss, and all the human race: bless and praise Him continually in hymns as Creator and Redeemer, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Having excessively and mindlessly delighted in harmful pleasures, senseless as I am, I have surpassed every sinner: O Thou Who hast an abundance of loving-kindness, grant me cleansing of my transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Now the Bridegroom is at the doors: adorn thy lamps, O soul, fueling them with the oil of mercy and with all good works, before the doors are shut: make haste to enter with Christ into ineffable joy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: When the valiant sufferers endured the pain of torments, they cried: "Lo, the acceptable time! Let us all stand with a steadfast mind; by small pains let us acquire a life free from sickness and food that never grows old!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Watered abundantly with divine waters, O passion-bearers of the Savior, ye water the earth with the imitation of your struggles, and make it fruitful in virtues unto the ages in Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: O Birth-giver of God, sure protectress and hope of Christians: in the dreadful day stand by me who have sinned greatly, and deliver me from the dreadful Gehenna, numbering me with the sheep on the right hand!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Forerunner].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos: Unto the only Beginningless King of glory:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: To be loosed from the bonds of many sins, pray, O Forerunner, unto the only Redeemer, Who was bound and granted release unto the bound, that I may unceasingly glorify thee unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: I have drawn near, O Forerunner, unto the weapon of pleasures, and in pain of heart I cry aloud: heal the sickness of my soul, having entreated Christ, the only Physician of souls and bodies!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїемъ: и҆ въ боле́зни срⷣца попѣ́[ти]
items.english_text: As thou art the Forerunner of the Word Whom thou didst baptize, unceasingly pray without ceasing, to deliver me from the river of sin, who have sinned much...[^290]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ погребо́хъ въ землѝ є҆з̾ли́вно,
items.english_text: ...greatly, and am humble and condemned.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тала́нтъ и҆́же мѝ ѿ Бг҃а оу҆вѣ́ренъ
items.english_text: As I have excessively buried in the earth the talent entrusted unto me by God, I await bitter torment: from which snatch me away, O Baptist, by thy prayers, as I faithfully beseech thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: предстоѧ́щихъ сла́вы, и҆ съ а҆́гг҃лы
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: О҆блече́ся въ мѧ̀ Гдⷭь, не́теже про́йде
items.english_text: Thou didst remain unburnt, O Virgin, having received the incomprehensible Fire in thy womb: therefore snatch me away from the unquenchable fire, dewing me now with beauteous forms of genuine repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ птѝ бж҃едѣ́йша къ сп҃се́нїа хо-
items.english_text: Penitential Canon.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ ро́дъ чл҃вческїи:
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гн҃и, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши во црⷭтвїи сѝ.
items.english_text: Who among the earthborn can declare the conception of the seedless birth? Who among men marvels not at the birthgiving of the incorruptible birth? Therefore all we, the earthly generations, magnify thee, O Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ ВТО́РОКЪ, ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, НА ГДⷭИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи̑ры крⷭтны, Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Не ктомꙋ̀ возбраня́емни:
items.english_text: Let us weep, let us groan, let us entreat Christ while we, the faithful, yet have time for repentance and supplication, that the enduring good things may overtake us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Дре́во и҆згна̀ мѧ дре́вле и҆з̾ Ра́ѧ:
items.english_text: Like the Canaanite woman I cry unto Thee: Have mercy upon me, O Christ! As of old Thou didst heal the bowed-down woman, make me upright, O Lord; and save me, O Savior, who am submerged in sins!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Constrained by afflictions, prisons, and torments, the passion-bearing Martyrs passed into the broad expanse of rest, delivering us from transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: The earth indeed hath now covered your bodies, but heaven holds your holy spirits, acceptably standing before the throne of glory and rejoicing with the Angels!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: The Lord clothed Himself with me, having passed through Thee, O all-pure one; do Thou therefore entreat Him, O Virgin, to enlighten me with a radiant garment, having stripped me of the grievous sackcloth of passions the most burdensome.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Forerunner].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos: O Master and Lover of mankind:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Thou didst bud forth from a holy root, having been born through the necessity of barrenness, O holy Forerunner; and thou didst uproot all evil roots, thereby enabling me to bring forth fruits of divine repentance, delivering me from the snares of vanity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: The Church knows thee, O great Forerunner, as the fairest and sweet turtledove; for thou didst proclaim the hymn of repentance unto souls that were desolate and frozen in evils: therefore in faith we ever call thee blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Thou didst show forth unto all the divine paths that lead unto salvation, O glorious Forerunner: strengthen me to walk therein, who am wandering in all the pathless ways of life, and through delusion have committed deceit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: The dreadful day at the doors hath drawn near, and having deeds worthy of condemnation, I weep aloud: O Lord, O Lord, Who alone art merciful, by the prayers of Thy Forerunner and of all the Saints, show me then uncondemned!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: O Maiden full of God's grace, who didst bear the Divine Light: enlighten my soul, I pray, which is darkened by transgressions, and show me free from eternal darkness, that I may ever magnify and glorify thee, the blessed one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Penitential. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Like the barren fig tree, cut me not down, O Savior, sinful as I am; but grant me patience for many years, watering my soul with the tears of repentance, that I may bring forth unto Thee the fruit of almsgiving!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: As Thou art the righteous Sun: enlighten the hearts of them that praise Thee; O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: In the midst of the tribunal of the lawless, Thy passion-bearers rejoiced, crying: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: O Christ, Thou Light that didst sprout from the Virgin and hast enlightened the human race: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: On Tuesday,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Beatitudes. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Beautiful was that fruit and good for food which put me to death; but Christ is the Tree of Life, whereof eating I die not, but cry aloud with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Heal the incurable wounds of my heart, O compassionate Lord, as Thou art the Physician of souls and bodies; and always prosper my walking uprightly in the paths of salvation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
