items.english_text: O Baptist of Christ, forerunner unto the righteous Sun: kindle the lamp of my soul that is extinguished by many evils, through thy divine prayers, that being saved, I may ever call thee blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Having suffered and been crowned, ye put the enemy to shame, O most wise Martyrs; and now ye dwell in the heavens, filled with unceasing light, praying for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Glory: Triadikon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Turn back my soul from long-standing passions, O Divine Trinity, granting me good confession and eternal life for the sake of Thy Forerunner, that I may magnify Thine immeasurable mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: In thy corruptible womb thou didst contain Him Whom nothing can contain; Him do thou ever entreat, O pure Mother, to deliver thy servants, who in love glorify thee, from every distress and assault of passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Of old the tree cast me out of Paradise; but now the Tree of the Cross hath led me back, when Thou wast crucified, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: A fearful wonder! How the Creator of creation, the throne of the Creator, is condemned and crucified for the salvation of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: The Cross of Christ is a wonder unto holy Angels, but unto the devil and demons a great plague: save Thy servants!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Beholding the Lamb stretched upon the Tree...[^291]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: неразꙋ́мны Є҆вре́йскїа, всѣ́хъ Гн҃а.
items.english_text: ...the spotless Ewe-lamb and Virgin, between two thieves, cried aloud: "Woe is me, my sweetest Child! What is this strange and most glorious mystery? How hath the lawless council lifted Thee up upon the Cross, and given gall to drink unto Him Who satisfied men with manna?"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́нꙋ тѧ̀ всепѣ́таѧ Влⷣчце, по ро-
items.english_text: When the Virgin and Thy Mother beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O my Christ, by the judgment of the lawless, by the Jews in the Place of the Skull, she cried aloud: "Woe is me, my most beloved Son! What is this strange sight? How do the senseless children of the Hebrews nail Thee upon the Cross, Who art the Lord of all?"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Влⷣчце всепѣ́таѧ, Дв҃о ро́ждша Гн҃а,
items.english_text: Thee alone, O all-hymned Sovereign Lady, did we know as Virgin after childbearing, and seeing Him Whom thou didst bear without seed willingly nailing His hands upon the Tree, the all-pure one weeping cried aloud: "Willingly, O Long-suffering One, Thou diest, delivering from death all them that praise Thee!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Е҆гда̀ за́лщи тѧ̀ Гн҃и, Дв҃аѧ распи-
items.english_text: O all-hymned Sovereign Lady, Virgin who didst bear the Lord, Who for compassion's sake was nailed upon the Cross and poured forth streams of life unto the world: do thou entreat Him that our souls may be saved; for thee alone have we, the faithful, as refuge, rampart, and protection: therefore do we flee unto thy protection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же на́съ ра́днь поно́сное прїе́мый
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: стрⷭти твоѧ, Хе Бже: и҆ сп҃си на[съ].
items.english_text: to the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се: и҆ ѿ него́ дре́вле оу҆ѧзвле́ныѧ
items.english_text: No longer are we forbidden from the Tree of Life, having the hope of Thy Cross: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Having been hanged upon the Tree, O Immortal One, Thou didst break the snares of the devil: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: O holy Martyrs, who also courageously preached Christ at the tribunal: ye received from Him the reward for your torments; but as ye have boldness, entreat Him as Almighty God to save our souls, who flee unto you, we pray you, O glorious ones!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Beholding of old thine own Son upon the Tree, O all-pure one, a sword of sorrow pierced thy heart!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: ON WEDNESDAY, AT MATINS.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: of the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Jacob cries aloud unto Thee, O Christ God, worshipping Thee through the pine, the cedar, and the cypress: grant victories unto our hierarchs, O Compassionate One, and have mercy upon us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Thou Who for my sake didst endure being nailed upon the Cross: accept also my vigilant praise, O Christ God, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Unceasingly pray, O Virgin Birth-giver of God, unto Christ our King Who was crucified for our sake and hath cast down the dominion of death, that He may save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: of the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: A fire brighter and more efficacious than flame hast Thou shown forth the Tree of Thy Cross to be, consuming the sins of men and enlightening the hearts of them that praise Thy voluntary crucifixion: O Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: O Thou Who rulest over the bodiless hosts: heal the blindness of my soul, and by Thy Cross save me, O Christ, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Rejoice, ye righteous! Let the heavens be glad! For the Martyrs, having contended upon earth, trampled down the enemies; let the joyful company of men celebrate, unto the only Umpire of the contest and Wonder-working God, Who grants great mercy unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: When the Virgin beheld Thee crucified, O Lord, weeping she cried aloud unto Thee: "I hymn Thine ineffable long-suffering, O my Son, and Thy supreme and divine descent unto mankind!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-

items.english_text: The Master, enduring crucifixion and reproach, bears the reproaches of men, as He is the Lover of mankind!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Bending Thy Cross like a bow, O Merciful One, Thou didst wound the adversary with the arrows of nails, O Savior, and didst heal mortals who of old were wounded by him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: By the blood of the saints, the abominable pollutions of blood offered unto idols ceased, and all the earth was cleansed, delighting them with praises!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: The heavenly powers sang praise, beholding the earthly martyrs lifted up and holding hands with the bodiless; therefore the Umpire of the contest crowned the victors!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: The handwriting of Adam was torn asunder, cried the all-pure Ewe-lamb, when Thy side was pierced with a spear, O Son; therefore I praise Thy suffering which hath poured forth dispassion unto all!

items.section:

items.section:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Loving to praise thy greatness, O Birth-giver of God, save thy people and deliver them from harm; for thou art our protectress, pure guide, and confirmation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Having brought forth the Water of Immortality, O Virgin, grant us waters of healing, washing away all death-bearing passions from our souls and bodies!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ кътѐ сѐи пре-
items.english_text: Thou wast shown forth as the joyful dwelling-place, O Birth-giver of God full of God's grace, of Him Who honored the nature of our forefather: therefore, O pure one, we pray thee: deliver us from every dishonor of passions...[^292]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Тебѐ те́рпїемъ, Чр҃вь лю́дїе законо-
items.english_text: ...passions which assail us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же, сїе́нїа, и҆ оу҆до́въ ѡ҆сѣче́нїа:
items.english_text: Having given birth unto the Sun of Righteousness for the world, O Maiden, Who hast enlightened all that are in darkness: in thy light-bearing and holy temple, O all-immaculate one!

items.section:

items.english_text: Canon of the Cross.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: За́кре́и оу҆стремле́нї, кре́пїа ѻ҆гн
items.english_text: Thou Who in the beginning established the heavens by Thy Word, O Lord and Savior, and by the all-effective and Divine Spirit all their power was made firm: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: When Thou wast stretched upon the Tree, O Jesus, Thou didst heal the incontinence of Adam's hands, as Thou art merciful; and from the hand of the deceiver Thou didst snatch away all that were in delusion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: The lawless people crowned Thee with thorns, O Christ, Who hast crowned the earth with flowers; taking away the thorn of Adam's ancient disobedience, and granting us the knowledge of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Through the nature of mortal men, ye put death to death, O most wise Martyrs: therefore having died unto bodily wounds and torments, ye rejoice, enduring all things!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: With a steadfast mind, having overcome the hostile prince of evil, O valiant sufferers, ye were magnified in Christ, and were exalted by the divine right hand to live with Him forever!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: When the Ewe-lamb and Mother beheld the Lamb Who came willingly unto the slaughter, weeping she cried aloud: "What is this strange wonder? How diest Thou, O Blessed One, Who hast willed to make alive all them that are dead?"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Ode 3. Same Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Grant forgiveness unto Thy servants, O pure one in this holy temple, wherein thou hast shown a fountain of wonders to flow continually: delivering us from eternal torment by thy divine mediation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Having given birth, O pure one, unto Christ the abyss of grace, Who is beyond cause and word, the Giver of all good things: by thy divine visitation heal the wounds of my soul from great passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O Virgin, who didst bear joy unto all the world, and didst in truth contain the Lover of mankind: destroy the sorrow of my sins, O Virgin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: O spiritual Ark, who didst truly bear the Manna that cannot be consumed: come into our midst, and from every defilement deliver them that honor thee, magnifying thee, O all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Without leaving the Father's bosom, Thou didst come down to earth, O Christ God; I have heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I have glorified Thee, Who alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: By the shedding of Thy blood, O Jesus, Thou didst redeem mankind, suffering for the unjust, O Long-suffering One: we chant unto Thy supreme loving-kindness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: By the fierce burning of fire, and by the cutting-off of hands and feet, and by many torments, the Martyrs endured, interceding for us unto the divine enjoyment of the end of bodily struggles, crying aloud unto the God of all: their voices were heard, and they were accounted worthy of divine perfection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: I pray thee, who didst bear the Incarnate One: make me, who am poor and in need of help, a temple of the Holy Spirit, O Birth-giver of God; that I may find help in the time of judgment, through the mediation of Him Who was born of thee, glorifying thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos: Habakkuk foresaw the mountain:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: O pure Birth-giver of God, adorned with the beauty of virtues, O Sovereign Lady, put out the fire of primal evil, which hath kindled within me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Accept the supplication of Thy servants, O pure one, who didst bring forth Christ: save from every harm them that are redeemed by His blood, as we praise thee as is meet!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Thy grace is exceedingly praised, O Maiden full of God's grace; for it heals the sickness of souls and bodies, and cleanses defilement, as we faithfully glorify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: By thy visitation, O Virgin, save us from temptations and afflictions, and by thy holy prayers, deliver us who love thee from all evil, granting us life and forgiveness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: O Lord my God, from the night I awake early unto Thee, I pray Thee: grant me remission of my transgressions, and direct my path unto the commandments of Thy precepts!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: When Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, O Word of God, Thou didst receive gall tasting it, Thou didst destroy the bitterness of the ancient food: Glory to Thy great mercy, O Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: When Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, the whole earth was shaken, O Christ, by Thy divine power; and the shaken souls of men Thou didst establish in the knowledge of Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: The valiant Martyrs spread their limbs upon wheels: but they were not broken from Christ; for through fire and water they attained unto the heavenly mansions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Tormented with unsparing tortures, the passion-bearers endured: as if others were suffering, they sang: "Unto Thee, O Savior, we offer our struggles!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: With what eyes shall I look upon Thee, O Eye that seest all, when Thou art lifted up upon the Cross, cried the Virgin, weeping and lamenting within herself!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos: Having driven away the dark night:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Deliver me, O pure one, from the heavy slumber of sin, who wake early in thy holy temple, praising thee, O all-immaculate one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Extend thy hand unto all of us, O pure one, who flee unto thee: deliver us from the darkness of all evil defilement, and heal our diseases by thy prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, сла́достнаго бра́шн[а]
items.english_text: Having conceived God in thy virgin womb, O Birth-giver of God, and given birth unto Him, O pure one: deliver from eternal condemnation them that praise thee, who with faith enter into thy temple...[^293]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Роди́телю приведѐ: оу҆би́й Крⷭто́мъ
items.english_text: ...who walk therein: renewing our soul that is grown old through sin: and as is meet we praise thee, O all-immaculate one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ю́но ѻ҆троча̀ ражда́еши, и҆́же пре́де
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́звы дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ, Бц҃е оу҆чи́сти,
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: родила̀ є҆сѝ, и҆ те́плою бц҃е моли́-
items.english_text: Floating on the sea of life, and tossed by the tempest of passions, I run to Thy calm haven, O Christ: lead my life up from corruption, O most merciful One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Кро́въ и҆ вода̀ и҆сте́кшаѧ и҆зре́бръ
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: і҆долскїи преста́ша. Всѧ̀ дѣла̀ Гн҃а
items.english_text: Through ancient lack of restraint, I fell into bitter falling, O Christ; but when Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, Thou didst stretch out Thy hands, O Savior, and didst heal my wounds: glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́наго безнача́лнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы:
items.english_text: By the sleep of delusion the enemy put the first-created to sleep; but when Thou wast put to sleep upon the Cross, O Word of God, Thou didst awaken all from the sleep of death!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Established upon the rock of Christ's commandments, the venerable Martyrs were unshaken by the assaults of torment: therefore having run the course, they were crowned by the divine hand!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Thou didst bear the Child, Who before was bodiless, O Maiden; Who by the Cross renewed the nature of mortals that was grown old through sin: therefore we praise thee, O all-immaculate one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos: Jonah cried from the belly of hades:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Remember us, O Savior, who call upon Thee Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind, who didst deliver our race from delusion; by the prayers of the all-pure one, and through Thy Cross, grant us freedom from passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Cleanse the sores of our souls, O Birth-giver of God, by the sprinkling of thy compassion, and heal bodily illnesses, that we may glorify thee, the good protectress!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Having broken the bond of ancient Eve, O Maiden, by thy divine childbearing: loose the bonds of our transgressions, who faithfully run unto thy shelter!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: The Children in the furnace were untouched and unharmed by the fire; then the three, as with one mouth, sang and blessed, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Delivered from the curse of the Law, the Lawgiver was lifted up upon the Cross, bringing forth blessing and mercy, and the fountain of incorruption unto them that praise Him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Cast into the burning fire by the decree of the lawless, the holy Martyrs extinguished the flame by the dew of the Spirit, and sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Having offered their bodies unto various torments, the Martyrs poured forth streams of blood, and through their struggles put down the arrogance of the adversary!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: How dost Thou endure crucifixion, O Child, cried the all-pure Virgin; I behold Thee hanging upon the Tree, Who didst establish the earth upon the waters O Child, beholding Thee, how can I not weep, seeing Thee suffer unjustly, Who hast crowned creation with beauty!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Ode 7. Same Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: O Fire Who didst bear the Divine Fire, consume the thorns of my passions, and by the light of repentance illumine my soul, as I faithfully call thee blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Having delivered the three Children from the furnace, O pure one, show me to be a temple of the Divine Spirit, who am consumed by the fire of sins, as I faithfully hymn thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Having brought forth the Wellspring of healing unto the world, heal the incurable wounds of my soul, O Virgin, and quench the burning furnace of passions by thy prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: The unconsumed fire on Sinai showed forth the virginity of the Mother of God; and now the Cross of the Savior hath renewed the world: let all works praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Crowned with thorns, O Savior, Thou didst pull up the thorns of the ancient curse; and tasting vinegar and gall, Thou didst sweeten our bitterness: let all works praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: The Martyrs, rich in the treasures of truth, accounted worldly poverty as nothing, and through their blood enriched the Church, crying: Let all works praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Thrown into the fiery furnace by the lawless decree, the holy Martyrs were preserved by the dew of God, and sang: Let all works praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: The rod of Aaron prefigured Thee, O pure Virgin, who without seed didst bud forth Christ the Lawgiver: Whom the lawless people nailed upon the Cross: let all works praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Ode 8. Same Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Unto the only beginningless King of glory, Whom the heavenly hosts praise and before Whom the ranks of Angels tremble: praise Him, ye priests, and supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: Having brought forth the rich Fountain of dispassion, O Virgin, dry up the torrent of our passions, and grant streams of tears unto us who faithfully honor thee as the Mother of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: O radiant Sun of Righteousness, Who didst shine forth from the Virgin: illumine them that are in darkness, and make them sons of light, who faithfully praise Thee, O Christ, unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стинно сл҃нце пра́ведное возсїѧ̀,
items.english_text: We who are assembled in thy holy temple, O Virgin, praise thee as the Mother of God...[^294]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ню́доже и҆ и҆́же сїѐ прⷭно соверша́ю-
items.english_text: ...and bless Him Who was born of thee unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: свѣ́тъ: и҆ въ вѣ́рныхъ и҆сполне́нїа,
items.english_text: In the light of thy childbearing, O Birth-giver of God, the world was enlightened; for thou didst bear the true God, Who enlightened all by His Cross: let all works praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: а҆́гг҃лы земны́и оу҆блажа́е, ꙗ҆́коже
items.english_text: Canon of the Cross.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ сы́нъ чл҃вколю́бче жизнода́вче,
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Распросте́рлъ є҆сѝ на Крⷭтѣ дла́н[и]:
items.english_text: A Mother of God and Virgin, giving birth and remaining a virgin, is not a work of nature, but the condescension of God: therefore as the only Mother of divine gifts, we magnify thee, O pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ченницы прехва́льныи: претерпѣ́сте мꙋ́ки многоѡбра́зныѧ: и҆
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ СРЕ́Дꙋ, ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, НА ГДⷭИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: The enemy's power was broken, O Savior, when Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross; and through Thy death Thou didst slay the deceiver, raising up Adam who was fallen: glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи̑ры ст҃ы́хъ А҆пⷭлъ, Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Не ктомꙋ̀ возбра[ня́емни]:
items.english_text: Like a lamb, Thou wast led willingly unto the slaughter, O Savior, and didst stretch out Thy hands upon the Cross: gathering the scattered sheep into the fold of Thy commandments!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Imitating the passions of Christ, the glorious Martyrs endured diverse torments: therefore having received crowns of glory, they were accounted worthy of Thy Kingdom, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: The assemblies of the faithful praise the memories of the Martyrs; who by their blood adorned the Church of Christ: therefore we celebrate their venerable memory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Beholding Thee hanging upon the Tree, O my Son, cried the Virgin, my heart is wounded with sorrow: but rising on the third day, as God, raise up Adam who was fallen!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Ode 9. Same Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Higher than the heavens art thou shown forth, O pure Virgin, having brought forth the Creator of all: therefore with the Angels we unceasingly magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: As the radiant mountain of God, the Prophet foresaw thee of old, O Virgin; from whence Christ came forth, enlightening the ends of the earth: therefore we call thee blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Thou didst appear as the golden jar, containing the heavenly Manna, Christ the Giver of Life: therefore we faithfully praise thee, O Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: A glorious tabernacle and holy dwelling-place of God didst thou appear, O Maiden; therefore deliver me from the defilement of sins, that I may magnify thee with pure lips!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: O Virgin who didst bear the unwaning Light: deliver me from eternal darkness, and enlighten my darkened soul, that in love I may hymn thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: to the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Having redeemed the world by Thy Cross, O Lover of mankind: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: When Thou wast nailed upon the Cross, the sun was darkened, and the earth was shaken: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Thou didst grant Thy Cross as an invincible weapon unto Thy people: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: The passion-bearing Martyrs of Christ endured torments, and received the reward of victory: therefore they pray for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Word of God, the all-pure one wept, saying: "Woe is me, my sweetest Child! How diest Thou willingly, wishing to deliver mankind from corruption?"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: ON WEDNESDAY, BEATITUDES.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Beautiful was that fruit and good for food which put me to death; but Christ is the Tree of Life, whereof eating I die not, but cry aloud with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Stretched upon the Cross, Thou didst stretch out Thy hands, O Savior, gathering the scattered children of Adam into one fold!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: By Thy crucifixion, O Christ, the enemy was bound, and hades was despoiled: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Through your struggles, O holy Martyrs, ye trampled down the hostile enemy, and now rejoice with the Angels: pray for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Glory: Triadikon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: O Consubstantial Trinity, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit: save them that praise Thee in faith, and deliver us from eternal torment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Beholding Him Who was born of thee hanging upon the Tree, O pure Virgin, weeping she cried: "How sufferest Thou willingly, my Son, wishing to deliver the nature of mortals from passions?"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: *Stichera of the Holy Apostles, Tone 7.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Ye spiritual luminaries of the Church, glorious Apostles: who by your preaching enlightened the whole earth, and dispelled the mist of idolatry: pray unto Christ our God that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Having cast the net of the Gospel into the deep of the world, ye drew the nations unto the knowledge of Christ: O blessed Apostles, pray for us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ Ѻ҆у҆чн҃ци Сло́ва, ѡ҆ неима́нїа,
items.english_text: Having plowed the human heart with the plow of faith, ye sowed the divine seed, bringing forth fruit unto God: O glorious disciples of the Savior...[^295]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же вѣ́рою тѧ̀ и҆ любо́вїю всѐ при-
items.english_text: ...of God, the assemblies of the nations.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: гла́да, и҆ трꙋ́са, и҆ гꙋби́тельства:
items.english_text: Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Моле́бъ принесѝ твои́хъ рабъ, свое́-
items.english_text: As of old thou didst deliver the three commanders who were about to die, O Nicholas, by thy prayers: so now also save us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: А҆́плїи сла́вныи, стѡ́лпы Цр҃ко́вныи:
items.english_text: All who in faith and love call upon thee and praise thee, O all-blessed hierarch Nicholas: deliver from famine, earthquake, and destruction, and from every sorrow and need free thy servants, O wise hierarch Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ на́шего спасе́нїа оу҆правле́нїе:
items.english_text: Offer supplication for thy servants, O all-hymned one, unto thine own Son, that He may save all whom He hath created!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́нцы твои̑ Гдⷭи, вра́га побѣди́ша:
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѡ҆блиста́ваете при́сно сло́во вѣ́ро-
items.english_text: to the Holy Apostles, Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́же мі́рꙋ ра́дость, Дв҃о, Сн҃а сво-
items.english_text: Glorious Apostles, pillars of the Church, true preachers, being radiant luminaries: in the spiritual fire ye burned up the great deceit, and enlightened the human race through faith: therefore we pray you: entreat our Savior and God, to give peace unto the world and save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Со́ль ꙗ҆́коже нарече́ни бы́вше всеѧ̀
items.english_text: Apostles of Christ, laborers of the Word, who bore the Cross upon your shoulders like a plow, plowing the earth that was barren through idolatrous deceit: ye sowed the word of faith, and are worthily praised, O holy Apostles of Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же невеще́ственныхъ слꙋ́гъ, Бц҃е,
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ́кѡ нб҃са сла́вꙋ Бж҃їю, ꙗ҆́коже речѐ
items.english_text: Praised Martyrs, spiritual sacrifices, acceptable whole burnt offerings well-pleasing unto Christ: the earth hath hidden you now, but heaven hath received you; ye were made partakers with the Angels: with them pray, we beseech you, unto our Savior and God, to grant peace unto the world and save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Thee alone as pure Virgin after childbearing do we hymn, saying: As the Mother of God the Word: Glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: ON THURSDAY, AT MATINS.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: of the Apostles. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Thou didst show forth Thine Apostles as laborers of the world, O Word, cutting down idols: therefore having preached Thee among the nations, they piously magnified Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Earthly things upon earth did the blessed ones not value: having preached the heavenly God unto men, they brought all unto Him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Though creation knew thee as a Mother, yet the Creator showed thee to be a Virgin; for in the flesh thou didst bear Christ God, Who saves our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: of the Apostles. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: As the helmsmen of our salvation, the most wise Apostles of Christ: let us honor with songs and hymns as is meet; for they drove away the impiety of delusion and saved the world, as eyewitnesses and ministers of the Word, and His friends and brethren!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Thy Martyrs, O Lord, overcame the enemy and put idolatrous deceit to shame, being armed with the power of Thy Cross: therefore singing with the Angels, they cry aloud the victory hymn, glorifying Thee, O Christ: by their prayers grant cleansing and great mercy unto our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: ...grant cleansing and great mercy unto our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Rejoice, for the unavoidable and unchangeable Word became flesh and dwelt among us! Rejoice, pure one, rejoicing of the Apostles and Martyrs, and salvation unto us the faithful! Rejoice, Mother of Christ God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: All-praised disciples of the Lord, who like luminaries illuminated the whole inhabited earth: pray that I may be enlightened, who am in the darkness of passions and transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Being luminaries unto the world, O Apostles of the Lord: ye ever cause the word to shine forth unto the faithful, driving away the mist of wicked delusion: therefore by baptism ye also enlighten the nations, being ever-honored preachers of the Trinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: O thou who didst bring forth Joy unto the world, O Virgin: unceasingly pray with the Apostles unto thy Son, that He may grant us forgiveness of transgressions and reformation of life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: CANON to the Holy Apostles.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Work of Theophanes.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: By Thy nod upon the earth:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Having become God-beholders through divine assent, when ye brought the ungodly to completion, ye lifted them up unto divine love, O all-honorable Apostles of Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Called as the salt of all the earth, O loud-voiced Apostles of the Lord: stop all the rotting of my heart, and heal that which is grievously corrupted!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: When the most righteous Judge of all is about to sit with you in His second coming, O divine Apostles: then deliver us from all condemnation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: O all-pure Birth-giver of God, with the Bodiless Angels, the Prophets, the Martyrs, and the Apostles: pray that we may receive remission of transgressions and rich mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Another Canon to Saint Nicholas.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Work of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Unto God Who worked salvation:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Having gloriously passed through life upon earth, O Nicholas: make them that glorify thee partakers of the glory that is there!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Sailing across the deep of corruptible life, tossed by the billows of temptations, O all-blessed one, we are surrounded: preserve us therefrom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Extend unto me now a helpful hand, O father Nicholas: and deliver me from enemies visible and invisible!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: He Who created the bodiless ministers, O Birth-giver of God, was born of thee through ineffable mercy, and was seen as man!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Canon of the Apostles.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: In the beginning the heavens, O Almighty:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: As the heavens declare the glory of God, as the Prophet said, so do ye proclaim it, O divine disciples, explaining His divine incarnation, O most wise ones, and His passions, whereby ye delivered all from passions, death, and corruption!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: премрⷭнїи, и҆́миже ѿ страсте́й и҆ сме́рт[и]
items.english_text: Sharpened arrows of Christ the Mighty One...[^296]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃е, и҆ Прчⷭтыѧ тѝ Мт҃ре, сп҃се́не
items.english_text: ...having been shown forth: from the arrows of the evil one deliver me, O most wise disciples of the Lord, and heal my heart that is grievously wounded by the weapon of sin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: принеси́ Гн҃и: соблюда́я на́съ прⷭно,
items.english_text: Me who am grievously deceived and stripped naked of divine garments: make haste to enlighten with divine garments, O disciples of Christ, who through faith laid bare all the wiles of the enemy, and clothed him with shame!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ стра́стей и҆зба́вите на̀ и҆ бѣ́дъ
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ Пррⷦки, моли́ся: вѣ́дъ, и҆ скорбей,
items.english_text: O God, Who by Thy Word didst fashion the heavenly hosts, and didst grant grace unto the Prophets, disciples, and all the Martyrs: by their supplications and of Thine all-pure Mother, O Savior of all, have compassion, as Thou art merciful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бгоблаже́не Ѽ́ч҃е Никола́е, и҆ срⷣце
items.english_text: Another Canon [to St. Nicholas].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Гд҃же всеѧ̀ тва́ри, крагꙋ вѣ́з-
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Thou Who didst establish the heavens by Thy Word, and didst make firm the earthly foundation upon many waters: establish my mind in Thy will, O only Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Offering supplications for the inhabited earth, in great necessity and unnumbered sorrows, save us, O hierarch Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: As thou didst deliver them that were bound in the inescapable prison, breaking the bonds of my evils by thy prayers: reconcile me unto God, O hierarch Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Night and day we call upon thee as our protector: offer our supplications unto the Lord, ever preserving us, O hierarch Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: As the bush that received the Divine Fire within thy divine womb and was not consumed: burn up our transgressions, O all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Canon of the Apostles.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Without leaving the Father's bosom:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: The Son Who shares the throne with the Father, having become incarnate upon earth as man: chose you as disciples, to proclaim His divinity unto all the nations!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: In the Creator of all, fallen into passions and wounded in mind, wounded in heart by the robbers of passions: heal me with mercy, O Apostles, physicians of the sick!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Deliver us from passions and grievous dangers, and sorrows, O glorious Apostles, and from every assault and endless torment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Chosen Mother of God, with the holy Apostles, Martyrs, and Prophets, pray: that He may deliver us from dangers, sorrows, and transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Another Canon [to St. Nicholas].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos: Thy virtue covered the heavens:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: By thy wisdom obscuring the mind that of old was darkened by heresy: thou hast now enlightened them that were deceived, O Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Heal my many wounds by thy God-acceptable prayers, O God-blessed father Nicholas, and enlighten my heart!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Having put to death passionate stirrings: by thy prayers make me alive and renew me, all-blessed one, who am put to death by them!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: In the flesh thou didst bear the Beneficent One, Whom do thou entreat to deliver us from long-standing evils, O all-immaculate helper!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Canon of the Apostles.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: O Lord my God, from the night I awake early unto Thee, I pray Thee: grant me remission of my transgressions, and direct my path unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: O Lord my God, Who of old didst grant Thy peace unto Thine Apostles: by their prayers grant peace and remission of transgressions unto all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: O Lord my God, Who knowest the transgressions of my soul, and the uncorrected disposition of my heart: freely have compassion upon me and save me, through the prayers of the Apostles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: O Lord my God, Who for Thy supreme goodness didst save the thief and the harlot when they sinned: through the prayers of Thine Apostles, have compassion also upon me, the prodigal!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: O Lord my God, born of the Virgin that knew not wedlock: through her prayers and of Thine Apostles, grant me cleansing of transgressions, and deliver me from future torment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Another Canon [to St. Nicholas].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos: In the morning my spirit:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: The counsels of undisciplined men that are continually stirred up against us, make of no effect by thy prayers, O Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Break the bonds of our evils by thy prayers, thou who didst bind the malice of the soul-destroying serpent, all-holy Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Slipping continually in our disposition and held fast by a multitude of grievous things, O father Nicholas, we call upon thee as our fervent protector!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: O Sovereign Lady of all creation, who hast power to reign without passion: completely free my humble heart!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Canon of the Apostles.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Floating on the sea:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Having become divine disciples by His wisdom, they made foolish the wisdom of the Greeks, and destroyed the malice of the wise, and being most wise they enlightened them that wandered in ignorance unto piety!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Thou Who of old didst cleanse Peter's denial through tears: by his prayers cleanse the unnumbered transgressions of my soul, according to Thy great loving-kindness and surpassing grace, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Thou Who of old didst have compassion upon the Ninevites who repented: by Thine own loving-kindness have mercy upon me for the sake of Thine Apostles, and deliver me from being surrendered to many torments for the multitude of my transgressions, O Redeemer!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear the Light: enlighten my soul that is darkened by passions; and pray, with the Apostles, Prophets, and Martyrs, to deliver me from great sin, from every harm, and from all the malice of the enemy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Another Canon [to St. Nicholas].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos: Jonah cried from the belly of hades:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Thou didst annul the unjust condemnation of death, and by thy mercy didst save them that were about to die, O father Nicholas, as a fervent protector of them that call upon thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Stop the diseases of our souls, and ward off the impending dangers from them that love thee, O most holy shepherd!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Thou didst consume the bitter pasture of Arius's impiety, O Nicholas, by the mingling of thy words, O sacred initiate: thou art the confirmation of the Orthodox!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Разори́лъ є҆сѝ сме́ртное непра́ведное
items.english_text: Heal the wounds...[^297]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Съ А҆́гглы, со Мꙋ́ннки и҆ А҆́плы, пре-
items.english_text: Heal, O all-immaculate one, my wretched soul that is incurably sick with worldly delusions and grown old through many sins!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ Гдⷭа: спастѝ рабы̑ твоя̀, и҆ско-
items.english_text: Canon of the Apostles.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭа, Гдⷭа по́йте, и҆ превозноси́т[е]
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭа, Гдⷭа по́йте, и҆ превозноси́т[е]
items.english_text: The Children in the fiery furnace:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ско́рбехъ, и҆ въско́рѣ неѡбрѣта́е[тъ]
items.english_text: The furnace of bitter godlessness of old did ye extinguish, O glorious Apostles, with the dew of divine preaching, crying aloud: Blessed and supremely praised is the God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ра́ла Сло́весе, и҆́же на вы́яхъ ле́гкое
items.english_text: From grievous sin, O Christ, from torment in hades, and from sickness in Gehenna, snatch me away and save me, O Word, through the supplications and prayers of Thine Apostles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆стествꙋ̀ Дв҃ꙋ: є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́[хъ]
items.english_text: Having caught men with the net of the Word out of the deep of ignorance: save me, O disciples of Christ, who am submerged in boundless transgressions and defiled!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Посѣче́нїе сме́ртное ꙗ҆́коже секи́ра
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: нелѣ́ннеся оу҆́бѡ, покаѧ́нїа плода́[е]
items.english_text: With the Angels, the Martyrs, and the Apostles, O all-immaculate one, pray unto thine own Son and Lord: that He may save thy servants from all temptations and sorrows!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: А҆́пли сла́вныи, стѡ́лпы Цр҃ко́вныи:
items.english_text: Another Canon [to St. Nicholas].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Having become a spiritual vessel of the Church, O most wise one, deliver me from every ugliness of dishonorable passions, entreating the Benefactor of the whole world, O hierarch Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: With the showers of thy prayers, O wise Nicholas, water the hearts of all of us: that we may bring forth unto thee fruits of divine virtues, mediating an unending life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Enlighten our thoughts through prayers, who awake early in faith and pray unto God, O holy Nicholas, who by thy prayers didst destroy the temple of Artemis!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Every nation glorifies thee in faith, O pure one: as the only glory and praise of our race, and the guide of the wandering, O all-blessed Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Canon of the Apostles.

items.section:
