CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Unconsumed by fire on Sinai:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Kindled with the spiritual Fire as coals: like reeds the disciples of Christ burned up all idolatrous deceit, and enlightened the souls of the faithful, crying: Let all works of the Lord praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Enlighten my soul that is darkened by sin, and my heart that is now grown rough with dishonorable passions, O partakers of the everlasting Light, Apostles of Christ: that I may unceasingly cry: Let all works of the Lord praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Heal my wounded soul that is bitten by venomous bites of pride, O Thou Who didst receive wounds in the flesh: through the prayers of Thy sacred disciples: and save me who praise Thee: Let all works of the Lord praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Having brought forth the Fire, thou wast preserved unburnt, O all-pure Virgin Mother: therefore pray unto Him Whom thou didst bear, with the bodiless choirs and with the Apostles: to save them that praise in faith: Let all works of the Lord praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Another Canon [to St. Nicholas].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos: Likened unto the Children in the furnace:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Having received the grace of the Spirit, likened unto the Children in the furnace, in faith we cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; praise the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Thy body lying in Myra, all-holy Nicholas, and smelling of fragrant myrrh, pours forth streams of myrrh unto them that run thither, and assuages diseases!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: He Who is the Creator and Lord of the world showed thee forth as a protector unto the world; therefore, O Nicholas, unto them that now call upon thee thou art found a ready deliverer!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: There is none that calls upon thee in sorrows and doth not quickly find comfort; therefore we pray thee, Nicholas: lighten all our sicknesses!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Every tongue praises and glorifies thee: for thou didst bear the all-hymned God, O Bride of God: unceasingly pray unto Him for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Canon of the Apostles.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: She who brought forth the fountain of incorruption:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: As sons of the light and the day did the Word of God the Father show you forth, O divine Apostles who loved Him: luminaries unto the inhabited earth, destroyers of the Greeks, guides of the wandering, firm foundations of the Church!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Bearing the light yoke of the plow of the Word upon your necks, renew now my soul that is frozen with passions, and make it fruitful with the seed of repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Me who have despised Thy divine laws, and have become a dwelling of demons and a workshop of every sin: have compassion upon me, O Word, through the prayers of Thy glorious Apostles, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Send me not into the fire prepared for me: the Virgin who bore Thee entreats Thee, and the divine bodiless choirs Apostles, Prophets, Martyrs, Hierarchs, and all the righteous: O all-compassionate and most merciful One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Another Canon [to St. Nicholas].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos: Her that is Mother above nature and Virgin:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Thou didst follow the customs of the sacred Apostles, and didst inherit their throne, O venerable hierarch, worthy of all blessing, Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: As a divine zealot and a helper everywhere, the Creator showed thee forth greatly unto the whole world, O blessed one, unto them that fervently call upon thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: With a contrite heart we cry aloud unto thee, O father: be comfort unto us in sorrows, ever dispelling grief from our souls, O Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: The cutting down of death lies like an axe upon the tree for thee, O soul: be not slothful therefore, but make haste to show forth the fruits of repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Bearing Him Who bears all things in thine arms, O pure one: entreat Him that we may be saved unharmed from alien evildoing!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: to the Holy Apostles, Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Glorious Apostles, pillars of the Church, true preachers, being radiant luminaries: in the spiritual fire ye burned up the great deceit, and enlightened the human race through faith: therefore we pray you: entreat our Savior and God, to give peace unto the world and save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ли́сте: и҆ чл҃чскїй ро́дъ вѣ́рою про-
items.english_text: Apostles of Christ, laborers of the Savior...[^298]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѽ҆́ле чꙋдесѐ! ꙗ҆́кѡ сокро́вища мꙋ́к[и]
items.english_text: ...bearing the Cross upon your shoulders like a plow, plowing the earth that was barren through idolatrous deceit: ye sowed the word of faith, and are worthily praised, O holy Apostles of Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: глаго́лꙋ: ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́ще ннѣ̀ неоу҆́мре[мъ]
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гн҃и, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши во црⷭтвїи сѝ.
items.english_text: United in mind, and looking unto the One, the passion-bearing Martyrs found the one path of life, even death for Christ: equally emulating one another in their end!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́хъ приведе́сте, сла́внїи А҆́пли.
items.english_text: O wonder! Like treasuries of torments snatching away the contest, one said unto another: "If we die not now, we shall die in any case; let us render what is due unto our nature! Let us make a necessity into an honor, and buy what is common by giving our own: by death let us purchase life!" By their prayers, O God, have mercy upon us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ве́те въ ра́дости: всѝ не́ною сла́-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ ЧЕТВЕРТО́КЪ ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, НА ГДⷭИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: Ineffably born of the Virgin, Thou didst enlighten the nations, all crying: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи̑ры крⷭтны, гла́съ, з҃. подѡ́бенъ: Не ктомꙋ̀ возбраня́емни:
items.english_text: ON THURSDAY,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: бы́лъ є҆сѝ преблг҃їи Хе, и҆ распя́л-
items.english_text: Beatitudes. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆вре́йскїи вожделѣ̀: землѧ̀ тряса́-
items.english_text: Beautiful was that fruit and good for food which put me to death; but Christ is the Tree of Life, whereof eating I die not, but cry aloud with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Те́рпїе тя безсме́ртне, ꙗ҆́ко вѣнча́
items.english_text: From the deep edge of evils, O most wise Apostles, ye caught the flocks of the nations unto the God-comely faith, and faithfully brought all as well-instructed disciples unto the spiritual table, O glorious Apostles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. Подѡ́бенъ: Дне́сь І҆ꙋ́да:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: неразꙋ́мны Є҆вре́йскїа, всѣ́хъ Гн҃а.
items.english_text: Having driven away the darkness of grievous deceit by the light of preaching, O Apostles of the Lord: ye enlightened the hearts of us, the pious: therefore in divine songs we call you blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́нꙋ тѧ̀ всепѣ́таѧ Влⷣчце, по ро-
items.english_text: Severed limb from limb by the sword, O divine sufferers: ye remained unsevered from the love of the Redeemer; unto Whom having ascended, ye now live in joy, all irradiated with eternal glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Влⷣчце всепѣ́таѧ, Дв҃о ро́ждша Гн҃а,
items.english_text: Glory: Triadikon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Evil-ending, the corrupter of the human race holds me fast: by the prayers of Thy preachers, O almighty Trinity, snatch me away from this burning, that I may magnify Thine immeasurable mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: O Virgin, from thy pure blood, O all-pure one, thou didst bring forth the Son Who shares the throne with the Father, bearing mortal flesh, that He might renew the nature of earthly beings: therefore as is meet all we call thee blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: That Thou mightest make man a god, Thou becamest man, O all-good Christ, and wast crucified: glory to Thy power!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: When the Jewish council desired to crucify Thee, O Jesus: the earth was shaken, and the light of the sun was hidden!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: The crown of thorns wherewith the lawless crowned Thee, O Immortal One: uprooted the thorns of deceit, renewing mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Beholding the Lamb stretched upon the Tree, the spotless Ewe-lamb and Virgin, between two thieves, cried aloud: "Woe is me, my sweetest Child! What is this strange and most glorious mystery? How hath the lawless council lifted Thee up upon the Cross, and given gall to drink unto Him Who satisfied men with manna?"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: When the Virgin and Thy Mother beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O my Christ, by the judgment of the lawless, by the Jews in the Place of the Skull, she cried aloud: "Woe is me, my most beloved Son! What is this strange sight? How do the senseless children of the Hebrews nail Thee upon the Cross, Who art the Lord of all?"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Thee alone, O all-hymned Sovereign Lady, did we know as Virgin after childbearing, and seeing Him Whom thou didst bear without seed willingly nailing His hands upon the Tree, the all-pure one weeping cried aloud: "Willingly, O Long-suffering One, Thou diest, delivering from death all them that praise Thee!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: O all-hymned Sovereign Lady, Virgin who didst bear the Lord, Who for compassion's sake was nailed upon the Cross and poured forth streams of life unto the world: do thou entreat Him that our souls may be saved; for thee alone have we, the faithful, as refuge, rampart, and protection: therefore do we flee unto thy protection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: to the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: No longer are we forbidden from the Tree of Life, having the hope of Thy Cross: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Having been hanged upon the Tree, O Immortal One, Thou didst break the snares of the devil: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Glory to Thee, O Christ God, praise of the Apostles and rejoicing of the Martyrs, whose preaching was the Consubstantial Trinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Beholding Thee willingly nailed upon the Tree, O all-immaculate one, weeping she sang praise unto Thy dominion, O Master!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: ON FRIDAY, AT MATINS.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: of the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Jacob cries aloud unto Thee, O Christ God, worshipping Thee through the pine, the cedar, and the cypress: grant victories unto our hierarchs, O Compassionate One, and have mercy upon us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Thou Who for my sake didst endure being nailed upon the Cross: accept also my unslumbering supplication, O Christ God, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: Being ever preserved by the Cross of thy Son, O Virgin, we escape the assault of heretical errors; therefore, as is meet, praising thee we glorify thee, O all-hymned Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: of the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же менѐ ра́ди претерпѣ́вый є҆́же
items.english_text: A fire brighter and more efficacious than flame hast Thou shown forth the Tree...[^299]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: мирѝ мі́ръ тво́й, сего̀ я҆вле́нїемъ,
items.english_text: ...of Thy Cross, which burns up the sins of men and enlightens the hearts of them that sing: O Christ God, glory to Thee for Thy voluntary Crucifixion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же А҆да́мово ѡ҆сужде́нїе, дре́во
items.english_text: Today beholding the elevation of Thy Cross, ever falling down in faith and kissing it with songs and singing, in fear and joy: cleanse Thy servants, and give peace unto Thy world by its manifestation, O Thou Who alone art most merciful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сокруше́нїя ѻ҆увра́чь, и҆ сп҃си́ на.
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Съ весе́лїемъ гла́съ Гаврїи́ловъ во-
items.english_text: Pray ye, O holy ones, that forgiveness of our transgressions may be granted unto us, and that we may be delivered from grievous secret sins and bitter death, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: не́бо непреста́нно пѣ́сньми вопіе́тъ
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ѿня́тїе, и҆ но́гъ, и҆ вся́ческїй
items.english_text: Beholding her Son hanging upon the Cross, O pure Birth-giver of God, ever Virgin, weeping like a Mother, the unwedded Sovereign Lady magnified His dreadful condescension!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: та́ющи и҆́же вѣ́рою тя̀ и҆ любо́вїю
items.english_text: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: of the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Thy precious Cross, O Christ, hath become a weapon and an invincible victory unto the world; wherewith casting down the invisible enemies, we thankfully sing praise unto Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: O Thou Who by the Tree of the Cross didst heal the condemnation of Adam: heal our incurable contusions, and save us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: The Fruit of thy womb, O all-pure one, hath planted the Cross in the ends of the earth and delivered the world from corruption: therefore, O most glorious one, we magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: CANON

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: to the Precious and Life-giving Cross of the Lord.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Creation of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Let us shake Pharaoh in the Red Sea before God: let us sing a song of victory, for He hath been glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ, Thou didst draw all men unto Thyself, and didst cast down the enemy who had cast down all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: From Thy life-bearing side, O Jesus, Thou didst pour forth the stream of my life, and didst slay the enemy, having become as one dead!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Offer supplication diligently unto Christ for us, O passion-bearers: that all may be delivered from the dreadful judgment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Having humbled yourselves for the sake of Christ, O most wise Martyrs: by divine grace ye cast down the proud enemy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Beholding Him Who shone forth from thee in exceedingly great compassion upon the Cross, O Sovereign Lady, thou didst weep, glorifying Him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: When our forefather Adam fell under corruption, having been deceived: thou didst renew him, O all-pure one, having borne God in the flesh!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: With joy I cry aloud unto thee the voice of Gabriel, O pure one: Rejoice, expectation of all, O all-pure Bride of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: My deadened mind, by the action of the Life Who was truly born of thee, O all-pure Virgin, do thou make alive!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: They that bless thee in faith are manifestly blessed of God; for thou didst bear the Fountain of blessing, O only all-immaculate, all-lauded one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: The Church of Christ hath been established by faith: the heaven unceasingly cries aloud with hymns, praising:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: praising: Holy art Thou, O Lord, and my spirit sings praise unto Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: "The Sinless One is moved: how did He endure suffering, Who is breathing life unto me? How was He put to death upon the Tree?" Thy Mother beat her breast, crying aloud at Thy long-suffering, O Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Lifted up unjustly upon the Cross between thieves, O Word: by faith Thou didst justify him that acknowledged Thee as Creator of all creation, willingly suffering!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Enduring the tearing of your flesh, the severance of hands and feet, and every torment of limbs, O passion-bearers: ye were accounted worthy of glory, O youths!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Having been divinely enlightened by the multitude of torments, surpassing glory, O most wise ones, ye now inherit: ever praying for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Entreat for us remission of debts, O Virgin Mother, and grant it through thy prayers, having borne God the Word made man, Who was nailed upon the Cross!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: God showed thee forth on the mountain unto Moses the Lawgiver as a living, all-holy tabernacle; for thou becamest the dwelling-place of Him Who sanctifies all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: We all know thee, O Virgin, as holy earth, who hast sprouted forth for us without seed the beauteous Ear of Wheat, Jesus Christ, Who nourishes them that call thee blessed, O Virgin, in faith and love!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: The goings of the most high God from thee, O Virgin, were seen, when He was ineffably incarnate; for thou becamest the Mother of Him Who reigns over all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Ever guided, the Church of Christ glorifies thee before God: O Virgin Mother of God thou didst bear the incarnate Savior unto them that sing praise unto thee, O Virgin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: I heard Thy report, and was afraid; I understood Thy works, and glorified Thee, O Lord, Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Lifted up upon the Cross like the fairest cluster of grapes: Thou dost pour forth the new wine of gladness unto all, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: As Thou didst receive voluntary suffering in Thy flesh, O Master: Thou didst put an end to the painful sufferings of men!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Being wounded with wounds, O passion-bearers: ye became the wounders of the adversary, and appeared as physicians unto our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: The passion-bearers set themselves in array against the tormentors; and having conquered, they were crowned with the triumphant wreath!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Without seed thou didst bring forth the Word, O Virgin: Who by the Cross destroyed corruption through His goodness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Habakkuk heard of thee, O all-pure mountain, being enlightened by spiritual shadows, that God was manifest incarnate from thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: The Orthodox assembly is made upright, singing praise unto thee, the all-holy Mother of God, and crying with the Archangel: "Rejoice!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: The face of Nestorius is confounded, who was unwilling to confess thee as pure Birth-giver of God; for thou didst truly bear God, O all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Having found thee beauteous and radiant in virtues, the Bridegroom took up His abode in thee, and made thee the all-holy Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́шахъ слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ꙋ҆боя́-
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos: My spirit seeks Thee early in the morning, O Christ...[^300]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: велѣ́нїа, бы́ша и҆сцѣле́нїа рабѡ́мъ
items.english_text: Lifted up upon the Tree in the flesh, O Master: Thou didst deliver all creation from the cruel slavery of folly unto Thy knowledge, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тїю: тва́рь всю̀ и҆з̾ ра́ба лю́таго
items.english_text: Upon the Place of the Skull, the lawless and unjust people crucified Thee, O Jesus, Who crushest the venomous head of the serpent!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: неразꙋ́мїа и҆зба́вилъ є҆сѝ: и҆з̾ ра-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: чи́теля, въ ни́хъ потопи́сте. Мч҃нъ:
items.english_text: Ye extinguished the torrents of impiety, O Martyrs of Christ, by your divine blood, and therein drowned Pharaoh the tormentor!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆стꙋ́пилъ є҆ⷭть Бг҃ъ ложесна̀ твоя̀,
items.english_text: Being mercilessly scraped with claws, O passion-bearers, ye tore in pieces the hearts of the wise tormentors by your reproof, and became victors!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ сладча́йшая и҆ ѡ҆чїсти́тельный до́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ, всеви́дца и҆
items.english_text: God entered thy womb, O holy and pure one, and was seen as Emmanuel lifted up upon the Cross, raising up creation with Himself!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Вседержи́теля, коѝ є҆го̀ ѻ҆утро́бу,
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше,
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: мы́ же тѝ вопі́емъ, всеси́лне Сп҃се
items.english_text: The all-holy turtledove, beauty of God, most sweet and purifying: having desired thy beauty, the Master God took up His abode in the Virgin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: се́ннаго: сла́вимъ и҆́же терпѣ́нїемъ
items.english_text: O all-holy and light-bearing gate of grace, who shinest upon the universe with the light of the Sun: having illumined us, O Maiden, enlighten them that sing praise unto thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ни гоне́нїе, ни гла́дъ, ни нагота̀,
items.english_text: Accounting thee as the bush, O Virgin Mother: may we be accounted worthy through thee, O Mother of God, to obtain the passing kingdom and food!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѽц҃ъ на́шыхъ Бж҃е, бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Thou wast shown forth as the temple of the all-seeing Almighty, Who found thy womb more honorable than the heavens and took up His abode therein, O all-venerable Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: поползе́нїе и҆спра́вилъ є҆сѝ, пла́-
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́наго безначя́лнаго, Цр҃ѧ сла́вы:
items.english_text: Jonah cried aloud from the belly of hades: Lead my life up from corruption! And we cry aloud unto Thee, O almighty Savior: Have mercy upon us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ты́ же Хѐ мо́й, ꙋ҆мерщвли́венъ є҆сѝ
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: гла́венны а҆́гг҃лы и҆звлекшаго. Мч҃нъ:
items.english_text: When human nature fell sick, Thou didst appear in compassion, O Savior, as a Physician unto the suffering; and by Thy Cross and Passion Thou didst heal it!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Мч҃ника мо́щны бл҃гоꙋха́нїа чꙋде́съ,
items.english_text: By the tree Adam was first condemned; but by the Tree of the Cross he hath now been justified, receiving entrance into Paradise and the enjoyment thereof once again!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: се́рдцемъ и҆спуща́ютъ, и҆ ѿстрасте́й
items.english_text: We sing praise unto Thee Who wast lifted up upon the Cross; we glorify Thee, the most good King, Who wast crowned with endurance and dost crown men with glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Having now passed through the threefold waves of torments, the passion-bearers, clad in suffering, died with Christ: neither persecution, nor famine, nor nakedness, nor peril, nor death could by any means separate the divine sufferers from the love of Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: In sorrow of heart thou didst behold Him Who was incarnate of thee, O pure and all-immaculate Virgin Mother, weeping as thou didst look upon Him lifted up upon the Cross!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Thou didst bear the One Who lived among men, O Virgin Birth-giver of God, the only Savior Who grants life unto mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Emmanuel, O Birth-giver of God, Whom thou didst bear according to essence, the perfect Word before all ages, incarnate God Who grants redemption unto us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The Ark that contained the tables of the law prefigured thee, O Birth-giver of God, as having received the Word of God in thy womb, incarnate for our sake!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The Children in the furnace of burning fire of old showed it forth dewy, singing of the one God and saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Thou didst lighten the weight of my transgressions, lifted up upon the Cross between the lawless, O most good Lord, God of our fathers, Who art supremely exalted: Blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Pierced with a spear in Thy divine side, O God, Thou didst make upright the slip of the rib, ever commanding the flaming sword to grant me entrance into Paradise, O Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Having become stars set upon the heights of the Church, the Martyrs enlighten creation by the manifestations of their sufferings and by the radiance of healings!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The Book of the living ever brings the names of the Lord's Martyrs written therein, who fervently preserved the divine commandments and valiantly suffered!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The all-holy Mother, beholding the all-holy Word Who came forth from her lifted up upon the holy Cross and cleansing mankind, wept aloud!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: We thankfully offer unto thee the "Rejoice," O Mother of God, having truly been delivered through thee from every difficulty, and harmoniously crying aloud: In majesty and joy we magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: David the forefather of God describes thy glory, O Virgin, and divinely proclaims thee as Queen of creation standing at the right hand of God the Father, O all-immaculate one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Thou hast renewed the nature of earthborn beings, O pure one, by the renewal of thy childbearing; therefore we cry aloud unto thee, O Virgin: Blessed unto all ages is God, the Fruit of thy womb!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Condemned Adam, held fast by death, is led up by the second Adam through thee, O all-pure one, crying: Blessed art Thou, Who hast renewed him by Thy birthgiving!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The only beginningless King of glory, Whom the heavenly hosts praise and the angelic ranks tremble before: Praise Him, ye priests, and supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The tree of knowledge showed me dead; but Thou, O my Christ, having been put to death upon the Tree, didst make me alive and enlighten me to sing: Praise Him, ye priests, and supremely exalt Him, ye people, unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The lawless assembly crowned Thee with patience, O King, disobeying the long-suffering of Adam the first-formed; and they lifted Thee upon the Cross, Who didst deliver all from headlong fall!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: O Word Who didst stretch out the heavens by Thy wisdom: the senseless people stretched Thee upon the Tree, Who by Thy Passion dost heal our passions, O Savior, and forgivest sicknesses by the pain of the nails!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The relics of the Martyrs pour forth sweet-smelling fragrances of miracles unto them that approach with undoubting heart, ever driving away the stench of passions and granting health from God unto all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: всѣ́мъ здра́вїе ѿ Бг҃а подава́ют. Бг҃о:
items.english_text: The ranks of the angels beseech the Maiden, for He Who came forth from thy womb...[^301]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: гле́тъ рожде́нїе зрѣ́ти є҆стество̀:
items.english_text: God Who came forth from thee, O pure Virgin, showed forth unto these holy ones the sufferings upon the Cross; and they bless thee as more honorable than all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Къ глаго́люще роди́ла є҆сѝ, ѻ҆умолѝ
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Всепречⷭта́я, нб҃са превы́шшїи: ꙗ҆́же
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На Крⷭтѣ тя̀ вознесе́на ꙗ҆́ко ви́дѣ,
items.english_text: The incomprehensible Master of all, Whom the heavens cannot contain, O Mother of God: is contained in thy womb, O Virgin; therefore we, the faithful, supremely exalt thee in love unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆чи́стиша положе́нїемъ мо́щей всю̀
items.english_text: Him Who is beyond the mind of all creation, O Maiden, Whose birth human nature cannot behold: thou didst carry in thine all-pure arms; therefore we, the faithful, supremely exalt thee in love unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣли́лъ А҆да́мовꙋ болѣ́знь, ю҆́же
items.english_text: Having borne the Word, entreat Him, O Virgin: to send down salvation unto them that faithfully honor thee, deliverance from perils, speedy changing of grievous sicknesses, and eternal grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви мꙋ́къ: и҆́же бг҃а тя̀ вѣро-
items.english_text: Seeing thee adorned with diverse virtues and enlightened, O all-holy Virgin, as the Church of the Most High: we piously sing praise unto thee and glorify thee unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ ПЯ́ТОКЪ ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, НА ГДⷭИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи̑ры ст҃ы̑мъ мꙋ́ченикѡмъ, ст҃и́телем, и҆ прпⷣбнымъ.
items.english_text: O all-pure one, higher than the heavens, who didst conceive the beginningless Word in thy womb and bear God incarnate unto men: therefore all we ever magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: When the sun beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O King of all, it was extinguished, and the earth was shaken, and the veil of the temple was rent in twain, unable to endure Thy radiance, O almighty Jesus!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: The lawless dug through Thy hands and feet, and pierced Thy life-bearing side with a spear, and gave Thee gall and vinegar to drink, O my Christ, Who art the Sweetness of all and true God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: The valiant passion-bearers crushed the evil-originating demons by manifold forms of torments; and having become crown-bearers in victory, they are called blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: By the laying down of their relics the passion-bearers cleansed all the earth, and put an end to the filth of idol sacrifices, having offered themselves unto the fire and therein mystically been ignited!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: O comely one, holier than the Cherubim, who didst bear God the Word incarnate in the flesh: pray diligently unto Him for all, Who was willingly lifted up upon the Cross!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Another Canon [to the Theotokos].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Divinely perfected humanity was assumed from thee, O all-pure Maiden, united unto the Word, flesh animate, adorned with the Word: therefore all we, the faithful, magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Let Egyptian praise now be silent; but let the trumpet of David divinely sound, praising thee, O Virgin, with radiant voices, and confessing thee as the true Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Humanity was now pitied through thee, being truly united in person unto the Word: and God, having become man, was lifted up, O Virgin: therefore all we ever magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Foreknowing by prophetic sharp vision the mystery of thy childbearing, O Maiden, that thou didst bear God incarnate unto men, Who delivers us from temptations: by thy prayers save us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: of the Cross. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Being the Master, Lover of mankind, and Giver of life, Thou didst redeem the universe by Thy Cross: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: The true Vine was nailed upon the Cross, embracing the nations: the Paradise of the Church with the Thief! Lo, this is the glory of the Church; lo, this is the richness of the Kingdom: O Thou Who didst suffer for our sake, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Celebrating the memory of Thy holy passion-bearers, we sing praise unto Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Beholding her Son upon the Tree of old, the grief of a sword wounded the heart of the all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: ON FRIDAY AT THE DIVINE LITURGY:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Beatitudes. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Beautiful was that fruit and good for food which put me to death; but Christ is the Tree of Life, whereof eating I die not, but cry aloud with the Thief: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Healing the disease of Adam, which he received through the counsel of the enemy, Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree of the Cross, O Christ King, and didst endure suffering, having Thy hands and feet nailed: therefore we glorify Thy long-suffering, O Word!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: In the midst of the lawless the Jewish assembly crucified Thee, the only Lawgiver and Deliverer, Who deliverest the human race from every transgression, O Christ: therefore we sing praise unto Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Bearing the wounds of many torments like beauteous ornaments, the valiant sufferers were manifestly recognized as the adornment of the Church: ever praying for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Glory: Triadikon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: O Holy Trinity, deliver Thy faithful servants from torments, who have believed in Thee as God, piously glorifying the one Godhead unceasingly; and grant Thy eternal Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Having neither form nor beauty, O Christ, when the all-immaculate Virgin beheld Thee lifted up in the flesh upon the Tree of the Cross, she sighed in pain: "Woe is me, my Child! How have the dark, lawless ones wounded Thee?"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: Stichera to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable Monastics.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: The Martyrs quenched the fire, and drove away idol deceit, showing forth in their time the light of the knowledge of God unto men!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ, з҃. По: Нїкто́мꙋ возбра́няеми:
items.english_text: By Orthodox teachings, with divine beams, ye illumined the Church of the Lord, O all-lauded pastors, in every...[^302]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: созда́вый и҆спе́рва чл҃ка, и҆ въ раѝ
items.english_text: ...way ye broke the snares, dwelling continually in the trackless wilderness, O venerable fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆́хже преста́вилъ є҆сѝ бра́тїю на́шꙋ
items.english_text: Other Stichera to the Holy Martyrs.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Мч҃нци твоѝ Гдⷭи, вра́га побѣди́ша,
items.english_text: Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: на́шы, ѡ҆чище́нїе и҆ ве́лїю млⷭть.
items.english_text: Glory to Thee, O Christ God: the praise of the Apostles and the joy of the Martyrs, whose preaching was the Consubstantial Trinity! (Twice)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Въ странѣ́ живы́хъ Гдⷭи, и҆ въ се́лѣ
items.english_text: Holy Martyrs, who valiantly suffered and were crowned: pray unto the Lord, that our souls may have mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ненѣвѣстобра́чнаѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це пре-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: кро́вїи воплоще́ннаго Бг҃а на́шего:
items.english_text: Thou wast known as a Mother beyond nature...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃лїе Хвы̑, и҆ Прпⷣбнїи всѝ подви-
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: to the Martyrs. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Disregarding all earthly things, O holy Martyrs, and valiantly confessing Christ in the judgment hall: ye received from Him the reward of your sufferings; but as ye have boldness: pray unto Him as almighty God to save our souls, who flee unto you, we pray!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: All-lauded Martyrs, spiritual armor, rational whole-burnt offerings, acceptable sacrifices well-pleasing unto God: the earth hid you not, but heaven received you! Ye were made partakers with the Angels; with them pray, we beseech you, unto our Savior and God, to give peace unto the world and save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: O Thou Who in the beginning didst create man according to Thine own image and likeness, and didst set him in Paradise to rule over Thy creatures; but being deceived through the envy of the devil, he partook of the food, becoming a transgressor of Thy commandments: therefore Thou didst condemn him, O Lord, to return again unto the earth whence he was taken, and to ask for rest!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Give rest, O our Savior and Giver of life, unto our brethren whom Thou hast translated from temporal things, who cry: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: O thou who alone didst contain the Uncontainable and didst bear God the Word incarnate: pray that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: ON SATURDAY AT MATINS.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: to the Martyrs. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Pray ye, O holy ones, that forgiveness of our transgressions may be granted unto us, and that we may be delivered from grievous secret sins and bitter death, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Thy holy ones, O Lord, having struggled upon the earth, trod down the enemy and abolished idol deceit: therefore they also received crowns from Thee, the Master Who lovest mankind and merciful God, Who grantest great mercy unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: As the treasury of our resurrection, O all-hymned one, lead us up from the pit and depth of transgressions, who hope in thee; for thou hast saved them that were guilty of sin, having borne our Salvation: who wast a Virgin before childbearing, a Virgin in childbearing, and after childbearing art still a Virgin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: to the Martyrs. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Rejoice, ye righteous, and let the heavens be glad! For the Martyrs having struggled upon earth, abolished deceit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Let the Church dance, triumphantly celebrating the contest of the athletes, and sending up honor unto Christ God, the only Triumphant One, Who grantest great mercy unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Thy Martyrs, O Lord, conquered the enemy and put to shame idol deceit, being armed with the power of Thy Cross: therefore, singing with the Angels, they send up a hymn of victory, glorifying Thee, O Christ! By their supplications grant unto our souls cleansing and great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: In the land of the living, O Lord, and in the tabernacles of Thy righteous ones, do Thou place those whose memory we celebrate, O Lover of mankind! And whatsoever they have sinned in this common life, as Thou art merciful and easily reconciled God, forgive, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: O unwedded Maiden, all-immaculate, who from thy blood didst bear our incarnate God: ever pray with the Prophets and the holy Martyrs, that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: CANON

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, Venerable Monastics, and the Departed.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Creation of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Unto God Who helped Moses in Egypt to deliver Israel: let us sing unto Him alone, for He hath been glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: The choir of Martyrs, having conquered every deceit of the adversary, rejoice together before the face of Him Who created them!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Hierarchs of Christ and all venerable ones who have struggled: ye were accounted worthy of eternal sustenance by grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Deliver us from all wrath by the prayers of Prophets, Venerable ones, and Holy Women, O Christ, and save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: O Word Who didst create me from the earth, and didst command me to return again unto the earth: give rest unto them whom Thou hast translated in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: O all-pure Mother, who didst bear the all-holy Word of God: sanctify all them that glorify thee in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Another Canon for the Departed.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Creation of Theophanes.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 7. Heirmos: By Thy nod upon the earth:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Creation adorned with virtuous forms and a divine offering radiant with diverse beauties, divinely marked, O Martyrs: ye were offered unto Christ God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Account Thy translated servants worthy to receive the beam of the inaccessible, super-solar radiance, O most merciful Lord: whence all sickness, sorrow, and sighing have fled away!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Nature having been condemned unto death, O Giver of life, having established life, Thou Thyself, O Christ, didst raise it up; therefore, as the only King, give rest unto them that were translated unto Thee in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Thou didst make upright the ancestral fall, O all-pure one, having borne the Lord Word Who raised her up, and breathed life into them that are in the graves by the authority of the Godhead!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тернее паде́нїе, ро́жши Гдⷭа Сло́во:
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos: Established...[^303]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѹ҆твержде́нїе мѝ бꙋ́ди, и҆́же сло́во
items.english_text: Be Thou my establishment, O Word Who established the heavens, and founded the earth upon the waters, O Savior: as Thou art mighty, save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆́хже ра́ди Хѐ, всѣ́хъ на́съ ѻ҆уще́дри.
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́ко ста́дꙋ Па́стыревы и҆ А҆́гнцевъ,
items.english_text: Being crushed with stones and cast into pits: ye crushed all the power of the evil one, and remained unbroken in mind, O Martyrs!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Мл҃и, є҆го́же роди́ла є҆сѝ Бг҃а всѣ-
items.english_text: By the beam of divine traditions and the rays of virtues, O venerable hierarchs, ye enlighten the faithful, driving away all the mist of heresies!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: велѣ́нїа, бы́ша и҆сцѣле́нїа рабѡ́м
items.english_text: Having died unto the world, Thy venerable ones, O Word, truly inherited the supermundane life: for whose sake, O Christ, have compassion upon us all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆́хъже преста́вилъ є҆сѝ, съ перво-
items.english_text: Them that were translated in faith and hope, we all beseech Thee, O good Master, that Thou mayest spare them in the hour of judgment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: O Word from the unwaning Father's bosom: held in thy bosom as an infant, O all-pure one, the beginningless was seen, taking a beginning from thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Another Canon [for the Departed].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos: In the beginning the heavens:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: The company of the Martyrs showed forth youthful and steadfast endurance valiantly unto the tormentors: alone they endured onslaughts and the wounds of torments, desiring the incorruptible glory and beauty of God, O Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Receive, O merciful One, the souls of them that died in the hope of Thy eternal life; and settling them in the desired, divine bosom of holy Abraham, number them with Lazarus and Thine elect!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: O compassionate Savior Who camest down from heaven to save the human race: account them that were piously translated worthy through Thy tender-heartedness to enjoy Thine immaterial Light and divine glory and joy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: When thou didst conceive the incomprehensible Word in thee, O pure one, the laws of nature were broken; and the divine law was given unto us, granting forgiveness of transgressions unto all through the grace of divine goodness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: The Prophet Habakkuk, being assured of Thy coming in the flesh, O Christ, cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Bound with the bonds of love toward the Lord, the Martyrs withered the power of the enemy: therefore they are called blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: As shepherds of the flock and of the lambs, O blessed hierarchs: ye became protectors of the rational flock by divine grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Radiant like stars with the brightness of virtues: ye illumined the fulness of the faithful, O our venerable fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: The single company of valiant women and the assembly of holy Prophets have obtained heavenly good things!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Pray, O all-hymned one, unto Him Whom thou didst bear, that thy flock may be delivered from great tribulations and sorrows!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Another Canon [for the Departed].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos: The heavens heard:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
