*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Having patiently shown forth the sufferings of athletes, O Christ, the Martyrs were crowned with the crowns of Thy righteousness and glorified Thy glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Account them that were piously translated worthy of the supernatural beauty of Thy glory, O Christ, when Thou comest in Thy glory with Thine Angels, O all-compassionate and most merciful One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Account them that have departed before us and glorify Thee, O Lover of mankind, worthy to enjoy the beam of the Triple-radiance and the lightning of the one Godhead!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Without leaving the Father, Christ took up His abode in the virginal womb, and delivered them that bless thee from death, O Mother of good, only all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: My spirit seeks Thee early in the morning, O Christ God; for Thy commandments are light, and have become healings unto Thy servants, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: The valiant passion-bearers cared not for bodily bonds, and by your divine wounds ye heal the wounds and passions of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ye received authority to loose and to bind upon earth, O hierarchs of Christ: therefore ever loose the burdens of our evils!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: With one mind we honor the godly company of the race, the honored ranks of Prophets and Righteous, and the choirs of venerable women, rejoicing together!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: O Thou Who alone art most merciful: settle the servants of the assembly of citizens, who have been translated from this life in faith, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: O Virgin, shown forth as an indestructible bridal-chamber: pray unto Him, O all-holy Virgin, to make me a dweller in the spiritual chamber!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Another Canon [for the Departed].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos: O Lord my God:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: The all-lauded Martyrs, clothed with the life-bearing deadening through torments, asking for radiant garment: ask divine rest for the souls that fell asleep before!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: O Savior, Who didst come down into the treasuries of the deep, pouring forth tender-heartedness: be pleased that the souls whom Thou hast translated may dwell with the first-born in their heavenly tabernacles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Having laid aside the burden of the flesh and loosed from bonds, Thy servants who have now passed unto the higher life, O Christ: be pleased that they may enjoy the brightness of Thy Saints, O Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: O Mother of good, grant forgiveness of my transgressions, and bestow upon me pardon of my offenses, O all-immaculate one, who didst bear the Life that established the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Jonah cried aloud from the belly of hades: Lead my life up from corruption! And we cry aloud unto Thee, O almighty Savior: Have mercy upon us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ye cast down the haughtiness of the enemy, being lifted up unto God in sufferings, O all-glorious sufferers, and became citizens of heaven!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Driving away the winter of heresies, the true hierarchs of Christ were shown forth as true ones, and brought a multitude of pious ones!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: By Thy power, O Christ, the multitudes of the Venerable, Prophets, and holy Women, being justified, enjoy the unwaning illumination!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Thou hast translated Thy servants from temporal things, O Compassionate One: but account them partakers of eternal gladness and incorruptible life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́сна и҆з̾ чре́ва а҆́дова вопія́ше:
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:...[^304]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: дꙋ́ша и҆́же преста́вилъ є҆сѝ, въселе́-
items.english_text: Deliver Thy servants from the fire, O all-holy Virgin, who didst bear the all-holy Word in the flesh, Whom every breath praises, calling thee blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ хра́мы созда́сте себѐ дꙋхо́вн[ы],
items.english_text: Another Canon [for the Departed].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же тва́ри бы́сте кри́ны бл҃гоꙋха́нныѧ
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos: Navigating the sea:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Па́че є҆стества̀ Мт҃рь: и҆ по є҆сте́-
items.english_text: The choir of Martyrs, having valiantly endured cruel, grievous diseases, inherited painless and sorrowless sustenance: receiving the crown of righteousness from the life-bearing right hand!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ствꙋ̀ Дв҃у: є҆ди́ну въ жена́хъ бл҃го-
items.english_text: With the righteous, where the choirs of the Saints are, and where the radiances of the Venerable and the enjoyment of eternal life abide: place Thy servants who have fallen asleep before us, O merciful One, as Thou art immortal God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: He Who by divine counsel and creative power established all things from non-being, came forth from thy womb, O all-pure one: and as God He delivered all from mortal corruption!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: In the Chaldean furnace of fire, the Young Men, taking courage, danced with the Angel, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: By streams of blood the passion-bearers quenched the flame of impiety, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: We praise the holy hierarchs, the illuminators of the whole world, who sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Let the holy assembly of Prophets and Venerable monastics be honored in hymns, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Deliver from Gehenna Thy faithful servants whom Thou hast received, O compassionate Christ, who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Together with the Angels we cry aloud unto thee, who art holier than the Angels: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Another Canon [for the Departed].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Having received dewy refreshment through torments, the Martyrs sing unto divine sustenance: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Having authority over death and life, O Compassionate One: account them that fell asleep before in Thy faith, O Savior, worthy of divine sustenance, who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: O Christ Who didst shine forth with the light of immaterial brightness: settle the souls whom Thou hast translated in the heavenly tabernacles, unceasingly to praise Thee with Thy Saints: O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: He Who was before without a mother from the Father, and now without a father from thee, O Virgin: Christ was ineffably born, willingly sanctifying mankind for our sake: Blessed is the all-pure Fruit of thy womb!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Likened unto the Children in the furnace, having received spiritual dew, we faithfully cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Having overthrown the temples of idols, ye made yourselves spiritual temples, O passion-bearers, having valiantly finished your course!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Ye became sweet-smelling lilies of creation, O hierarchs, delighting the souls of the faithful with the knowledge of piety: therefore as is meet ye are called blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: The venerable ones, arms of God, were strangers unto all the earth, looking unto the higher inheritance and ever-abiding glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: As Lord of the living and the dead, O Word, number Thy servants who have fallen asleep in faith among the choir of all Thine elect, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Let us honor the company of holy women, who glorified the Lord by purity and struggles of torments: they pray unceasingly unto Thy divine Lamb, O all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Another Canon [for the Departed].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos: The only beginningless:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Looking unto future glory, the witnesses of Christ's coming disregarded earthly glory: piously singing of Him as the Giver of life unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst destroy the earthly tabernacle: grant heavenly joy unto them that have fallen asleep in the hope of life, settling them in the resting-places of the Righteous unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Granting rest unto the dead as God, Who hast the fountain of life: water with the stream of sustenance them that have fallen asleep before us, as Thou alone art good, unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Having ineffably received the Inaccessible Light in thy womb, O Virgin Mother of God: thou didst enlighten all that were in the darkness of life, piously to glorify Christ Who ineffably came forth from thee, O Virgin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Mother beyond nature and Virgin according to nature, the only blessed one among women: with songs we, the faithful, as is meet, call thee blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: By the prayers of the most wise Martyrs, Prophets, and Righteous ones who have lived well from all ages: have mercy upon our souls, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: As servants of the Good One, having appeared as sacred mystagogues, ye are joined unto the heavenly ministers: with them offer supplications for us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: With the women who finished their blessed course, let us honor the holy fasting choirs, that by their prayers we may obtain radiances!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Account Thy translated servants who served Thee in Orthodox faith, O Christ, worthy to partake of the glory of all the Saints who rejoice!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Being a lover of sin, I tremble before the dreadful judgment seat of Him Who was born of thee, O pure one: unto Whom do thou preserve me uncondemned, as thou art good!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Another Canon [for the Departed].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Manifestly the valiant Martyrs enlighten the world, being pillars of the faith, unshakable foundation and bulwarks of piety unto the Churches: them, as is meet, we, the faithful, call blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: Deliver from the fire of Gehenna them that have been translated from us, O Master; for with the spear of Thy side Thou didst tear up the handwriting of sins, as Thou alone art the Lover of mankind: and account them worthy of the brightness of the Saints!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: As Thou art good and the Lover of mankind, merciful and compassionate, as Thou art the inexhaustible treasury of immortal life, O Savior: account them that have fallen asleep before in faith worthy of Thine incorruptible sustenance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѣ́хъ досто́йно вѣ́рнїи ѡ҆ублажи́[мъ].
items.english_text: The shadows of the law and former dark riddles have passed away by thy childbearing; for Christ became the fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets, Whom...[^305]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: гла́ху: ꙗ҆́ко а҆́ще ны́нѣ не ꙋ҆мре́мъ,
items.english_text: ...Whom singing as essentially God, we ever call thee, the pure Virgin, blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: созда́вый и҆спе́рва чл҃ка, и҆ въ раѝ
items.english_text: At the Praises, Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: е҆го́же роди́ла є҆сѝ Бг҃а Сло́ва, зо-
items.english_text: to the Martyrs. Tone 7:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стї: Блаже́ни я҆̀же и҆збра́лъ и҆ прїя́лъ
items.english_text: Celebrating the memory of Thy holy passion-bearers, we sing praise unto Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ сла́достїю красоты̀, и҆ бж҃тве́н-
items.english_text: In the midst of the lawless judgment hall, the passion-bearers rejoiced, crying out unto Thee, O Christ: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стї: Душа̀ и҆́хъ во бл҃ги́хъ водвори́тся:
items.english_text: The all-lauded passion-bearers appeared as luminaries unto the universe, crying aloud unto Christ: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭи Гдⷭи, не ѿве́рзи на́съ ѿ твое́го
items.english_text: United in mind, and looking unto the One, the passion-bearing Martyrs found the one path of life, even death for Christ: equally emulating one another in their end! O wonder! Like treasuries of torments snatching away the contest, one said unto another: "If we die not now, we shall die in any case; let us render what is due unto our nature! Let us make a necessity into an honor, and buy what is common by giving our own: by death let us purchase life!" By their prayers, O God, have mercy upon us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Твое́ и҆з̾ме́ртвыхъ твоѐ Воскрⷭнїе,
items.english_text: O Thou Who in the beginning didst create man according to Thine own image and likeness, and didst set him in Paradise to rule over Thy creatures; but being deceived through the envy of the devil, he partook of the food, becoming a transgressor of Thy commandments: therefore Thou didst condemn him, O Lord, to return again unto the earth whence he was taken, and to ask for rest!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ся на Крⷭтѣ́, и҆ воскресе́ и҆згрѡ́ба
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: слы́ши, и҆ спасѝ на́съ, воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: We sing praise unto thee, O all-holy Birth-giver of God, and we glorify Him Whom thou didst bear, God the Word, crying: Glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Aposticha Stichera.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Seen dead upon the Cross, O Thou Who alone art immortal, and laid in the grave as one dead: delivering men from deadness and mortal corruption; but as Thou art an inexhaustible abyss of compassion and a fountain of grace: give rest unto the souls of Thy servants who have departed from us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: By Thine ineffable goodness, the sweetness of Thy beauty, and the beams of Thy divine Light, account them that were translated worthy to be brightly illuminated, O Good One: rejoicing before Thee, the Master, King of glory, and Lord, with the Angels at the immaterial out-pouring of Thy Light!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: As Thou hast an unfailing greatness of gifts, as an unfailing treasury of the wealth of grace: settle them that have been translated unto Thee, as God, in the lands of Thine elect: in a place of refreshment, in the house of Thy glory, in the delight of Paradise, in the spiritual chamber, as Thou art merciful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Thou didst bear the Deliverer Who came in the flesh as the fulfillment of the Law, Who became justification unto them that were formerly under the Law; and for our sake Christ was crucified and justified [us]...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Creation of John of Damascus.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: An evening song and rational service we offer unto Thee, O Christ: for Thou wast well pleased to have mercy upon us for the sake of Thy Resurrection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: O Lord, Lord, cast us not away from Thy face; but be well pleased to have mercy upon us for the sake of Thy Resurrection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O holy Sion, mother of the Churches, dwelling-place of God: for thou didst first receive forgiveness of sins for the sake of the Resurrection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Other Eastern Stichera.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: The Word born of God the Father before all ages: in the last times, incarnate of the unwedded Virgin by His own will, endured death upon the Cross: and saved man, deadened of old, by His Resurrection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Thy Resurrection from the dead we glorify, O Christ: wherewith Thou didst set free the race of Adam from the tyranny of hades, and as God didst bestow upon the world eternal life and great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Glory to Thee, O Christ Savior, only-begotten Son of God, Who wast nailed upon the Cross, and didst rise from the tomb on the third day!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Thee do we glorify, O Lord, Who willingly didst endure crucifixion for our sake: and unto Thee we bow down, O almighty Savior, cast us not away from Thy face; but hear and save us for the sake of Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Dogmatic Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋгꙋ́бъ є҆стество́м, а҆ не соста́во.
items.english_text: The King of heaven for His love of mankind appeared upon earth and lived among men: for taking flesh from the pure Virgin and coming forth from her with the assumption thereof, He is one Son, twofold in nature, but not in hypostasis: therefore, truly proclaiming Him as perfect God and perfect man, we confess Christ our God! Entreat Him, O unwedded Mother, that our souls may be saved![^306]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Возше́лъ є҆сѝ на Крⷭтъ ІС҃е: соше́-
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: въ а҆́дъ соше́дши, є҆го́же и҆ плѣнѝ.
items.english_text: Resurrectional. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆сѝ а҆́дова мꙋчи́тельства: и҆ ꙗ҆́ко
items.english_text: Thou didst ascend the Cross, O Jesus, Who camest down from heaven; Thou camest unto death, O immortal Life, the true Light unto them that were in darkness; the Resurrection and illumination of all them that had fallen: O our Savior, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: грѣхѡ́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ бл҃гоꙋтро́бе.
items.english_text: Other Stichera according to Alphabet:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ Воскресе́нїе ꙗ҆вле́й ꙗ҆́ко Бг҃ъ. не
items.english_text: We glorify Christ Who rose from the dead: for He assumed soul and body, and by His Passion separated them one from the other: His soul indeed descended into hades, which also He despoiled; but in the tomb His holy body saw no corruption, the Redeemer of our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: пре́зри и҆́хже созда̀ рꙋко́ю свое́ю:
items.english_text: With psalms and songs we glorify Thy Resurrection from the dead, O Christ, wherewith Thou didst free us from the tyranny of hades; and as God Thou didst bestow upon us eternal life and great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆́же по на́съ, на ра́ди воспрїе́мшїй
items.english_text: O incomprehensible Master of all, Creator of heaven and earth: by the sufferings of the Cross Thou didst pour forth dispassion unto me; and having received burial and risen in glory, Thou didst raise up Adam with Thyself by Thine almighty hand! Glory to Thy third-day rising, wherewith Thou hast granted us eternal life and cleansing of sins, as Thou alone art compassionate!

items.section:

items.english_text: O unwedded Virgin, who ineffably didst conceive God in the flesh, Mother of God the Most High: receive the supplications of thy servants, O all-immaculate one, who grantest unto all cleansing of transgressions: now receiving our entreaties, pray that we all may be saved!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: From on high didst Thou descend, O Compassionate One, and didst submit to three-day burial, that Thou mightest free us from our passions: O our Life and Resurrection, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: O Thou Who for our sake wast born of the Virgin and didst endure crucifixion, O Good One: Who by death didst despoil death and show forth the Resurrection as God: despise not them whom Thou didst create with Thine own hand; show forth Thy love for mankind, O Merciful One; accept the Birth-giver of God who bore Thee, who prays for us: and save a despairing people, O our Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: SUNDAY AT THE MIDNIGHT OFFICE

items.english_text: He plunged the armed Pharaoh into the deep:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Unto the Triple-radiant dominion, the Creator and Provider of all things, God Who alone is good by nature, and possesses the single glory of Godhead: we fall down before the single Beginning, singing the Thrice-holy hymn!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Remembering the divine utterances and the all-pure sayings that declared it: we glorify the single divine Nature, ever-existing, co-beginningless, in three Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, creative and almighty!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Abraham having become a sacred mystagogue, saw the Trinity of old in sacred manner, and receiving it as unto the Lord in three Persons, he rejoiced; and in three Hypostases he recognized the single dominion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Without experience of wedlock thou didst bear Christ, Who assumed our nature for our sake, O all-pure one, and remained unchanged in both: Whom do thou entreat without ceasing, to grant me forgiveness of sins and deliverance from temptations!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.english_text: Thou Who in the beginning established the heavens:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.english_text: Isaiah, seeing Thee on high upon the throne, O inaccessible God and King of glory, and the Cherubim and Seraphim crying aloud with unceasing hymns, praised the single three-hypostatic God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: The marvelous Word, begotten of the Father as from Mind, and the Holy Spirit ineffably proceeding: comprehended by each thought and by scriptural teachings, we honor the one Triple-radiant God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: The unbegotten Father, having incorruptibly begotten the Son as the radiance of His own essence, Light from Light, sets forth by procession the co-enthroned Light of the Spirit, all-creative and of equal honor!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Theotokion:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Thou wast shown forth as a pure temple, O Virgin Mother Mary: unto Him Who divinely, all-powerfully, and most wisely established the other creation, ordering and upholding it: make Him merciful through thy maternal prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Sessional Hymn, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: The power of the Triple-radiant and honorable Godhead let us, the faithful, praise in hymns: for by a nod alone He established all things: the higher angelic ranks and the lower sacred orders of the Church, that they may cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O most good God! Glory and song be unto Thy dominion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear the Unchangeable God: my heart, ever changing through sin and slothfulness by the assaults of the deceitful one, do thou, as good, establish by thy maternal prayers, that I also may thankfully glorify thee: O Birth-giver of God Mary, have mercy upon thy flock which thou hast acquired, O all-immaculate one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.english_text: The mysteries, O Christ Lord...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS

items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: The Orient of the Godhead having appeared: it dispersed all the dark night of passions from them that were in darkness, and the Sun of Righteousness shone forth: simple indeed according to essence, but three-hypostatic in Persons: Whom we ever praise and glorify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: же ли́цы. є҆́же ѻ҆у́бо пое́мъ при́сно,
items.english_text: Praised by Seraphic mouths, with one mouth we glorify Thee, the single and Triune in glory, in essence and in hypostases: crying aloud unto Thee for all: grant diverse forgiveness of sins unto Thy servants, O Upholder of all existing things![^307]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сего́ра́ди зовꙋ̀ живонача́льная Трⷪце:
items.english_text: Indivisible, all-compassionate, tender-hearted, loving mankind, honorable and divine Trinity: forget not me Thy servant unto the end, nor annul the covenant which Thou hast made with Thy servants, for Thine ineffable mercy's sake!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: А҆́гг҃лы: Ст҃ъ є҆сѝ, Ѽц҃е, и҆ Сн҃е,
items.english_text: He Who was born of thee, O all-pure one, One of the Trinity, the all-creative and divine Word, almighty God, renewed human nature: Whom do thou entreat without ceasing, to deliver me from all sorrow!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: дре́вле: и҆зба́ви ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїа, Трⷪце

items.english_text: My spirit seeks Thee early in the morning:

items.section:

items.english_text: I understand Thee, O three-hypostatic, co-ever-existing Three Persons glorified: yet one Lord, the divine Nature, simply dividing and uniting; and faithfully we cry aloud: O single Beginning, Holy Trinity, deliver Thy servants from sorrow!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪце пресвѣ́тлаѧ: ѡ҆ба́че и҆ мы̀, во-
items.english_text: I weep bitterly for the weakness of my mind: how do I suffer against my will? An unstable alteration in truth: therefore I cry unto the Life-originating Trinity: O Holy Trinity, establish me in the good station!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На землѝ возсїя̀, невече́рнее со́лнце:
items.english_text: Weighed down by the slumber of my sin, and cast into the sleep of death: as Thou art loving mankind, most good, and all-merciful, O divine Holy Trinity, have compassion and raise me up!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: O Virgin Mother, Maiden, all-pure, all-immaculate, full of God's grace: by thy prayers make Thy Son and God, the Lord Who loves mankind, merciful unto me; and speedily deliver Thy servant from the passions of sin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS

items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine...*

items.section:

items.english_text: Troparia:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Emulating the ranks of heavenly minds, O single Beginning of all, supersubstantial Trinity: with Thrice-holy hymns we glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: With our earthen lips, unto Thee Who didst create man according to Thine image, and didst most wisely bring all things from non-being, God in three Persons, I bow down and honor, sing and magnify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: O God the Ruler of all, and only Indivisible One: beholding me in Thine ineffable mercy, O three-hypostatic Master: enlighten me and give me understanding, as Thou art merciful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Thou wast shown forth as a temple unto the Uncontainable God, O all-pure one: show me also forth as a temple of divine grace, O all-holy Sovereign Lady, by thy supplications, and preserve me unharmed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Sessional Hymn, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: As beginningless Root, and co-beginningless Son, and Divine Spirit, truly we confess: unconfusedly, unchangeably, and indivisibly: a simple Trinity in essence and equal in dignity, singing with the Angels: Holy art Thou, O Father, and Son, with the most holy and honorable Spirit: remember them whom Thou hast created according to Thine image, O Word!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: We ever thank thee, O Birth-giver of God, and we magnify thee, O pure one, and bow down before thee: singing of thy birthgiving, O full of grace, crying unceasingly: Save us, O most merciful Virgin, as thou art good before the trial, that we thy servants may not be put to shame!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: The descending of the Father, the fire:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: By Thine ineffable wisdom and the abyss of Thy goodness, show me Thy servant pitied now as of old; and deliver me from affliction, O Trinity, single God, and from sins and passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: The Father unbegotten Father, and the Word begotten of Him, and the Divine Spirit, proceeding incomprehensibly: O single Beginning and Triple-radiant: unto Thee I sing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Slaying all by giving them to drink of the venom of sin, the enemy came upon me; but fleeing unto thee in faith, who didst bear the Prince of life: by thy prayers make Thy servant alive, and deliver me from assaults and passions, O only pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Sevenfold the furnace was heated:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Light unwaning, triple-radiant and supremely brilliant, single Beginning, sovereign, most simple, incomprehensible God, and sovereign Lord: now illumine my dark and darkened heart, and show it forth radiant and light-bearing, faithfully to praise and glorify Thee unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: With most sacred wings the divine Seraphim reverently cover their faces and feet, unable to endure the incomprehensible glory of Thy divine, self-beginning, supremely radiant Trinity: yet we also dare to sing of Thee and glorify Thee unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Beginningless Lordship, all-powerful, most good, perfect in origin, beneficent, creative, ever-existing, providing for and saving all, single in essence and in three Persons: I glorify Thee, O my God, in faith unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: The unwaning Sun shone forth upon earth by thy virginal birthgiving, O all-pure Sovereign Lady, and delivered earthly beings from the dark gloom of idolatry and evil: therefore now illumine me even more with the rays of the Godhead, and preserve thy servant!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: The heaven was amazed at this:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: O Nature ruling over all, all-creative, primordial, higher nature, life-originating, tender-heartedly loving mankind: O single Beginning, Trinity, we sinners now glorify Thee, asking forgiveness of sins, peace unto the world, and unity of mind unto the Churches!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: O single Dominion and Triple-radiant, single Beginning and Triple-sun: accept Thine own singers in beauteous manner, and deliver from transgressions, temptations, and difficulties; and speedily grant peace, O Lover of mankind, and union unto the Churches!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нственное Бг҃онача́лїе трїсо́-
items.english_text: Taking up Thine abode in the virginal womb, O Christ my Savior...[^308]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́сный. Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: И҆́же
items.english_text: ...wisely, in a God-man manner, unchangeably, unconfusedly in truth: and sanctifying forever, Thy mercy abides with Thy servants; therefore by the prayers of her that bore Thee, grant peace unto Thy Church!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́слъ є҆сѝ и҆зме́ртвыхъ живо́те
items.english_text: AT MATINS, AFTER THE PSALMS:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́сый и҆з̾ гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко вои́стиннꙋ:
items.english_text: "God is the Lord": and the Resurrectional Troparion. Glory: Now and ever: "O Thou Who for our sake wast born of the Virgin": Then the customary chanting of the Psalter.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́кѡ спаса́еши всѣ́хъ, Сп҃се на́шъ,
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: вся̀ тва́рь, а҆рха́гглїискїй собо́р,
items.english_text: Resurrectional. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ри́зѣ свое́й, и҆́же кри́ны се́лныѧ
items.english_text: Thou didst rise from the dead, O Life of all; and a radiant Angel cried unto the women: "Cease from tears, proclaim the good tidings unto the Apostles, crying aloud and singing: Christ the Lord hath risen, Who was well pleased as God to save the human race!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Having truly risen from the tomb, Thou didst command the holy women to preach the Resurrection unto the Apostles, as it is written: and Peter, running swiftly, came unto the tomb, and seeing the light in the tomb, he was amazed; and he saw the winding-sheets lying alone, which no one could see in the night: and believing, he cried aloud: Glory to Thee, O Christ God, for Thou savest all, O our Savior, for Thou art the Radiance of the Father!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Rejoice, thou who from the Angel didst receive the joy of the world! Rejoice, thou who didst bear the Creator of creation! Rejoice, thou who wast accounted worthy to be the Mother of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Resurrectional. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Men sealed Thy tomb, O Savior, and an Angel rolled away the stone from the doors: and the women, seeing Thee risen from the dead, proclaimed the good tidings unto Thy disciples in Sion: that the Life of all hath risen, and the bonds of death have been loosed! O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: The women, bringing burial myrrh, heard an angelic voice from the tomb: "Cease from tears, and bring joy instead of grief; shout aloud, singing: Christ the Lord hath risen, Who was well pleased as God to save the human race!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: In thee, O full of grace, all creation rejoices: the angelic assembly and the human race: hallowed temple and rational paradise, virginal boast: whereof God was incarnate and became a child, Who is our God before all ages! For He made thy womb a throne, and made thy belly more spacious than the heavens! In thee, O full of grace, all creation rejoices: glory to thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Ypakoë. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: The Myrrh-bearers, standing before the life-giving tomb, sought the Master, the Immortal One among the dead: and receiving the joyful tidings from the Angel, they announced unto the Apostles that Christ God hath risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Hymns of Ascent (Anavathmoi). Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Antiphon 1:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: From my youth the enemy tempts me and burns me with pleasures; but hoping in Thee, O Lord, I conquer him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: They that hate Sion shall become as grass before it is plucked up; for Christ shall cut off their necks with the cutting of torments!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit all things have life: Light from Light, great God, we sing praise unto Him with the Father and with the Word!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Antiphon 2:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: I cried unto Thee, O Lord, attend, incline Thine ear unto me as I cry; and cleanse me before Thou takest me hence!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: He that hath hope in the Lord shall not be afraid then, when He shall judge all things with fire and torment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit is the God-spoken unity, the Thrice-holy: for the Father is beginningless, from Whom the Son was timelessly begotten; and the Spirit, co-enthroned and conformed, proceeds from the Father!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Antiphon 3:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Let my heart be covered with Thy fear, being humble-minded: lest being lifted up, it fall away from Thee, O all-compassionate One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Everyone that departs unto his mother, the earth, shall come again to receive torments or rewards according to what he hath lived!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit everyone divinely sees and foretells: he works wonders on high, singing of one God in three Persons: for though it shines triply, the Godhead reigns as one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Antiphon 4:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Behold now, what is so good, or what is so pleasant, as for brethren to dwell together in unity? For herein the Lord promised eternal life [Ps. 132:1]!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Concerning His garment, He Who adorns the lilies of the field commands that it is not meet to be anxious [Matt. 6:28]!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit, as by a single cause, all things are upheld, giving peace: for He is God, consubstantial with the Father and the Son, in Lordship!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Prokeimenon, Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: The Lord shall reign forever: thy God, O Sion, from generation to generation [Ps. 145:10].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Then: "Let every breath praise the Lord" [Ps. 150:6].

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: The Resurrectional Gospel. Then: "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ": Psalm 50: And the rest in order.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: RESURRECTIONAL CANON.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: He plunged the armed Pharaoh into the deep: of old the wonder-working rod of Moses, striking the sea crosswise, divided it; and it saved Israel, the fugitive traveling on foot, as he sang a song unto God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: How can we not marvel at the almighty Godhead of Christ? Which gushes forth dispassion unto all the faithful from His sufferings, an ever-flowing fountain from the Holy One, and [everlasting life]!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Еѵ҆а́гглїе Воскре́сное. Посе́мъ, Воскресе́нїе
items.english_text: As Thou wast well [pleased to take flesh, O Christ], now having [sanctified] our nature [by Thy divine Passion]...[^309]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: въ ро́дѣхъ родо́въ: ꙗ҆́же Бж҃іе Сло́во
items.english_text: ...by the spear: The Lord hath risen!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [Прест҃аѧ] Бц҃е... [ꙗ҆́же воплоще́нно]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [Прⷭтая Бц҃е... Ра́й] живоно́сный и҆ все...
items.english_text: Most glorious things have been spoken of thee in generation and generation: who didst contain God the Word in thy womb, yet remainedst pure, O Virgin Mother of God: therefore we all revere thee, our mediatress before God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: [Прⷭтая Бц҃е... ты̀ есѝ па́че] ѹ҆ма̀
items.english_text: Another Canon, Cross-Resurrectional.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: спаси́тельною стра́стїю, ѡ҆правда́лъ
items.english_text: Ode 1. Heirmos: Passing through water:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскресе́нїя свѣ́тъ возсїя̀, и҆́же
items.english_text: The gates of anguish were broken open, and the gatekeepers of hades were terrified, beholding the Most High in the nether regions, Who is transcendent above all nature!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: дѧ́щи[мъ], Бг҃ъ мо́й ІС҃: и҆ свои́мъ
items.english_text: The angelic ranks were amazed, beholding fallen human nature, which had been shut up in the nethermost parts of the earth, seated upon the divine Throne!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ Бц҃е. Ты́ бо є҆ди́на
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: гоже ѹ҆страни́хся всѝ. Во́ньже вож[е]-
items.english_text: The angelic and human ranks unceasingly praise thee, unwedded Mother; for thou didst bear in thine arms, as an Infant, the Creator of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же премꙋ́дростїю вся̀ ѹ҆строя́яй
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сло́ве Бж҃ій, воскресе́нїемъ твои́мъ,
items.english_text: Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos: Let us sing unto the Lord:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ ꙗ҆ви́лся є҆сѝ человѣ́комъ, ꙗ҆́коже
items.english_text: [O Most Holy] Theotokos... who didst bear beyond nature the divine Word, [Who came in the flesh]: we sing praise unto thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ, І҆рмо́. Ты́ є҆сѝ ѹ҆твержде́нїе:
items.english_text: [O Most Holy Theotokos... as a] life-bearing [paradise] and all-pure Virgin, thou didst bear Christ, [Who] sprinkles... of salvation unto all the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: бы́[сть], нача́лника жи́зни мі́рови,
items.english_text: [O Most Holy Theotokos... thou who art] elevated beyond understanding... [save] thee!

items.section:
