items.english_text: A temple of God, the Ark, a living bridal chamber, and the gate of heaven, O Theotokos, do we the faithful proclaim thee: worshipping Him Who destroyed corruption as God, even thy Childbearing, O Mary Bride: we bow down before thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: As God with the Father and the Spirit, God the Word showed thee forth unto earthborn men, O Theotokos, as a heavenly ladder: for through thee He descended unto us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: KONTAKION, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Having risen from the tomb, Thou didst raise the dead, and didst resurrect Adam, and Eve dances in Thy Resurrection: the ends of the world hold festival at Thy rising from the dead, O most merciful One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: IKOS

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Having plundered the realms of hades, and having resurrected the dead, O long-suffering One: Thou didst meet the Myrrh-bearing women, bringing joy instead of sorrow: and Thou didst proclaim unto Thine Apostles the tokens of victory, O my Savior, Giver of life: and Thou dost enlighten creation, O Lover of mankind! Therefore also the world rejoices together at Thy rising from the dead, O most merciful One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: The fire was ashamed before the condescension of God in Babylon of old: therefore the Children in the furnace with joyful step, as in a radiant meadow, danced, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: The glorious self-emptying, the divine wealth of Thy poverty, O Christ, amazes the Angels, who behold Thee nailed in the flesh upon the Cross, in order to save them that cry aloud in faith: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: By Thy divine descent the nether regions were filled with light, and the darkness which formerly drove them was banished...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: ...banished: therefore the prisoners from the ages arose, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: As Lord of all, yet to the only-begotten Son alone, we orthodoxly proclaim Thee, glorifying His Father: one upright, co-essential, and co-eternal God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The Children from Judea:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: (Cross-Resurrectional)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: He wrought salvation in the midst of the earth, the all-pure One pierced with a spear: for having been lifted up upon the Tree, Thou didst call all that cry aloud in faith: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Having risen from the tomb as from sleep, O compassionate One: Thou didst deliver all from corruption, and creation was established by the Apostles who preached the Resurrection: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: We worship the Father, and the pure Son, and the Holy Spirit, confessing three consubstantial Persons, and one God and Lord, crying aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Having become incarnate from the virginal womb, Thou didst appear for our salvation: therefore knowing Thy Mother as the Theotokos, we orthodoxly cry: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: A Rod from the root of Jesse didst thou bud forth, O Virgin, an all-blessed Fruit, bearing the saving Flower unto them that cry aloud in faith unto thy Son: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ со гро́ба ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сна̀ ще́дре:
items.english_text: Fill all with wisdom and divine strength...[^311]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѡ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ Бж҃е, бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: ...divine strength: ordering the wisdom of the Most High for the sake of the Theotokos, unto them that cry aloud in faith unto Thee: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же и҆з̾преиспо́дни а҆́да возне́сша
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же въ тріе́хъ лицѣ́хъ ꙗ҆́звѣльнѡ-
items.english_text: Sevenfold the furnace the Chaldean tyrant fiercely kindled for the godly: but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried aloud unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing praise; ye people, supreme Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Па́че є҆стества̀ содѣ́теля и҆ Сп҃са,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆сте́ствомъ простъ сы́й: сложе́нъ...
items.english_text: The divine power of the Word of God hath divinely shone forth in us; for having taken upon Him the testament of death upon the Cross, He shattered the power of hades: Him unceasingly bless, ye children; praise, ye priests; supreme Him, ye people, unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: въ себѣ́ и҆з̾ соста́влѣ сло́ве Бж҃ій,
items.english_text: The Crucified hath risen! The haughty one is fallen! And fallen, crushed man is restored: corruption is overthrown, and incorruption hath blossomed; for that which was mortal hath been swallowed up by life! Ye children, bless; ye priests, praise; ye people, supreme Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: а҆ и҆́коже є҆стество́мъ бы́въ чл҃къ:
items.english_text: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: жїи твоѐ непобѣди́мо: є҆го́же бон...
items.english_text: The Triune Godhead, shining forth with single flash from one three-hypostatic Nature: the unoriginate Begetter, and the Son consubstantial with the Father, and the co-hallowed Spirit reigning on high: Ye children, bless; ye priests, praise; ye people, supreme Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дости, и҆ весе́лїа, и҆спо́лненна
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The victors in the furnace:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Кра́сенъ Бц҃е процвѣтѐ пло́дъ тво́й:
items.english_text: (Cross-Resurrectional)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же а҆́ще и҆ ꙗ҆́ко ме́ртва, въ гро́бѣ
items.english_text: Unto Him Who stretched out His hands upon the Tree for me...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: ...for me who was naked, calling me to be buried with His honorable nakedness, and to say: Bless all ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supreme Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Unto Him Who raised me that was fallen from nethermost hades, and honored me with high-enthroned paternal glory, as I cry: Bless all ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supreme Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Triadicon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: The indivisible Godhead manifest in three Persons, three Hypostases in one holiness and glory, singing: Bless all ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supreme Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The King of heaven:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Extinguish the burning and flaming arrows of adversities, O pure one: that we may sing praise unto thee unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Beyond nature didst thou bear God the Word, the Creator and Savior, O Virgin: therefore we sing praise unto thee, O pure one, unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Enlightening and gold-gleaming, an inaccessible lampstand in the dark, O pure Virgin, didst thou appear as a torch unto the world: therefore we sing praise unto thee unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: The heaven was amazed at this, and the ends of the earth were struck with wonder: that God appeared unto men in the flesh, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens: therefore the ranks of Angels and of men magnify thee, O Theotokos!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Being simple in Thy divine and beginningless Nature: Thou becamest composite...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: ...Thou becamest composite by the assumption of the flesh, subsisting in Thyself, O Word of God; and having suffered as man, Thou remainedst beyond passion as God: therefore we magnify Thee in two natures, undivided and unconfused!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Being Father according to divine essence, yet becoming man according to nature: the Son of God Most High descended unto His servants: and having risen from the tomb by the grace of the Father, He set forth for earthborn men God and Master according to nature: with Whom we all magnify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: O Virgin, Mother of God, thou wast seen to have borne beyond nature in the flesh the good Word: Whom the Father brought forth from His heart before all ages as good: Whom now we understand to be above bodies, even though He was clothed in a body!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Beginningless Nature:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: (Cross-Resurrectional)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: We all know Thee as Son by nature, conceived in the womb of the Mother of God, and become man for our sake, and nailed upon the Cross: suffering indeed by Thy fleshly nature, yet remaining impassible as God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Gloomy darkness hath been dispersed; for from hades the Sun of righteousness hath shone forth, O Christ, enlightening all the ends of the earth, the power of the Godhead shining upon frail man: Whom in two natures we magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: O Son of the Mother of God, subduing the Ishmaelite people that boast against us, grant victory unto the Christ-bearing king, as Thine invincible weapon: wherewith He hath endowed us...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: ...hath endowed them that are pierced with the spear of Thy Cross!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Truly the Birth-giver of God:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Full of joy and gladness is thy memory, flowing with healings unto them that approach: and piously proclaiming thee as the Theotokos!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: With psalms we sing praise unto thee, O full of grace, and unceasingly cry unto thee: Rejoice! For thou didst pour forth gladness unto all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Fair blossomed thy fruit, O Theotokos: bringing life unto them that partake of incorruption, and interceding for them that magnify thee in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: AT THE PRAISES: Resurrectional Stichera. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: O Lord, though Thou didst stand before the judgment seat, judged by Pilate, yet Thou didst not depart from the Throne, sitting together with the Father: and having risen from the dead, Thou didst deliver the world from the bondage of the stranger, as Thou art compassionate and the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou didst give us Thy Cross as a weapon against the devil: for he trembles and shakes, not enduring to look upon its power; for it raises the dead, and hath abolished death: therefore we worship Thy Burial and Thy Resurrection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Though the Jews laid Thee as dead in the tomb, yet the soldiers guarded Thee as a sleeping King, and sealed Thee with a seal as a treasury of life: but Thou didst rise and grant incorruption unto our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: скре́съ, и҆ пода́лъ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нїе
items.english_text: Thine Angel, O Lord, who proclaimed the Resurrection, struck terror into the guards, and cried unto the women...[^312]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: гл҃я: Что̀ и҆́щете, жива́го съ ме́рт-
items.english_text: ...saying: "Why seek ye the Living among the dead? He hath risen, being God, and hath granted life unto the world!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: се́нїе, є҆го́же ра́ди свободи́лъ є҆сѝ
items.english_text: Other Stichera, Eastern. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆́зъ, и҆ дарова̀ мі́рови, ꙗ҆́ко Бг҃ъ,
items.english_text: Thou didst suffer upon the Cross, being impassible in Thy Godhead; Thou didst accept three-day Burial, that Thou mightest deliver us from the bondage of the enemy, and make us immortal and quicken us, O Christ God, by Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ и҆ всеси́ленъ, воскре́слъ є҆сѝ
items.english_text: We worship, and glorify, and sing praise unto Thy Resurrection from the tomb, O Christ, whereby Thou didst deliver us from the insoluble bonds of hades, and didst grant unto the world, as God, incorruption and eternal life: for Thou alone art good and the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: на дре́вѣ: и҆ сподо́би всѣ́хъ є҆ди́не
items.english_text: The transgressors kept watch over Thy life-receiving tomb, and sealed it with a guard: yet Thou, as immortal God and almighty, didst rise on the third day!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Дне́сь ХС҃ воскре́съ ѿ гро́ба: всѣ̑мъ
items.english_text: When Thou didst descend unto the gates of hades, O Master Christ, and didst shatter them, the captives cried aloud thus: "Who is this, that He is not condemned in the nether parts of the earth, but hath destroyed the bonds of death like a shadow? I received Him as one dead, and I tremble at Him as God!" [O Lord, glory to Thee!]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: На дре́вѣ пригвожде́нъ бы́въ, Сп҃се,
items.english_text: Glory: Evangelical Sticheron. Now and ever: Thou art most blessed, O Virgin Theotokos: The Great Doxology: And the Dismissal.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: си́це и҆ на землѝ, ро́дъ чл҃чєскїй,
items.english_text: AT THE LITURGY:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѡ҆бою̀ вы̀, и҆ пре́лести ра́ди пріѧ́тъ
items.english_text: Beatitudes. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нство: сопресто́лнаѧ є҆ди́нице:
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the Thief upon the Tree: and account us all worthy of Thy heavenly Kingdom, O Thou Who alone art compassionate!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: В НЕДѢ́ЛЮ ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, НА ГДⷭИ ВОЗЗВА́ХЪ:
items.english_text: Today Christ hath risen from the tomb, granting incorruption unto all the faithful: and He renews joy unto the Myrrh-bearing women, after Thy Passion and Resurrection, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭи, безсо́нныѧ ли́ки А҆гг҃льскїа,
items.english_text: Having been nailed upon the Tree, O Savior, upon the wood: Thou didst deliver Adam from the curse of the tree, and didst restore, as Thou art compassionate, that which is according to Thine image, and the habitation of Paradise!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: As in heaven the multitude of Angels, so on earth the human race celebrates the most holy Resurrection of Thy goodness, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Raise us up from the tomb of sin, O Savior, who are deadened by many passions: and by Thy rising destroy the tyranny of death, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Hear, O Adam, and rejoice with Eve; for he that formerly stripped you both, and took you captive through deceit, is abolished by the Cross of Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Glory:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Beginningless Trinity, undivided Unity, co-enthroned Monad, equal in honor of glory, supreme Nature and Kingdom: save them that sing praise unto Thee in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Rejoice in our behalf, O Holy Theotokos, palace that didst bear joy unto the world! Rejoice, only mediatress of men, and salvation of our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: ON SUNDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Penitential Stichera, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: O Lord, Who camest into the world to call sinners, and didst receive the Thief, the Publican, the Harlot, and the Prodigal: call me also, who have sinned against Thee more than all men, O my Christ, though I repent not, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: O Lord, Who from publicans didst appoint a Pastor of Thy Church, and didst make him who was formerly a persecutor to be now a defender: by their supplications show me forth as Thine own sheep, O Savior, lest I follow after the stranger and become unprofitable, O Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Weep, O wretched soul, before the end, and cleave unto God, crying aloud unto Him for betrothal; and groaning for all wherewith thou hast defiled thyself: "I have sinned against Thee, O Christ, despise me not, I pray Thee: but having compassion upon me, as Thou art merciful, account me worthy of forgiveness!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Other Stichera to the Bodiless Hosts. Same Tone:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: O Lord, the assemblies of the Bodiless unceasingly glorify Thee, enjoying Thy beauty and Thine ineffable goodness, and being richly illuminated with three-sunned rays: by their supplications and intercession, O Savior, save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: O Lord, the sleepless choirs of the Angels Thou didst establish by Thy sublime Word...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: ...Word, and by Thy Holy Spirit, granting them a radiance that falls not away: by their supplications and intercessions, O Christ Savior, save all us that sing praise unto Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: O Lord, the Seraphim sing praise unto Thee: the Principalities, the Angels, the Authorities, the Dominions, the Thrones, the Powers, the Archangels, and the dread Cherubim sing hymns unto Thee: by the protection of them all, save all that sing praise unto Thee in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Continually do I anger and grieve the Creator; grant me amendment, O Maiden, having first made Him well-pleased; and by thine aid rise up unto works well-pleasing, that I may obtain salvation and forgiveness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Unto Thee, the King and God, the Angels unceasingly sing praise; and I fall down before Thee, crying like the Publican: O God, cleanse me and have mercy on me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се, всѣ́хъ на́съ спасѝ пою́щихъ тя̀.
items.english_text: Immortal art thou, O my soul; be not overwhelmed by the waves of this life: but crying with sober mind unto thy Benefactor: O God, [cleanse me and save me]!...[^313]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Мч҃нцы Гдⷭни, вся́ко мѣ́сто ѡ҆сщ҃а́-
items.english_text: ...cleanse me and have mercy on me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: А҆рха́ггла Гаврі́ила гла́съ воспріе́-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́мъ бл҃гоѹ҆тро́бнѣй Гдⷭи, ви́ждь
items.english_text: Ye Martyrs of the Lord hallow every place and heal every sickness: and now pray ye that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: моѐ смире́нїе, ꙗ҆́ко пома́лꙋ жи́знь
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ви́ждь моѐ смире́нїе, и҆ спаси́ мя.
items.english_text: Receiving the voice of the Archangel Gabriel, let us say: Rejoice, Mother of God, who didst bear the Giver of life unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се: є҆ди́нъ бо є҆сѝ безгрѣ́шенъ.
items.english_text: ON MONDAY AT MATINS:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйся, две́ри Цр҃я сла́вы: є҆́юже
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: любленїе: вѣ́нценосцы всехва́льнии.
items.english_text: O most tender-hearted Lord, behold my lowliness, for little by little my life is consumed, and from my works there is no salvation for me: therefore I pray: O most tender-hearted Lord, behold my lowliness and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ Сп҃са ѡ҆ на́съ моли́те А҆рха́ггли.
items.english_text: When the Day of the Judge is come, take heed, O my soul, and meditate upon the hour of that dread Day; for judgment is without mercy unto them that have shown no mercy: therefore spare me, O Savior, for Thou alone art sinless!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Conceiving in his mind the commanded mystery, the Bodiless One speedily presented himself in the tent of Joseph, saying unto the unwedded Maiden: He Who bowed the heavens by His descent is contained wholly and unchangeably in thee: and beholding Him in thy womb taking the form of a servant, I am amazed to cry unto thee: Rejoice, unwedded Bride!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Meditating upon that dread Day, O my soul, watch: lighting...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: ...lighting thy lamp and brightening it with oil; for thou knowest not when the voice shall come unto thee, saying: "Behold, the Bridegroom comes!" Take heed therefore, O my soul, lest thou slumber and remain outside knocking, like the five foolish Virgins: but wait vigilantly, that thou mayest meet Christ God with fatness of oil, and He may give thee the chamber of His divine glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Like the Harlot I fall down before Thee, that I may receive forgiveness; instead of myrrh I offer Thee tears from my heart: that as Thou didst have compassion on her, O Savior, so Thou mayest grant me cleansing of sins: for like her I cry aloud unto Thee: Deliver me from the mire of my deeds!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: With heavenly light this temple is enlightened today; for the angelic hosts rejoice therein, and with them the choirs of the Martyrs make merry in memory of the Passion-bearers: by their prayers send down peace and great mercy upon Thy world, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Rejoice, gate of the King of glory, through which the Most High alone passed, and which remained sealed according to His good pleasure, for the salvation of our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: After the 3rd Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Receive before the end, O my soul, the groaning of the Publican and the weeping of the Harlot, confessing unceasingly with weeping and mourning, with fasting, vigilance, and sorrow of heart unto Him Who knows thy secret deeds, crying aloud: "I have sinned; cleanse me, O Savior, by the prayers...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: ...of Thine Angels, as Thou art compassionate, and save me!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: How long, O my soul, dost thou live in negligence? How long dost thou abide in despondency? Arise from the sleep of despondency, O wretched one, taking knowledge of thy deeds! Tremble at the answer: what shalt thou answer in that hour? Or how, remaining unamended, shalt thou escape the burning that awaits thee? Cry aloud before the end unto the Judge: "Grant me forgiveness of transgressions, O Savior, for Thou alone art long-suffering!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: O full of grace, pure and blessed one, who didst bear Him Who was born of heaven through the compassion of His mercies: with the Hosts on high, with the Archangels, and with all the Bodiless Powers, unceasingly pray for us: that forgiveness and cleansing of sins, and amendment of life may be granted unto us before the end, that we may find mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: PENITENTIAL CANON.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Creation of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Passing through water as on dry land, and fleeing from Egyptian evil, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Deliver me from gehenna, which I have prepared for myself by unbecoming deeds, O Deliverer: and kindle in my mind the blessed fire of Thy love!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: I have bowed down unto the passions, and have been darkened, and have become irrational...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: ...irrational: having been honored by the Word, O Lord, grant recovery unto my soul: and by whatever judgments Thou knowest, save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Having their bodies tormented with wounds, they possessed an upright and inflexible character: even their love toward the Creator, O all-lauded crown-bearers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: The rivers of blood that flowed from the bodies of Thy holy, glorious sufferers, by Thy power, O compassionate One, quenched the thorns of idol-madness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Heal me, O pure one, who am grievously afflicted with deadly sin, from fleshly and spiritual defilements: that in faith I may ever bless thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Bodiless Hosts.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Creation of Theophanes. Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: As leaders of the holy Angels, enjoying the splendor of the vision of God: pray ye unto the Giver of grace and the Savior for us, O Archangels!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Held fast by distressing temptations, unto you as intercessors do we the faithful now flee, O divine Archangels: entreat the Good One in our behalf!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Be thou unto me a refuge, O Virgin: a harbor, a rampart, and an intercessor, who in the flesh didst bear God, the Mother of God: the Deliverer and all-compassionate One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: O Lord, Builder of the vault of heaven and Founder of the Church: do Thou establish me in Thy love, O summit of desires, confirmation of the faithful, O Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѹ҆твержде́нїе, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: With what eyes shall I look upon Thee, O Christ...[^314]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ни́сте нера́зꙋмїа те́рнїе: и҆ пло-
items.english_text: ...with what eyes shall I look upon Thee, O Savior, having not kept even one of Thy commandments upon the earth? How shall I stand before Thine unbearable Throne, to render an account of mine immeasurable evils?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: О҆рꙋ́жїемъ бл҃говоле́нїа, вѣ́рныхъ
items.english_text: Stretching out the hands of Thy compassions, receive me as formerly the Prodigal, who in like manner was enslaved to dishonorable passions, and departed far from Thee, O most good Jesus, Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆сполне́нїа, правосла́вїа добро́-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ста́телїе Бж҃їи, и҆зба́вьте, Боже́-
items.english_text: Rooted upon the rock of the knowledge of God, O Martyrs of Christ, passion-bearers: with the sword of faith ye uprooted the thorns of ignorance, and yielded the fruits of suffering!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ра́ненъ бы́сть вра́гъ ра́ною Мч҃е-
items.english_text: Unshakable pillars of true understanding, all-radiant adornments of the Church, most sacred sheep of Christ willingly slain: let the Martyrs be praised!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: пло́тїю: и҆́же бл҃гоꙋха́нїа поча́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́коже ѿ тлѝ ѻ҆́наго, спа́слъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Thee have I gained as a guardian in temptations, O most holy one; thee next to God have I as a vigilant intercessor: may I find thee, O Sovereign Lady, delivering me from all condemnation in the Day of judgment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆дꙋшевле́нный Влады́чнїй черто́гъ,
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ю́ще: ѡ҆ц҃ъ на́ши Бж҃е, бл҃гвнъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: (Canon to Bodiless Hosts)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́но є҆стество̀ Трⷪца, въ тріе́хъ
items.english_text: O light-radiant pair of the angelic rank, as chief commanders and masters, Archistrategoi: adorning the Church of Christ, ye firmly preserve her by your intercession!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: With the weapon of good will, the fulfillment of the faithful, being crowned today with the beauties of Orthodoxy: from tribulations deliver us, O benign intercessors of God, divine Archangels!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Thou becamest the divine Tabernacle of incorruptible life, higher than all, O pure Virgin Mother: therefore, all-holy one, direct me who am asleep in the shadow of death unto life by thy prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: From the overshadowing mountain, O Word, the Prophet divinely perceiving Thee about to become incarnate of the only Theotokos, with trembling glorified Thy power!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Great is the contest of the soul, perceiving the dread trembling: when the Judge sits, and each man's sins are made manifest! Woe is me, what shall I do, the condemned one?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Having a heart full of defilements, and the heavy burdens of sins, I flee unto Thy compassions: despise me not, but have mercy upon me, O Good One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Precious was your death found before God, O noble passion-bearers; for ye denied Him not when surrounded by myriads of sorrows and wounds!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: The enemy was wounded by the wound of the Martyrs; his haughty heresy is fallen: and the sacred Crown-giver is magnified, being glorified with divine songs!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Thee, pure receptacle of God, in faith I entreat: cleanse me, O Birth-giver of God, from every defilement, and show me forth as a temple unto the pure and divine Spirit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: I heard Thy report, O Lord:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: (Canon to Bodiless Hosts)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: O pair holding chief rule over the angelic choir: save from every adversity them that flee beneath your protection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Beholders of the primal brightness and grace-givers, all-glorious Archistrategoi: enlighten now your flock!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Sacredly do the divine hosts of the Bodiless glorify thee, all-immaculate Mother of God; for thou didst bear their Creator!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Enlightening us by Thy commandment, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant Thy peace unto us, O Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: By evil darkness have I embittered Thee, O Lord, committing unbecoming deeds: but have compassion upon me as I turn back, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Having a mind that rises not from evil, and through senseless insensibility: dispel my darkness, O Jesus, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Thou didst set Thy divine Martyrs in this age, O Giver of light, as precious stones shining with the knowledge of God, and dispersing the darkness of deceit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Against wicked laws ye set the divine laws: and preaching God, ye were slain for His sake, willingly enduring!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Slay, O pure one, the motions of my flesh: who by thy childbearing didst slay the living sin of our forefather, O Maiden!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: (Canon to Bodiless Hosts)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Standing around the Cross, O Archistrategoi, and enlightened thence by incorruptible rays: preserve your flock!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: That healing may be granted unto us, entreat the Master and our God, as intercessors of the deliverance of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Mystical myrrh do we name thee, all-pure one: as having borne God in the flesh, Who bestows gifts of sweet fragrance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Jonah in the whale, O Lord, Thou alone didst cause to dwell: and me that am bound in the nets of the enemy save, as Thou didst save him from corruption!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Cause the sunlit light of repentance to shine upon me who sit in the darkness of transgressions, O Christ, Giver of light: that I may sing of Thy grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: I tremble ever at Thy dread tribunal, yet I depart not from evils, being enslaved to evil custom: amend me, O Christ, that I may sing of Thy grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: The choirs of the honorable Martyrs suffered, and vanquished the demon ranks: and were united in joy with the angelic choirs: by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: By Thy strength Thou didst show forth Thy Martyrs as mighty, O Lord, and they cast down the whole power of the ancient deceiver: by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: That with compassionate voices I may ever glorify thee, all-blameless one, chase away the darkness of my soul: and by the light of repentance loose my gloomy transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: I pour out my prayer:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: (Canon to Bodiless Hosts)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Now standing before the dread throne, having become like God-seers without wavering: and filled with the splendor of the Holy Trinity: pray ye for them that flee unto you, that they may be delivered from temptations and passions, O Archangels!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Entreat ye that we may obtain blessed citizenship...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: ...blessed citizenship, who in faith praise you with hymns, and that we may be accounted worthy of everlasting joy and divine splendor, O God-beholding Archangels Gabriel and Michael all-glorious!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.english_text: The Children from Judea that arrived in Babylon of old: established by faith, trampled the flame of the furnace, singing: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.english_text: Grant me groaning, O Christ, as once unto the Publican and the Harlot, washing away the foulness of mine evils with tears: and have compassion upon me as I cry: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Having fallen among soul-destroying thieves, O Savior, and being sorely wounded: heal me with the oil of primal repentance, and make me complete to sing unto Thee: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:

items.english_text: Ye were deadened unto the world, and denying not Christ Who was dead and life-bearing, O noble passion-bearers, ye cried aloud, singing: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:

items.english_text: Cutting not asunder the one nature of the Trinity in three Characters, O wise passion-bearers of the Lord: ye destroyed manifold deceit, singing: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:

items.english_text: God the Word of God dwelt in thy womb, O Virgin pure Mother, and showed thee forth as our intercessor and hope as we cry: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Manifold grace, O divine Archistrategoi, hath the Benefactor of all granted unto you: Whom now the Church sings praise unto as ye protect her: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Strengthened by the power of the All-seeing One, ye traverse now all the ends of the earth, and save all that sing praise in faith: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Having thee now as a saving harbor, O Virgin Theotokos: we flee from worldly perils and turmoils, crying aloud unto thy Son: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.english_text: Him Who was manifested on the holy mountain, and in the fiery bush revealed the mystery of the Virgin unto Moses: sing praise unto the Lord, and supreme Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Enticed by fleshly pleasures, and foolishly departed far from Thee, O Word, and become like unto all the beasts: despise me not, O Savior, but turning me back before the end, save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Having no forgiveness of sins, never working conversion, I cry, the wretched one: I have sinned against Thee, O Lord, and the deceiver hath impoverished my soul, O compassionate One...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же Бж҃їе Бг҃ъ сло́во, въ ѹ҆тро́бꙋ...
items.english_text: The noble passion-bearers of the Lord, made all-radiant by streams of blood, were not defiled by second stains...[^315]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: ...were not defiled by second stains: and crowned, they keep festival with the Angels unceasingly!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Strengthened by the hope of future blessings, having nobly endured a multitude of torments for piety, and finished their course: they stand unceasingly before the throne of the Master!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Theotokion:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Thou art the confirmation of them that stand, and the restoration of them that are fallen, O Maiden: therefore raise me up that am fallen, that I may glorify thee, the blessed and full of grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS

items.section:

items.english_text: (Canon to Bodiless Hosts)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Receive the ministers and singers of Thine ineffable and unutterable glory, who now entreat Thee, O Christ, for the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: O Thou Who alone art good, O Christ: receive the angelic hosts now entreating Thee in our behalf, who sing praise unto Thee unto the ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: With radiant flashings, O Mother of God, thou enlightenest them that sing praise unto thee in faith and supreme Christ unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Every hearing was amazed at the ineffable condescension of God, how the Most High willingly descended even unto the flesh, having become man from the virginal womb: therefore the faithful magnify the all-pure Theotokos!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: As of old Thou didst cleanse the Harlot who fell down with weeping, O Christ Savior; and as Thou didst justify the Publican, speed forth, O God-inspired Word; as Thou didst receive Manasseh, and as Thou didst have mercy on David when he repented: so also receive me and save me, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Sigh and weep, O my soul, and depart from thy former sins...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: ...depart from thy former sins, and openly fall down before Him Who knows thy secrets, and warmly cry aloud: "I have sinned against Thee, O Lord, have compassion upon me, as Thou hast bowels of compassions, O most merciful One!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Having suffered most patiently upon the earth, the God-wise passion-bearers obtained an unshakable kingdom: and rejoicing, they partake of the delight of Paradise: by their prayers, O Christ God, make us partakers of all Thy glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Truly ye appeared as unwaning stars of the East, and destroyed the night of godlessness, O most wise ones; and with sacred rays ye illuminate all that magnify your light-bearing feast, O passion-bearers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Theotokion:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Enlighten, O Sovereign Lady, the radiant doors of mine eyes of heart, I pray thee, which deep sinful darkness hath darkened: and send down upon me the dawn of repentance, and from eternal fire deliver me by thine intercession, O pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Truly the Birth-giver of God:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: (Canon to Bodiless Hosts)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Confessing thee as truly the Theotokos, saved by thee, O pure Virgin, with the bodiless hosts we magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Show forth Thy Church imitating the choirs of the Bodiless by virtue, shielding Thy flock with Angels, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Pray ye that salvation may be granted by God, O angelic defenders, unto them that flee beneath your protection, O all-glorious ones!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле блꙋ́дницꙋ, со пла́че
items.english_text: As a morning dawn unto them that sit in darkness and error, O Virgin: holding the righteous Sun, Christ, upon thine arms, thou didst shine forth!...[^316]

items.section:

items.section:

items.english_text: When I take to mind the multitude of mine evil deeds, and come to the thought of that dread reckoning, held fast by trembling, I flee unto Thee, the Lover of mankind and God: therefore despise me not, I pray Thee, O Thou Who alone art sinless: grant compunction unto my humble soul before the end, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ста́нно прославля́ете є҆го̀. А҆́гглы
items.english_text: Grant me tears, O God, as formerly unto the sinful woman: and account me worthy to wet Thy feet, which delivered me from the path of error, and to offer Thee sweet-smelling myrrh: a pure life acquired by repentance: that I also may hear Thy good voice: "Thy faith hath saved thee, go in peace!" [Luke 7:50]

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.english_text: What shall we call you, O holy ones? Cherubim? For upon you Christ rested. Seraphim? For unceasingly ye glorify Him. Angels? For ye turned away from the body. Powers? Ye work in miracles: many are your names and greater your gifts: pray ye that our souls may be saved!

items.section:

items.english_text: Heavenly beings sing praise unto thee, O full of grace, unwedded Mother: and we glorify thine unsearchable Childbearing: O Theotokos, pray that our souls may be saved!

items.section:

items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the Thief upon the Tree: and account us all worthy of Thy heavenly Kingdom, O Thou Who alone art compassionate!

items.section:

items.english_text: Heal, O Christ, the passions of my soul, O Thou Who alone art the Physician of souls and bodies: and washing me with streams of compunction, cleanse me wholly, as Thou art merciful!

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

items.english_text: Standing around the throne of the honored Godhead, the Thrones, Cherubim, Principalities, and Authorities, and the other ranks of the Bodiless sacredly sing praise!

items.section:

items.english_text: Kindled with the warmth of the love of Christ: unconsumed in the midst of fire the sufferers remained, burning up the thorns of impiety by divine grace!

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: A scroll Isaiah of old foresaw thee, O full of divine grace, wherein by the Father's finger the Word was ineffably written, inscribing us in the book of the living!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: Penitential Stichera, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: No compunction have I gained, nor fountain of tears, nor warm confession, nor tears that bring tenderness, nor intellectual humility; neither have I become an emulator of the Publican, nor of the Harlot: how then shall I find deliverance from the torments of many sins? But by whatever judgments Thou knowest, O Christ, save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: Estranged from every divine commandment have I made myself; of the virtue of the soul I took no care at all, and foolishly I lived in prodigality through all my life: and unto myself I did all deeds unbecoming and lawless: therefore, O Christ, have compassion as Thou art tender-hearted, and save me from the abyss!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: Clothe me sacredly, the work of the hands of Thy goodness, who was torn away by senseless mind: O Lover of mankind, Who for my sake was well pleased to be born after me, for the sake of the abyss of Thine ineffable compassions: by the prayers of Thine ever-Virgin Mother, O Word, account me worthy of divine conversion, as God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Forerunner John.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: Blessed John Forerunner: ever increasing my humble soul in love toward the Lord by thy sacred intercessions...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: ...quench the fire of my pleasures, stir me up to the fulfillment of the divine commandments, and cleanse the feelings of my heart in truth, that I may glorify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: Offspring of the barren woman, and garden of pious purity, adornment of men, all-lauded Forerunner John: divine guardian of my humble soul, grant beneficence by thy prayers, delivering me from the serpent's deceit, and from his wicked assaults and snares!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: All sweetness art thou and delight, filled with divine grace, O ever-glorious one, gladdening all that in faith come unto thee: sweetening human infirmities of soul and body, sorrows and assaults of evil, and destroying for us the bitterness of all soul-corrupting pleasures!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆мѣ́я пꙋчи́нꙋ, и҆ сп҃се́нїа ꙗ҆́вль-
items.english_text: All my hope I place in thy protection, O pure Birth-giver of God: from temptations, perils, dread outpouring of wrath, and demonic oppression save me, as thou hast an abyss of mercy, and wast revealed as the mediatress of salvation, O Sovereign Lady: who didst bear the merciful God, Who alone is all-compassionate and abundant in tender mercies!...[^317]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ ко́мъ бл҃гоѹ҆тро́бный Гдⷭи, ви́ждь
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: моѐ смѣре́нїе, ꙗ҆́ко пома́лꙋ жи́знь
items.english_text: Unto Thee, the King and God, the Angels unceasingly sing praise: and I fall down before Thee, crying like the Publican: O God, cleanse me and have mercy on me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ви́ждь моѐ смѣре́нїе, и҆ спаси́ мя.
items.english_text: Immortal art thou, O my soul; be not submerged by the waves of this life: but arise, crying aloud unto thy Benefactor: O God, cleanse me and have mercy on me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃се: є҆ди́нъ бо є҆сѝ безгрѣ́шенъ.
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: вѣ́ры: и҆ че́стное дарова́нїе дꙋша́
items.english_text: Ye Martyrs of the Lord, pray unto our God, and entreat for our souls a multitude of compassions, and cleansing of our many transgressions, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Хѐ: въ ѹ҆́мѣ пріемлю дн҃ь и҆ ча́съ:
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: сꙋ́да, сама̀ себѐ ѡ҆сꙋдѝ: и҆ ѹ҆бѣ́-
items.english_text: Rejoice, boast of the universe! Rejoice, temple of the Lord! Rejoice, overshadowing mountain! Rejoice, refuge of all! Rejoice, golden lampstand! Rejoice, pure glory of the Orthodox! Rejoice, Mary Mother of Christ God! Rejoice, Paradise! Rejoice, divine table! Rejoice, temple! Rejoice, all-golden jar! Rejoice, hope of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ прове́дшемꙋ І҆и҃ля, сквозѣ̀ че́р-
items.english_text: ON TUESDAY AT MATINS:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆спо́лни срⷣце моѐ ѹ҆миле́нїа, Хѐ:
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ле́нїа в̾слѣ́: и҆ и҆сповѣ́данїе при-
items.english_text: O most tender-hearted Lord, behold my lowliness, for little by little my life is consumed, and from my works there is no salvation for me: therefore I pray: O most tender-hearted Lord, behold my lowliness and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Въз̾я́стеся ко высотѣ̀ вели́кое мꙋ́-
items.english_text: When the Day of the Judge is come, take heed, O my soul, and meditate upon the hour of that dread Day; for judgment is without...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и҆ ѡ҆тверзꙋ́тиѧ мѝ ко грѣхꙋ̀ ѡ҆бра-
items.english_text: ...without mercy unto them that have shown no mercy: therefore spare me, O Savior, for Thou alone art sinless!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тѝ стє́зи, да тя̀ пою̀, многопѣ́тꙋю
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Потрясе́мъ въ мо́ри мꙋчи́[тельскомъ]...
items.english_text: As the unshakable establishment of the faith and the honorable gift unto our souls, in songs do we the faithful magnify the Theotokos: Rejoice, thou who didst contain the living Stone in thy womb! Rejoice, hope of the ends of the earth, and defender of the sorrowful! Rejoice, unwedded Bride!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Like the Harlot I fall down before Thee, that I may receive forgiveness; and instead of myrrh, I offer Thee tears from my heart: that as Thou didst have compassion on her, O Savior, so Thou mayest grant me cleansing of sins: for like her I cry aloud unto Thee: Deliver me from the mire of my deeds!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: My life is drawing to a close, and the dread throne is being prepared; life passes by, the judgment awaits me, threatening me with fiery torment and unquenchable flame: grant me a rain of tears and quench its power, O Thou Who desirest all men to be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: As spiritual luminaries were ye revealed, O holy Martyrs: for by faith ye destroyed the mist of deceit, enlightened your spiritual lamps, and entered with glory into the heavenly bridal chamber with the Bridegroom: and now pray ye that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: All-pure Virgin, Mother of Christ: healing the cruel passions of my soul, I pray thee: and grant forgiveness unto my transgressions...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: ...transgressions, which I have foolishly committed, defiling my soul and polluting my body, the wretched one! Woe is me, what shall I do in that hour when the Angels shall separate my soul from my wretched body? Then be thou my helper and intercessor, for in thee thy servant hath placed his hope!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: After the 3rd Kathisma, Penitential Sessional Hymns. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Taking to mind the day and the hour of Thy dread, awesome, and inexorable tribunal, O Master Christ: I tremble like a malefactor, having shameful works and cruel deeds, which alone I have zealously committed: therefore with fear I fall down before Thee, and painfully cry aloud: By the prayers of Thy Forerunner, O most merciful One, save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: O my soul, consuming thy life in negligence: arise at last and cry aloud unto repentance! Weep for the ruin of hardened hearts, lest thou wail there without success, shuddering with fear as thou meditatest upon the dread Second Coming; and before the judgment, condemn thyself, and thou shalt escape that righteous tribunal!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Glory: Now and ever: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
