items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Entreated by the prayers of Thy Bodiless Hosts, O Christ, and of Thy Forerunner, the Disciples, the Prophets, the Martyrs, and All the Saints, and of Thine unwedded Theotokos and good Mother: grant us to walk in Thy light, and account us worthy to obtain Thy Kingdom, for the tender mercies of Thy grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: PENITENTIAL CANON.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Creation of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Unto Him Who crushed wars with His arm, and led Israel through the Red Sea: let us sing unto Him as our Deliverer, for He hath been glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Fill my heart with compunction, O Christ, that through repentance I may enter into the habitation: and I will bring confession unto Thee, Who hast loosed me from debts!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Loose me, O Word, from the bonds of my countless evils: that I may walk in repentance in Thy righteous paths, which guide unto the divine resting-place of eternal beauty!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: The great majesty of Thy Martyrs was lifted up unto the heights, O Christ, having suffered most excellently: and they were magnified with Thy supreme gifts of grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: By the sprinkling of the divine blood of the holy sufferers, the blood sacrifice offered by the enemy ceased: and the earth was sanctified by the grace of the Spirit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Show me the paths of repentance, O Virgin: and turn my steps that open unto sin, that I may sing praise unto thee, all-hymned Birth-giver of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Forerunner John.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: Same Tone and Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: [Let us shake the tyrant in the sea]... O Forerunner, herald of repentance... my soul being bound by vows, ever pray unto the Savior and Lord, enlightening my mind and heart, who honor thee in love!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прⷭте́че, проповѣ́дниче покая́нїа...
items.english_text: As a most fair nurture...[^318]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆тверди́ся срⷣце моѐ ѡ҆ Гдⷭѣ: воз-
items.english_text: ...most fair nurture, O Forerunner, Martyr of Christ: guide me who am now in the wilderness of the passions unto the life of repentance, by thy divine prayer!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: несе́ся ро́гъ мо́й ѡ҆ Бз҃ѣ мое́. раз-
items.english_text: Quickly deliver me by thine intercession from sin which torments me, O wise Forerunner, I pray thee: and destroy the moving darts of demons against us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: бл҃гоꙋтро́бїа Гдⷭа всѣ́хъ, Прⷭте́че
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Оуслы́шахъ Гдⷭи слꙋ́хъ тво́й, и҆ ѹ҆-
items.english_text: Save me, Mother of the Truth, who am sorely tempest-tossed by passions and often submerged: and direct me, O pure one, unto the calm harbor of salvation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: My heart hath been established in the Lord: my horn hath been exalted in my God; my mouth hath been enlarged over mine enemies: I have rejoiced in Thy salvation [1 Sam. 2:1]!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Wash my heart clean from malicious defilement, and account me worthy to appear blameless before Thee in the dread Day, O my Christ, as Thou art most good!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Belial was able to deaden me through deceit by the sting of sin, O Word; but do Thou Thyself heal me with the life-bearing remedies of repentance, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Couragiously the passion-bearers cried aloud unto one another in the stadium: "Let no one deny! The Master stands before us as helper, while we suffer with noble mind!"

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Precious stones of the Church, divine pillars of piety, overthrowers of deceit: let us all praise, honoring in faith the Martyrs of the Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Restoration of the fallen, O all-pure one...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: ...raise me up that am fallen from the pit of mine evils, and establish me, O Sovereign Lady, upon the rock of the commandments of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Another Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: (Canon to the Forerunner)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Establish our mind and hearts: rain down upon me a drop of repentance, O thou who in the river Jordan didst baptize the tender-hearted Lord of all, O Forerunner and Martyr worthy of glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: My mind is ever tossed about by the entwined waves of life: I flee unto thy protection, O Forerunner of the Savior: speed forth as a helper unto thy servant!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: In nightly prayers I call upon thee, the torch of day unto the world, O God-blessed Forerunner: enlighten the feelings of my heart!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Rejoice in our behalf, O Holy Theotokos! Rejoice, thou who didst bear joy unto the world! Rejoice, jar whence the heavenly Manna was given unto all the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: I heard Thy report, O Lord, and I was afraid: that by Thine ineffable counsel, being God everlasting, Thou didst come forth incarnate from the Virgin! Glory to Thy glory, O Christ; glory to Thy power!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: The deceiving enemy by the tasting of sinful deceit hath driven me far from Thee, O Good One, and by his custom hath made me his food: speed forth, O Thou Who alone art the Savior, to deliver me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Unrevealed and secret things of mine Thou Thyself knowest, O Lord, who have sinned much against Thee: have compassion according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies, as Thou art the Word of God abundant in mercy, and grant me a cleansing season of repentance...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: ...grant me a cleansing season of repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Being tempest-tossed by torments as by waves, O Martyrs, by the pilotage of Christ ye were guided unto the harbors of the heavenly Kingdom, having severed the enemy: truly adorned with crowns!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Having renewed the earth by piety through sufferings, O Martyrs: ye sowed the seed of confession upon it, and reaped the harvest of eternity from martyrdom, a fair ear of wheat yielding a hundredfold by grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: All-pure Sovereign Lady, fill my thought with all joy as I sing aloud unto thee: granting me good weeping, causes of repentance, and understanding of salvation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: I heard Thy report, O Lord:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: (Canon to the Forerunner)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: I weep for myself, having an uncorrected life ever: save me and have compassion upon me, O Forerunner, who have sunk in sins!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: In prayers and supplications may I find thee as a helper, O blessed one, strengthening my soul and illuminating my thought!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Submerged by the tempest of transgressions and in peril, O Baptist of Christ: guide me unto the harbor of divine knowledge!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Having humbled me who live in high-mindedness, save me, O all-pure one: who didst bear Him Who exalted our humbled nature, O all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Drive away the darkness of my soul, O Giver of light, Christ God, Who didst banish the primordial darkness from the abyss: and grant me the light of Thy commandments, O Word, that rising early in the morning, I may glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst cleanse the Harlot and the lepers by Thy command, Creator of all things: cleanse my humble soul from the defilement of sin, and make it beautiful with shining garments, O Master!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Loosing me from the bonds of my many transgressions, O Christ God: direct me to walk without stumbling in Thy paths, that being delivered from the flesh and having dwelt in the resting-place of the Saints, I may glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Having decayed the garment of their bodies in afflictions, the glorious Martyrs, being clothed, were adorned: they dwell in the Kingdom on high in joy, adorned with radiant severed crowns!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: The fury of the persecutors the Martyrs wisely exchanged: being weighed down and surrounded by diverse torments, they hastened rejoicing unto the true expanse of the heavenly Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Holy Theotokos, who didst bear in the flesh the Holy Word, Who alone rests upon all the Saints: hallow my mind, that it may ever cleave unto good works!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: From the night of ignorance:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: (Canon to the Forerunner)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: In the night of life, enlighten me who have gone astray, O glorious Forerunner: who art the lamp of the Sun of righteousness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: In the coming judgment, when I am to stand before the Tribunal: may I find thee as an intercessor, O Forerunner, delivering me from dread condemnation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: И҆стлѣ́вше въ болѣ́зней се́бѣ ѡ҆де́-
items.english_text: In assault, and shaken by the attacks of demons: establish me...[^319]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...established upon the rock of divine desires imparted unto me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: As thou art higher than all creatures, O Mother of God, ever-Virgin: [show me delivered from the snares of the enemy]!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Even as Thou didst deliver the Prophet from the nethermost deep, O Christ God: so also deliver me from my sins, as Thou art the Lover of mankind, and direct my life, I pray Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Accept me at the last: even as once Thou didst the Ninevites who repented at the divine preaching of Thy Prophet, O Christ: and direct my life, I pray Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Like the Publican I groan; like the Harlot I shed tears; like Peter I cry aloud: being submerged by many transgressions, O Christ: stretch forth Thy hand of help unto me, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: As divinely radiant beacons, ye illumine all the surrounding world with the rays of your sufferings: and disperse the darkness of deceit, O Martyrs of Christ, by your confession!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having found a most blessed end, O all-holy Martyrs, ye ever honor the blessed God: taking delight in His splendors!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The jar that received the Manna formerly prefigured thee, O Theotokos: for thou didst bear Christ, Who gave the spiritual Manna unto all that honor thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Grant me a voice:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to the Forerunner)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: By the tears of true repentance cleanse the substance of my heart, O all-wise John: making it fruitful in virtues!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Surrounded by the corners of afflictions, and groaning from the depth of my heart unto thee, O immaculate one...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...deliver me from cruel afflictions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O my soul, repent fervently: the judgment hath drawn near; arise, crying aloud: O my Jesus God, for the sake of Thy Forerunner, do Thou have compassion upon me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O pure one who alone in the flesh didst bear the Word: deliver our souls, I pray thee, from the snares of the enemy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou Who didst save the Children from the fire through the Angel, and didst turn the furnace roaring with flames into cool dew: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Since I was conceived and born in iniquities, O compassionate One: I have sinned more than all men: grant me a time of conversion that will justify me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having exalted myself foolishly as formerly the Pharisee, I have fallen down in a grievous fall, and the adversary rejoices over my fall; O Word of God, despise me not!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The assembly of the honored Martyrs, the invincible army, the holy regiment: having shown themselves surpassingly upon the earth, they dwell in the heavens!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having endured suffering with fortitude, the Martyrs, mediating immortality: pour forth a stream of healings, putting human passions to shame!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Beyond cause thou bearest the magnificent Cause, Who through the multitude of His goodness became man: therefore with one accord we bless thee, O pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to the Forerunner)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou Who didst establish the earth upon understanding:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Forerunner who didst prepare the ways of the Lord: direct my paths unto Him, that I may cry aloud: Blessed art Thou unto ages, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O preacher of the Light, enlighten my soul: and deliver me who flee unto thee with unswerving soul from cruel darkness and burning gehenna!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O fruitful son of a barren mother: by thy prayers transform the fruitlessness of my heart into good fruitfulness, O all-wise Baptist of Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O chosen Ewe-lamb of God the Word: entreat Christ Who was incarnate of thee, that He may number me with the chosen sheep at the dread hour!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou Who coverest Thy high chambers with waters, Who settest the sand as a bound unto the sea, and Who upholdest all things: the sun chants praise unto Thee, the moon glorifies Thee, all creation brings praise unto Thee, as the Creator of all unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O my soul, thou hast greatly defiled thy hands with evil deeds: and how wilt thou lift them up on high unto the all-knowing God? Thou hast made thy feet unprofitable, walking in lewd ways: make haste to lay hold of the paths of salvation through repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I have never walked in Thy commandments, O Lord; I have not performed Thy will for even a single day, O Good One: how then shall I look upon Thee with mine eyes when Thou sittest to execute righteous judgment, sending the guilty into the fire of gehenna?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ye quenched the burning furnace of polytheism, O wise sufferers...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...shedding your many streams of blood unjustly poured out for the sake of the love of the Creator: therefore take delight in the torrent of pleasure!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The holy passion-bearers by patient endurance rose above the earthly body: and the torments, enduring as if another were suffering the severance of hands and feet, whence they are accounted worthy of everlasting life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Tossed about by the storm of sin, I cry aloud unto thee, O good and pure one: by thy mediation direct me unto saving repentance and unto the eternal haven: that I, who am continually darkened by slothfulness, may know the light of salvation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The beginningless King:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to the Forerunner)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Entreat the Lamb of God Who bears away the sin of the world, Whom thou didst point out unto all, O Forerunner: to put my passions to death and to save my soul!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Lighten the burden of my soul, O Baptist of the Lord, vanquishing them that burn me: and show me uninjured from their malice!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou didst withdraw far off, O Forerunner, and didst make thy dwelling in the impassable wilderness: therefore I pray thee, quickly extinguish the burning passions of my soul!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou art the Vine, O Virgin, who didst bear the ripe Cluster: watering me now with the wine of compunction, take away the drunkenness of mine evils!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel: Who hath raised up a horn of salvation for us...[^320]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: и Прр҃че, и предстꙋпи Бг҃у спасенна,
items.english_text: ...in the house of David His servant; wherein the Dayspring from on high hath visited us, and hath directed us into the way of peace [Lk. 1:68-69, 78-79]!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Иже древле Хрⷭ҇та въ водах крⷭ҇тившии,
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВО ВТОРНИКЪ, ВЕЧЕРЪ. НА ГДⷭ҇И ВОЗЗВАХЪ:
items.english_text: That I also may be saved, I give thanks unto Thee, O Christ, and magnify Thee; look down upon me who have received many wounds upon my back: and heal me, pouring in the wine and oil of the knowledge of Thy compassion, O Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Even as Thou didst deliver the good-natured thief from murder and cruel ruin at his innocent cry: even as Thou didst show mercy unto the weeping harlot, and unto Peter the great disciple, and David the Prophet: so also have mercy upon me, O Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Having become conformed unto the Passions of Him Who suffered for our sake, the passion-bearers are glorified together with Him: being deified by divine communion, and shining brighter than the rays of the visible sun: ye enlighten the hearts of the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: The virtue of the holy sufferers shone forth, enriching every city with these imperishable treasures of faith: shining with the consecrated grace of most glorious miracles: we hymn them as fervent protectors!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: With the illuminating splendors of the Son of God Who came forth from thy womb, O all-immaculate one: enlighten them that sing praise unto thee in faith: and deliver from ignorant darkness and future torment us that have thee as mediatress of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Another Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: (Canon to the Forerunner)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Him Who was manifested on the mountain:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: When I am about to stand before Thy dread tribunal, O Word, and the cause of my deeds is to be examined: what answer shall I find, wretched as I am? For the sake of Thy Baptist, O Lord my God, spare me then!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: As the voice of the Word: direct my paths unto God, O all-wise Baptist: and deliver me from the malice of demons and from the assault of men: that I may worthily bless thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Feed me with the immortal food of Christ's commandments; give me to drink of the water of life, O Baptist and Prophet: and present me saved unto God, who flee under thy protection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: O pure and most glorified Virgin Theotokos: with the Forerunner pray thou unto thy Son and God, to save from every distress them that bless thee in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Penitential. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: When I consider in my mind the multitude of evils committed by me, and come to the thought of that dread examination: seized with trembling, I flee unto Thee, the Lover of mankind and God. Therefore, despise me not, I pray Thee, Who alone art without sin: grant compunction unto my humble soul before the end, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Grant me tears, O God, as once unto the sinful woman: and account me worthy to wet Thy feet that have delivered me from the path of error; and to offer unto Thee the myrrh of sweet fragrance: a pure life acquired by me through repentance, that I also may hear Thy gracious voice: Thy faith hath saved thee, go in peace [Lk. 7:50]!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Greatly did ye contend, O holy ones, enduring torments from the lawless with valor: confessing Christ before kings, and having departed from life, ye work wonders in the world: and heal the sick by your sufferings, O holy ones. Intercede that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Thy protection, O Virgin Theotokos, is a spiritual infirmary: for fleeing thereto, we are delivered from spiritual illnesses!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: ON TUESDAY,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: The Beatitudes. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree: and account us all worthy of Thy heavenly Kingdom, O Thou Who alone art compassionate!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Extinguish the abyss of my transgressions, O Christ, Son of Wisdom: and wash me with tears of compunction, cleansing me entirely, as Thou art merciful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: O divine Baptist who of old didst baptize Christ in the waters: direct my heart, sharpened by repentance, unto the haven of salvation by thy supplications!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: By your blood, O holy passion-bearers, ye quenched the fire of idolatry: ye ever pour forth streams of healings, curing diverse passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Glory...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: O beginningless Father, and Son, and divine Spirit: by the prayers of the Baptist, appease the long-standing passions of my soul, O merciful One: and save me, Thy servant!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Deliver me from passions, and sins, and cruel future torment, by thy prayers, O most pure Theotokos: who blessest them that piously magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: ON TUESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: *Stichera of the Precious Cross, Tone 8.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Nailed upon the Cross, O Christ, Thou wast pierced in the ribs, and in Thy side Thou wast wounded: pouring forth drops of divine salvation unto me, O most good One, both blood and water, that Thou mightest wash away my festering filth and defilement. Glory to Thy goodness, O all-compassionate One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Having endured suffering, O Master, that Thou mightest grant passionlessness unto all them...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: ...that venerate Thy Sufferings, and voluntary Slaughter, and Spear, and Nails, and Reed: which Thou didst endure willingly in long-suffering, that Thou mightest procure passionlessness for me, O Lord, by Thy Sufferings!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы крⷭ҇тны, Гласъ, и҃. Под: Мч҃нци Гдⷭ҇ни:
items.english_text: The unblemished Heifer, beholding the Bullock voluntarily suspended upon the Tree, lamented and cried aloud with compunction...[^321]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...Woe is me, most beloved Child! What hath the ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, seeking to bereave me of Thee, O all-beloved One?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Tone the same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I cannot bear, O Child, to see Thee asleep upon the Tree, Who givest vigilance unto all: that Thou mightest grant divine and saving vigilance unto them that of old fell asleep through the slumber of the fruit's transgression, cried the weeping Virgin: whom we magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The unjust assembly lifted Thee up upon the Cross, O Lamb That takest away the sins of the world: and the spear pierced Thy ribs, O Long-suffering One; and they nailed Thy hands and Thy feet: O what wicked boldness! O what impudence! cried the most pure one with compunction, weeping!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: What is this sight that I now behold, O Master? Thou Who most marvelously holdest all creation in Thy palm art unjustly slaughtered upon the Tree like a lamb, O Word of God, hanged among the disobedient! O what forbearance! O what goodness of Thine, all-compassionate One! cried the all-immaculate one with tears!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: When the Ewe-lamb and Virgin beheld Thee, the Lamb, led unto the slaughter: she followed with tears, O Word, and cried aloud: Whither art Thou hastening, my Child? I shall go with Thee, my sweetest One; for I cannot bear not to behold Thee, O my Jesus abundant in mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Cross, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having been lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ God: and Thou didst open the gates of Paradise: we glorify Thy Sufferings!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou wast nailed upon the Cross, O Christ God: and didst save the human race: we glorify Thee, our Deliverer!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thy Martyrs, O Lord, forgot the things of this life and disregarded torments for the sake of the life to come: and were shown forth as heirs thereof: therefore they also rejoice with the Angels. By their prayers, grant great mercy unto Thy people!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Lord, when the sun beheld Thee, the Sun of righteousness, suspended upon the Tree: it hid its rays, and the moon turned its light into darkness; and Thine all-immaculate Mother was pierced in her maternal heart!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ON WEDNESDAY, AT MATINS,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Cross, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Beholding the Author of life hanging upon the Cross, the thief said: If He that is crucified with us were not God incarnate, the sun would not have hidden its rays, nor would the earth have quaked with trembling. But O Thou Who endurest all things: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Between two thieves Thy Cross was found as a righteous balance: for the one, it was dragged down into hades by the weight of blasphemy; but for the other, it was lightened of sins unto the knowledge of theology...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...O Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Beholding the Lamb, Pastor, and Deliverer unjustly lifted up upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb wept bitterly and cried aloud: The world indeed rejoices, receiving redemption through Thee; but my maternal heart burns, beholding Thy Crucifixion which Thou endurest for the tender mercy of Thy compassion, O most good, sinless Lord! Therefore with one accord let us cry aloud: O Virgin, have compassion upon us, and deliver thy servants from every distress!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Cross, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: In the midst of Eden a tree budded forth death; but in the midst of all the earth, the Tree blossomed life. For having tasted of the first fruit, being incorrupt, we became corrupt; but having obtained the second, we have enjoyed incorruption: for by the Cross we have been saved, since God is the Deliverer of the human race!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: In Paradise of old the tree stripped man bare, through the tasting of which the enemy brought in deadening; but the Tree of the Cross, bearing for mankind the garment of eternal life, was planted upon the earth, and all the world was filled with all joy. Beholding it lifted up, let us the faithful people cry aloud in faith unto God: Thy house is full of glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Shown forth as ever-shining beacons unto the universe through faith, O Martyrs, ye placed all your hope upon the Lord: and by the spiritual brilliance of the Holy Spirit, ye enlightened the eyes of your souls. Therefore, pouring out your blood like water as a spiritual chalice...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...ye were revealed unto the Church, O all-praised Passion-bearers: pray unto Christ God, to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto us that celebrate your holy memory with love!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: When thou didst behold Him Who was incarnate without change lifted up upon the Cross between two thieves, having taken up lamentation, thou didst cry aloud: Woe is me, my sweetest Child! How art Thou willingly crucified, Who takest away the sins of the world? For as Thou art compassionate, Thou didst desire, as God, that hymns of praise should be offered unto Thee by mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ, the unwaning Sun: through fear the sun was darkened, and all the earth quaked; the stones split apart in trembling, and the veil of the temple was rent in twain; and the dead arose from the tombs, glorifying the dread and divine condescension of our only God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The tree in Eden formerly brought forth bitterness; but the Tree of the Cross hath blossomed forth sweet life. For Adam by eating slid into corruption; but we, partaking of the flesh of Christ, are quickened and deified mystically, receiving the unshared Kingdom of God. Therefore in faith we cry aloud: Glory to Thy Passion, O Christ![^322]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Being preserved ever by the Cross of thy Son and God, O Virgin: we overcome demonic assaults and snares: chanting unto thee, the true Theotokos, and loving thee, all generations bless thee, O all-pure one, even as thou didst foretell. Therefore grant forgiveness of our transgressions through thy prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: CANON OF THE PRECIOUS AND LIFE-CREATING CROSS OF THE LORD.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Composition of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: He submerged the armed Pharaoh:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: When I was dead through the pleasurable fall by the tree, O Word: dying upon the Cross Thou didst quicken me, and didst adorn me with glory: I venerate Thy Wood, glorifying Thy Sufferings and boundless mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: When the Vine was stretched out upon the Tree: He poured forth the uncultivated wine of grace: gladdening hearts, utterly destroying the drunkenness of deceit, and cleansing sin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Adorned with wounds, O great martyrs, and beautified with the sufferings of torments: ye stand with glory before the Master Who made all things beautiful, shining ingloriously yet revealed as godlike!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Plainly strengthened by divine power, O blessed ones: ye manfully cast down all the destructive might of the strong one: and crowned with crowns of victory, ye stand rejoicing before God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Standing by Thy Cross, O Lord, she that knew not wedlock...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...and beholding Thy wounding, O Master, lamented and cried aloud: Woe is me, my Child! Having escaped pains in Thy birthgiving, now I am pained and torn with grief!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Heirmos the same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Upon thee, O Virgin, have I placed the hope of my salvation: wash me clean from all defilement of sin, and make me pure before God and thy Son, to do that which is well-pleasing unto His all-holy name!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Gate of Light, enlighten mine eyes which the gloomy serpent hath darkened with the darkness of transgressions; and open unto me the gates of repentance, O Virgin: and guide me unto life, snatching me from flame and darkness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Mother of God, as thou hast boldness toward the only-begotten Word Who was incorruptibly born of thee, and Who is co-beginningless with the Father: pray, O all-immaculate one, to deliver my soul from demonic malice, and from fire, and from every torment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Blessed is the Fruit of thy womb, O Bride of God: whereby all we earthborn were delivered from the curse: O blessed, all-pure one, ineffable wonder, incomprehensible vision, salvation of all the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Thou Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou Who didst establish the heavens, and didst lay the foundation of the earth, and didst bind the sea by Thy word: Thou wast proclaimed for my sake and nailed unto the Cross, that Thou mightest loose me from the bonds of sin, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Rushing against the Tree of the Cross, the enemy was slain together with all his evil deeds; and he that was condemned by deceitful arrogance was shown mercy: and the establishment of piety was established in Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Delivered over by the wicked persecutor unto diverse woundings, and to the sword, and to beasts, with stripped flesh, O divine and noble sufferers: ye remained unshaken by the divine nod!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Lifting up their contemplation and elevating their minds unto eternal things, the glorious Martyrs of Christ completely disregarded passing things: therefore rejoicing they endured unbearable pains!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The all-hymned Ewe-lamb, beholding the Lamb unjustly lifted up upon the Tree: lamented and cried aloud, weeping with maternal tears, singing and glorifying His long-suffering!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Thou art the establishment:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Directing all my desire unto thee, O good and pure one: quickly deliver me from carnal desires!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Shining upon me with the pure dawn of repentance, O good one, Gate of Light: disperse the mist of my sins!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O thou who alone art all-immaculate: deliver us from great reproach, and from coming temptations, and from eternal fire!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Hasten to visit him that is sick, O honored one: and deliver me from cruel wounds and from great sorrow!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou art my Christ, O Lord, Thou art my power Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The human race was raised up from the fall which the First-formed suffered of old: for the Creator of all was lifted up upon the Tree, His fingers stained with blood, willingly nailed by nails in His hands, and pierced with a spear in His side!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The Cross was set up, and all hades fell down: when Thou wast stripped naked, O Savior, the stranger was stripped bare; and Adam was clothed in the garment of divine incorruption: creation was enlightened when the sun was darkened, while Thou wast crucified upon the Tree, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: As lambs of the new slaughter, O Martyrs, ye were offered unto the slaughtered Word: by streams of blood having dried up the sea of deceit through divine grace, and having quenched the burning of passionate diseases by the shower of miracles, O glorious ones, ye are ever praised!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The severance of all limbs ye endured, O Martyrs: the tearing of skin and nails, the pitiless cutting off of hands and feet, of tongue, and the dismemberment of the joints of the body: therefore ye were accounted worthy of exceeding great glory, standing before the God of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Beholding her Lamb lifted up upon the Tree, the immaculate Heifer cried aloud with lamentation: My Child! How hath the lawless assembly shown no compassion at all unto Thee Who didst show them mercy, but through deceitful counsel unjustly resolved to deliver Thee unto death?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: I heard Thy report, O Lord:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Mine obscure soul, darkened by transgressions, do thou illuminate with light, O ever-Virgin: who didst bear the Sun of righteousness![^323]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Deliver me from temptations, and from the soul-destroying storm of life, and free me from eternal fire, O Bride of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O radiant and sacred vessel, and dwelling of the uncontainable Nature: enlighten my soul which is darkened by many passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O most holy Bride of God, Sovereign Lady of the world: save me, delivering me from tribulations and driving away the assault of passions by thy supplication!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Therefore hast Thou cast me off from Thy face:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: That Thou mightest deliver me from pleasurable tasting, O Long-suffering One, Thou didst willingly taste gall; and that Thou mightest strip me of deadness, O Jesus, Thou didst deign to be nailed naked upon the Tree: I sing praise unto Thy compassion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Making new my soul that had become corrupt through passions, O Word, Thou didst surrender Thy soul unto the Father while hanging upon the Tree: and the soulless earth, unable to endure this, shook with fear, singing praise unto Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ye were adorned, O divine Martyrs, being beautified with sufferings, and following in the footsteps of Him Who through His Passions granted passionlessness unto all, the only-begotten Word of the beginningless Father: therefore ye are glorified together with Him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having withdrawn from earthly things, ye inherited invisible things, taking up your abode in the heavenly mansions: and being deified immaterially by divine communion, O victorious Martyrs, ye are saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: An awesome vision do I behold! cried the all-praised one, sighing: How hast Thou Who by a nod shakest all the earth...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...fallen asleep, suspended upon the Tree, desiring to awaken sleeping men? I venerate Thy long-suffering, O my Son!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Rising early in the morning:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: We sing praise unto thee, O all-immaculate Virgin: who didst contain God the Word in thy womb, O all-blameless one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: From unquenchable fire and from the worm deliver me, O Mother of God: as thou hast the power to show mercy with compunction!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: A rampart and all-holy strength art thou unto the faithful: save from perils them that sing praise unto thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Heal my sick soul, O pure Sovereign Lady: who didst bear the salvation of all and the Bearer of diseases!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The abyss of sins and the storm of transgressions trouble me, and violently cast me into the deep of despair: but do Thou Thyself stretch forth Thy strong hand unto me, as unto Peter, and lead me up from corruption, O my God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: All the heavenly Powers sang praise and were terrified, beholding Thee, O Word, hanging upon the Cross: and wounded Adam was healed by Thy wound, O Savior, and the curse was banished!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Humanity is loosed from unbreakable bonds, when Thou, O Word, wast bound in the flesh: and the tormentor is exposed like a bird, and mocked in the hands of the faithful: glory to Thy compassion, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The passion-bearers of the Lord were revealed like coals of fire, burning up every substance of impiety by grace...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...and walking upon the coals of fire with pure feet, they received divine refreshment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Revealed as sheep of the true Shepherd, O passion-bearers: ye remained uninjured in the midst of wild wolves, and having finished well the divine course, ye took up your abode in the heavenly city!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: When the Virgin beheld Thee, the Life, Who art beautiful in countenance beyond the sons of men, she cried aloud: And how dost Thou die for my sake, O Son, without form upon the Crucifixion, Who didst adorn all things by Thy nod?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O pure Mary and all-honored dwelling of the Creator of all: granting tears that cleanse the soul, deliver me from future judgment and torment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Gate of God, show divine entrances unto my humble soul: entering into which with confession, I may receive forgiveness of evils, O Theotokos!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: A deep of sins and waves of despair buffet my mind: have compassion, O Sovereign Lady, and stretch forth thy hand unto me and save me, who didst bear the Savior!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: All we faithful have thee as mediatress and rampart, who ever find ourselves in the depth of evils, tumult, and afflictions, O Theotokos, sole refuge of the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The fire was ashamed before the condescension of God: Thou wast pierced in Thy hands wherewith Thou didst work miracles, O Christ, and didst endure wounds, healing all my wounds: I sing praise unto Thee, crying aloud...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou wast nailed in Thy hands and feet with nails, O Savior, when Thou wast crucified, and pierced in the side: pouring forth streams of forgiveness unto all them that unceasingly sing praise, saying: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The Martyrs of God formed a choir, singing praise: being numbered with the angelic ranks, and enlightening the earth, and ever chanting: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The universe, being illumined with the splendors of the Saints, sends up sanctification and deliverance unto all them that praise you, O divine Martyrs, and sing praise unto Christ: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: How hath the unwaning Sun set, crucified upon the Tree? cried the Virgin unto Thee, O Word; and seeing it, the sun stayed its course, unable to shine: while Thou sufferest, O Master, I praise Thy guilelessness, O my Son!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The Children from Judea:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I pray thee, O all-pure one: put to death the sin that dwells in me, and account me worthy to attain life, O Virgin, and deliver me from the portion of them that are tormented there!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Diverse passions surround me: O pure one who didst bear the Fountain of passionlessness, deliver me from their dominion and from eternal fire, O Theotokos, by thy prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Through willful inclination I have sinned, and I am enslaved to disorderly habits: renew me who now flee unto thy tender mercy, and save me from despair, O all-holy Theotokos: quench...[^324]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...quench the burning coals of the passions of my soul, and calm the storm of my heart, O pure Mother of God; and deliver me, O all-pure one, from demonic torment and from eternal fire!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Sevenfold the furnace:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having sprung from the root of Jesse, O Christ, incarnate: Thou dost root out the overgrowing thorn of Adam's transgression, wearing a crown of thorns and nailed upon the Tree, which budded forth healing from the wood for them that sing of Thy salvation: Children, bless; priests, sing praise; people, supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: That Thou mightest make man a lover of God, O Christ Lover of mankind, Thou becamest man and partookest of the Cross, pierced in the ribs and given vinegar with gall to drink: therefore, saved by Thy Sufferings, O Word, we cry aloud in thanksgiving: Children, bless; priests, sing praise; people, supremely exalt Christ unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Bound as martyrs and slaughtered like lambs, and pitilessly roasted upon the fire, cast unto wild beasts, and beheaded in the head: ye rejoice with ineffable joy, crying aloud: Children, bless; priests, sing praise; people, supremely exalt Christ unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Crowned Martyrs, companions of the Angels, who trampled underfoot the bodiless enemies: make supplication unto the Lord for us, that we may live in love and great unity of mind, crying aloud: Children, bless; priests, sing praise; people, supremely exalt Christ unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Maternally groaning in pain, lamenting, and unable to bear the agitation of her maternal heart...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...looking upon the Cross unto Him Who was born of her womb, she cried aloud: What is this sight, my Child? How dost Thou suffer, Who art impassible by nature, desiring in every way to free the human race from corruption?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The King of heaven:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Virgin Birth-giver of God: hide my sins, and lighten the burden of my transgressions, that I may magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Virgin who alone didst bear Christ God: by thy fervent and transforming supplications, show His prayer favorable unto me, O pure one, that I may be saved from eternal fire!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: My transgressions have multiplied, rising above my head, O Theotokos: give me now a helping hand, and deliver me, an unprofitable servant, from unquenchable flame!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Enlighten the eyes of my heart, I pray thee, O all-pure one, who am blinded by the blackness of sin, and show them receptive of divine radiance: that through thee I may appear pure unto thy Son!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Every ear was amazed at this:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou didst heal my wounds, O my Master, being wounded and staining Thy hands with blood: and to walk in saving paths, as Thou art good, Thou didst direct me, O Lord, having nailed Thy feet upon the Cross: seeing Thee walking of old in Paradise, the forebears hid themselves; but restored upon the Cross, the First-formed who fell in a great fall was righted...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...and all the might of the adversary fell down: and all the earth was sanctified by the blood and water poured forth from Thy ribs: therefore we unceasingly magnify Thee, O all-compassionate One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Blessed holy Martyrs: ye loosed the bonds of the wicked one, and by the fetters which ye patiently endured ye bound him, and made him subject beneath your feet, filled with shame and made a laughing-stock unto the beholders by divine grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The earth was sanctified by the laying down of the relics of the holy Martyrs; for it pours forth a fountain of great healings: these things divinely establish us, unceasingly curing the passions of body and soul, and banishing the malice of demons by divine grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having escaped maternal pains at the time of Thy birthgiving, O Long-suffering One: yet now beholding Thee partaking of the pains of suffering, and having received Thee upon her knees from the Cross, the all-pure one was filled with grief of heart and soul, and cried aloud: whom worthily we magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Amazed was every ear:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Theotokos)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Have compassion, O all-pure one, upon my wretched soul, and put to death destructive passions: and drive away tormenting perplexity, and grant me streams of holy tears multiplied: whereby I may be delivered from the cruel condemnation awaiting me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: A rampart unto Christians and a firm refuge unto the world, wherein we are saved, art thou, O pure Virgin Bride of God: for God, truly incarnate, gave thee unto all as a saving protection...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...therefore, O pure one, save me, the unworthy one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O beginningless Word of the Father, my Son, and co-enthroned with the Holy Spirit: how hast Thou stretched out Thy most pure hands upon the Cross? Whither hath Thy great poverty fled? cried the all-immaculate one, standing before Thy Crucifixion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Distilling divine sweetness, O thou that didst bear the Joy of all: sweeten my soul which hath been embittered by the venom of the serpent, alienating me from bitter sin ever through thine intercession, O unashamed mediatress of the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Cross, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The rod of Moses prefigured Thy precious Cross, O our Savior: for thereby Thou savest Thy people from the depth of the sea, as the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: In the Paradise of Eden of old, a tree bringing eating blossomed in the midst of the orchard; but the Church, O Christ, blossomed Thy Cross, pouring forth life unto all the world. But that one brought death unto Adam who ate thereof; whereas this one quickened the thief who was saved through faith. Show us also partakers of his salvation, O Christ God, Who by Thy Passion didst destroy the snares of the enemy against us, and account us worthy of Thy Kingdom, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Invincible Martyrs of Christ: having conquered deceit by the power of the Cross, and received the grace of eternal life, ye feared not the threats of the tormentors, and were glad when bruised with tortures...[^325]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ СРЕДꙋ, ВЕЧЕРЪ. НА ГДⷭ҇И ВОЗЗВАХЪ:
items.english_text: ...And now your blood hath become healings for our souls: intercede that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Beholding Thee nailed unto the Cross, O Lord, she that bare Thee, the pure one, in sorrow and weeping cried aloud: My Child, why dost Thou suffer these things in the flesh? Thou hastest to make me bereft of honor; make haste to be glorified, that I may be magnified by Thy Passion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: ON WEDNESDAY,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: The Beatitudes. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree: and account us all worthy of Thy heavenly Kingdom, O Thou Who alone art compassionate!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Prefiguring the Cross with his rod, Moses divided the deep, leading through the people of Israel; but we, picturing this, conquer noetic enemies!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Of old Jacob, blessing the children, the sons of his sons: stretching out his hands crosswise, prefigured Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, whereby we all were freed from the curse!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
