*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Emulating the Sufferings of Christ, O passion-bearers, ye manfully bore bitter torments: and crowned with incorruptible crowns, ye dwell in the heavens!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Glory...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: O Christ, Who art one in the Trinity: cause me to observe Thy laws, and snatch me from the lawful bondage of the wicked one by the power of the almighty Cross!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: From thy virginal womb, O pure one, the Creator of the sun and of day shone forth: beholding Whom suspended upon the Tree, all creation was shaken!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: *Stichera of the Holy Apostles, Tone 8.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: O Lord, with the rays of the Comforter Thou didst enlighten Thine Apostles, and set them as luminaries, the establishment of the faith, through the noetic illumination of Thy knowledge, O Master: therefore we venerate Thine ineffable love for mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: O Lord, by the prayers of the Apostles protect this Thy flock, preserving it unharmed from the assaults of enemies: since Thou didst redeem it with Thy precious blood from the bondage of the stranger, as Thou art compassionate and the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Ye appeared together in the foundation of the Church like precious stones, shining upon the universe with bright radiance, the certain knowledge of God, O divine Apostles: intercessors before the Trinity, and pray-ers for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Tone the same.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou didst glorify Thy holy hierarch Nicholas in the ends of the earth, giving unto him the grace of miracles, and showing him forth as a champion unto them that are in cruel perils, and who fall under the affliction of sorrows, and who ever ask of him protection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: O Lord, through the divine supplications of Thy hierarch, have mercy: and deliver Thy servants from every distress, and from all harm, and from the assault of enemies, who in faith venerate Thine invincible dominion!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Having thee as an advocate and fervent protector before the Sovereign Lady, O Nicholas: we flee unto thee in faith, and cry aloud: Turn us not away, unprofitable ones, from thy protection, but show thy mercy stretched out over thy servants!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Behold the groaning of my contrite heart, O Bride of God; accept, O Virgin Mary, the lifting up of the hands of me, thy servant, as thou art the lover of mankind, and cast me not off, O all-immaculate one: that I may sing praise and magnify thee, who didst magnify our race!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Of the Holy Apostles. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: O Lord, Thine Apostles, truly loving Thee upon the earth, counted all things as refuse that they might gain Thee alone: and for Thy sake they surrendered their bodies unto wounds: therefore, being glorified, they pray for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou didst magnify the memory of the Apostles upon the earth: assembled together on this day, we glorify Thee, for through them Thou grantest healings unto us, and peace unto all the world by their prayers, and great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: If there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, it is meet for the Saints: for having bowed their necks unto the sword for Thy sake Who didst bow down the heavens and descend, they shed their blood for Thy sake Who didst empty Thyself and take the form of a servant; they humbled themselves even unto death, emulating Thy poverty: through the multitude of whose tender mercies, O God, have mercy upon us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: I, O holy Virgin Theotokos, flee under thy protection: I know that through thee I shall find salvation, for thou art able, O pure one, to help me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: ON THURSDAY, AT MATINS,

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Luminaries unto the world and guides of our salvation: let us sing praise unto the divine Disciples of our God from the beginning; for they shone forth like light unto us that were in darkness, and proclaimed the Sun of glory unto all. Therefore they also cast down idolatrous deceit, having trumpeted forth the proclamation of the one Godhead: therefore we pray unto you, O Apostles: intercede with Christ God to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto us, and great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїры сты Ап҃лѡ, Глас, и҃. по: Гдⷭ҇и аще и на сꙋдищи:
items.english_text: Into all the ends of the earth went forth your all-wise utterance: for truly, O all-praised Apostles of the Lord...[^326]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: ...ye proclaimed the knowledge of God openly unto the world, and converted gentile ignorance into understanding: whence, having driven away idolatrous mist, the light of understanding shone forth unto them that were in darkness: therefore we pray: Intercede with Christ God to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto them that celebrate your holy memory with love!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Having fallen into manifold temptations from enemies visible and invisible, and held fast by the tempest of mine innumerable sins, O all-pure one: I flee unto thy grace as unto fervent protection, and rampart, and my haven. Therefore, O all-pure one, pray thou unto Him Who was incarnate of thee without seed on behalf of all thy servants who unceasingly sing praise unto thee, O immaculate Theotokos: entreating Him earnestly to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto them that venerate thy birthgiving in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Of the Apostles, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Into all the earth, as the Prophet said, went forth the utterance of the all-wise Apostles: for having proclaimed the Word, they enlightened all nations. Therefore, worthily praising them, let us honor them with songs, for they ever intercede with Christ that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Having put to death the fiery looks and motions of the passions through abstinence, the Martyrs of Christ received grace to drive away illnesses from the sick...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: ...and while living in rest to work wonders in truth, a most glorious miracle: that bare bones pour forth healings! Glory to the one all-wise Creator God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: O receptacle of the faithful, Birth-giver of God, joy of the sorrowing, and great consolation of the weeping: pray thou unceasingly together with the holy Apostles unto Him Who was born beyond nature from thy womb, O all-holy Virgin, to deliver us from every testing and cruel condemnation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Ye appeared as radiant luminaries, eyewitnesses of Christ: ever enlightening all the earth, and driving away the darkness of polytheism with the light of the teachings of piety. Therefore, enlighten me who am in the darkness of passions, walking without fear, by your holy prayers, O God-bearing Apostles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Catching men endowed with reason alive in the net of divine words like fish: ye brought them as firstfruits unto our God; and having loved the wounds of Christ, ye desired them, and were shown forth as imitators of His Sufferings. Therefore, having come together, we worthily honor your celebration today, O glorious Apostles, and with one accord cry aloud: Intercede with Christ God that forgiveness of transgressions may be granted unto them that celebrate your holy memory with love!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: O Theotokos, pray thou together with the Apostles...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: ...unto the incomprehensible Son and Word of God, Who was ineffably born of thee incorruptibly beyond understanding, to grant true peace unto the universe, and to bestow upon us forgiveness of transgressions before the end, and to account thy servants worthy of the heavenly Kingdom for the sake of His extreme goodness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: CANON TO THE HOLY APOSTLES.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Passing through water as on dry land:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: The light-bearing choir of the Apostles, standing before the great Light: illuminate my darkened heart, and direct me unto saving paths!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Close friends of the Deliverer: deliver me from friendship with passions, who am overcome by many deceptions of life, and covered by the night of ignorance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Heal the weapon-wounded of the wicked one, being the arrows of the Mighty One, O divine Apostles: unto them that flee under your protection in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: He that is full empties Himself in godlike manner, and issues from thy womb bearing flesh, O pure Mother: saving by His compassion them that were deceived by the malice of the serpent!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Another Canon to Saint Nicholas.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Composition of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Unto Him Who cleft the unhewn sea:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: O sacred and supreme among saints, standing all-blessed before the throne and God: save us who upon earth continually invoke thee, Nicholas, from every cruel affliction: asking forgiveness of our transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Enriched with thee as an advocate, O Nicholas, in day and night we cry unto thee in faith: now incline unto us who are sorely troubled by demonic evil plots and corrupt men, that having obtained refreshment, we may praise thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: With the strongest sinews of thy prayers, O Nicholas, having delivered unto utter destruction them that strive to strangle us: deliver us from their cruel plot, who cry aloud in praise: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Beyond the laws of nature thou didst bear God the Lawgiver, Who became man: entreat Him as good, O all-immaculate one, to overlook our iniquities, who ever cry aloud: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Thou art the establishment of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord, Thou art the Light of the darkened: and my spirit chants praise unto Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Gird my fainting heart with power, O Apostles of the Savior, and by your noetic thoughts, O brightest divine radiance: destroy the darkness of polytheism!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Heal the cruelest woundings of my heart, as physicians with divine motion of the hands, O Disciples of our God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: O pure Sovereign Lady, haven of salvation: who beyond nature didst bear the Creator of all, both Master, and Savior, and Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Священный высшїй святых, прⷭ҇толу и Бг҃у
items.english_text: Another Heirmos the same.[^327]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Saint Nicholas)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: That we may honor thee and sing praise unto thee, O holy one: grant us a hand of help, O hierarch Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Put to sleep, O Nicholas, by thine unsleeping prayers, the affliction that rises up against us, we pray thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Heal me who am wholly surrounded by passions and by the temptations of wicked men, by thine intercession, O Saint Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Pray thou, O pure one, unto the Deliverer to grant me forgiveness of sins and deliverance from the cruel distresses of life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ye were adorned, O glorious Apostles, being beautified with divine splendors, and enlightened with rays by Him Who showed you forth as luminaries unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Deliver me from a great storm, O helmsmen of all, divine Apostles: who am in peril in the abyss, and troubled by the temptations of life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O horses chosen of God, who troubled the sea of polytheism: drown the abyss of my transgressions by your prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Equally effective with the Father, O Virgin, thou didst embody the Word from thy womb: therefore thou wast revealed as higher than all creatures, O Sovereign Lady!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos the same:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Saint Nicholas)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: From the multitude of my transgressions I have fallen into a multitude of innumerable sorrows: show thyself, O Saint Nicholas, as helper and benefactor!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I weep for myself who am lost, living in slothfulness...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...by thy prayers, O Nicholas, lead me unto repentance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Nicholas who didst deliver the three youths from being surrendered unto death: deliver me from every constriction and from eternal condemnation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Strengthen me, O all-pure one, who am devoid of spiritual understanding: directing the movements of my soul unto life-bearing entrances!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Rising early in the morning we cry unto Thee, O Lord, save us: for Thou art our God, and beside Thee we know no other!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Being straitened by many transgressions: direct us unto saving expanse, as helmsmen, O Apostles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O eyewitnesses of God in the Spirit: deliver me who am caught in the snare of dishonorable deeds, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having emulated the holy Sufferings of the Savior: drive away all voluptuousness from my soul, O Apostles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Heal my sick soul, O all-pure Sovereign Lady: who didst bear Him Who bears away the diseases of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos the same:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Saint Nicholas)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Strengthen us by thy prayers, O divinely blessed Nicholas, to keep the commandments of Christ, our only God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having lived in Myra, O Nicholas: fill us with divine fragrance, who piously sing praise unto thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Have compassion upon us through thy prayers, O hierarch: entreat God, the all-compassionate, O Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Being full of life-bearing waters, O Maiden...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...give drink unto all of us that piously and wisely sing praise unto thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I pour out my prayer unto the Lord, and unto Him will I declare my sorrows: for my soul is filled with evils, and my life hath drawn near unto hades; but like Jonah I pray: Lead me up from corruption, O my God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: By the invocation of prayers ye cast down the temples of idols, O Disciples of Christ: but I pray in faith: crush the idols of my mind, and show me forth as a temple of God, who am guilty of many sins!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Built upon the rock of discernment, as chosen stones, O eyewitnesses of God: save my heart built upon the moist sand, for the rivers of temptations rush together and cruelly batter me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Deliver me from the deceitful friendship of the flesh, O friends of the Word, and bring me who have become hateful through much malice unto the love of the Beloved, through the forgiveness of sins for the sake of His great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: As a rose, as a chosen lily, as a sweet-smelling fragrance from the damp valleys of the world: the Creator, having chosen thee, O Maiden, dwelt in thy womb, and being born, filled all things with fragrance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos the same:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Saint Nicholas)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thy heart was revealed as a Paradise, O Nicholas, having the Tree of life in its midst, Christ the Deliverer: Whom entreat unceasingly...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...to make citizens of Paradise all of us that have acquired thee as a fervent protector!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: In slothfulness I pass my life, and unceasingly I sin, wretched one: and I behold that ineffable judgment there, and I am seized with fear: have compassion upon me, O God, by the prayers of Nicholas, as Thou art compassionate!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Against the storm of manifold temptations that suddenly comes upon me for the multitude of my sins, I cry: Leave me not, O blessed one, without protection; but stretch forth unto me a hand of merciful help, and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Palace of the high King, and fiery throne wast thou, O Virgin, higher than the Cherubim and Seraphim beyond understanding: therefore let every breath glorify thee as the Mother of the Creator!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The Hebrew Children in the furnace boldly trampled upon the flame, and turned the fire into dew, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The night of slothfulness holds me fast, and the darkness of sin covers me: O all-wise Apostles who were revealed as the light of the world, hasten to enlighten my darkened heart!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Revealed as another heaven, declaring the glory of our God: deliver from the misery of passions, O divine heralds, them that flee in faith under your mighty protection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Revealed as fiery coals, O Apostles: kindled by the fire of the Comforter...[^328]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...burn up every substance of our malice, and deliver us from unquenchable fire unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou wast revealed as an overshadowing mountain unhewn, from which the Cornerstone was cut: therefore grant compunction, O Sovereign Lady, unto my soul darkened and petrified by bitter pleasures!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos the same:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Saint Nicholas)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou didst pour forth streams of teachings, and driedst up the torrents of heresy, sweetly watering the souls of the faithful, O sacred minister Nicholas: therefore we honor thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou wast strengthened by the power of the Trinity, prevailing to destroy the sluggish idols: therefore, by thy faithful prayer, drive away the passionate idols of my mind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having become the first-enthroned hierarch of the people of Myra, O venerable one: after death thou pourest forth divine myrrh, driving away our foul-smelling illnesses, O all-blessed Nicholas, from them that approach thee in faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou didst stay the mortal assault, having borne the immortal God: Whom pray, O pure one, to put to death the passions of my humble body, and to account me worthy of life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Sevenfold the furnace:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Strengthen my soul that is shaken by passions, O ye who are the indestructible foundations of the Church and immovable pillars, the ramparts of the faithful, fishers of them that are in the deep of perdition, pleasant havens unto them that sing in faith...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...Children, bless; priests, sing praise; people, supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Unto me lying in the pit of dark despair, and fallen into the nether pit of passions: raise me up by your prayers, have compassion, O Disciples of the Savior, who were enriched with the Teacher's compassion, as ye were accounted worthy, O God-beholding Apostles, unto ages of ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Bright in the beauties of virtues didst thou appear, O all-pure one: having contained in thy womb the fair-visaged beauty of the Creator of all: Whom earnestly entreat, O pure one, to enlighten my soul, held fast by the growth of sins and estranged from ancient beauty, exceedingly beautiful, unto ages of ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The God-proclaiming Children:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Saint Nicholas)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Being an illuminator, O divinely wise hierarch, with the light-bearing rays of the sunlike Godhead: destroy the darkness of my passions, O Nicholas, by thy prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O sacred initiate Nicholas, who by an awesome appearance didst deliver the generals from death: deliver us from great deadly harm!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Strengthen us by thy prayers, O all-blessed Nicholas, who are shaken by demonic temptations and by abusive men: and keep us unharmed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Offer supplication unto the Lord, O most holy Virgin, helper of mankind: to have compassion and to save them that flee unto thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Amazed was the heaven at this, and the ends of the earth were struck with awe, that God appeared unto men in the flesh, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens: therefore the ranks of Angels and men magnify thee, O Theotokos!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having crushed the jaws of soul-destroying deceit by divine power, O Apostles: ye were set as princes upon the earth by Christ, spiritually correcting with psalms in piety: therefore subdue the disorderly audacities of my heart unto the divine law!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having proclaimed in the world the Word of God, Who appeared more beautiful than all the sons of men: your feet were adorned, as ye preached the Gospel of peace and life unto all: therefore by your prayers put to death my soul which is languishing with passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having put to death your limbs upon the earth, ye were clothed with great life, having depicted the Passions through passions: therefore quicken me who was slain by the arrow of the malice of the wicked one, through the remedies of true repentance, O divinely blessed Apostles!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Heal my soul that is sick with cruel passion, O thou who didst bear the most good God, as thou art merciful: and deliver me ever, O all-pure one, from the enemies that destroy me and attack me: that being saved, I may earnestly magnify thee, who didst magnify our race!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Truly the Birth-giver of God:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to Saint Nicholas)

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: As the deliverer of them that pray unto thee in faith: deliver me from all malice of visible and invisible enemies, O all-blessed Nicholas...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...all-blessed Nicholas!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Dwelling now with the heavenly choirs, O most sacred father Nicholas: by a nod of the Good One, intercede that we may obtain mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The judgment is at the doors, take heed, O my soul! And cry aloud unto the Judge and God: By the prayers of Nicholas, spare me, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O receptacle of the Light: enlighten my soul, O Virgin, which hath been darkened by passions: that in faith and love I may ever glorify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Apostles, Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Lord, Thine Apostles, truly loving Thee upon the earth, counted all things as refuse that they might gain Thee alone: and for Thy sake they surrendered their bodies unto wounds: therefore, being glorified, they pray for our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou didst magnify the memory of the Apostles upon the earth: assembled together on this day, we glorify Thee, for through them Thou grantest healings unto us, and peace unto all the world by their prayers, and great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Clothed well in the faith of faith, and armed with the weapon of the Cross: ye appeared as valiant soldiers, manfully opposing the tormentors, and casting down the deceit of the devil; having become victors, ye were accounted worthy of crowns: pray unceasingly on our behalf, that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Snatch me, O Sovereign Lady, from the hands of the serpent...[^329]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: наго, Дв҃о всенепорочнаѧ. Иже клѧтву печаль
items.english_text: ...of the manslayer, who desires craftily to swallow me up utterly: crush his jaws, I pray thee, and destroy his snares: that, delivered from his claws, I may magnify thy protection!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Въ ЧЕТВЕРТОКЪ ВЕЧЕРЪ. НА ГДⷭ҇И ВОЗЗВАⷯ:
items.english_text: On Thursday, at the Divine Liturgy.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: The Beatitudes. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, even as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree: and account all worthy, O Thou Who alone art compassionate, of Thy heavenly Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Revealing yourselves as the trumpets of Christ, O Apostles: ye raised up them that were lying in the graves of wicked belief, and made them partakers of divine life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Sowing the secret seed of the Word of God, O eloquent ones: ye made the barren hearts of all the nations fruitful with divine understanding...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: ...with divine understanding: therefore ye are worthily blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Stripping away great malice from themselves, the champions passed manfully through the midst of cruel trials, and were clothed from heaven with a robe of radiance!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Glory... Triadikon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Put to death the uprising of passions, O honored, all-holy Trinity, by the prayers of Thy divine Apostles: that, being saved, we may glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Rejoice, O all-immaculate Virgin, who didst heal the curse of divine sorrow, and them that proclaimed the curse unto Adam, O all-pure Theotokos: through whom we have been delivered from corruption!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: On Thursday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: *Stichera of the Precious Cross. Tone 8.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: O most glorious wonder! The life-bearing tree, the all-honored Cross, is shown today lifted up on high! All the ends of the earth glorify it, and all the demons are driven away! O what a divine gift hath been bestowed upon earthly men, through which, O Christ, save our souls, as Thou art alone compassionate!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: O most glorious wonder! As a cluster of divine life, borne from on high, taken up from the earth: the Cross is exalted today...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: ...whereby we have all been drawn unto God, and death hath been swallowed up utterly! O all-honored Tree, whereby we have taken delight in the immortal food in Eden, glorifying Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Many are Thy bounties toward us, O good Jesus! How Thou didst humble Thyself, and became man, and didst will to suffer the Cross and shameful death, held fast for the sake of unprofitable servants! What worthy gift, meet for God, shall we offer unto Thee? Only glorifying Thee, we the faithful give thanks!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: O the ineffable goodness of Him Who was incarnate of thee, O all-hymned Theotokos! For as the Lover of mankind He endured the Cross and death, that He might save the world which He created. Entreat Him to deliver me, wretched one, from painful torment, and to settle me where the unwaning Light shines!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: What is this visible sight which is seen by mine eyes, O Master, Who upholdest all creation? Lifted up upon the Tree, and dying, Thou givest life unto all! The Theotokos, weeping, cried aloud when she beheld the King and God, Who shone forth ineffably from her, lifted up upon the Cross!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Deliver from tribulations, O all-pure one, by thy precious prayers, the flock which Thy Son and God acquired and sprinkled with His Blood: driving away visible and invisible enemies like wild beasts, and fill their faces with dishonor, even as David the singer proclaimed of old, O pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Beholding Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Jesus, and willingly accepting sufferings, the Virgin and Thy Mother, weeping, cried aloud: Woe is me, my sweet Child! How dost Thou suffer wounds unjustly, O Physician Who didst heal human infirmity and didst deliver all from corruption by Thy tender mercy?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Precious Cross. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ God, Thou didst save the human race: we glorify Thy sufferings!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Nailed upon the Cross, O Christ God, Thou didst open the gates of Paradise: we glorify Thee, our Deliverer!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: O Martyrs of the Lord, ye sanctify every place and heal every infirmity: and now pray ye that our souls may be delivered from the snare of the enemy, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: The unblemished Heifer, beholding the Bullock willingly lifted up upon the Tree, weeping bitterly, cried aloud: Woe is me, longed-for Child! What hath the ungrateful Jewish council rendered unto Thee, desiring to make me childless of Thee, O Beloved?

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: On Friday, at Matins.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Precious Cross. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Beholding the Author of life hanging upon the Cross, the thief said: If He Who is crucified with us were not God incarnate, the sun would not have quenched its rays, nor would the quaking earth have trembled! But Thou Who endurest all things, remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: In the midst of two thieves Thy Cross was found as a righteous balance: unto the one, bringing him down into hades by the weight of blasphemy; but unto the other, lightened of sins, unto the knowledge of theology: O Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхиры Крⷭ҇тны, гласъ, и҃. Под: О преславное чудо:
items.english_text: Preserved unceasingly by the Cross of Thy Son and God, O Virgin: the demonic snares...[^330]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: ...and assaults we repel, singing praise unto thee who art truly the Theotokos: and with love all generations bless thee, O all-pure one, even as thou didst foretell. Therefore grant us the forgiveness of transgressions by thy prayers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Precious Cross. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: In the midst of Eden, the tree blossomed forth death: but in the midst of all the earth, the Tree grew forth life! For having tasted of the first fruit, being incorruptible, we became corruptible; but having partaken of the second, we have enjoyed incorruption. For by the Cross Thou hast saved the human race, as Thou art God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: The tree in Paradise stripped me bare of old, the enemy bringing in death through tasting: but the Tree of the Cross, bearing the garment of eternal life for men, was planted upon the earth, and all the world was filled with all joy! Beholding it exalted, let us the people cry aloud in faith unto God with one accord: Fill Thy house with glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Today this temple is enlightened with heavenly light: for the angelic hosts rejoice in God, and with them the choirs of Martyrs make merry at the memory of the passion-bearers. At their supplications, send down now, O Christ, peace unto Thy world, and great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Beholding Him Who was incarnate of thy precious blood, and Who beyond understanding was born of thee, O pure one, hanging upon the Tree in the midst of evildoers, suffering in thy womb, and weeping like a mother, thou didst cry aloud...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: ...Woe is me, my Child! What is this divine and ineffable dispensation of Thine, whereby Thou hast quickened Thine own creation? I hymn Thy tender mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Precious Cross. Tone 8.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Christ Savior, and by Thy death, the tyranny of the enemy was cast down, and death was put to death; and the dead whom hades held fast from the ages were suddenly loosed as captives, praising Thy dominion, and Thy dread and divine descent, O Good One, whereby Thou hast saved all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Hoping for false deification, the forefather became the author of corruption for all: but Thou, by Thy Cross, hast granted unending life as Thou art most good: for Thou wast willingly nailed, that Thou mightest loose us from the first condemnation. Therefore we hymn Thy voluntary Passion, O Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: The unblemished Ewe-lamb, beholding the Lamb and Shepherd hanging upon the Cross, cried aloud: My Child, what strange and unexpected sight is this? How is Life condemned unto death, like unto earthly men? But rise again on the third day from the dead, as Thou didst say: that rejoicing, I may glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Canon to the Precious and Life-creating Cross of the Lord.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: A work of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Moses, having traced the Cross cut the Red Sea upright with his rod for Israel that went on foot; and turning it back, he struck and united it over Pharaoh and his chariots, writing crosswise the invincible weapon: therefore let us sing unto Christ our God, for He hath been glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Stretching forth Thy divine palms upon the Cross, O Jesus: Thou didst gather unto Thyself the creation of Thy hands, and didst deliver it forever from the hand of the deceiver, and didst subdue it with Thy mighty hand unto the Church of all: therefore, we the faithful sing praise unto Thy majesty, for Thou hast been glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Slaying in Eden was the bitter tasting of the tree, bringing in death; but Christ, being put to death upon the Tree, poured forth life unto all, and put the serpent to sleep by divine power: therefore let us sing unto Him, our God, for He hath been glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: The multitude of Martyrs stood manfully, O Jesus: and by Thy Cross and Passion they rose up against passions, and confessed Thee as King and good Master before enemies: and they endured boundless torments and tribulations. Therefore they have attained the glory of all, the everlasting life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Having found deliverance by the sprinkling of Thy precious and life-creating Blood, O Lord: Thy Martyrs poured forth their blood to the end, being unjustly tormented to offer sacrifices unto defiled demons: therefore they were offered unto Thee as precious sacrifices, O King of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: When the immaculate one beheld Thee, Who seest all things, nailed upon the Cross, weeping she said: What is this, my Child? What have they rendered unto Thee...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: ...who enjoyed Thy many gifts? How hast Thou endured pains? Glory to Thy tender mercy and to Thy dread dispensation, O longsuffering One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos: Passing through water as on dry land:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Troparia:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: With Thine enlightenment, O Mother of God: enlighten my soul, which is darkened by the pleasures of life and helplessly troubled by worldly sorrows!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: The heavenly gates were opened by thy divine Childbearing, O Mother of God: whereinto grant my soul an entrance through prayer, and direct me unto them!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Heal my soul, O Virgin, with thy mercy: which hath been struck by the arrow of the wicked one, and wounded by his wiles and deceits!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: O hope of the hopeless, correction of the fallen: who didst bear the divine Light: enlighten my soul which is in darkness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: O Lord, Supreme Creator of the heavenly circle:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: (Canon of the Cross Ode 3 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: The rod is received as an image of the mystery, for by foretokening it appointed the priest; and for the Church that formerly was barren, the Tree of the Cross hath now blossomed forth into dominion and establishment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: The sun was darkened in its course, beholding Thee unjustly lifted up upon the Tree: and the rocks were split, and all the earth was terrified with fear, O Thou Who alone art the Savior, the deliverance of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Небⷭ҇снагѡ крꙋга, верхотворче Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: Moses, stretching forth his hands, prefigured the precious Cross: which we now, God-wisely depicting, overcome all the ranks of aliens...[^331]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...and overcome all demonic workings, remaining unharmed from every hurt of theirs!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Enduring sufferings, the passion-bearers depicted the Passion, partaking in manifold passions of Him Who willingly suffered and granted life unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having trodden the path of martyrdom without turning back, the glorious trophy-bearers cast down the stumbling-blocks of deceit from their hearts, and hastened with rejoicing unto divine rest!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Beyond the lawful customs of men, I brought Thee forth, my Child; and how have the lawless lifted Thee up upon the Tree in the midst of the lawless, Who alone didst establish the law of life? the Theotokos, weeping, cried aloud!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Lord, Supreme Creator of the heavenly circle:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to the Theotokos Ode 3 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Grant me unceasing groans, and fervent tears, and a contrite heart, O Virgin: that I may weep for what I have committed, and consume the passions that grow within me, O thou who alone art all-hymned!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Snatch my soul, O good one, which is weighed down by the slumbers of sin and hath slipped down unto the womb of hades: and grant me the thought of true repentance, O divinely blessed one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Grant unto my soul, which is grievously deficient in understanding and virtues and hath sinned through transgressions, O all-immaculate one: to love silent contemplation and to possess divine desire, O all-immaculate one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Placing my hope in thee, O Mother of God, may I quickly be delivered from despair: for I know, yea, I know the wealth of thy tender mercy...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...and the saving strength of thy boldness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, I understood Thy works, and I glorified Thy Divinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of the Cross Ode 4 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Bearing piety like the cedar, faith like the cypress, and love like the pine: let us worship the divine Cross!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: By Thy Cross, O Savior, Paradise was opened: and the condemned man entered therein again, magnifying Thy goodness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having become dead, O Savior, Thou didst quicken men who were slain, and didst put to death the serpent who brought in sin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having become partakers of Christ's Sufferings, the divine Martyrs were also shown to be partakers of heavenly splendor!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ye were adorned, O Martyrs, being united unto the fair Word: brightly enlightened, having loved the Sun of righteousness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou didst bear as a young babe Him Who was perfect before the ages, O all-immaculate Maiden, Who accomplishes marvelous deeds by the Cross and through goodness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Thou art my strength, O Lord:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to the Theotokos Ode 4 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O thou who didst ineffably bear God the Word: assuage the passions of my soul, pouring out the grief of cruel assaults with the precious Blood of thy Son, Who destroyed the soul-devouring womb of hades and poured forth resurrection unto the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Bride of God, send down cleansing of transgressions unto my suffering soul, and drive away evil thoughts, and account it worthy to become most pure: for I have fled unto thy mediation and thy help, O Virgin Theotokos!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I flee now unto thy protection, O all-pure one: anticipate and deliver me, O all-honored one, from the cruel storm of the enemy and from the torrents of iniquity that trouble me; and direct me without turning aside unto thy haven and unto thy calm, O Mother of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The enemy hath wounded all my soul with the arrows of sin, and defiled my heart with pleasures, and turned me away from the right path: therefore I cry aloud unto thee: Having converted me, heal me and save me!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O thrice-blessed Tree, whereon Christ the King and Lord was crucified, through which he who deceived by the tree fell, being caught by thee, when God was nailed in the flesh, Who grants peace unto our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of the Cross Ode 5 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Desiring to clothe us who were stripped bare of the garment of incorruption: Thou wast crucified upon the Cross, O Christ, and didst strip bare the wiles of the enemy: therefore we glorify Thy sufferings!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The saving Blood of incorruption from Thy side hath cleansed the world for Thee: the blood of idol-shrines hath ceased, and Thou hast renewed the incorruptible through intelligent fruit, and poured forth incorruption unto our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having blossomed with the beauty of manifold wounds, O glorious Martyrs...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...and marked with divine blood, they have passed now through the sword that formerly barred the way, and rejoice making merry in Paradise!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: How wondrous art Thou in Thy saints, O Christ, who loved Thee in faith: for enriched by Thee, they pour forth rivers of divine healings unto the world, and dry up the outflow of our passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou hast healed us who were sick with sin, O Virgin, having born the Savior and Physician of all: Who was nailed upon the Tree of the Cross, O all-pure one, and poured forth salvation unto our souls!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Therefore hast Thou cast me off:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to the Theotokos Ode 5 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: With deliberate zeal I hasten unto thy protection, O all-immaculate one, and I lift up the eye of my soul: turn not away from me, but protect me as thou art good, and heal me, and wash away the filth of my transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The deadly venom of the bites of sin was injected: but destroy it by the divine nails and spear of thy Child, Who suffered in the flesh for our sake through tender mercy, O thou who alone art all-hymned!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Quicken me who was slain in my manner of life and corrupted by transgressions, O thou who didst bear the eternal Life: and by spiritual renewal, transform me unto incorruption, O divinely blessed one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Deliver me, O good one, from the corrupter of the Jewish nation and from evil expectations: and speedily heal the sickness of my soul and body, O thou who alone didst bear the Physician, Savior, and Lord of our great flesh and sins!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бездну грѣховъ и согрѣшенїй... длани Іѡна крⷭ҇тоѡбразно распростер: спасеннꙋю Стрⷭ҇ть проѡбразоваше явѣ. Тѣмже и тридневно исшедъ, премїрное Воскресенїе прописꙋваше: плотїю пригвожденна Хрⷭ҇та Бг҃а, и тридневнымъ Воскресенїемъ, миръ просвѣщшаго.
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тъ водрузися на мѣстѣ лобнѣмъ, посредѣ землѧ: и посредѣ Раѧ, прозябшꙋю дрѣво язву исцѣли. Многа бо Хе҃, посредѣ беззаконных разбоиникъ, единъ праведны менѧся: егоже ѡ собоздиже вся: и со высоте падшаго, въ преисподнее пасть изверже.
items.english_text: Jonah stretched forth his hands crosswise in the belly of the sea monster, clearly prefiguring the saving Passion; therefore also, coming forth on the third day, he depicted the transcendent Resurrection of Christ God, Who was nailed in the flesh and by His three-day Resurrection enlightened the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Лꙋкъ Хе҃ напрягъ, Бж҃твеннаго и всечт҃наго твоего Крⷭ҇та: на-спꙋстилъ еси стрѣлы на бо-ритела врага, гвоздиа рук твоюхъ: и концамъ вся въ отгѣванное и вневечернее его срⷭ҇це, Влко: и совершеннѣ того оумертвилъ еси: и ѿ того оу-мерщвленныя, щедре, ѡжи-вилъ еси.
items.english_text: (Canon of the Cross Ode 6 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Кровеи истекшымъ ѿ ранъ, из телесъ ст҃ыхъ страдалєц: оугасиша дхомъ, ꙗкѡ Ідоло-скїа пламень: и Чр҃ковныѧ честныѧ бразды напоиша: и класъ прозѧблїи сотвориша, спасенныѧ надежды и вѣры: имиже питаетъся, всякаѧ дша Бж҃твенною бл҃годатїю.
items.english_text: The Cross was planted on the place of a skull, in the midst of the earth: and healed the wound that sprouted from the tree in the midst of Paradise! For Christ, counted as the only righteous One in the midst of lawless thieves, overturned everything, and cast down from the height him that had fallen into the nethermost abyss!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Въжегахꙋ ѻгнь болшаго изъꙗ-вленїа Бж҃твенаго, отражꙋщїи славныи Стратотерпцы: егда вещественнымъ ѻгнемъ, сож-
items.english_text: Bending the bow of Thy divine and all-honored Cross, O Christ: Thou didst release arrows against the fighting enemy, even the nails of Thy hands, penetrating into his darkened and sunless heart, O Master: and Thou didst utterly put him to death, and quicken those slain by him, O compassionate One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: женно быти, зѣло лукавнѣйшихъ сꙋдїи, рѡдом ѡсꙋждаемни: и неврежденны сохранлѧемн бы-ваху, дѣйствомъ и бл҃гатїю Ст҃го Дх҃а: венчавшаго тѣхъ законно пострадавших. Ко:
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Орꙋжїе срⷭ҇це твое пройде, Пречт҃ая Отроковице: зрящи Сн҃а своего на Крⷭ҇тѣ простерта, и стрⷭ҇ть терпѧща, и копїемъ въ Бо-жественное ребро проколодаема волею: и закланїа нѣмъ во-рительнаго ѕмїа. Тѣмжеже плачꙋщи, Мт҃рьски того оублажаше, величаше.
items.english_text: The streams of blood that flowed from the wounds of the bodies of the holy martyrs extinguished the flames of idolatry by the Spirit, and watered the honored furrows of the Church, making ears of grain to blossom forth in saving hope and faith, wherewith every soul is nourished by divine grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Страстмъ и блудно поживах: и рлече сластемъ ѡка-янїи быхъ: и всякїа ѡбнажи-хся добродѣтели Бж҃твенныя. но покꙋти мя Пречт҃ая.
items.english_text: Kindling the fire of greater divine manifestation, the glorious passion-bearers repelled the judges of utmost deceit: when condemned by lineage to be burned with material fire, they were preserved unharmed by the operation and grace of the Holy Spirit, Who crowned them that suffered lawfully!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бѣглець данныхъ ми заповѣди быхъ: и оудалихся живота, къ смерти прилижнувся: но настави ма къ ѡбращенїю, Бг҃о-мати Пречт҃ая.
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Житїе мое блудно, и исполнено нерадѣнїа: но милости твоя многая и неизреченнаѧ, Пре-чт҃ая, да оудолѣет, и млордїе бл҃гости твоея, неможенїю мысли моеи.
items.english_text: A sword pierced thy heart, O all-pure Maiden, beholding thy Son stretched upon the Cross, enduring suffering, and willingly pierced in His divine side with a spear, slaying the warring serpent: therefore weeping like a mother, thou didst bless and magnify Him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сп҃са и Избавителя рождши, и всещедраго: ѡчисти мя чт҃ая, и спаси и избави ѿ бывшыхъ мя, и нападающїй немлⷭ҇тивно на немощь мою.
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Безумна заповедь мучителя злочестиваго, людьми поко-леба: дышꙋщи прещенїемъ и злохуленїемъ Бг҃омерзкнымъ.
items.english_text: (Canon to the Theotokos Ode 6 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ѡбаче трїехъ ѻтрокъ, не оу-страши ꙗрость звѣрскаѧ: ни ѻгнь снѣдаѧи, но противоды-шꙋщꙋ хладному Дх҃у: въ ѻгни сꙋще, пояху: Препѣтый ѿц҃ъ нашнхъ Бж҃е, бл҃гвенъ еси.
items.english_text: In passions and profligacy have I lived, and wretchedly have I been enslaved unto pleasures, and stripped bare of every divine virtue: but show compassion unto me, O all-pure one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Егда распростре есить на древѣ Крⷭ҇тнемъ: ꙗкоже виноградъ Слово ѿчее: млетъ искапалъ еси тайны, престлати твоѧ пїянїехъ престꙋпленїа: и всѣх весела вѣдꙋщих тѧ Бг҃а и Зи-ждителя, волею страждꙋща: и спасенїа поющыхъ: Препѣ-тый ѿц҃ъ нашихъ Бж҃е, бл҃го-словенъ еси.
items.english_text: I have become a fugitive from the commandments given unto me, and have departed far from life, drawing near unto death: but guide me unto conversion, O all-pure Mother of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Распятїе претерпѣлъ еси Хрⷭ҇те мои Іс҃е, поносное: ѡставил(ъ) нщее чл҃вкѡмъ поношенїе и во-здыханїе. желчꙋ же въкусилъ еси, горесть всякꙋ заѡбнꙋю шемля. оуязвилъ еси рꙋцѣ скои, язвы щедре душевныя наша исцѣляя: и пѣти пове-лѣваѧ: Препѣтыи ѿц҃ъ нш҃ихъ Бж҃е, бл҃гвенъ еси. М:
items.english_text: My life is profligate and full of negligence: but let thy many and ineffable mercies, O all-pure one, prevail, and let the tender mercy of thy goodness overcome the weakness of my mind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Болѣзньми неболѣзненꙋю, до-блїи страдалцы жизнь прїята-жасте. Тѣмьже наша болѣ-зни ѡблегчаете, велїкꙋ бл҃го-дать прїемше свыше ст҃аин, исцѣлѣвати страсти, и духи ѡгонити, и вѣрныхъ застꙋ-пати, и спасати поющїа: Препѣтый ѿц҃ъ нашихъ Бж҃е, бл҃гословенъ еси. Муч:
