items.english_text: Having born the Savior, Deliverer, and all-compassionate One: cleanse me, O pure one, and save and deliver me from the evils that have befallen me and unmercifully assault my infirmity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стл҃пте Мунцы на судищи, Хл проповѣдающе, плоть насъ ради воспрїемшаго понесъ, и подобници страстемъ его явльшеми конечннми. Ѻгна разжоженїе, и всякїа иныя муки претерпѣсте: въ веселїи
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: зовуще: Препѣтый ѿц҃ъ нш҃их Бж҃е, бл҃гвенъ еси. Ко:
items.english_text: The senseless command of the wicked tyrant shook the people, breathing forth threats and blasphemy hateful to God yet the bestial fury and the consuming fire frightened not the three Children; but as a cool Spirit breathed against the fire, being in the furnace they sang: O God of our fathers, supremely praised and blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Печали исполнихуся, зрящи тѧ Сн҃е неправеднѣ страдающа, оуязвлѧюся дшею: копїемъ оуязвленнꙋ тн въ ребро, Бц҃а вопїяше, плачꙋщи и рыдающи едина Бл҃гуе: юже достойно вси оублажаемъ, бл҃гочестно зовуще: Препѣтый ѿц҃ъ нашихъ Бж҃е, бл҃гвенъ еси.
items.english_text: (Canon of the Cross Ode 7 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Вся еси свѣтоноснаѧ, свѣтъ незаходимый Дв҃о прїемши, и просвѣщаеши чт҃ая, вѣрою тебѣ вопїющыхъ: бл҃гословен Пречт҃ая, пло твоего чрева.
items.english_text: When Thou wast stretched upon the Tree of the Cross, O Word of the Father, as the Vine: Thou didst drop down mystic sweet wine, taking away the drunkenness of transgressions, and gladdening all that know Thee as God and Creator willingly suffering, and that sing of salvation: O God of our fathers, supremely praised and blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Дѣтвое чл҃колюбїе и мл҃ть, Дв҃о явнши: изглавлены мя злых возведи вопїюща: бл҃гословенъ Пречт҃ая, пло твоего чрева.
items.english_text: Thou didst endure the shameful Crucifixion, O my Christ Jesus: taking away reproach and groaning from men! And Thou didst taste gall, destroying every bitter sorrow; Thou didst wound Thine own hands, healing our spiritual wounds, O compassionate One, and commanding us to sing: O God of our fathers, supremely praised and blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: К тебѣ Мт҃и Дв҃о притѣкаю, оуязвляемъ стрѣлами душевтаинными. венго мя мл҃тью твоею ѡгради, вопїюща: бл҃гословенъ Пречт҃ая, плодъ твоего чрева.
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Избави мя Мт҃и Сп҃сова, ѡдержащаго лютаго плѣненїа помышлеинїи лукавыхъ, и винъ грѣховныхъ. ꙗкѡ да присно спасаем, по долгꙋ тѧ славлю.
items.english_text: By painless suffering, the valiant sufferers acquired painless life! Therefore ye lighten our illnesses, having received great grace from on high, O holy ones, to heal passions, to drive away spirits, to protect the faithful, and to save them that sing: O God of our fathers, supremely praised and blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословите дѣти, Трⷪ҇ци равно-численїи: Содѣтела Ѻц҃а Бг҃а пойте, съшедшаго Слова, и ѻгнь въ росꙋ претворшаго, и превозносите всѣмъ животъ дающаго, Дх҃а прест҃аго. во вѣки вся.
items.english_text: Standing as pillars before the tribunal, preaching Christ Who took flesh for our sake, the Martyrs appeared as conformable unto His ultimate Passions: ye endured the burning of fire and all other torments, crying aloud in gladness...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: ...crying aloud: O God of our fathers, supremely praised and blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Filled with sorrow, beholding Thee unjustly suffering, O Son, I am wounded in my soul: seeing Thee pierced in Thy side with a spear, the Theotokos cried aloud, weeping and lamenting, she who alone is good: whom we all worthily bless, crying aloud in piety: O God of our fathers, supremely praised and blessed art Thou!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The Hebrew Children:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: (Canon to the Theotokos Ode 7 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Thou art all light-bearing, O Virgin, having received the unwaning Light, and thou dost enlighten, O pure one, them that cry aloud unto thee in faith: Blessed art thou, O all-pure one, and blessed is the Fruit of thy womb!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Show forth thy love for mankind and thy mercy, O Virgin: raise me up, delivered from evils, who cry aloud: Blessed art thou, O all-pure one, and blessed is the Fruit of thy womb!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Unto thee, O Mother and Virgin, do I flee, being wounded by hidden arrows of the soul: protect me with all thy mercy, as I cry aloud: Blessed art thou, O all-pure one, and blessed is the Fruit of thy womb!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Deliver me, O Mother of the Savior, from the cruel captivity of wicked thoughts and sinful causes that holds me fast: that, being ever saved, I may glorify thee as is meet!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Bless, ye Children, equal in number to the Trinity: sing praise unto God the Father and Creator, and unto the Word Who came down and turned the fire into dew; and supremely exalt unto all ages the all-holy Spirit, Who gives life unto all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: (Canon of the Cross Ode 8 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гословенно есть дрѣво, имже вся потребися, яже въ Едеме клятва
items.english_text: Blessed is the Tree, whereby all the curse was destroyed that sprouted in Eden...[^333]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...the cruel curse that grew from the branch of the evil tree: and Christ, the supremely glorified, is lifted up, Who hath cleansed us, having willed it of His own accord through tender mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Sacredly crossing his hands, the ever-glorious patriarch blessed his grandsons of old, revealing the image of the sacred Tree: whereby blessing was granted unto all who were cursed through the evil eating of the tree and had slipped down into the depth of evils!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: All mankind is righted, O Master, when Thou wast stretched upon the Cross; and the host of wicked demons falls, and being scattered, receives destruction; and the dominion of Thy power and Thy strength is exalted unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Blessed glory, and incorruptible food, and light-bearing dwellings have ye inherited now, O divine martyrs of the Lord: and ye have been joined with heavenly ranks, and in gladness have received now the fulfillment of your blessed hopes!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: With courage surpassing the sun, the light-bearing martyrs of Christ shone forth, and by divine power ground to powder all the deceit of the devil, and God-wisely enlightened the hearts of all in all ends of the earth unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Spiritual cloud and sacred shadow, throne of God, and gate of light, candlestick and dawn of the Word, all we the faithful call thee, O all-pure Virgin: being the Mother of Him Who made all things, O blessed one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Sevenfold the furnace:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to the Theotokos Ode 8 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The Almighty Lord, the all-powerful, dwelling in thy womb, O Virgin: showed thee forth as a pillar of establishment unto the faithful: fleeing unto whom, we are delivered from misfortunes and perils...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...and are freed from temptations, singing with one accord: Ye priests, sing praise; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having fallen away from sacred life, O Sovereign Lady, I am dragged without restraint toward sin and enslaved unto it, and I am stripped bare of the freedom that is in Christ and of true righteousness: but despise me not, O treasury of salvation, who flee unto thee naked and afflicted!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Let the petition of my prayer be righted unto the Lord, O Virgin, Who came forth from thy womb: and may He deliver me from the transgression of commandments, and from condemnation and the legal curse; and may He wash away the filth of my grievous sins, as He alone is merciful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O all-pure Birth-giver of God: cleanse the wounds of my soul and sinful stumbling-blocks, washing them with the fountain that flowed from the side of thy Son, and with the arrows of comfort that come from Him: for unto thee do I call, and unto thee do I flee, and thee do I invoke, O full of divine grace!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Death, which came upon our race through the eating from the tree, hath been abolished today by the Cross; for the curse of our foremother and of our race hath been loosed by the blossoming of the pure Mother of God, whom all the heavenly Powers magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of the Cross Ode 9 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Exalting Thee most sacredly, O compassionate One, we worship Thy Cross...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...we worship Thy Cross, and the Spear, and the Sponge, and the Reed, and the holy nails driven into Thy hands and feet, O Master: whereby we have found perfect forgiveness and have been accounted worthy of dwelling in Paradise!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O how the most righteous One, the only King of all, was condemned unjustly to be nailed and crucified upon the Tree, to justify all who with faith glorify Thy voluntary sufferings and dispensation, and who faithfully magnify Thee, O my Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having surrendered their bodies unto torments with their whole soul, the glorious Martyrs endured wounds and violent death, the severing of limbs, and tearing, and burning with fire, being kindled with love toward God: therefore, crowned with victors' wreaths, they dwell in the heavens!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O sweetness of the Apostles and the Martyrs: by their prayers fill us all with mercy, as Thou art tenderhearted, granting the remission of sins, and deliverance from all evils, and the joy of Thy Kingdom, O Christ God, Who for our sake didst appear as man!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: A light-bearing bridal chamber wast thou shown to be, O Virgin, of Him Who dwelt in thy virginal womb, and willingly endured the divine Passion, and granted dispassion unto all through ineffable mercy: Whom worshipping, with gracious voice we magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Amazed was the heaven at this:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon to the Theotokos Ode 9 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O true Mother of God of the true God: cease not to entreat Him...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...Whom thou didst bear, to grant forgiveness of sins unto thy servants, and complete pardon of the evils committed by me, and to account me worthy in due time of eternal enjoyment!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Gird my humble soul with spiritual strength and power, with weapon and dominion, O most holy Theotokos: and clothe it with the armor of the Cross; and cleanse the wounds of my sin with the dew of thy love for mankind and with thy great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Be thou a pillar of salvation unto me, O pure one, chasing away the invisible ranks of demons, cutting off the multitude of temptations and tribulations, driving far off the assaults of passions, and granting pure liberation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O pure and glorified Mother of God: save them that sing praise unto thee in love, and mercifully destroy the tempest of temptations: for having born God, thou canst do whatsoever thou desirest, and dost grant it without hindrance, O Virgin: therefore we all magnify thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Precious Cross. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The rod of Moses prefigured Thy precious Cross, O our Savior, whereby Thou didst lead Thy people unto salvation, as from the depths of the sea, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The tree that grew in the midst of the garden in Eden of old was for food; but the Church, O Christ, hath blossomed forth Thy Cross, pouring forth life unto all the world: but that one brought death unto Adam who ate of the food, whereas this one quickens through faith...[^334]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ВЪ ПѦТОКЪ. ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ. НА ГДⷭ҇И ВОЗЗВАⷯ:
items.english_text: ...and saved the thief through faith: show us forth as partakers of his salvation, O Christ God, Who by Thy Passion didst loose the snares of the enemy that were set against us: and account us worthy of Thy Kingdom, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхы ст҃ыхъ мч҃никѡмъ, ст҃ителе(м), и прпⷣбнымъ.
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Гласъ, и҃. По: Что вы наречемъ ст҃ыи;
items.english_text: What shall we call you, O holy ones? Cherubim? For Christ rests upon you! Seraphim? For unceasingly ye glorify Him! Angels? For ye turned away from the body! Powers? For ye work miracles! Many are your names, and yet greater are your gifts! Pray ye that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: I cannot endure, my Child, beholding Thee fallen asleep upon the Tree, Who bestowest wakefulness unto all: that Thou mayest bestow divine and saving wakefulness unto them that of old fell asleep in the fatal sleep through the fruit of transgression! the Virgin said, weeping: whom we magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: On Friday, the Beatitudes. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, even as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree: and account all worthy, O Thou Who alone art compassionate of Thy heavenly Kingdom!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Stretching forth Thy palms upon the Tree, O Christ, Thou didst strip bare the principalities and powers of the devil, and didst save from their harm them that piously glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Pierced suddenly with a spear upon the Tree, Thou didst pour forth streams of immortality unto us who were put to death through mindless transgression: therefore, with fear we glorify Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Martyrs:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Desiring strange things beyond the earth, the visible masters of earthly things, the sufferers gave themselves unto strange torments, wounding the apostate with their holy wounds!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Glory... Triadikon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Being One of the unoriginate Trinity, Thou didst willingly endure suffering upon the Cross: dry up all the torrents of my passions, and account me worthy of salvation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Both now... Stavrotheotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Seeing the Lamb of God and the Word hanging in the flesh upon the Tree: the only unblemished Ewe-lamb and Virgin, held fast with sorrow, shed tears!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: On Friday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried":

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: *Stichera of the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerables. Tone 8.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: I, wretched one, am wounded ever by the arrows of the enemy, and I am at a loss what to do: but ye who broke his arrows, who suffered manfully, and who sanctify all creation with the stream of your blood heal me who am sick, O divine Martyrs, as ye have boldness before the Lord, O worthily blessed ones!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: I am held fast with utter perplexity when I consider in my mind that dread hour of Thine examination, O Thou Who alone art God of all: and I weep and lament and mourn, remembering the abyss of mine evils. Therefore save me, O Lover of mankind, by the supplications of Thy Martyrs, and deliver me from torment, as Thou art tenderhearted!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: O divine Martyrs, pray unto God on behalf of them that perform your all-sacred memory in faith: that they may be delivered from temptations and obtain heavenly mansions, which the all-holy One prepared as the only Benefactor and Lover of mankind; and that He may settle their souls where the ranks of Patriarchs ever make merry, as He is longsuffering!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Other Stichera to the Martyrs, the same Tone:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: O Martyrs of the Lord, ye sanctify every place and heal every sickness: and now pray ye that our souls may be delivered from the snares of the enemy, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: O Martyrs of the Lord, entreat our God and ask for our souls a multitude of bounties and cleansing from our many transgressions, we pray you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Dogmatikon:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: The King of heaven, for His love of mankind [hath appeared upon the earth]...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Martyrs. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Thy Martyrs, O Lord, forgot the things of this life and heedless of torments for the sake of the life to come, they were shown to be heirs thereof: therefore they also rejoice with the Angels. By their prayers, grant Thy people great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: If there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, it is meet for the holy ones: for they bowed their necks to the sword for the sake of Thee Who didst bow the heavens and come down; they shed their blood for the sake of Thee Who didst pour out Thyself and take the form of a servant; they humbled themselves even unto death, conforming themselves unto Thy poverty: by their prayers have mercy on us, O God, according to Thy great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Aposticha of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: I weep and lament when I contemplate death, and behold our beauty, fashioned according to the image of God, lying in the graves, formless, inglorious, having no shape! O wonder! What is this mystery that hath happened unto us? How have we been surrendered unto corruption? How have we been yoked unto death? Truly by the command of God, as it is written: Who gives rest unto the departed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion. Tone 4:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: O Sovereign Lady, receive the supplications of thy servants, and deliver us from every distress and sorrow!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: On Saturday, at Matins.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: After the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs. Tone 8.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: тои часъ страшный, испытанїа твоего един всѣхъ и Бг҃а.
items.english_text: Today this temple is enlightened with heavenly light: for the angelic hosts rejoice therein, and with them the choirs of the Martyrs make merry at the memory of the passion-bearers...[^335]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: ...at the memory of the passion-bearers: by their prayers, send down peace unto Thy world, O Christ, and great mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: As noetic luminaries were ye revealed, O holy Martyrs, for by faith ye destroyed the gloom of deceit, and enlightened your spiritual lamps, and entered with glory with the Bridegroom into the heavenly bridal chamber: and now we pray you: Entreat that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Thou Who for our sake wast born of the Virgin and didst endure the Crucifixion, O Good One, Who by death didst despoil death and manifest the Resurrection as God: despise not them whom Thou didst create with Thy hand; show forth Thy love for mankind, O merciful One; accept the Theotokos who bore Thee and prays for us: and save, O our Savior, a despairing people!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs. Tone 8.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Luminaries shining ever in the universe were ye revealed through martyrdom: ye placed all your hope in the Lord, and with the spiritual oil of the Holy Spirit ye enlightened your spiritual lamps: whence also ye were revealed as cups of the spiritual Church, pouring forth healings like water! O all-lauded passion-bearers, entreat Christ God to grant remission of transgressions unto them that honor your holy memory with love!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having put to death the fiery forms and stirrings of passions through abstinence, the Martyrs of Christ received grace to drive away illnesses from the sick, and while living quietly in order, to work miracles: truly a most glorious wonder, that bare bones pour forth healings! Glory to God, the only all-wise Creator!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Sessional Hymn of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Thou Who by the depth of wisdom orderest all things in love for mankind, and givest what is profitable unto all, O only Creator: give rest, O Lord, unto the souls of Thy servants, for they placed their hope in Thee, our Creator, Maker, and God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: In thee we have a wall and a haven, and an acceptable intercessor before God Who was born of thee, O unwedded Theotokos, thou salvation of the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Canon to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, Venerables, and the Departed.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: A work of Joseph.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea: a song of victory, for He hath been glorified!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of All Saints Ode 1 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Revealed as an honored necklace, adorning the crown of the precious Church, O valiant passion-bearers of Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Shining with the divine splendors of dogmas and virtues, the hierarchs of Christ enlightened hearts in all ends of the earth!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: We pray Thee, O Word: wondrous art Thou in the Prophets and Venerables: By their supplications, save us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: When Thou comest to execute righteous judgment, O most righteous One, Who alone art unjudged, O Lord: deliver Thy servants from condemnation!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Knowing thee who didst bear God, the choir of women, having acted valiantly in every virtue, was brought unto Him!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Canon for the Departed.

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 1. Tone 8. Heirmos: Passing through water as on dry land:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon for the Departed Ode 1 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having truly imitated death by death and sufferings by sufferings, all the Martyrs attained divine and blessed life!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Overlooking the transgressions of youth, and passing over sins, O Christ Savior: number with Thine elect Thy servants who have fallen asleep before us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Abundantly grant unto Thy servants whom Thou hast received, O most merciful One, to attain the glory and joy and blessed dwelling where the saints abide!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou didst conceive the Word of the Father, united hypostatically with the flesh, O all-immaculate Maiden: Who by divine power abolished hades!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 3. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou Who didst establish the heavens by Thy Word, and founded the earth upon many waters: establish me unto the singing of Thy glorification, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of All Saints Ode 3 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Rejecting abominable sacrifices with steadfast mind, the sufferers were offered as a most precious sacrifice unto the Word!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Renewing speech, O sacred ministers, ye were revealed as divine teachers of Him Who renewed the world and me who was grown old with all manner of passions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The grace of the divine Spirit, which was formerly given assuredly unto the Prophets filled the ascetics afterward with divine gifts!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Number with the choirs of the saints, O God, them that have departed this life in faith: and make them dwellers of Paradise, for the sake of Thine ineffable mercy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Jesus, Who is nowhere contained, was contained incorruptibly in thy consecrated womb, O all-hymned, all-pure Virgin!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: There is none holy like Thee:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon for the Departed Ode 3 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Cleansed of the ancient ancestral fall by baptism and regeneration, sprinkled with the streams of their own blood, the blessed ones reign with Christ!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having willingly been laid dead in a grave, raising them that dwell in the graves, O Savior: be well-pleased that those whom Thou hast received from us may dwell in the mansions of Thy saints!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Being entreated through divine tender mercy and the true goodness of Thy nature, grant remission of sins unto Thy servants, and give rest unto them who have fallen asleep!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Incarnate from thy womb and having become man, He Who alone is supremely the Lover of mankind saves man from the gates of death, O all-pure, all-hymned Mother of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 4. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: I heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, I understood Thy works, and I glorified Thy Divinity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of All Saints Ode 4 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Entering into the spiritual contest, O divinely blessed sufferers, ye burned up material deceit by the fiery Spirit!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou hast brightly glorified Thy Venerables, O Lord, and the hierarchs: by their divine supplications make me a sacred minister of Thy glory!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The inspiration of the divine Spirit, which enlightened the Prophets, granted strength unto women to destroy the arrogant enemy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Account Thy servants, whom Thou hast translated, O most good One, worthy of the promised mansions with all the saints, as I invoke the prayers of the saints!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Beyond the law of nature thou didst bear the Giver of the divine law, Who renews fallen human nature, O Bride of God!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Thou art my strength, O Lord:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon for the Departed Ode 4 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: That they might behold Thy glory, O Master, and receive brightly Thy light-bestowing rays in the heavens: the divine Martyrs endured to bear every kind of torture, singing unto Thee, O Christ: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Many are the mansions with Thee, O Savior, distributed unto all according to worth, according to the measure of virtues: account them that have fallen asleep in faith, who piously cry aloud unto Thee, worthy to be filled with them, O compassionate One: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Appearing unto us as man, O immortal One, Thou didst endure death common to all, and didst show forth the path of life: therefore account them that have been translated worthy of forgiveness of sins, O Lover of mankind, granting as Master the communion of light!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou art the praise of the faithful, O unwedded one; thou art the protectress, the refuge of Christians, a wall and a haven: for thou offerest supplications unto thy Son, O all-immaculate one, and deliverest from perils them that know thee in faith and love as the pure Theotokos!...[^336]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 5. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Enlighten us by Thy commandments:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of All Saints Ode 5 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The divine Martyrs endured bodily wounds, therefore they ever heal our wounds, wounding the demons!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O holy hierarchs of God, with all the Venerables entreat Christ: to grant unto us the remission of transgressions!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having restrained the flesh by mortification and asceticism, the God-loving women were accounted worthy of the hoped-for good things!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having slain death by Thy death, O immortal One: give rest unto Thy faithful servants who died in the hope of life, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou hast abolished the condemnation of our forefather, O pure one, having born in the flesh Jesus, the only Lord, Who justifies all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Therefore hast Thou cast me off:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon for the Departed Ode 5 Heirmos and Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: In Thy ineffable glory, and in Thy blessedness which is beyond word, in the dwellings of the righteous where the fair voice of them that feast is heard: account them that have been translated unto immortal life worthy through Thy bounties, O Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Where the angelic ranks and the assemblies of the righteous rejoice: settle Thy servants, O Savior, in the bosom of Abraham, and with boldness to stand before Thy dread and divine throne, be pleased, O merciful One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou wast revealed unto us as cleansing, righteousness, and redemption, and by Thy wisdom Thou hast healed our infirmities: do Thou Thyself, O compassionate and good One, establish in the delight of Paradise them that have been translated!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: In mercy, as a child, Thou didst take the measure of humanity, adorning it with divine glory and transcendent elevations; and in the virginal womb Thou didst take animate, rational flesh, whereby Thou didst destroy death!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 6. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of All Saints Ode 6 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: By your precious wounds ye heal spiritual sicknesses, and ever draw out bodily sores, wounding the multitudes of wicked demons, O holy Martyrs!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The choir of the praised, the concord of the Prophets, and the holy assembly of women, having suffered steadfastly, inherited unexpected things!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having put to death the flesh, the ascetics attained life; having well pastured the flock of Christ, the all-wise hierarchs were accounted worthy of immortal glory after their end!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Being life unto the living, O Word, and rest unto the dead: by Thy divine nod settle Thy translated servants in the bosom of Abraham Thy servant!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O all-hymned, pure dawn of the Father: with the material rays of thy Godhead, thou didst destroy the darkness of polytheism, and enlighten the world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos the same:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon for the Departed Ode 6 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thy Martyrs, O Savior, endured many torments: having wounded their holy souls with love for Thee, desiring everlasting glory and sweet communion with Thee!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou didst tear asunder the death enmity of sin, O Savior, and didst raise the prisoners that were held therein, granting life: whereunto account them that have been translated worthy, O Benefactor!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Deliver Thy servants from tears and groaning in hades, O Savior, as Thou alone art merciful: taking away every tear from every face of them that bless Thee unto eternity!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: He Who is by nature the Creator is formed in thy womb: being full as God, He is emptied, O all-immaculate one: the only immortal One dies by death for the salvation of all!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Kontakion. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: With the saints give rest, O Christ, unto the souls of Thy servants, where there is no sickness, nor sorrow, nor sighing, but life unending!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ikos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou alone art immortal, Who didst make and fashion man: for we mortals were fashioned from the earth, and unto the earth shall we return, even as Thou didst command, Who didst fashion me and say unto me: Earth thou art, and unto the earth shalt thou return; whither all we mortals go, making the funeral lamentation, chanting the hymn: Alleluia!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The Children...[^337]

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 7. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The pious Children in Babylon bowed not down unto the golden image; but cooling in the midst of the burning furnace, they sang the hymn, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of All Saints Ode 7 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having loosed the rampart of wickedness by your sacred bonds, O all-praised ones: disperse the burden of my transgressions, and save me who cry aloud, O Martyrs: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: With the showers of your sacred teachings, quench the fire of heresies, and burn up the cruel tares of impiety, O all-wise hierarchs of piety: and enlighten the souls of the faithful!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having put to death the flesh by abstinence, the ascetics live after death; the choir of holy Prophets and the company of women, having suffered, were glorified: by their prayers, O Christ, deliver us!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Give rest, O Christ, unto the souls of all them that have fallen asleep in the hope of life, overlooking their sins committed in life: for the sake of Thy great tender mercy, O Thou Who alone art compassionate, the God of our fathers, Who art blessed!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: As a head thou didst receive the Word incarnate in thy womb: but entreat Him, O all-pure one, to cleanse me from sins, who flee unto thee in soul and body, and with pure faith!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: The Hebrew Children:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon for the Departed Ode 7 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: All desire was stretched forth by the Martyrs unto the only Master, being united unto Him in love, and singing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou grantest unto them that have been translated in faith the splendor of the divine Kingdom, clothing them with gifts of incorruption, as they cry aloud: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Fill with joy and gladness Thy servants whom Thou hast translated, O compassionate One: and account them worthy to exclaim and sing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thou didst loose the curse of Eve, taking up Thine abode in the all-immaculate Virgin: Who showed her forth as a fountain of blessing unto them that cry aloud: Blessed art thou, O all-pure one, and blessed is the Fruit of thy womb!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 8. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The God-proclaiming Children in the furnace, trampling upon the flame with the fire, chanted: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of All Saints Ode 8 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Suffering, ye cast down the temples of idols, and fashioned yourselves as divine temples of the Trinity, O trophy-bearers of the Lord, companions of the Angels!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thy priests, O Christ, clothed in righteousness, rejoice now together with the Venerables, clearly beholding Thy divine beauty!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: By the prayers of Thy sacred Prophets, and of the all-blessed women, and of the righteous among men: grant Thy mercies, O Word, unto Thy world!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O righteous Judge, when Thou comest to judge: keep uncondemned those whom Thou hast received from us, overlooking their sins committed upon the earth, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Appearing unto me, O Virgin, quicken the dark clouds of my soul with thine enlightenment, O thou who didst bring forth the Sun of righteousness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: In the furnace the Children of Israel:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon for the Departed Ode 8 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Having passed through earthly passions, the true Martyrs received heavenly crowns, crying unceasingly: Sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Descending into the nether pit, with Thy life-originating palm Thou didst raise them that dwelt in the graves: and Thou grantest rest unto Thy servants who have fallen asleep before us in faith, O compassionate One!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: As the fountain of everlasting life, as the torrent of delight: account Thy servants who have piously departed unto Thee worthy to sing and glorify Thee unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: O Mary, Virgin Theotokos, who in the flesh didst bear God the Savior unto men: save them that sing praise in faith unto thy Childbearing, and that supremely exalt the pure one unto all ages!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Ode 9. Heirmos:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Thee, the Mother of the Most High God, who knewest not wedlock, who beyond understanding didst bear the Word Who is truly God, and art higher than the all-pure Hosts, with unceasing glorifications we magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon of All Saints Ode 9 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Standing as pillars before the most unrighteous tribunal, the Martyrs condemned every unrighteousness by the grace of Christ, and snatching men from the hold of the enemy, they received the crowns of righteousness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Setting up teachers as rudders, piously steering this ship into the haven of God's commandments: all the sacred hierarchs and divine pastors: therefore as helmsmen we honor you!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: The assembly of Prophets, the choir of Venerables, and the company of women who suffered brightly and shone in asceticism entreat Thee, O Lord: O Lover of mankind, we pray Thee: grant us Thy bounties!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: That they may be accounted worthy of this honor and eternal glory, all the holy ones of Christ: account them that have departed from this life in faith worthy to receive the bright light, O merciful One, by the prayers of Thy saints!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Bearing the fullness of good things in thine arms, O all-immaculate one: fulfill the supplications of us thy servants, and direct our paths unto God, strengthening us to live in virtues!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Another Heirmos: Every ear was amazed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: (Canon for the Departed Ode 9 Troparia):

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Possessing unconquerable and invincible strength, O Martyrs of Christ: ye brought to naught the godless decree of the tormentors, and were accounted worthy of the heavenly Kingdom, being enlightened with the rays of the Trinity, O admirable ones!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Bitter hades was destroyed when Thou didst destroy it, O Lover of mankind: raising them that slept therein from the ages: and now also, as God, account them that have passed from this life worthy of Thine unwaning light!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: All of Thee, O my Savior, art sweetness; all of Thee art desire and love truly insatiable; all of Thee art ineffable beauty: be pleased that they who have been translated unto Thee may take delight in Thy beauty, and make them partakers of Thy divine loveliness!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*

CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Спаси мя Мт҃и Бж҃їа, рожшїа Сп҃са моего, Бл҃же и чл҃ка: сꙋгубо естество, а не составо: единародна оубо, ѡ Ѻц҃а: нетлѣже, первенца всеѧ твари: егоже въ двои естествѣхъ величаемъ.
items.english_text: Save me, O Mother of God, who didst bear my Savior, God and man: two natures, but not two persons: only-begotten of the Father, incorruptible, firstborn of all creation, Whom in two natures we magnify!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Что васъ наречемъ ст҃ын; Херувимъ ли; ꙗкѡ на васъ почиетъ Хс҃. Серафимъ ли; ꙗкѡ непрестанно прославляете его. Агг҃лы ли; тѣла бо ѿвратистеся. Силы ли; дѣиствуете бо чудеса. многа ваша имена, болшая же дарованїа. Мл҃теся спастися дшамъ нашй.
items.english_text: At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs. Tone 8:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Велми подвигостеся ст҃ин: мук(и) ѡ беззаконникъ претерпѣвше доблественнѣ: Ха исповѣдающе пред Ца́рми. и паки преставльшеся ѡ житїа: Силы дѣиствуете въмирѣ, и недужныѧ исцѣлѧете, страстьми своими ст҃ин. молитеся спастися дшамъ нашимъ.
items.english_text: What shall we call you, O holy ones? Cherubim? For Christ rests upon you! Seraphim? For unceasingly ye glorify Him! Angels? For ye turned away from the body! Powers? For ye work miracles! Many are your names, and yet greater are your gifts! Pray ye that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Мч҃нци Хв҃ы непобѣдимыи, побѣждше лесть силою Крⷭ҇тною: воспрїясте бл҃годать вѣчныѧ жизни: мучительскихъ прещенїи неꙋбоястеся: мꙋками оуранѧеми, веселитеся. А ннѣ крови ваша, быша исцѣленїа дꙋшамъ нашым: Хв҃а молѣтеся, спастися дшам нашим.
items.english_text: Greatly did ye contend, O holy ones, manfully enduring torments from the lawless, confessing Christ before kings! And having departed from this life, ye work powers in the world, and heal the sick through your sufferings, O holy ones: pray that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Вѣрою и вѣры ѡболокошеся добрѣ, и ѡрꙋжїемъ Крⷭ҇тнымъ взарꙋживше себе: воини крѣпцїи явистеся, мучителем мужески противястеся, и дїаволю прелесть низложисте, побѣдителїе бывше, вѣнцемъ сподоби-
items.english_text: Invincible Martyrs of Christ, having overcome deceit by the power of the Cross, ye received the grace of eternal life: ye feared not the threats of the tormentors, and when wounded by torments, ye made merry! And now your blood hath become healings for our souls: entreat Christ that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: стеся: молитеся прино ѡнасъ, спастися дшамъ нашым. По:
items.english_text: Clothed well in faith and by faith, and armed with the weapon of the Cross: ye appeared as valiant soldiers, manfully opposing the tormentors, and casting down the deceit of the devil; having become victors, ye were accounted worthy of crowns: pray unceasingly on our behalf, that our souls may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Смотри твоя Гдⷭ҇и, безсмертїе Хрⷭ҇та ти. Аще бо небы вогробѣ положенъ бывъ, небы раи ѡверзлъ ся. Тѣмже преставльшися оупокой Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: Of the Departed:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Чистая Дв҃о, слову двери: Бг҃а нашего Мт҃и: моли спастися намъ.
items.english_text: Behold Thy mortality, O Christ! For hadst Thou not been laid in a grave, Paradise would not have been opened: therefore, give rest unto them that have been translated, O Lord!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Арьки мнѣ попнгалъ еси свобожденїе, шаромъ червленнымъ персты свои ѡкрвавнвъ Влко: и ѡбагривъ своею кровїю: и ннѣ тя вѣрою молимъ: съ первородными ти сопричти, и праведными твоимъ, радости сподоби получити, прешедшїи ктебѣ милосердомꙋ.
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхъ: Блажени ихже избра(лъ) и прїятъ ихъ Гдⷭ҇ь.
items.english_text: O pure Virgin, door of the Word, Mother of our God: pray that we may be saved!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Сꙋщїиствовавъ ꙗкѡ чл҃къ, заклавъ себе, приношенїе принеслъ еси Ѻц҃у: чл҃ка из тли возводя: преставльшихся оубо, ꙗкѡ чл҃колюбецъ въ странѣ живыхъ оучини. идеже потоц(и) пищиныя происхо́да: и ндеже источницы приснотекꙋщїн, неѡтстекаютъ.
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Departed. Tone 8.*

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Стїхъ: Душа их во бл҃гихъ водворятса.
items.english_text: By a signature Thou didst write my liberation, O Master, staining Thy fingers with scarlet dye and reddening them with Thine own blood: and now we entreat Thee in faith: Number with Thy firstborn and with Thy righteous ones, and account them that have departed unto Thee, O merciful One, worthy to obtain joy!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Глꙋбинами премꙋдрости неизреченныѧ твоеѧ: предѣлъ положивши животꙋ: и провидивъ смерть: и къ житїю иному преселивши рабы своя, ихже прїя бл҃го: ннѣ оучини на водахъ покойныхъ
items.english_text: Existing as man, Thou didst offer Thyself as a sacrifice unto the Father, raising man up from corruption: therefore settle them that have been translated in the land of the living, as Thou art the Lover of mankind, where the torrents of delight flow, and where the ever-flowing streams never run dry!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃їа и Бг҃а: Матерним дерзновенїемъ своимъ прилежно моли: оучинити рабы твоя: идеже ликъ неразходящїйся, веселящихся и восхваляющихъ тѧ.
items.english_text: In the depths of Thine ineffable wisdom, Thou didst set a bound unto life, and didst foresee death: and translating Thy servants unto another life, whom Thou hast received in Thy goodness: settle them now upon the waters of rest...

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Бѣмъ болѣзнемъ крѣпко приѡбщающеся: язвами вашими
items.english_text: ...in the splendors of the saints, where the voice of rejoicing and thanksgiving is heard!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: ст҃ин страстотерпци, оумѣкчисте всѧ тма бѣсовъскїа, Бж҃твенною
items.english_text: Glory... Both now... Theotokion:

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS
*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: Прпⷣбныи Хв҃ы, и Бж҃твенныи ст҃ителїе: соборъ Пррⷪ҇ческїн, и всѣхъ
items.english_text: Having conceived the beginningless Word of God and God: with thy motherly boldness earnestly pray that He may settle thy servants where the never-dispersing assembly of them that rejoice and praise thee is found, where the splendors are assembled together, and the sweet voice of them that feast is heard, O divinely blessed one!

items.section:
CANON TO SAINT NICHOLAS

items.english_text: Remember us, O Christ, Savior of the world, even as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Tree: and account all worthy, O Thou Who alone art compassionate, of Thy heavenly Kingdom!

items.section:

items.english_text: Firmly partaking in all illnesses: by your wounds, O holy passion-bearers, ye softened all the demonic darkness, through divine grace!

items.section:

*Ode 4. The Heirmos:*
items.slavonic_text: согрѣшенїй намъ ѡставленїе просящи, и
items.english_text: Venerables of Christ, and divine hierarchs, the assembly of the Prophets, and of all the righteous, have obtained the heavenly inheritance: whom let us worthily bless!

items.slavonic_text: согрѣшенїй намъ ѡставленїе просящи, и
items.english_text: Settle, O God, in the lands of the righteous all them that have been translated in faith from this life: and show them to be heirs of Paradise, who God-fittingly hymn Thee!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: согрѣшенїй намъ ѡставленїе просящи, и
items.english_text: I offer unto Thee, O Trinity, the final hymnody: account them whom Thou hast translated in faith from the earth worthy of the mansions of the saints, and have mercy upon me, a prodigal!

items.section:

items.slavonic_text: согрѣшенїй намъ ѡставленїе просящи, и
items.english_text: Both now... Theotokion:

items.english_text: Having born the Fullness of all good things, fulfill our supplications, O Virgin: asking for us the forgiveness of transgressions, enlightenment, and great mercy!

items.english_text: Let us go up with the disciples into the mountain of Galilee, by faith to behold Christ saying: Authority over the highest and lowest hath been received; let us learn how He teaches to baptize in the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and to abide with the initiates of the mysteries, even as He promised, unto the end of the age. (Twice)

items.english_text: Rejoice with the disciples, O Virgin Theotokos, for thou didst behold Christ risen from the tomb on the third day, even as He said; unto whom He appeared, teaching and saying as He revealed Himself: Baptize in the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit; commanding us to believe in His Resurrection, and to glorify thee, O Maiden!

items.english_text: When the disciples went up into the mountain for the earthly ascension, the Lord stood before them, and they worshipped Him; and having been taught of the authority given everywhere unto Him, they are sent forth into all under heaven to preach the Resurrection from the dead, and the translation into the heavens; which Christ God, the truthful One and the Savior of our souls, promised.

items.english_text: Beholding the stone rolled away, the Myrrh-bearing women rejoiced; for they saw a young man sitting in the tomb, and he said unto them: Behold, Christ is risen! Say unto the disciples with Peter: Make haste unto the mountain of Galilee; there shall He appear unto you, even as He foretold unto His friends!

items.slavonic_text: слово, чюдеси оукрѣпляюще. тѣмже просвѣтивше-
items.english_text: An angel indeed brought unto the Virgin the 'Rejoice!' before Thy conception, O Christ; and an angel also rolled away the stone from Thy tomb; in the place of sorrow, the one indeed brought signs of ineffable joy[^341] while the other, in place of death, proclaimed and magnified Thee, the Giver of life, and declared the Resurrection unto the initiates of the mysteries.

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: ся и ради славимъ твое иже йзмертвыхъ во-

items.slavonic_text: Свѣтиленъ Гласъ д҃ Г[оспо]д[ь] наш[ъ]
items.english_text: When the women with Mary came with myrrh and were wondering how it would be possible for them to attain their desire, the stone appeared taken away, and a divine youth, calming the turmoil of their souls, said: For Jesus the Lord is risen! Therefore preach unto the preachers, His disciples, to hasten unto Galilee, and to behold Him risen from the dead, as the Giver of life and the Lord!

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Добродѣтелми просвѣтившеся вида предстоѧща
items.english_text: Tone 3. Exaposteilarion 3:

items.slavonic_text: въживоноснѣмь Гробѣ, мужей во блищающих-
items.english_text: That Christ is risen, let no one disbelieve! For He appeared unto Mary, and was then seen by two who were walking into the countryside; and He appeared again unto the eleven disciples as they reclined at table; and having sent them forth to baptize, He ascended into the heavens whence He had descended, confirming the preaching with multitudes of signs!

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: ся ризахъ мѵроносицамъ преклоньшимъ лица своѧ
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: на землю, Нб̃сы wблад[а]ющаго Воскресенїю да на-
items.english_text: Thou hast shone forth, O Sun, from the tomb today as a Bridegroom from his bridal chamber, and hast despoiled hades; by the maternal prayers of her who bore Thee, send down Light upon us: the Light that illuminates hearts and souls, a light for all souls to walk, setting their steps upon the paths of Thy commandments and into the way of peace!

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: учимся: и к въ животу къ гробу съ петромъ прите-
items.english_text: Evangelical Stichera 3. Tone 3:[^342]

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: цѣмъ й содѣяннымъ оудивляшеся, пребудемъ хваляще [Хр̃та].
items.english_text: When Mary Magdalene announced the glad tidings of the Savior's Resurrection from the dead and His appearance, the disciples, being disbelieving, were reproached for the hardness of their hearts; but armed with signs and miracles, they were sent forth unto preaching; and Thou indeed, O Lord, didst ascend unto the Father, the primal Light; while they preached the Word everywhere, confirming it with miracles. Therefore, having been enlightened, we also glorify Thy Resurrection from the dead, O Lover of mankind!

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: Из чрева твоего Гд̃ь воплощься, погибшагw мира

items.english_text: Enlightened by the virtues, having seen the men standing in shining garments at the life-bearing Tomb, while the Myrrh-bearing women bowed their faces to the earth: let us learn of the Resurrection of the Ruler of heaven, and with Peter let us run unto life, unto the tomb; and marvelling at what hath been done, let us remain praising Christ!

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: ся въ тя, Бц̃е спасенїеже вси wбрѣтше, вопїем[ти]
items.english_text: Theotokion:

items.slavonic_text: яко аг̃глъ: Радуйся едина Ч[ис]тая, во жена[х] преб[лагосло]-
items.english_text: From thy womb, O Virgin, the Lord having become incarnate, willed to recall the perishing world from corruption, even as the Almighty One knows; and finding salvation in thee, O Theotokos, we all cry aloud unto thee as the angel: Rejoice, thou who alone art pure and most blessed among women, who didst bear salvation unto all the universe!

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: в[ло]венная, сп̃сенїеш родила еси всей вселеннѣи.
items.english_text: Evangelical Stichera 4. Tone 4:

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: де того ср̃дца, ко познанїю Твоему распаластася еже
items.english_text: Very early in the morning the women came unto Thy Tomb, O Christ, but the Body loved by them was not found; therefore, while they were perplexed, those standing by in shining garments said: Why seek ye the Living among the dead?[^343] He is risen, even as He said before! Why do ye not remember His words? Believing whom, they preached what they had seen; but their glad tidings seemed to be idle tales: so dull of understanding were the disciples yet. But Peter ran, and saw, and glorified Thy all-powerful wonders!

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: и оученико собрано, оуже ясно проповѣдаста...

items.english_text: Christ, the Life and the Way, having risen from the dead, journeyed with Cleopas and Luke, by whom He was also made known at Emmaus in the breaking of bread; whose souls and hearts were burning within them when He spoke unto them on the way, and expounded the Scriptures concerning what He had suffered: with them let us cry aloud: He is risen! Even as He appeared also unto Peter!

items.section: EXAPOSTILARIA AND EVANGELICAL STICHERA
items.slavonic_text: средѣ ставъ оучаше: Воскресе из wтрока, пи-

items.slavonic_text: щи вкусивъ, и Крещенїе покаянїа завѣща:
items.english_text: The Creator of creation and God of all things, having taken earthly flesh from thy pure blood, O all-holy Theotokos: made whole nature which was corrupted new again, leaving thee after childbearing even as thou wast before birth; therefore in faith we all praise thee, crying aloud: Rejoice, O glory of the world!

items.english_text: O how wise are Thy judgments, O Christ! How unto Peter indeed by the grave-clothes alone Thou gavest understanding of Thy Resurrection; and walking with Luke and Cleopas, Thou didst converse with them, and didst not reveal Thyself unto them quickly; therefore Thou wast reproached as being the only stranger in Jerusalem who knew not the counsel thereof unto the end; yet ordering all things unto the profit of creation, Thou didst unveil the prophetic words concerning Thyself; and in the blessing of the bread Thou wast made known unto them, whose hearts before that were kindled unto the knowledge of Thee; who also, when the disciples were gathered together, already clearly preached[^344] Thy Resurrection, through which have mercy on us!

items.english_text: Inventory No. CD-97 [Monumental seventeenth-century blind-tooled calfskin binding over bevelled wooden boards. The decorative program consists of an outer rectangular border impressed with a Renaissance floral and vine roll, enclosed within triple fillet blind lines; an intermediate frieze of palmette scrolls; and an inner rectangular panel divided into two quadripartite compartments by diagonal blind fillets forming cross-hatched triangular fields. Along the fore-edge are affixed three chased brass clasp catches mounted upon layered calfskin thongs with brass rivets, matching the front board fittings and preserving the volume under tension. Marking the physical completion of Monument 9: 1630 Lviv Octoechos.][^351]
